title: Mace Limiterrr
description: Adds a mace limit command to the game to limit the craftable amount of maces
body:
# Mace Limiter

Mace Limiter is a simple Fabric server-side mod that limits how many maces can exist in a world.

## Features

- Limits newly crafted maces
- Tracks maces using unique IDs
- Blocks extra mace crafting once the server limit is reached
- Includes an admin command to change the limit in-game

## Commands

`/macelimit`  
Shows the current mace limit and active tracked maces.

`/macelimit <number>`  
Changes the mace limit.

Example:  
`/macelimit 3`

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

## Notes

This mod is intended for servers. Operators/admins can change the mace limit using the command.

title: Kabus - Psychological Horror
description: A psychological horror mod that shatters your sanity and stalks you from the shadows. Face custom DFS labyrinths, armor-piercing entities, and dark rituals in Minecraft 1.20.1
body:
This mod is currently in its early beta stage. Features are functional, but you may encounter bugs. Please report any issues in the comments!

#  About Kabus: The Nightmare Mod
"Kabus" is an immersive psychological horror mod built around a dynamic **Sanity System** for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge). Darkness is no longer just a lack of light—it is a threat to your mind. As your sanity drains, the world around you will begin to fracture, forcing you to question what is real and what is a hallucination.

## Core Features:
* **Dynamic Sanity HUD:** Track your mental state with a custom hotbar overlay that shakes and turns red as paranoia sets in.
* **Environmental Sanity:** Staying in pitch-black areas, sprinting, being low on health, or caught in the rain will drain your sanity. Holding a Flashlight or staying near campfires/pets will help restore it.
* **The "Kabus" Entity:** A terrifying, tall, shadow-like stalker with glowing white eyes. It destroys blocks in its path to reach you, but it plays by psychological rules—approaching faster when your back is turned and vanishing when stared at.

## Advanced Horror & Uncertainty Systems:
1. **Shadow Figures:** Spot distant humanoid silhouettes wearing random skins—or even your own. They vanish when approached or directly observed (<30% Sanity).
2. **Inventory Hallucinations:** Distorted item counts, swapped textures, or valuable ores looking like stone (visual only, actual items are safe).
3. **Mimic Sound System:** Hear fake Creeper hisses, footsteps, breaking blocks, or opening doors right behind you.
4. **Nightmare Sleep Event:** Trying to sleep with critically low sanity might trigger sudden wake-ups, glowing eyes, and terrifying sounds.
5. **Uncertainty System:** Reaching 0% sanity won't always spawn the monster. Sometimes it’s just blindness, sometimes it's pure silence. You will never know if you are truly safe.
6. **Name Whispering:** Dynamic spatial audio that literally whispers YOUR Minecraft username in the dark, paired with faint gray [Whisper] chat messages.
7. **Reality Distortion:** Experience rare, client-side visual anomalies like blood moons, inverted trees, or screen-inverting shader effects (`invert.json`).
8. **Disturbing Notes:** Stumble upon extremely rare notes left in the world reading: *"don't look behind you"*, *"it knows"*, or *"stop running"*.
9. **Adaptive AI & Psychological Tracking:** Kabus tracks your movements and how many times you look behind, changing its hunting patterns based on your behavior.

## 🛠️ Crafting Recipes
It is highly recommended to use **JEI (Just Enough Items)** to see all crafting recipes in-game for items like the Flashlight and Calming Syrup.



Kabus Mod v2.0.0 — Major Update
 Dungeon Combat Arena
Rooms now spawn monster waves when you enter them
Iron doors between rooms stay locked until the wave is cleared

 Boss Summon System
Type anything with "come" in chat to summon the Nightmare Boss
A red countdown shows on screen: THE NIGHTMARE is coming in 5...
60-second cooldown between summons
 Flashlight & Battery
New Battery item found in camp and tower chests
Press R to recharge your flashlight
Flashlight flickers when below 25% charge
 Hallucinations
Low sanity causes fake ores (diamond/gold) to appear in the world
Ghost chests spawn nearby — they vanish when you get close
 Simon Says Event
1.5 seconds to react — fail and you get punished
Moving your camera also counts as moving during DON'T MOVE
Collection Challenge
Random event: a chest spawns nearby with a sign saying "Put Items Here"
You have a time limit to gather and deposit the required items

 Kabus Realm
A dark dimension made of floating obsidian islands in the void
Activate 3 Ancient Altars scattered across the realm to break the shield around the Heart of Nightmare
Destroy the Heart to purify the world and end the nightmare forever
Low gravity, random levitation, and shadow hands punish you for standing still
 Misc
New hidden clues added to the starter book

title: JMC (Java Music Control)
description: A mod that allows the experienced Modpack developer to create advanced dynamic triggers for Minecraft. Check Description!
body:
Java Music Control (JMC) is a dynamic music creation tool that makes it easy to create advanced, dynamic music! You will need to create your own mod to use this one. However, if you are new to modding, this is a great place to start.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/0qFleVcOVFw" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Download the example! https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jmc-example

Current features: 

**Easy Access Context:** The ClientContext class contains many different playable events, for example, rain, low health, mob count, and a ton more. This will get a lot of additional content over time.

**Multilayered audio:** different instruments can be played during different situations in real time!

**Underwater muffling:** Audio is muffled in real time. The amount can be adjusted per trigger.

**Fading:** Both fade-in and fade-out are available; this is done on a per-song basis rather than on a trigger basis.

**Start and End delay:** You can set the amount of time before a trigger can play or be replaced.

**Force interrupt:** This can allow a trigger to start and replace another trigger immediately; it skips fade-outs.

 
More features are in the mod currently; you can find more details on GitHub



**Update Plans:**

I have plans to update this mod to 1.21.x and backport it to 1.19.2, 1.18.x, and 1.16.5. Given that most of this mod doesn't depend on many Minecraft features, this will happen fairly quickly. As for feature updates, they will come as requested; if something isn't in the mod, drop a request on the GitHub page.

**Creating a Mod Using JMC:**

JMC has a simple trigger creation system. You create your class (Your trigger), create a new song(s), and add it to your mod constructor. You could have some basic triggers set up in 10-30 minutes. Currently, I'm working on an example mod and documentation with pictures. Soon after, I will also have a video. The documentation will explain the basics of Java, creating triggers, attaching songs, and the use of Context (essentially just true or false statements, but made easier and more reliable). Check out the GitHub page.



**You are free to use this mod in your modpacks as long as it stays within the CurseForge and Modrinth ecosystems.**

title: MysticHorror
description: MysticHorror is a plugin aimed at trolling.
body:
🔮 MysticHorror | Horror effects for your server

**Supported: Paper 1.17.х  
Category: Fun / Immersive**

---

👻 About

**MysticHorror** adds random scary events to your Minecraft server — sounds, visual effects, camera shake. Your players will jump at unexpected screamers, whispers, demon laughs, and other eerie phenomena.

No resource packs required — everything works with vanilla Minecraft sounds.

---

 ✨ Features

🎭 Local Events (single player)
Events happen **individually** for each player. Chance, interval, and cooldown are fully configurable.

| Event | Effect |
|-------|--------|
| WHISPER | Mysterious whisper |
| SCREAMER | Loud scream + camera shake |
| DEMON | Demon laugh + blindness (2 sec) |
| DOOR_CREAK | Creaking door sound |
| HEARTBEAT | Fast heartbeat (5 beats) |
| STATIC | Radio static + slowness (2 sec) |
| CHILD_LAUGH | Child's laugh |
| JUMPSCARE | Sudden scream + nausea (3 sec) + camera shake |

 
🌍 Global Events (all players)
Events affect **everyone online** at the same time.

| Event | Effect |
|-------|--------|
| **THUNDER_CRASH** | Thunder strike (loud sound) |
| **EARTHQUAKE** | Rumbling ground sound |
| **BANSHEE_SCREAM** | Banshee scream |
| **SHADOW_PASS** | Passing shadow sound |

 📋 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/mh reload` | Reload configuration | `mystichorror.admin` |
| `/mh list` | List all events | `mystichorror.admin` |
| `/mh trigger local <player> <event>` | Trigger local event | `mystichorror.admin` |
| `/mh trigger global <event>` | Trigger global event | `mystichorror.admin` |

**Examples:**
_bash
/mh trigger local Notch jumpscare
/mh trigger global thunder_crash_


🔧 Configuration (config.yml)

```
yaml
# Local events (single player)
local-events:
  enabled: true
  interval: 10
  chance-min: 5
  chance-max: 15
  cooldown-min: 60
  cooldown-max: 180

# Global events (all players)
global-events:
  enabled: true
  interval: 30
  chance-min: 2
  chance-max: 8
  cooldown-min: 180
  cooldown-max: 300
```

🚀 Installation
Download MysticHorror

Place it into your server's plugins folder (Paper server required)

Restart the server

Adjust config.yml to your preferences

Grant 
```
mystichorror.admin
```
 permission to trusted players or leave it for OPs only

🎯 Permissions
Permission	Description
mystichorror.admin	Access to all commands (default: operators)
💡 Tips
For Halloween events — temporarily increase chance to 50–70% for maximum scares

For regular gameplay — keep 5–15% (won't get annoying)

title: SMP Core
description: all-in-one utility plugin for SMP servers
body:
🔥 Essential SMP Core Plugin

A powerful all-in-one plugin designed for SMP servers, combining combat logging prevention, command control, teleportation, and chat management into a single lightweight solution.

---

✨ Features

⚔️ Combat System

* Enter combat for 30 minutes when attacking or being attacked
* Triggers include:

  * Melee attacks
  * Player projectiles (arrows, tridents, potions, etc.)
  * Player-ignited TNT
  * End crystals and TNT minecarts (proper damage source tracking)
* Non-combat damage (fall, fire, drowning, etc.) does NOT trigger combat
* Both players exit combat on death
* Logging out during combat results in instant death
* `/pvpcancel` — request to cancel combat (requires both players to accept)
* `/pvpdeny` — deny combat cancel request

🛑 Command Control

* No restrictions outside combat
* During combat:

  * All commands require a 15-second warmup
  * Warmup is canceled if valid combat damage is taken
* Implemented globally for all commands

📡 Teleport Requests (TPA)

* `/tpa <player>` — send teleport request (expires in 60 seconds)
* `/tpaccept` — accept and teleport instantly
* `/tpdeny` — deny request

🏠 Home System

* `/sethome <name>` — set a home (max 3)
* `/home <name>` — teleport or view home list
* `/delhome <name>` — delete a home
* Works with combat warmup
* Data is saved per-player (UUID) and persists after restart

↩️ Utility Commands

* `/back` — return to last death location within 1 minute
* `/logout` — safe logout (15s warmup in combat, instant otherwise)

💬 Chat Control

* Chat disabled during combat
* 2-second chat cooldown (first message after join is exempt)
* Prevents duplicate messages
* Blocks configurable messages from `config.yml` (case-insensitive)

---

💡 Why this plugin?

* All-in-one SMP solution (no need for multiple plugins)
* Designed specifically for survival multiplayer servers
* Lightweight and optimized
* Fair combat system (no abuse, no unfair escapes)
* Simple but powerful configuration

---

📦 Installation

1. Download the plugin
2. Place it in your `/plugins` folder
3. Restart your server

---

🎯 Recommended For

* SMP / Survival servers
* Small to medium communities
* Server owners who want a clean, balanced gameplay experience

title: Obliterator
description: Obliterator is a powerful world-editing Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that lets you mass-destroy blocks, kill entities, and remove liquids with a simple confirm-to-execute workflow — no block-by-block tedium.
body:
**Mass Block Breaker** — a Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that lets you perform massive world-editing operations with a simple two-step confirmation system.

**How it works:** Break a block, kill an entity, or scoop a liquid once to see a count of all matching targets nearby. Perform the same action again within a few seconds to confirm and execute the operation. Every action can be fully undone.

---

**Three core systems:**

**`/massbreak` — Block Operations**
- Destroys every block of the same type within a configurable radius (up to 500)
- **Chain Mode** — Only destroys connected blocks (flood-fill vein mining)
- **Replace Mode** — Replaces broken blocks with another block instead of removing them
- **Flatten Mode** — Removes all blocks above a target Y-level and fills holes below with your chosen fill block
- **Timelapse Mode** — Dissolves blocks layer-by-layer outward from or inward toward the player, great for video recording
- **Wave Mode** — Breaks blocks in expanding rings with a configurable tick delay between rings
- **Preview Mode** — Highlights all affected blocks with glowing particles before you commit
- Configurable drops, processing speed, and max block limits

**`/masskill` — Entity Operations**
- Kills all entities of the same type within a configurable radius
- **Safety Filters** — Individually toggle protection for named entities, tamed pets, baby mobs, villagers, and other players
- Toggle loot drops and XP separately
- Full undo respawns exact copies with NBT data preserved

**`/massliquid` — Liquid Operations**
- Drains all water or lava within a configurable radius
- Triggered by using an empty bucket on a liquid source
- **Source-Only Mode** — Removes only source blocks; flowing liquid drains naturally
- **All-Liquid Mode** — Removes sources and flowing blocks together
- Also detects bucket fills (picking up liquid triggers the removal prompt)

**Safety & controls:**
- Built-in blacklists for blocks (bedrock, spawners, portal blocks, command blocks, jigsaw, etc.) and entities (ender dragon, wither, warden, iron golems)
- Configurable max operation size and blocks/entities processed per tick to prevent lag
- Confirmation timeout prevents accidental triggers
- Operator permission level 2 required by default (configurable)
- Undo history stores up to 10 operations per player per category

title: Sound Tweaks
description: Per-sound and per-block volume control. Silence, or fine-tune any Minecraft sound individually. Create presets and bind shortcuts.
body:
# SoundTweaks
A client-side Fabric mod for adjusting the volume of individual sounds and blocks, independent of each other and the game's master volume.

---

## What it does

### Per-sound volume control
Every sound event gets its own volume slider, from **0% (silent) to 100% (default)**. Changing one sound doesn't affect anything else.

### Per-block volume control
Some blocks make sounds that Minecraft's built-in categories can't separate — pistons, dispensers, note blocks, observers, and others. SoundTweaks adds its own volume layer for those. Block volumes run from **0% to 100%**.

### Category and object filtering
The main screen has two dropdown filters: **Category** (Block, Entity, Item, Ambient, Music, Music Disc, UI, Weather, Enchant, Event, Redstone, Others) and **Object** (the specific entity, item, or block within that category). There's a text search bar too.

**Redstone** is a cross-cutting category — it groups sounds from redstone-adjacent blocks (pistons, comparators, levers, note blocks, dispensers, sculk sensors, etc.) regardless of their base sound prefix.

### Simple View / Detail View
Two ways to browse the list:
- **Simple View** — one entry per sound event
- **Detail View** — the individual `.ogg` files within each event, so you can target the exact sounds that play

### Mute button
The speaker icon in the top-left mutes everything currently visible (based on your active filters). Click again to restore. Nothing gets written to your saved config — it's a temporary layer.

---

## Presets
A preset stores a set of sound and block volume overrides. When active, its values take priority over the base config. If multiple presets are active and both define a value for the same sound, whichever deviates most from 100% wins.

**Creating a preset:** go to the Presets screen and click "New Preset". It starts as a copy of your current base config — only entries that aren't at 100% get carried over.

**Editing a preset:** select it from the list to open the detail panel. Available tabs:- **Open Config Folder** (Presets screen footer): opens the `.minecraft/config/` folder in the system file manager.

---

## Config files

All config is stored in `.minecraft/config/` as plain JSON:

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `soundtweaks.json` | Base sound volumes (key: sound event ID, value: float 0–1) |
| `soundtweaks_blocks.json` | Base block volumes (key: block ID, value: float 0–1) |
| `soundtweaks_presets.json` | All presets, active state, and favorites list |

Config is saved automatically ~300ms after the last change. You can also edit the JSON files directly while the game is closed.

---

## Volume resolution order

For any given sound, the effective volume is determined in this order:

1. **Volatile mute layer** — set by the mute button; cleared when toggled off or the game restarts
2. **Active presets** — if multiple presets define the same sound, the one with the biggest deviation from 100% wins
3. **Base config** — `soundtweaks.json` / `soundtweaks_blocks.json`
4. **Default** — 100% (no change)

---

## How to open the UI

Press **K** (default keybind, rebindable in Minecraft's controls settings) to open the SoundTweaks screen.

---

## Compatibility

- **Client-side only** — the server doesn't need the mod installed
- **Fabric** loader only
- Minecraft **26.1.2**
- Does not replace or wrap the sound engine — intercepts volume at playback time via mixin

title: Crop Sentinel
description: Notifies you when crops in a configurable radius are fully grown. Supports wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, nether wart, cocoa, and sweet berries.
body:
# Crop Sentinel

**Never miss a harvest again.** Crop Sentinel silently scans crops in a configurable radius around you and sends an action bar notification the moment they're fully grown — including crops from mods.

---

## Features

### Vanilla Crop Detection
Scans a cylinder of configurable radius (default 32 blocks, up to 64) every 4 seconds. Detects all vanilla crops:
- Wheat, Carrots, Potatoes, Beetroot
- Nether Wart
- Cocoa Pods
- Sweet Berries

### Modded Crop Detection *(new in 1.1)*
Automatically detects non-vanilla crops from any mod — no configuration needed. Any block that uses a standard `age` property (the same convention used by most modded crops) is tracked and notified when fully grown.

Works with mods like **Farmer's Delight**, **Pam's HarvestCraft**, and many more out of the box. Can be disabled in the config screen if needed.

### Smart Notifications
Only notifies you once per crop — won't spam you if you stay near a farm. Clears the notification once a crop is harvested so you'll be notified again next time it's ready.

### Periodic Reminders
Optional reminder (default every 60 seconds) to let you know crops are still waiting. Set to 0 to disable.

### Notification Style
- **Action bar** (default) — unobtrusive overlay above the hotbar
- **Chat** — optional additional chat message

### In-Game Config Screen
All settings adjustable in-game. Open with a configurable keybind (unbound by default).

---

## Keybinds

| Action | Default |
|---|---|
| Toggle Crop Sentinel on/off | *(unbound)* |
| Open settings | *(unbound)* |

---

## Configuration

| Setting | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master on/off switch |
| `radius` | `32` | Scan radius in blocks (8–64) |
| `scanIntervalTicks` | `80` | Ticks between scans (~4 seconds) |
| `actionBarNotify` | `true` | Show notification in action bar |
| `chatNotify` | `false` | Also send a chat message |
| `reminderIntervalSeconds` | `60` | Seconds between reminders (0 = off) |
| `detectModdedCrops` | `true` | Detect crops from mods |

---

title: ClaimFly
description: Allows players to fly in their GriefPrevention claims.
body:
# ClaimFly Reloaded A lightweight Paper plugin that allows players to fly **inside GriefPrevention claims only**, while keeping flight disabled everywhere else. ClaimFly Reloaded is designed for survival servers that want convenient claim-based flight without giving players unrestricted creative-style flying. --- ## Where does flight work? | Location | Allowed | |----------|----------| | **Your own claim** | ✅ Yes | | **Trusted player claim + permission** | ✅ Yes | | **Trusted player claim without permission** | ❌ No | | **Unclaimed land** | ❌ No | | **Admin claims + permission** | ✅ Yes | Players leaving allowed claims automatically lose managed flight. ---
Commands
### Player | Command | Permission | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `/claimfly` | `claimfly.command` | Toggle claim flight | | `/cfly` | `claimfly.command` | Alias for `/claimfly` | | `/claimfly boundary` | `claimfly.commands.boundary.toggle` | Toggle claim boundary particles | | `/claimfly boundary ` | `claimfly.commands.boundary.set` | Set boundary particle distance | ### Admin | Command | Permission | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `/claimfly reload` | `claimfly.commands.admin` | Reload plugin config | | `/claimfly checkinterval ` | `claimfly.commands.admin` | Change flight check interval | | `/claimfly version` | `claimfly.commands.admin` | Show installed version |
Permissions
| Permission | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `claimfly.*` | OP | Grants all ClaimFly permissions | | `claimfly.use` | false | Allow claim-based flight | | `claimfly.command` | false | Use `/claimfly` | | `claimfly.commands.admin` | false | Admin commands | | `claimfly.commands.boundary.toggle` | false | Toggle boundary particles | | `claimfly.commands.boundary.set` | false | Change boundary distance | | `claimfly.claims.others` | false | Fly in trusted player claims | | `claimfly.claims.admin` | false | Fly in admin claims |
--- ## Features * Flight inside owned claims * Optional flight in trusted player claims * Optional admin claim flight * Automatic flight disable outside allowed claims * Claim boundary particle visualization * Configurable messages and cooldowns * YAML or SQLite storage * Optional bStats metrics * Lightweight survival-friendly design * Supports GriefPrevention trust systems --- ## Requirements | Requirement | Version | |-------------|---------| | **Server Software** | Paper 1.21.11+ | | **Java** | Java 21+ | | **Dependencies** | GriefPrevention + Vault | Both **GriefPrevention** and **Vault** are required. --- ## Installation 1. Install GriefPrevention. 2. Install Vault. 3. Place `ClaimFlyReloaded.jar` into `/plugins`. 4. Start or restart the server. 5. Edit generated files in `plugins/ClaimFly/`. 6. Configure permissions. 7. Done. ---
Plugin Files
ClaimFly Reloaded generates: | Path | Purpose | |------|---------| | `config.yml` | Main settings and storage | | `lang.yml` | Editable plugin messages | | `players.db` | SQLite player data (optional) | | `players/` | YAML player data when using local storage |
Configuration
Default config: ```yaml check-interval: 5 flight-toggle-cooldown: 10 storage: "sqlite" enable-metrics: true boundary: show-distance: 10 show-by-default: true ``` Messages: ```yaml message: flight-toggle-on: "&aFlight enabled." flight-toggle-off: "&cFlight disabled." cannot-fly-outside-claims: "&cYou cannot fly outside claims." ``` Storage options: ```yaml storage: sqlite ``` or ```yaml storage: yaml ```
Important Behavior
ClaimFly Reloaded intentionally removes managed flight when players leave an allowed claim. This prevents: * Keeping `allowFlight` outside claims * Flying through wilderness * Bypassing normal survival movement * Unintended protection from fall damage ClaimFly does **not** grant unrestricted flight. For flight inside another player's claim, both are required: ``` claimfly.claims.others ``` AND GriefPrevention access trust. Permission alone is not enough.
--- ## Important Notes * ClaimFly only manages flight inside allowed claims. * Unclaimed land never grants flight. * Access trust alone does not allow flight. * SQLite and YAML storage are supported. * Flight checks run on configurable intervals. * Boundary particles may be disabled by players. --- ## Support Found a bug or have a suggestion? Open an issue with: * Server version * ClaimFly version * Console errors * Relevant config settings --- ## Authors - HBOJ ## Sponsored By - AsteroidMC ## License - GPL-3.0

title: Cornball's Music Player
description: This mod adds a music GUI that allows you to play most of the music without a jukebox.
body:
## Cornball’s Music Player

Cornball’s Music Player is a client-side Fabric mod that gives you a simple, polished way to play vanilla and custom music from anywhere in-game. Instead of placing a jukebox or manually swapping discs, you can open the mod’s custom music player GUI at any time by pressing **`M`** and instantly browse the full supported library from one screen.

The interface is designed to feel clean and easy to use. The left side displays a scrollable library of vanilla and custom music with each songs icon, name, and song title, while the right side gives you dedicated playback controls and a live view of the current track. Clicking a song starts playing it immediately, and the mod makes sure only one track plays at a time so audio stays organized and never overlaps.

Cornball’s Music Player also includes quality-of-life features that make it much more convenient than a normal jukebox setup. You can pause, resume, stop, adjust volume, monitor playback progress with a built-in progress bar, and keep track of what is currently playing through a compact HUD overlay. The HUD can be moved anywhere on your screen through a placement mode with **Save** and **Cancel** options, or disabled entirely if you prefer a cleaner look.

Everything runs client-side, so the mod is lightweight and easy to use. There’s no extra block to place, no complicated setup, and no required config files to get started. Install the mod, launch the game with Fabric, and press **`M`** to open the music player.

### Features
- Open the music player GUI anywhere by pressing **`M`**
- Browse supported vanilla and custom music in a custom scrollable menu
- View song icons, song names, and song titles in the selector
- Instantly play tracks by clicking them
- Dedicated **Play**, **Pause**, and **Stop** controls
- Only one track plays at a time (at the moment)
- Built-in volume slider
- Playback progress bar and time display
- Small movable HUD overlay for current song and progress
- HUD placement mode with **Save** and **Cancel**
- Button to enable or disable the HUD
- Custom .ogg music support

### Requirements
- Fabric
- Fabric API

To access custom music you first need to put your .ogg into the "tracks" folder found in the "musicplayer" folder inside your Minecraft instance file. Then simply navigate into the local tab inside the mods in-game menu.

Feedback is appreciated and the mod will continue to update with even more music.

title: FootLib
description: This is the shared class and API for all of my mods
body:
# FootLib
FootLib is a lightweight API and utility library used by Foot‑series mods.
It provides shared systems such as:

Foot Economy API

Currency definitions

Exchange‑rate systems

Auto‑rate engine hooks

Service injection for mod interoperability

FootLib is intentionally minimal, stable, and designed to act as the backbone for the entire Foot ecosystem.

## Versioning
FootLib uses a **four‑segment versioning system:**

### Overhaul.Major.Semi‑major.Patch/Hotfix/Minor‑alpha/beta/release
Example:
0.0.1.0 → Semi‑major update (1 in the third position)

### Meaning of each segment
- **Overhaul**  
A complete rewrite of the codebase, API, and systems.
This is a new era of FootLib.
Backward compatibility is not preserved.

- **Major**
Large feature wave.
New systems, new mechanics, or major expansions.
Backward compatible unless stated otherwise.

- **Semi‑major**
Significant content or system additions.
Big‑minor updates that don’t break API.

- **Patch / Hotfix / Minor**
Small updates, bugfixes, micro‑features, or emergency fixes.

### Pre‑release tags
**‑alpha** → Experimental, unstable

**‑beta** → Feature‑complete, stabilizing

**(blank)** → Release build/stable

### Important Note
An Overhaul (1.x.x.x, 2.x.x.x, etc.) ends support for all previous Foot mods unless explicitly stated otherwise.

This is why FootLib does not use SemVer — SemVer cannot express the difference between a major update and a full architectural overhaul.
FootLib’s versioning makes the reason for incompatibility explicit.
**DON'T WORRY THIS MOD IS STILL GETTING UPDATES AND NEW FEATURES, I ALSO JUST HAPPEN TO HAVE MORE PROJECTS IN MIND SO GETTING THEM COMPLETED IS KEY**
Usage
Maven Repo
```gradle
repositories {
    maven { url = "https://api.modrinth.com/maven" }
}
```
Gradle (Groovy)
```gradle
dependencies {
    implementation("maven.modrinth:footlib:${footlib_version}")
}
```
neoforge.mods.toml
```toml
[[dependencies.yourmod]]
modId="footlib"
mandatory=true
versionRange="[min_version, maxversion)"
#Put an actual version in min_version and max_version
```

description: A Minecraft mod that introduces a crawfish trapping and cooking mechanic, complete with custom rewards and custom food items.
body:
# Crawfish Mod

This mod expands Minecraft's swamps and oceans by adding a fully automated trapping system and a unique cooking mechanic for Crawfish. It adds 5 different crawfish variants, a custom block, and new high-tier food options.

## How it works

### 1. Catching Crawfish
To start, you need to craft a **Crawfish Trap**. Place it underwater in any swamp, river, or ocean biome. The trap works automatically over time and will slowly collect raw crawfish. You have to put spam, chicken, kelp, bread or any other meat i8n the trap so it works. 

There are 5 different color variants you can catch:
* Blue Crawfish
* Yellow Crawfish
* Green Crawfish
* Purple Crawfish
* Orange Crawfish

### 2. Boiling Mechanics (Cauldron Cooking)
You cannot cook these crawfish in a standard furnace or smoker. Instead, you have to boil them using a water cauldron.
* Place a **Cauldron** down and fill it with **Water**.
* Place a **Lava block** directly underneath the cauldron to heat it up.
* Toss your raw crawfish into the boiling water. 
* The crawfish will cook instantly, showing bubble and smoke particles, and pop out as a finished item.

### 3. Food Values
Eating raw crawfish isn't very effective (restores only 1 hunger bar). However, once boiled, any of the 5 cooked crawfish variants becomes an excellent food source, restoring **5 full hunger bars (10 hunger points)** with high saturation.

title: NoteBox
description: About A powerful Minecraft Spigot/Paper music plugin that plays NBS (Note Block Studio) format songs
body:
# NoteBox

A powerful NBS music plugin for Spigot/Paper servers. Plays Note Block Studio format songs with a built-in audio engine -- no external dependencies required.

## Features

- **NBS Song Playback** - Play Note Block Studio format music files seamlessly
- **Radio Mode** - Listen privately (only you can hear)
- **Speaker Mode** - Broadcast music to nearby players
- **Music Signs** - Redstone-triggered music playback
- **Jukebox Integration** - Right-click jukeboxes to open the music GUI
- **GUI Browser** - Intuitive graphical interface for browsing songs
- **Playlists** - Create and manage personal playlists
- **Disc Shop** - Economy-powered music disc store (Vault support)
- **Song Search** - Search songs by keyword
- **Song Request** - Request songs with configurable cooldown
- **Volume Control** - Per-player volume adjustment (0-100)
- **Loop Modes** - None, Single, All, Shuffle
- **Particle Effects** - Visual effects synchronized with music
- **Region Music** - Auto-play music in WorldGuard regions
- **PlaceholderAPI** - Placeholder support for other plugins
- **Multi-language** - Chinese, English, Russian
- **Permission System** - Granular permission control
- **Self-contained** - Built-in NBS parser and sequencer, no NoteBlockAPI needed

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/notebox` | Open the music GUI | `notebox.use` |
| `/notebox play <song>` | Play a song | `notebox.use` |
| `/notebox silent [player]` | Toggle silent mode | `notebox.use` |
| `/notebox stop` | Stop current playback | `notebox.use` |
| `/notebox next` | Skip to next song | `notebox.use` |
| `/notebox volume <0-100>` | Set personal volume | `notebox.use` |
| `/notebox loop` | Cycle loop mode | `notebox.use` |
| `/notebox search <query>` | Search songs | `notebox.use` |
| `/notebox request <song>` | Request a song | `notebox.request` |
| `/notebox particles` | Toggle particle effects | `notebox.use` |
| `/notebox shop [player]` | Open disc shop | `notebox.shop` |
| `/notebox give <player> <song>` | Give a music disc | `notebox.get` |
| `/notebox reload` | Reload configuration | `notebox.admin` |
| `/notebox shutup` | Stop all music | `notebox.admin` |

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `notebox.use` | Use /notebox command | All players |
| `notebox.speaker` | Use speaker mode | All players |
| `notebox.shop` | Access disc shop | All players |
| `notebox.shop.other` | Open shop for others | Operators |
| `notebox.get` | Get any music disc | Operators |
| `notebox.request` | Use song request | All players |
| `notebox.sign` | Create music signs | All players |
| `notebox.hear` | Hear music (when check enabled) | All players |
| `notebox.admin` | Reload and manage music | Operators |

## Installation

1. Download `NoteBox-x.x.x.jar` from the [Releases](https://github.com/ALingqing/NoteBox/releases) page.
2. Place the JAR file in your server's `plugins/` directory.
3. Restart your server.
4. Place `.nbs` song files in `plugins/NoteBox/songs/`.
5. Run `/notebox reload` to load all songs.
6. Use `/notebox` to start listening.

## Requirements

| Dependency | Type | Required |
|------------|------|----------|
| Spigot/Paper 1.13+ | API | Yes |
| Vault | Plugin | No (economy) |
| PlaceholderAPI | Plugin | No (placeholders) |
| WorldGuard | Plugin | No (region music) |

## Configuration

```yaml
# Language (zh, en, ru)
lang: zh
# Speaker mode range (blocks)
speakerRadius: 10
# Jukebox range (blocks)
jukeboxRadius: 64
# Economy settings
economy:
  enable: true
  price: 500
# BossBar display
bossbar:
  enable: true
  color: GREEN
  style: SEGMENTED_20
# Auto-destroy idle players (seconds, 0 = disable)
autoDestroy: 60
# Default player volume (0-100)
defaultVolume: 100
# Song request cooldown (seconds)
request:
  enable: true
  cooldown: 30
# Particle effects
particles:
  enable: true
  style: note
```

Full configuration guide: [Configuration Reference](https://github.com/ALingqing/NoteBox/blob/main/docs/CONFIGURATION.md)

## Technical Notes

NoteBox includes a complete NBS file parser and sequencing engine integrated directly into the plugin. No additional NoteBlockAPI installation is needed. The plugin also provides a public API for addon developers.

---

title: Multi-LangTTS-MC
description: Adds real-time multilingual Text-to-Speech (TTS) to Minecraft chat using Google Translate and ElevenLabs, with async processing and zero performance impact.
body:
# Multi LangTTS MC

> **Multi-language Text-to-Speech Mod for Minecraft**

---

## 📋 Overview

**Multi LangTTS MC** is a client-side modification that delivers real-time, multi-language Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis for in-game chat. Designed for accessibility, immersion, and multilingual server environments, the mod intercepts chat messages, processes them asynchronously, and converts them into high-quality speech using configurable external providers—all without impacting game performance.

---


## ✨ Core Features

### 🔊 Text-to-Speech Engine
- **Dual Provider Support**:
  - **Google Translate TTS** (Free, 100+ languages)
  - **ElevenLabs API** (Premium, expressive voices, 29+ languages)
- **Non-Blocking Architecture**: All synthesis, network requests, and audio decoding run on dedicated background threads.
- **Audio Caching**: Reduces redundant API calls and latency for repeated phrases.
- **MP3 Validation**: Strict byte-signature detection filters malformed or error responses.
- **Rate Limiting**: Configurable minimum interval between synthesis requests prevents queue saturation.

### 💬 Chat Processing
- **Real-Time Synthesis**: Automatically converts player messages, server broadcasts, and system notifications into spoken audio.
- **Smart Spam Filtering**: Configurable cooldown thresholds prevent repetitive messages from triggering excessive playback.
- **Text Sanitization**: Strips Minecraft formatting codes (`§`, `&`), handles bidirectional markers, and applies RTL formatting for Arabic scripts.
- **Player Name Handling**: Optional speaker labels with language-aware formatting (e.g., "يقول" for Arabic, "says" for English).

### 🗂️ Chat Logging System
- **Daily Rotated Logs**: Plaintext logs stored in `logs/multilangtts-mc/chat-YYYY-MM-DD.txt`.
- **In-Game Viewer**: Scrollable interface with per-message replay via TTS.
- **Export Functionality**: Export session logs to custom file paths.
- **Async I/O**: Non-blocking file writes prevent gameplay stutter.

### ⚙️ Configuration & UI
- **ModMenu Integration**: Full settings interface accessible via ModMenu or keybind.
- **Cloth Config Backend**: Live configuration reloading without restarting the game.
- **Provider-Specific Settings**:
  - Google: Language code selection
  - ElevenLabs: API key, Voice ID, Model ID, Stability, Similarity Boost, Style Exaggeration, Speed
- **Test Suite**: Custom phrase input with one-click playback verification.

### ⌨️ Keybindings
| Action | Default Key | Category |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Toggle TTS | `B` | Multi LangTTS MC |
| Open Chat Log Viewer | `V` | Multi LangTTS MC |

*Fully customizable via Minecraft Controls menu*

---


### Supported Locales (Markdown Table)

| Locale Code | Language | Region |
|-------------|----------|--------|

## 👥 Contributors

| Contributor | Role |
|-------------|------|
| **mgv** | Lead Development, Architecture, Core Systems |
| **DFD3** | Co-Development, Testing, Integration |

---

## ⚠️ Important Notes

- **ElevenLabs API Key**: Required for premium voice synthesis. Obtain it from https://elevenlabs.io
  The API key is stored locally in the Minecraft config files on the user’s device
  It is only used to access Text-to-Speech (TTS) services and is not shared externally by the mod
  **Recommended setup:**
  https://elevenlabs.io/app/developers/api-keys > Create Key > set **Access** to **Text to Speech**
  Avoid using full-access API keys for better security
- **Google TTS Rate Limits**: Public endpoint usage is subject to undocumented throttling.
- **Arabic Text Handling**: Automatic RTL embedding via Unicode bidi markers; stripped in logs for readability.
- **Audio Playback**: Blocking on worker thread only—never impacts main game loop.

title: BlockBack
description: Restore stripped logs, dirt paths, and tilled farmland with a click.
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/feff29543d00ea6eefde5730c3e9f1a5a31204f6.png)

BlockBack lets players reverse common block transformations with a right-click. Unstrip logs to restore bark, turn dirt paths back into grass blocks, and untill farmland back to dirt.

Lightweight, Folia-safe, and survival-friendly with no commands or setup required. Compatible with Paper and Folia 1.21+.

Built for survival SMPs, creative servers, and any community where players need to undo common block changes without WorldEdit, creative mode, or admin intervention.

![features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb0f0341a0bb4aae58d1f44dfeafd77c341f283b.png)

### BarkBack - Log Restoration

![Bark Back](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3deb5fd4befb150e14a35964635cc56d354aebfb.gif)

Right-click any stripped log with an axe to restore its bark. Also known as unstripping.

- Preserves log orientation and placement
- Works with all 10 wood types: oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry, crimson, and warped
- Includes stripped wood blocks and stripped bamboo

### PathBack - Path Restoration

![Path Back](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e2fdb8d64e7b22f24ea5169d38246c8acb9af057.gif)

Right-click a dirt path (formerly known as grass path) with a shovel to convert it back to dirt.

- Perfect for undoing accidental path creation
- Useful for terraforming and landscaping
- Maintains natural terrain appearance

### FarmBack - Farmland Restoration

![Farm Back](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d91f1ac6eff7e541c4bcb8a9a04665e57c6fcc9.gif)

Right-click farmland with a hoe to revert it back to dirt.

- Essential for changing farm layouts
- Cleans up abandoned farms without breaking and replacing blocks
- No more accidental farmland from sprinting players

![installation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3f658e10f059474003ea90cba3e3560bb0e30bb.png)

1. Download the latest BlockBack.jar from the Files section
2. Place the file in your server's `plugins/` directory
3. Start your server to generate configuration files
4. Done. Players can use every feature immediately with no permissions setup required.

![commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88dbbfe52b093fb16bcb187c9b5f568ed1e74dbe.png)

| Command | Description |
|----------------------|------------------------------------|
| `/blockback` | View your current feature settings |
| `/barkback` | Toggle BarkBack on/off |
| `/pathback` | Toggle PathBack on/off |
| `/farmback` | Toggle FarmBack on/off |
| `/blockback reload` | Reload configurations |

Each feature is toggleable per-player, so players who don't want it can opt out without affecting anyone else.

![permissions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8827807b3879bdc04e52ea0c9e63298234a09288.png)

| Permission | Description | Default |
|----------------------|------------------------------------|------------------|
| `blockback.use` | Default Use | Everyone |
| `blockback.bark` | Use BarkBack | Everyone |
| `blockback.path` | Use PathBack | Everyone |
| `blockback.farm` | Use FarmBack | Everyone |
| `blockback.reload` | Reload configurations | Operators only |

Default permissions ensure immediate functionality while maintaining admin control. No permissions plugin required.

![whywho](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e13f70c17afb7b2f2ec8be9204670ce9592d8a36.png)

### For Server Owners

- No tutorials needed, no commands required, no config edits to get started
- Folia-safe and lightweight with negligible TPS impact
- Works alongside protection plugins, claims plugins, and WorldGuard
- Each feature can be globally disabled in the config

### For Players

- Intuitive controls using the right tool for each block
- Toggle individual features on or off to match your playstyle
- Makes building, terraforming, and farm management faster
- No need to break and replace blocks to fix small mistakes

### Support

- **Issues and feature requests:** [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/your-repo-here)
- **Discord:** clearpixels (or invite link to your Discord)

title: kii's Simple EXPerience
description: A lightweight mod that aims to improve anvil math, experience curves, enchanting behavior and experience gathering.
body:
# ✨ kii's Simple EXPerience [![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/kiis-simple-experience?logo=modrinth&label=downloads&color=00AF5C)](https://modrinth.com/mod/kiis-simple-experience) [![Modrinth Version](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/v/kiis-simple-experience?logo=modrinth&color=00AF5C)](https://modrinth.com/mod/kiis-simple-experience) ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20.1-green) ![Loader](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-Forge-orange) ![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/soaringpromise/kii-simple-experience) A lightweight mod that simplifies and improves Minecraft's experience, enchanting, and anvil mechanics while staying close to vanilla gameplay. The goal is to reduce unnecessary grind and randomness while keeping the system predictable, configurable, and balanced. Most features can be individually enabled, disabled, or adjusted through the configuration file. --- ## 📦 Features
📈 Experience Progression - **Linear XP progression:** Replaces the default exponential level curve with a fixed XP requirement per level. *(Toggleable)* - **Configurable XP per level:** Define exactly how much experience each level requires.
🪦 Death Mechanics - **XP retention on death:** Keep a percentage of your experience after dying. *(Toggleable)* - **Configurable retention percentage:** Change how much XP is kept ranging from 0% to 100%.
🧪 Bottles o' Enchanting - **Fixed XP from bottles:** Bottles o' Enchanting grant a consistent amount of experience instead of a random value from a range. *(Toggleable)* - **Configurable bottle XP:** Set the exact amount of XP each bottle grants. - **Optional removal from Villagers:** Removes Bottles o' Enchanting from Cleric Villager trade pools. *(Toggleable)* - **Brewable Bottles o' Enchanting:** Brew Bottles o' Enchanting by using an Echo Shard on any Awkward Potion variant!

📚 Enchanting & Books - **Additive book merging:** Combine enchanted books of different levels additively (e.g. I + II = III). *(Toggleable)* - **Smart Mending:** Mending prioritizes repairing the most damaged item instead of selecting randomly. *(Toggleable)*
🏹 Infinity Enchantment Improvements - **No arrows required:** Bows or crossbows with Infinity can fire even with no arrows in inventory. *(Toggleable)* - **Any arrow type:** Infinity can work with any arrow variant. *(Toggleable)* - **Crossbow support:** Infinity can be applied to crossbows. *(Toggleable)* - **Infinity + Mending compatibility:** Removes the vanilla mutual exclusivity between the two enchantments. *(Toggleable)*
⚒️ Anvil Improvements - **Remove repair penalty:** Eliminates the increasing XP cost for repeatedly repairing items. *(Toggleable)* - **Cheap renaming:** Renaming items without other modifications costs no XP. *(Toggleable)* - **No "Too Expensive!" limit:** Removes the vanilla anvil cost cap. *(Toggleable)*
🔥 Furnace Quality of Life - **Stored XP drops from furnaces:** Breaking a furnace releases accumulated smelting XP. *(Toggleable)*
⭐ XP Collection - **Experience magnet:** Increases the range at which XP orbs are pulled toward the player. - **Configurable magnet range:** Adjust the attraction range for XP orbs.
🌾 Farming Rewards - **Crops grant XP:** Harvesting fully grown crops can drop experience. *(Toggleable)* - **Configurable crop XP:** Adjust how much XP crops provide.
🛠️ New Crafting Recipes and Block Tweaks - **Silk Touch Budding Amethyst:** Allows Budding Amethyst blocks to be mined using Silk Touch. - **Renewable Echo Shards:** Craft Echo Shards by surrounding an Amethyst Shard with 4 Sculk Blocks!

- **Modern Name Tag Recipe Backport:** Backports the current 26.1 Name Tag recipe that takes 1 Iron or Gold Nugget and a piece of Paper!

- **Craftable Enchanted Golden Apples:** Craft Enchanted Golden Apples by surrounding a regular Golden Apple with 8 Bottles o' Enchanting!

--- ## ⚙️ Configuration All features can be configured through the mod's config file. You can: - Enable or disable individual features - Adjust XP values - Tune gameplay balance for modpacks or servers ## 🧩 Compatibility The mod is designed to stay close to vanilla mechanics and should work with most mods. Although, mods that change the behaviour of: - Experience mechanics - Enchanting systems - Anvils - Villager trades may override or conflict with some features. ## 🚧 Planned Features Features currently being considered or planned for future updates: - **Compatibility with newer Forge versions and Fabric port.** - **Toggleable Enchanted Golden Apple recipe:** Allow enabling or disabling the crafting recipe through the config. - Additional configuration options for existing mechanics. - Further small quality-of-life tweaks to XP and enchanting systems. --- ## 🐛 Feedback & Issues This is my first formal mod, so there may still be a few rough edges. Feedback, bug reports, and suggestions are always welcome! If you encounter any issues or have ideas for improvements, feel free to reach out to me on [**X/Twitter**](https://x.com/soaringpromise) or message me on Discord (@soaringpromise). Feature suggestions are always appreciated, and I'm happy to hear ideas that could improve the mod. **Modpack permissions:** You are free to include this mod in modpacks. Thanks for trying the mod and helping make it better! If you enjoy the mod, consider sharing it!

title: AE2 Mod ID View Cell
description: Adds an AE2 View Cell that filters terminal lists by mod ID, not individual items. Configure via Sneak + Right Click with whitelist or blacklist, tab completion, multi-select, and quick transfers.
body:
## AE2 Mod ID View Cell

Adds a new **Applied Energistics 2 View Cell** for **Minecraft 1.12.2** that filters terminal listings by **mod ID** instead of individual items.

If you play big modpacks, this makes it much easier to browse storage by mod, for example only Thermal items, only Ender IO items, only Botania items, etc.

***

## Why

AE2’s normal View Cell is item-based. If you want to hide an entire mod (or only show one mod), you end up adding lots of individual items manually.

It also caps out at **63 items**, so larger mods hit the limit quickly and you cannot fully represent them unless you use multiple View Cells.

**Mod ID View Cell** solves this by letting you filter by **mod ID**, so a single entry can cover an entire mod.

***

## Features

*   **Mod ID filtering**
    *   Filter the terminal item list using mod IDs like `thermalfoundation`, `enderio`, `botania`, etc.
*   **Whitelist and Blacklist**
    *   **Whitelist**: only show items from the listed mod IDs
    *   **Blacklist**: hide items from the listed mod IDs
*   **Fast input**
    *   Paste multiple mod IDs at once, separated by commas, semicolons, or spaces
    *   Input is normalized (trim + lowercase) and supports the optional `@modid` format

***

## Usage

1.  Hold the cell in your hand and **Shift + Right Click** to open the filter GUI.
2.  Type one or more ModIDs into the entry field (examples: `appliedenergistics2`, `mekanism`, `thermalfoundation`).
3.  Click **Add to Whitelist** or **Add to Blacklist** (or press **Enter** to add to the active list).
4.  Apply changes by clicking **Save**, pressing **Enter** with an empty input, or pressing **Ctrl + S**.
5.  Place the cell into any AE2 terminal **View Cell** slot (ME Terminal, wireless terminal, etc.).

  

### Input tips

You can paste multiple entries like:

*   `ae2 mekanism thermalfoundation`
*   `ae2, mekanism; thermalfoundation`
*   `@ae2 @mekanism`

***

## Controls and shortcuts

*   **Tab**
    *   If the entry field is not focused: focus it
    *   If the entry field is focused: tab-complete the current token and cycle forward through matches
*   **Shift + Tab**: cycle backwards through matches
*   **Enter**
    *   When the entry field is focused and has text: add to the active list
    *   When the entry field is focused and empty: Save
    *   When the entry field is not focused: Save
*   **Ctrl + S**: Save
*   **Delete (Supr)**
    *   Remove selected entry/entries
    *   If nothing is selected: remove the latest added entry
*   **Up / Down**: Move selection in the active list and auto-scroll to keep it visible
*   Mouse wheel over a list: Scroll that list (also sets it as the active list)
*   **Ctrl + Click**: Multi-select individual entries in the active list
*   **Shift + Click**: Select a range (from anchor to clicked entry)
*   **Move buttons**: Transfer selected entry/entries between Whitelist and Blacklist

***

## Compatibility

*   **Minecraft**: 1.12.2
*   **Requires**: AE2 UEL

***

## Notes

*   Mod IDs must be the registry mod id (lowercase), for example `appliedenergistics2`, not the display name.

*   **Botania** (Solegnolia compatibility)

If a recipe is too large, it will require a crafting table in proximity of the player. (Configurable)

- Recipe menu openable via keybind.
- Support for recipes with any number of ingredient entries and per-entry counts.
- Scrollable recipe browser tied to the player's inventory.
- Inclusion of vanilla crafting-table recipes.
- Support for data driven workstations.
- Datapack recipe support through the custom **gad:gad_crafting** recipe type.

body:
# EcoMOTD

**The Lightweight MOTD Plugin for Minecraft Servers**

---

## Description

EcoMOTD is a lightweight, high-performance MOTD plugin for Minecraft servers running Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, Purpur, and Folia. Supporting versions 1.12 through 1.26, this plugin allows you to fully customize your server's message of the day with minimal resource usage.

At only 15-25 KB per JAR with zero external dependencies, EcoMOTD is one of the smallest MOTD plugins available. It offers single, random, and rotating MOTD modes, maintenance mode, fake player count, custom hover lists, and full placeholder support including online players, max players, TPS, date, and time.

---

## Features

- **Ultra Lightweight** - Only 15-25 KB with no dependencies
- **Multi-Version Support** - Works on 1.12 through 1.26
- **Three MOTD Modes** - Single, Random (with weights), and Rotating (with interval)
- **Maintenance Mode** - Custom MOTD with bypass permission
- **Fake Player Count** - Inflate or override online player count
- **Custom Hover List** - Customize player list hover text
- **Placeholders** - %online%, %max%, %tps%, %date%, %time%, %newline%
- **Color Support** - Standard & codes (all versions) + Hex colors (1.16+)
- **Protocol Override** - Change displayed version name
- **Configurable Cache** - Reduce server load

---

## Commands

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---------|------------|-------------|
| /motd reload | motd.admin | Reload configuration |
| /motd info | motd.admin | Show plugin information |
| /motd help | none | Show help message |

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|------------|---------|-------------|
| motd.admin | op | Access to all plugin commands |
| motd.maintenance.bypass | false | Bypass maintenance mode |

---

## Installation

1. Download the JAR file for your Minecraft version
2. Place the file in your server's /plugins/ folder
3. Restart or reload your server
4. Edit config.yml in /plugins/MOTDPlugin/
5. Run /motd reload to apply changes

---

## Server Software

**Compatible:**
- Bukkit

- Paper

- Folia

---

## Version Support

Anadolu Lezzetleri
Anadolu Lezzetleri is a Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that adds Turkish-inspired foods, drinks, ingredients, crops, and themed kitchen items.

The mod focuses on adding new craftable food content using vanilla-style crafting recipes. It also adds several new crops, olives, and olive trees to support those recipes.

What this mod adds
New foods such as Doner, Iskender, Lahmacun, Pide, Manti, Karniyarik, Kuru Fasulye, Pilav, Lentil Soup, Cig Kofte, Sarma, Dolma, Menemen, Gozleme, Borek, Baklava, Sutlac, Kunefe, Lokum, Revani, and Tavuk Gogsu
New drinks: Ayran, Turkish Tea, Turkish Coffee, and Salgam
New crops: Tomato, Pepper, Eggplant, Onion, Chickpea, Lentil, and Rice
New ingredients: Olive, Olive Oil, Flour, Dough, Yogurt, Cheese, Butter, Minced Meat, Spice Blend, and Syrup
New themed items and blocks such as Cutting Board, Pot, Pan, Baking Tray, Stove, Teapot, Coffee Pot, Serving Plate, Doner Spit, Baklava Tray, and Chef Hat
Olive trees and olive saplings
How ingredients are obtained
Most ingredients come from one of these sources:

Breaking grass and fern-type plants for crop seeds
Harvesting the new crops after planting them
Finding naturally generated olive trees

title: VoidChat+
description: VoidChat | A high-performance, lightweight local and global chat system for servers.
body:
# 💬 VoidChat+ | Advanced Communication

**VoidChat+** is a professional, high-performance communication solution for modern Minecraft servers. It provides a complete chat management system by splitting communication into local and global channels, while maintaining top-tier security with integrated Anti-Swear and Anti-Bot mining requirements.

### 🛠️ Key Features

  * **Dual-Channel System** – Seamless transition between local (proximity-based) and global communication (using the `!` prefix).
  * **Infinite Local Mode** – Configure local chat range to `-1` to cover the entire world or dimension, perfect for specialized survival modes.
  * **Anti-Bot Security** – Unique system requiring new players to mine a specific amount of blocks before they are granted the ability to chat.
  * **HEX & PAPI Support** – Full support for modern HEX colors and PlaceholderAPI integration for dynamic, beautiful chat formats.
  * **Admin Chat Spy** – Allows staff members to monitor local conversations to ensure community guidelines are followed.

-----

### 💻 Installation & Setup

1.  Download the `.jar` file.
2.  Drop the file into your server's `/plugins` folder.
3.  Restart your server to generate the configuration files.
4.  Customize your settings and word filters in `config.yml`.

-----

### 📜〢 Configuration Example

```yaml
############################################################
#                                                          #
#             VOIDCHAT - CREATED BY KUBA_121               #
#         Professional local & global chat system          #
#                                                          #
############################################################

############################################################
#                                                          #
#  PERMISSIONS:                                            #
#  - voidchat.use: Access to basic commands                #
#  - voidchat.reload: Access to /voidchat reload           #
#  - voidchat.admin: Access to Admin/Spy/Clear/Toggle      #
#  - voidchat.color: Ability to use & and HEX colors       #
#  - voidchat.bypass: Bypass block break requirement       #
#  - voidchat.globalbypass: Bypass global cooldown         #
#                                                          #
############################################################

# --- GENERAL SETTINGS ---

# Time in seconds for global message (!) cooldown.
# Bypass this with voidchat.globalbypass permission.
global-message-cooldown: 30

# Distance in blocks for the local chat.
# Set to -1 for infinite range (everyone in the world hears you).
local-chat-range: 100.0

# Number of blocks a player must break before they can use the chat.
blocks-required: 10

# Should the block requirement be active?
chat-requirement-enabled: true

# --- ANTI SWEAR ---
anti-swear:
  # List of words that will be replaced with ****
  banned-words:
    - "badword1"
    - "badword2"
    - "badword3"

# --- CHAT FORMATTING ---
# You can use Placeholders from PAPI (if installed) using %placeholder%
# {player} and {message} are internal placeholders.

# Format for global chat (triggered by ! at the start)
global-format: "&a&lGLOBAL &r&8»&7 {player}: {message}"

# Format for local chat (based on range)
local-format: "&e&lLOCAL &r&8»&7 {player}: {message}"

# --- SYSTEM MESSAGES ---

messages:
  # The global prefix for all system messages
  prefix: "&b&lVoidChat &r&8»&7"

  # Error when player lacks required permissions
  no-permission: "%prefix% You lack the &bvoid power &7to do this."
  
  # Notification for successful config reload
  reload-success: "%prefix% Configuration &bpurged &7and &breloaded &7successfully."

  # Message when no one is in range for local chat
  no-one-in-range: "%prefix% &7The void is silent. No one is close enough to hear you."

  # Requirement message. Use {blocks_required} for remaining count.
  requirement-not-met: "%prefix% &7Your voice is weak. Break &b{blocks_required} &7more blocks to speak."

  # Global chat cooldown notification
  global-cooldown: "%prefix% &7The void needs &b{time_remaining}s &7to resonate again."

  # Admin Spy mode toggles
  admin-enabled: "%prefix% &bAdmin Spy &7is now &aactive&7. All whispers are yours."
  admin-disabled: "%prefix% &bAdmin Spy &7has been &cdisactivated&7."

  # Global mute notifications (self-toggle)
  global-muted: "%prefix% &7You have &cclosed &7your ears to the global void."
  global-unmuted: "%prefix% &7You can now &ahear &7the global resonance again."
  global-muted-error: "%prefix% &cYou cannot speak while your global ears are closed."

  # Chat Management (Clear & Toggle)
  chat-cleared: "%prefix% &7The chat has been &bpurified &7by &b{player}&7."
  chat-toggled-on: "%prefix% &aGlobal resonance has been restored. Chat is now enabled."
  chat-toggled-off: "%prefix% &cThe void has been silenced. Chat is now disabled."
  chat-disabled-error: "%prefix% &cThe chat is currently suppressed by an administrator."

  # Command usage and help
  usage-voidchat: "%prefix% Usage: &b/voidchat &8<&7help/reload/admin/clear/toggle&8>"
  only-players: "%prefix% &cOnly those with a physical form can use this command."

  # Help menu structure
  help-menu:
    - "&8&m--------&r &b&lVoidChat Help &8&m--------"
    - "&7/voidchat help &8- &fDisplays this menu"
    - "&7/voidchat reload &8- &fReloads the configuration"
    - "&7/voidchat admin &8- &fToggle Admin Spy mode"
    - "&7/voidchat clear &8- &fClear the chat history"
    - "&7/voidchat toggle &8- &fEnable or disable the chat"
    - "&7/global <msg> &8- &fSend a global message"
    - "&bTip: &7Use &b!message &7or &b/g <msg> &7for global!"
    - "&8&m--------------------------------"
```

-----

title: Better Stones (Granite, Diorite Andesite)
description: Expands granite, diorite and andesite to full range of stone type blocks, and completely changes their textures.
body:
Мод поддерживает Русский язык.

"With this mod, granite, diorite and andesite will stop being a clutter in your inventory during mining, and will become the target of mining themself! I made this mod to make it so for myself!"

This is my first mod. As it became clear that it will be a VERY long way before I would be able to realise my "way-too-big" game overhaul mod ideas, I decided to use some of the textures I made for it to make a smaller simple standalone mod, for practice, and playing it in my minimalistic vanilla+ modpack.

This is a simple mod that adds a bunch of new blocks (6 full blocks per each rock type, that, together with the vanilla 2, make it a nice number 8, so 18 new full blocks/24 full blocks overall. Together with 45 other type blocks, like stairs etc, 63 new blocks in total). Its goal is to make granite, diorite and andesite (GDA triad) a proper versatile building material akin to the regular stone.

Gameplay-wise, it adds dozen of new blocks for each of the rock types, namely, cobblestone (including mossy), bricks (including mossy, chiseled and cracked), with full (except chiseled and cracked) list of corresponding stairs, slabs and walls. It also adds missing polished wall variants, and even buttons and pressure plates if you ever will need them! Also, now natural GDA rocks drop corresponding cobblestone instead of themself, similarly to to regular stone, that needs to be smelted to get the rock variant back, that in turn, as in vanilla, is used to craft polished variant, that in turn are used to craft brick variant. Overall, all new crafting recipes are the same as for the regular stone.

Aesthetically, this mod replaces the vanilla GDA rock and polished textures with the ones made by me (obviously, along with the new blocks), that are much better looking and more realistic representation of the real stones, in my opinion, while aiming at the original Minecraft texture style. As such, this mod is intended to be played with Programmer art texture pack, though it can be played with modern default textures as well, I'm just not sure how well my textures will blend with the modern textures (that are blurry, lacking contrast, clearness and sharpness - qualities exactly for which I prefer the old textures in the first place). Just make sure that mod resources are placed higher than Programmer art, or any other pack affecting GDA textures. Also, because all textures in each stone type use almost the same colours, they mix very well together.

A bit of personal background.

Ever since I saw the addition of GDA triad back in 1.8, they were one of my personal most disliked additions. Of course, the most fundamental issue I have is that they should had been introduced as part of larger geologic overhaul, together with dozen of other stone types, while removing "generic stone" (having which became illogical together with inclusion of such specific stone types). Sadly, years later, Caves&Cliffs made it clear that we will never get a proper geologic system in a game called _Mine_craft.
Other than that, GDA stones just had quite an ugly textures (no offense to whoever made them). This is a rare case where I agree that the new textures are actually better than the old one, though both are still far from actual representation of the real stones. Also, for some years even vanilla GDA rock and polished variants lacked stairs and slabs, making them even less useful as a building material!
Thus, this mod is largely my longawaited (12 years!) "fix", changing GDA stones in the way they should had been introduced in the first place.

I'm not an artist. So, I can't/don't have skills to actually paint the textures I want. Instead, I _construct_ them, using other textures as base and making both general manipulations, and pixel to pixel tweaks. It might be hard to believe, but all textures in the mod actually are based on old stone texture, with new granite as their "progenitor". I took the old stone texture, recoloured and detalised it using colours from actual photo of real granite texture, that fit with my vision of a "most typical granite" (real rock types have very varied textures!). Then I decoloured it and made some other tweaks and manipulations to get the diorite and andesite, and the rest of the textures followed up fairly simply (among other things, I used my favourite texture, the old cobblestone, as the base for GDA cobblestones). In the end, I think this makes my textures have very cohesive style overall.

You can use this mod in a modpack (likely, some minimalistic vanilla+ with original/old Minecraft aesthetics, just as I do).
It affects only textures, crafting and loot of vanilla GDA blocks, so it should be compatible with pretty much any mod except the ones that significantly affect GDA blocks - obviously, this mod wouldn't be really compatible with other similar mods that add "missing" (GDA in that case) building blocks.
Because I want these textures to be integral part of my future huge mod, any use of the mod or textures in any mod or modpack that significantly changes distribution/behaviour of the affected blocks, is prohibited without my explicit permission. In short, you may not use this mod or textures in any context other than vanilla+ modpacks (but you obviously can use it in both survival and creative mode building, just in case), without my explicit permission.
You may not port or recreate this mod on other versions without my explicit permission. I might learn and port this mod to 1.16.5 and some popular later versions, if there will be player demand. If you want, you can ask my permission to port this mod to 1.12.2 or earlier versions (they are quite different for modding, so I will be happy with someone remaking it for earlier versions, with my permission).

# 📖 Adventure Notes

Your personal adventure journal for Minecraft. Never forget where you built your base, found diamonds, or died again.

---

## ✨ Features

### 📝 Notes
Create unlimited notes with titles, text, and categories. Write down anything — base locations, plans, observations, coordinates of interesting places.

### 🏷️ Categories
Organize your notes with 8 color-coded categories:
- **General** — for anything
- **Base** — your builds and homes
- **Mines** — ore locations and caves
- **Village** — trading posts and villages
- **Nether** — nether locations
- **End** — end dimension notes
- **Danger** — dangerous areas
- **To-Do** — your task list

### 📍 Coordinates
Attach your current XYZ position and dimension to any note. Never lose a location again.

### 💀 Death Tracking
Every death is automatically recorded with coordinates, dimension, time, and cause. Open the death log anytime with a hotkey.

### 📕 Sealed Journal
Create a read-only copy of your journal and give it to another player. They can read all your notes but cannot edit them. The sealed journal glows with enchantment effect.

### ✏️ View & Edit Modes
Switch between View mode (read-only) and Edit mode. No accidental edits.

### 📋 Full Text Editing
- Select text with Shift+Arrows
- Select all with Ctrl+A
- Copy/Paste/Cut with Ctrl+C/V/X
- Scrollable text area with draggable scrollbar

### ⌨️ Hotkeys
- **J** — Open journal (requires item in inventory)
- **O** — Open death log
- **Right-click** — Open journal from hand
- **Shift+Right-click** — Create sealed copy

### 💾 Persistent Storage
All notes are saved per-player in the world data. Your notes survive death, relog, and server restart.

### 🌐 Multiplayer Ready
Full client-server synchronization. Works in singleplayer and on dedicated servers.

---

## 📦 How to Use

1. Craft or grab an **Adventure Notes** item
2. Right-click to open your journal
3. Press **New** to create your first note
4. Click **View** to switch to **Editing** mode
5. Write your title and text
6. Choose a category, attach coordinates if needed
7. Press **Save**
8. Done! Your note is stored forever.

---

- Minecraft **1.20.1**
- Forge **47.x**
- Java **17**

---

- Russian

body:
# Kick World

Kick World automatically leaves the world after a configurable delay when the player joins. The mod shows a timer above the XP bar, supports manual exit with a command, and works for both singleplayer and servers.

## Features

- starts an auto-leave timer after entering a world;
- shows the remaining time above the XP bar;
- adds the `/kw leave` command for instant exit;
- includes a configurable setup for delay and auto-start;
- supports multiple interface languages.

## Config

Main options:

- `AutoKick` - start the timer automatically after joining a world;
- `leaveDelaySeconds` - delay before leaving the world, in seconds.

## Languages

The mod already includes translations for:

- English
- Russian
- German
- French
- Spanish

## Supported versions

- NeoForge: `1.21.11`, `1.21.8`, `1.21.6`, `1.21.4`, `1.21.1`, `1.21`, `1.20.4`
- Forge: `1.20.1`

## Installation

- install the mod on both client and server for full compatibility;
- for singleplayer, a normal installation in the `mods` folder is enough.

## Commands

- `/kw leave` - leave the world immediately.

Kick World does not add blocks, items, or gameplay content. It is a small utility mod focused on timed world exit.

![Plugin Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4343f605f704a18326d44b7b56b34869009945bc_0.webp)
LiteBans Discord Bridge is a small utility plugin made to send any LiteBans events from your Minecraft Network or server, into a Discord channel.


It supports a global webhook and granular webhooks-per-event, and has full embed customisation with placeholders and more.


**NOTE: THE DOWNLOADS PROVIDED ON MODRINTH ARE COMPILED WITH JAVA 8. FOR A *TINY* PERFORMANCE BOOST, YOU CAN VISIT GITHUB TO DOWNLOAD THE [JAVA 21 COMPILATIONS](https://github.com/colocated/LitebansDiscordBridge/releases/latest) OF THE PLUGIN.**


![Requirements header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a16d6e70e86e2d0c8ff41ca748b589cb5f0220f4.png)
As would be somewhat obvious, you're required to have a valid copy of LiteBans on your server. \
You can purchase a copy of Litebans over at [SpigotMC](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/litebans.3715/). It is a paid plugin, so it's not included in this _free download_.

![Installation header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c43838f464bbef237cbe4895605288f0f583cb0d.png)
Installing the plugin is super easy. \
Make sure to select the correct platform JAR for your product. \
For more information about which JAR to select, visit the [Latest GitHub Release](https://github.com/colocated/LitebansDiscordBridge/releases/latest).


Drag and drop the plugin file into your platform's plugins folder and restart the server. \
The plugins configuration directory will create automatically on first load, and you'll be able to edit the plugin over at **plugins/litebansdiscordbridge/config.yml**.


There are many placeholders that the plugin supports - check out the default config file for more information on how to use them.


![Get support header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9bdff5087a76723828d91980c42e0ea8bb1679fe.png)

This plugin is open source, and thus provided as-is and free of charge. \
Compiled versions are available at Modrinth or [GitHub](https://github.com/colocated/LitebansDiscordBridge/releases/latest).


[Pull requests](https://github.com/colocated/LitebansDiscordBridge/pulls) and [issues](https://github.com/colocated/LitebansDiscordBridge/issues) are welcome on the relevant GitHub pages. \
Please try to be descriptive if you want me to be able to fix an issue. "It isn't working" is NOT a bug report!


If you're somehow really stuck with the plugin, you can message me on Discord **@colocated** - I'll try my best to help, but no support is guaranteed as standard.
