title: Pushable Budding Amethyst
description: This mod makes Budding Amethyst blocks pushable by pistons
body:
# Pushable Budding Amethyst

This mod allows you to push Budding Amethyst blocks with pistons.

![Example image showing Budding Amethyst before and after being pushed by a piston](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0ac64a44ff62e1f02e63a83d332b37f68e97c94.png)

The implementation is simply taken from Gnembon's Carpet mod ([Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/carpet) | [Github](https://github.com/gnembon/fabric-carpet)). Carpet mod adds a custom
gamerule to allow for the same functionality (`/carpet movableAmethyst true`). However that
same rule also allows the player to mine Budding Amethyst blocks using a Silk Touch pickaxe.
As I don't like that part of the rule, I separated out just the pushing functionality into its
own mod.

There is also an [earlier mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/pushable-amethysts) by [clearKeep](https://codeberg.org/clearKeep) which does the same thing for older Minecraft versions (1.20 - 1.20.2).

title: GracePeriod+
description: Grace Period Plugin with all the config needed.
body:
# ⚔ GracePeriod+ **GracePeriod+** is a PaperMC plugin that protects new and specific players from PvP (and optionally mobs) for a configurable amount of time — perfect for survival, SMP, and competitive servers. --- ## Features - **New player grace period** - automatically protects players the first time they join - **Server-wide grace period** - disable PvP for all players with a live countdown timer - **Per-player grace** - grant individual players an additional grace period at any time - **Mob protection** - optionally prevent mobs from targeting or damaging grace players - **Action bar / BossBar timer** - real-time countdown shown above the hotbar or at the top of the screen, with a smooth fade-out when done - **LuckPerms integration** - automatically assigns and removes a configurable `[GRACE]` group with a coloured prefix while a player is protected - **Persistent grace periods** - grace timers survive server restarts and player disconnects - **Live config reload** - change settings without restarting the server --- [](https://discord.gg/7Sa9VmmWZX) [](https://ko-fi.com/justbuddy) --- ## Support If you find any bugs or have any suggestions join my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/Pjm9GFuSyG). --- ## Requirements | Dependency | Type | |---|---| | [PaperMC 1.21.1+](https://papermc.io) | Required | | [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net) | Required | --- ## Installation 1. Drop `GracePeriodPlus-1.0.0.jar` into your `plugins/` folder 2. Make sure **LuckPerms** is installed 3. Start the server - the plugin will generate a `config.yml` and create the `grace` LuckPerms group automatically --- ## Commands All commands require the `graceplugin.admin` permission (default: OP). | Command | Description | |---|---| | `/grace specific ` | Give a specific player a personal grace period | | `/grace period ` | Start a server-wide grace period (disables PvP for everyone) | | `/grace end` | End the active server-wide grace period early | | `/grace end ` | End a specific player's personal grace period early | | `/grace status [player]` | Check the grace status of yourself or another player | | `/grace reload` | Reload the config.yml without restarting | ### Time Format | Input | Meaning | |---|---| | `30s` | 30 seconds | | `5m` | 5 minutes | | `2h` | 2 hours | | `3d` | 3 days (max: 999d) | | `120` | 120 seconds (plain number = seconds) | --- ## Permissions | Permission | Description | Default | |---|---|---| | `graceplugin.admin` | Access to all `/grace` commands | OP | | `graceplugin.bypass` | Can attack grace-protected players freely | false | --- ## Configuration ```yaml # How long (in seconds) a brand-new player is protected after their first join. # Set to 0 to disable. new-player-grace-duration: 300 protection: # Prevent players from attacking grace-protected players (and vice versa) block-player-damage: true # Prevent mobs from targeting or damaging grace-protected players block-mob-damage: false luckperms: # Name of the LuckPerms group assigned during grace (created automatically) group-name: "GRACE" # Colour of the group prefix — MiniMessage format # Options: , , , , , , , etc. group-prefix-color: "" messages: grace-start: "✦ Grace Period You are protected from PvP for {time}." grace-end: "✦ Grace Period Over You are no longer protected from PvP." cannot-attack: "You cannot attack players during your grace period!" cannot-be-attacked: "{player} is currently in a grace period and cannot be attacked!" specific-success: "Grace period of {time} applied to {player}." period-start-broadcast: "⚔ Server Grace Period PvP disabled for {time}. Enjoy the peace!" period-end-broadcast: "⚔ Server Grace Period Over PvP has been re-enabled. Good luck!" reload-success: "GracePeriod+ config reloaded successfully." no-permission: "You don't have permission to use this command." usage: "Usage: /grace " timer: # How to display the countdown — "actionbar" (above hotbar) or "bossbar" (top of screen) display-type: "actionbar" actionbar-format: "⚔ Grace Period: {time}" bossbar-title: "⚔ Grace Period: {time}" bossbar-color: "YELLOW" # WHITE, YELLOW, GREEN, BLUE, RED, PURPLE, PINK bossbar-style: "SOLID" # SOLID, SEGMENTED_6, SEGMENTED_10, SEGMENTED_12, SEGMENTED_20 # How long the timer takes to fade out when the grace period ends (in ticks, 20 = 1 second) fade-out-ticks: 40 ``` --- ## LuckPerms Group On first startup, GracePeriod+ automatically creates a LuckPerms group named `grace` (configurable) with a coloured prefix. Players are added to this group when their grace period starts and removed when it ends - even if they go offline mid-grace. The prefix colour is configurable via MiniMessage tags in `config.yml`. --- ## How It Works **New player grace:** When a player joins for the first time, they are automatically placed in a personal grace period for the configured duration. During this time only that specific player is protected — other players are unaffected. **Personal grace (`/grace specific`):** Grants an individual player a grace period at any time. Useful for welcoming returning players or staff discretion. **Server grace (`/grace period`):** Disables PvP for the entire server for the specified duration. A live countdown is shown to all players via action bar or BossBar. PvP is automatically restored when the timer ends. **Mob protection:** When `block-mob-damage: true`, mobs will completely ignore grace-protected players - they won't target, pathfind toward, or deal damage to them. Works for all mob types including projectiles. ---

title: AlaLoot
description: Random loot from the entire item registry - drop chance equals your XP level. Boss kills give legendary stacks. Multi-language, fully configurable, server-side only.
body:
## What is AlaLoot?

AlaLoot turns every block break and mob kill into a chance to drop a **random item from the entire item registry**. The more XP you have, the more likely you are to get something. Boss fights always reward fixed legendary stacks — so progression actually feels rewarding.

Server-side only — vanilla clients can join servers running AlaLoot. No client install required.

---

## Features

- **XP-based loot** — drop chance equals your XP level (1 lvl = 1%, capped at 100%).
- **Random items from the full registry** — anything that exists in the game can drop.
- **Boss rewards** — Ender Dragon, Wither, Warden and Elder Guardian always drop legendary stacks.
- **6 smart categories** — Common, Rare, Nether, End, Mob, Boss. Nether/End drops only fire in their dimensions.
- **Per-mod and per-item blacklists** — fully editable in-game, no JSON wrangling.
- **Live admin commands** — toggle, blacklist, reload config without restarting the server.
- **Server-side only** — install once on the server, every player benefits.
- **Fully configurable** — every chance, category and reward is editable in `config/alaloot-server.toml`.
- **8 languages out of the box** — English, Русский, Українська, 简体中文, Deutsch, Español, Français, Português (BR).

---

## How it works

| Action | Effect |
|---|---|
| Break a block | Vanilla drop is replaced by a random item. Chance = `min(xpLevel, 100) / 100`. +1 XP regardless of the roll. |
| Kill a mob | Same chance formula. +10 XP regardless of the roll. |
| Kill a boss | Fixed legendary stack — always drops. |

Blocks are sorted into 6 categories. Each category can be toggled, blacklisted or limited live from in-game commands.

---

## Commands

All commands require operator permission.

```
/alaloot reload                                  Reload config without restart.
/alaloot stats                                   Show item-pool stats.
/alaloot info                                    Show category of the block you are standing on.
/alaloot toggle <area> <on|off>                  Toggle drops for blocks / mobs / bosses.
/alaloot blacklist <add|remove> <item|mod> <id>  Manage the blacklist live.
```

---

## Configuration

After the first world load AlaLoot creates `config/alaloot-server.toml`. Drop chance multipliers, dimension gates, blacklists and boss reward sizes — all editable there. Run `/alaloot reload` to apply changes without restarting.

---

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.10 (26.1.2)
- **Loader:** NeoForge 26.1+
- **Side:** server-only — works with vanilla clients

---

## Links

- **Source code:** https://github.com/Ma3auka/AlaLoot
- **Bug reports:** https://github.com/Ma3auka/AlaLoot/issues
- **License:** MIT

title: HealthHiderPacket
description: Hides player health from other players to prevent ESP and unfair advantages in PvP.
body:
**sHealthHiderPacket** - is a lightweight anti-cheat plugin designed to protect fair PvP gameplay.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You must install ProtocolLib on the server for the plugin to work properly!

The plugin hides player health information from other players by intercepting and filtering `ENTITY_METADATA` packets using ProtocolLib. This prevents cheats such as ESP, health indicators, and other unfair tools from accessing real-time health data.

Perfect for PvP servers where competitive integrity matters.

**Features:**

- Hides player health from other players
- Blocks ESP and health-based cheats
- Works via ProtocolLib packet filtering
- Lightweight and optimized
- Fully configurable

Notice the health bar this is the player's real HP, it is not fixed or faked.

ESP always shows 20 HP regardless of the player's actual health real data is hidden.

title: Foxtrot
description: Foxes! Added new foxes to Minecraft
body:
# Foxes!

I added new foxes to Minecraft! Currently the mod includes 1 new fox type, the fennec fox! There are different biome variants. Currently the 4 in the mod are the normal (found in deserts), red (found in taiga), silver (found in dark forest), and arctic fox (found in snowy taiga). 

This mod also includes a Kitsune! You can find them in the Jungle. 

With the foxes it includes some new items, mainly the fox treats, made with either vegetables or meat. It also includes Fox/Kitsune daggers, made using the drops from a fox. **Please don't actually hurt foxes.**

There is also a new status effect, bleeding. When hit with a Fox/Kitsune dagger, you get the bleeding effect for a few seconds. It causes you to take damage over time like poison or wither.

That is all that is currently in the mod, hope you enjoy!

title: TitancraftQOL
description: Minecraft plugin that adds various quality-of-life changes, which can be configured to be enabled/disabled.
body:
## TitancraftQOL
A **Minecraft server plugin** that provides a bunch of quality-of-life functionalities to the game.
Some of such features are Silent Mobs, Baby Mobs, Anti Enderman Griefing, and more.

This plugin has been designed to be reloadable and configurable in-game without restarting the server, and is intended for latest version support. (1.21.11) Currently only tested on Purpur servers, but should work on everything. 

---

## Features
### Anti Enderman Grief
Removes functionality of endermen being able to pick up blocks
### Baby Mobs
Adds a customizable case-sensitive name tag that stops mobs from being able to grow, or turning them into their baby variant if they are already adults. (Only works on breedable animals)
### Cauldron Concrete Conversion
Gives the option to allow players to convert concrete powder into it's regular concrete variant by dropping the item into a cauldron full of water.
### Infinite Villager Trading
Sets the amount of trades allowed to be infinite, IRREVERSIBLE AT THE MOMENT. If the villager doesn't have infinite trading capability yet, when the villager replenishes, it should fix.
### No Anvil Limit
Removes the "Too Expensive!" limit in anvils. Functionality may be removed if bukkit's deprecation turns into full non-support and loss of functionality.

The scaling continues as Minecraft regularly would, and since the "Too Expensive!" prompt is hard-coded client-side for anvil uses that cost more than 39 experience levels, it will still show for the player, but the anvil will still have a usable output.
### Silent Mobs
Adds a customizable case-sensitive name tag that will silence a mob with the given name.
### Silk Touch+
Adds the ability to let silk touch work on reinforced deepslate and budding amethyst.
### Sitting Stairs/Slabs
Adds ability for players to run '/sit' to enable sitting on stairs and slabs. Moderately experimental, join the discord for suggestions 🙏
### Vault Resetting
Because of Minecraft's odd system for trial vaults, this is a toggleable config that allows for trial vaults to reset their player lists on chunk load. (Vaults only reset once per server restart)
### Configs & Commands
Modify configs and reload the plugin via in-game commands.

## Support
Need help or have suggestions for the plugin? [Join the Discord!](https://discord.gg/cHEtKnvCR9)

## GitHub
This project is on GitHub! Take a look at the repository [here](https://github.com/idkdom-dev/TitancraftQOL).

---

To get started on your server, put the `.jar` file in the plugins folder and run `/titancraftqol`

title: Iceology
description: Harness the power of the cold...
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Ven2oo9_d34" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

![Logo](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/539/iceology-logo-png.png)

Special thanks to the Wicks for composing some of the music found in this mod!

https://www.youtube.com/@WhiteWicks


Curseforge page is [Here](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/iceology)


What if the Iceologer got its own update? That's what this mod is about! It adds a new dimension known as Frostholm, full of towering mountains and cavernous valleys. A powerful new crafting system also exists within this mod! The portal for this dimension can be found in a Mountain Cabin in the Overworld.

![Mountain Cabin](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/540/cabin-png.png)

Iceologers that spawn in Raids can drop a map leading to this place. You will also want to obtain an Iceology Wand from an Iceologer to be able to make many of the things in this mod.



DO NOT read beyond this point if you don't want spoilers! Take a look at the Advancements tab for a bit of guidance if you want to go in blind.



## New Additions:

# Blocks

Penimerite:

 -This cold version of Stone is the main underground block of Frostholm. It can be made into bricks to create a portal and can be made by using any type of Iceology Wand on normal Stone.

Penimerite Ores:

 -There are three Vanilla Ores found in Frostholm; Iron, Diamond, and Emerald. They spawn more often here than normal Overworld ores.

Ancient Ice:

 -An extra slippery variant of Ice found in the Deepsnow Peaks of Frostholm. It is used in making the basic Iceology Wand and the Iceology Table, two very important items.

Ancient Icicle:

 -A common block found on the floors and ceilings of caves in Frostholm. It has no use.

Permafrost:

 -An icy version of Dirt found in Frostholm.

Snowcapped Grass:

 -This variant of grass does not drop Wheat Seeds. It can be found in Frostholm and can be Snowlogged.

Cordalbloom:

 -A purple flower found in Frostholm. It can be Snowlogged.

Starnis:

 -A tall glowing plant found in any biome of Frostholm, with it being more common in Deepsnow Peaks.

Icemoss:

 -A variant of moss found in Frostholm Caves. This is pretty much the same as normal moss, except for the fact that the Sprouts glow.

Coldglow Wood:

 -A new dark purple wood set found in the Coldglow Woods biome. It has a few special crafting uses, such as making Iceology Tables and Frost Handles.

Heated Lamp:

 -A decorative light block crafted from Orkullun Ingots and a Torch on the Iceology Table.

Iceology Table:

 -A very important crafting station from this mod. It allows the player to create unique resources that can't be found anywhere else or modify gear. You need an Iceology Wand to use this block.

Creeping Iceweaver:

 -A frozen bush made with Sweet Berries and Blizzard Charges on the Iceology Table. It freezes mobs that walk in it.

Frostcaller Heart:

 -A functional block crafted with rare resources that can be used to make a Frostcaller. Place this block with a Block of Orkullun above and below it, then place a Carved Pumpkin on top of the pillar to spawn a Frostcaller.

Penimerite Core:

 -This block is used to create a portal to Frostholm. You can craft it on the Iceology Table.

Mysterious Ice:

 -Magically imbued ice found inside the portal frame of Mountain Cabins. Use a Warm Key on the Penimerite Core to break it.

Chthonic Safe:

 -A special container found in Frozen Chambers. It can be unlocked with a Warm Key, which will allow you to loot it. Special items not found anywhere else can be obtained from this block. They will reset 45 minutes after being opened.


# Ores

Orkullun:

![Orkullun Ore](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/561/1-png.png)

Orkullun is a metal found at most heights in Frostholm, with it being more common lower down. It can also be made by using an Iceology Wand on any Iron ore or block, making it renewable. It is used for many recipes in Iceology, it can be used as a trim material, and It can be made into decorative variants such as chains and Lanterns.

Chthonic Ice:

![Chthonic Ice](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/562/2-png.png)

Chthonic Ice is a semi-rare material found deeper in Frostholm. It is used for some higher end crafting recipes and as a modifier for weapons.

Mendrilite:

![Crafting Mendrilite](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/563/3-png.png)

This is an alloy metal made with Orkullun, Diamond, and Blizzard drops. It is used to make equipment, trim armor, and as decoration, coming in the same variants that Orkullun decorations do. Crafting Mendrilite with a basic Iceology Wand requires an Orkullun Ingot, Diamond, and Blizzard Rod, but if you make the Greater Iceology Wand, then you can make an ingot with a Block of Orkullun, Diamond, and Bottle of Freezing Heart.


# Items

Frost Handle:

 -This is an important item used in making Iceology Wands and Mendrilite tools. It can be crafted on the Iceology Table with two Coldglow Planks and an Orkullun Nugget.

Iceology Wand:

 -The most basic version of the Iceology Wands, this can be used to craft a limited number of items on the Iceology Table, such as more wand, Heated Lamps, and Mendrilite Nuggets. Its other uses include being able to convert some Overworld blocks to Iceology blocks or summon an Ice Chunk on an entity at a range.

Chthonic Ice Chunk:

 -Dropped from Chthonic Ice Ore, this item's primary use is to make Chthonic Ice for crafting, but you can apply to a weapon to grant it +0.5 Attack Damage and -0.1 Attack Speed.

Mendrilite Tools:

 -These tools, made from Mendrilite Ingots and Frost Handles, are pretty similar to Diamond, having slightly better stats and being able to repair themselves while the holder is in Frostholm.

Greater Iceology Wand:

 -An upgraded version of the Iceology Wand crafted from a Frost Handle, Mendrilite Ingot, and Chthonic Ice that can do more things, such as converting Blocks of Iron to blocks of Orkullun, modifying equipment, and making higher tier items in the Iceology Table.

Blizzard Rod:

 -A common drop from Blizzards that can be used to make Blizzard Charges, Blue Fabric, and Mendrilite Nuggets. Brewing this item with an Awkward Potion will make Potions of Freeze resistance.

Blizzard Charge:

 -A projectile item that acts like a Snowball. It will inflict the Frozen effect on an entity that is hit.

Bottle of Freezing Heart:

 -A valuable item that can be obtained by using a Glass Bottle on a Blizzard with less than one health point. It is used to make Mendrilite Ingots and Freezing Potions, along with being able to modify core armor, giving the +1 Max Health modifier. Consuming this item will give you a temporary extra Heart.

Blue Fabric:

 -A crafting ingredient made with Orkullun Nuggets, Blizzard Rods, and Blue Wool. Modifying a Chestplate with it will make the wearer immune to Powdered Snow damage.

Iceologer Robes:

 -This three-piece armor set will make you immune to Powdered Snow and the Frozen Effect. It is crafted using Orkullun and Blue Fabric.

Warm Key:

 -A key dropped from Iceologers or Trial Spawners used to unlock Chthonic Safes, Vaults, and Mountain Cabin Portals.

Frostbite Lighter:

 -The Frostholm Portal's igniter. It can be crafted on an Iceology Table with a Flint, Ancient Ice, and Orkullun.

Equipment Modifiers:

 -There are many items found in this mod that can be used to modify your existing Equipment, and many of them are found in Chthonic Safes, with the exceptions of a few craftable ones and Mendrilite Plating, which is dropped from hostile Frostcallers. Each has their own special abilities and they can stack.

Snowflake Banner Pattern:

 -A special banner pattern found in Iceologer Villages.

Smithing Templates:

 -This mod includes a new Armor Trim and Upgrade template:
 
  -The Chilly Armor Trim is found in Iceologer Villages
  
  -And the Chthonic Ice Upgrade is found in most structures

Music Disc:

 -A brand new Music Disc can be found in Iceologer Villages known as Verglas, composed by the Wicks!

Blade of Frostholm:

 -This is a craftable special weapon. It can Parry Attacks, and when you do parry it will make your next hit stronger.

Reshaping Glacier:

 -A craftable multitool that can mine most blocks that Pickaxes, Axes, Shovels, and Hoes can. It will change shape to match the block you are looking at.

New Painting:

 -A new Painting variant can be found in this mod called Abode. It depicts an Iceologer's house in Frostholm and is a 3x3 painting.

 
# New Enchantments

Frost:

 -A bow enchantment found in most places in Frostholm. It will freeze the target when they are hit with any arrow. Max level is I.

Glacial Speed:

 -This goes on Iceology Wand to reduce the cooldown between summoning Ice Chunks. Max level is III.

Ice Aspect:

 -A sword enchantment that freezes the target when struck, similar to Frost. Max level is II.

Icewoven:

 -A rare enchantment that allows Iceology Wands to repair themselves when held while the holder is in Frostholm. Max level is I.

Titan's Guard:

 -An enchantment for the Blade of Frostholm that further reduces the damage taken when blocking. Max level is III.

 
# Mobs

Iceologer:

![Iceologer](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/564/iceologer-png.png)

This illager calls Frostholm its home. They are found often in Iceologer Villages in Frostholm and Mountain Cabins in the Overworld, while also occasionally appearing in Raids.

Stats:

HP: 24

Atk: 20 (From Ice Chunk)

Def: 0

Drops:

 -1 Warm Key (20%)
 
 -1 Iceology Wand (Can be enchanted, 8.5%, increased with Looting)
 
 -1 Mountain Cabin Explorer Map (50%, only if in a Raid)

 

Blizzard:

![Blizzard](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/565/blizzard-png.png)

This is a frozen version of a Blaze that spawns in the Deepsnow Peaks of Frostholm. It has four Blizzard Charges floating around it, which it will shoot at a target. Once it runs out of Blizzard charges, it will try to attack the target with melee hits. If you use a Glass Bottle on this mob when it has less that one health remaining, then it will instantly kill the Blizzard and grant the player a bottle of Freezing Heart.

Stats:

HP: 20

Atk: 1 (Ranged), 6 (Melee)

Def: 0

Drops:

 -0-1 Blizzard Rod (+0-1 extra per level of Looting)

 

Frostcaller:

![Frostcaller](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/566/frostcaller-png.png)

The Frostcaller is a strong golem-like mob found in Frostholm or created by the player. It has two attacks: an occasional AOE slam attack and a melee attack. Hostile Frostcallers may drop the Medrilite Plating item modifier. You can heal player-created Frostcallers with Mendrilite Ingots.

Stats:

HP: 100

Atk: 19 (Slam), 11 (Melee)

Def: 0

Drops:

 -3-5 Orkullun Ingot
 
 -1 Bottle of Freezing Heart (33%)


 
# Biomes

Coldglow Woods:

![Coldglow Woods](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/568/cgw-png.png)

The Coldglow Woods is a common biome filled with Coldglow Trees, which can be used as normal wood or for crafting some special items.

Coldglow Woods Edge:

![Coldglow Woods Edge](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/569/cgwe-png.png)

A rare variant of the Coldglow Woods with small trees.

Everfrost Plain:

![Everfrost Plain](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/570/efp-png.png)

This is the most common biome in Frostholm. It contain more Snowcapped Grass thatn any other biome, and Coarse Permafrost is common here.

Deepsnow Peaks:

![Deepsnow Peaks](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/567/dsp-png.png)

This is an uncommon biome usually found in mountainous areas. Large floes of Ancient Ice spawn here, along with Blizzards.



# Structures

Mountain Cabin:

![Mountain Cabin](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/571/mc-png.png)

The Mountain Cabin is an uncommon Overworld structure found in Mountains. You can easily find this place by getting a map from an Iceologer in a Raid. The cabin usually consists of on main house with and Iceologer and a Vault in it, with a path leading to a ruined structure that houses a Frostholm portal and a Trial Spawner.

Frozen Chamber:

![Frozen Chamber](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/572/fc-png.png)

This is a common underground structure found in Frostholm. There is always one main room with a Chthonic safe that branches out into more rooms that can contain Trial Spawners, more Safes, or Orkullun Ore deposits.

Iceologer Village:

![Iceologer Village](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1435/573/iv-png.png)

An uncommon structure found on the surface of Frostholm. Many houses contain Iceology Tables, Chests, or Vaults, all of which can contain loot. A single Frostcaller spawns at the structure's center.

# Links


Report bugs [Here](https://discord.gg/65Y5pn2TAW)



Go to my [Youtube channel](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCuvzUmcTrqXztT7R1oJGQeg) for more updates and info.

title: Default Spawn Dimension
description: Set a dimension other than the overworld for players to initially spawn in. Configurable and modpack-friendly!
body:
Simple Minecraft mod to spawn players in a dimension other than the Overworld by default.

## Configuration

| Value               | Description                                                                                                             |
|---------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| startingDimension   | The resource location of the desired starting dimension.                                                                |
| specificCoordinates | Whether players should be spawned at specific coordinates in the dimension.                                             |
| spawnX              | The x coordinate to spawn players at if `specificCoordinates` is true.                                                  |
| spawnY              | The y coordinate to spawn players at if `specificCoordinates` is true.                                                  |
| spawnZ              | The z coordinate to spawn players at if `specificCoordinates` is true.                                                  |
| generatePlatform    | Whether a 3x3 platform should be generated under players if their first spawn is in the air.                            |
| platformBlockState  | The blockstate that `generatePlatform` uses to make the platform. Supports string format e.g. `minecraft:cake[bites=3]` |


## Platform-specific Notes
### Fabric
Changes to the configuration will be reflected immediately. The config is located in the `.minecraft/config/` folder.

### Forge
Changes to the configuration will be reflected immediately. The config is server-sided on Forge, meaning it's located inside the `.minecraft/saves/[WORLD_NAME]/serverconfigs/` folder. You can set a default value by placing a copy of the configuration you'd like to have in the `.minecraft/defaultconfigs/` folder.

body:
Mod Checker – Mod (Client)

Mod Checker – Mod  (Client) is the companion mod to the Mod Checker plugin, designed to ensure secure and transparent connections between players and servers. Acting as a verification layer during login, it communicates directly with the server to provide an accurate list of installed client mods.

When joining a server that uses Mod Checker, the client mod participates in a handshake process that shares your mod environment for validation. This allows the server to confirm compatibility and enforce its configured rules before gameplay begins.

The client itself does not block or manage mods locally. Instead, it focuses on providing reliable, tamper-resistant reporting so servers can make informed decisions about who is allowed to join.

Key Benefits

Seamless Verification – Automatically shares your installed mods during connection without extra setup
Fast & Lightweight – Minimal performance impact with a simple, focused purpose
Server Compatibility – Ensures you meet server requirements before fully joining
Fair Gameplay Support – Helps servers maintain balanced environments by enforcing mod policies

Mod Checker – Client is essential for servers that require mod verification, making connections smoother, more transparent, and more secure for everyone involved.

title: Pocket Gnomes
description: Three magical wands. Three specialized gnomes. Build, farm, and hunt with charming little helpers.
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3eb6725cd917fdbd019d9ac2a4d3f1f646690b88.png)
**Tiny magical helpers for building, farming, and hunting in Minecraft.**

Pocket Gnomes adds **three magical wands** that summon specialized gnome helpers:
a **Builder**, a **Farmer**, and a **Hunter**.

Simple to learn, fun to use, and perfect for players who want a little magical automation in their world.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/qjWi-y_WLZo" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

---

## What Is Pocket Gnomes?

**Pocket Gnomes** is a **Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11** that lets you command tiny magical workers with unique roles.

With the right wand, you can:

- summon a **Builder Gnome** to construct structures
- summon a **Farmer Gnome** to create and maintain farms
- summon a **Hunter Gnome** to fight mobs, hunt animals, and collect loot

Each wand has its own identity, custom model, and purpose.

---

## Features

### Builder Gnomes
Use the **Builder Wand** to select an area and choose a structure preset.

Your gnome will appear and start building for you.

Included default structure presets:

- Small House
- Large House
- Stone Fortress
- Cottage
- Workshop
- Manor

You can also add your own custom presets with `.nbt` files.

### Farmer Gnomes
Use the **Farmer Wand** to mark a farm area and choose a crop mode.

Your farmer gnome will:

- prepare the land
- place fences and a chest
- plant crops
- replant after harvesting
- keep the farm running automatically

Available farm modes:

- Mixed Farm
- Wheat
- Carrot
- Potato
- Oak Saplings
### Compatible with the Farmer's Delight Refabricated mod. 
### Additional resources:
- Beetroot
- Cabbage
- Onion
- Tomato
- Rice

### Hunter Gnomes
Use the **Hunter Wand** to summon a combat helper.

Your hunter gnome will:

- patrol near your position
- attack hostile mobs
- hunt selected animals
- pick up drops
- store loot in your **Ender Chest**

### Undo Support
Made a mistake?

Use:

`/gnome undo`

to revert the latest builder or farmer action.

### Custom Presets
Add your own building presets by placing `.nbt` files in:

`config/gnomebuilders/presets`

They will appear automatically in the Builder Wand menu.

### Optional Farmers Delight Support
Pocket Gnomes supports additional crop modes when compatible crops are available.

---

## Crafting Recipes

All three wands use simple **shapeless crafting recipes**.

### Builder Wand
- Stick
- Oak Planks
- Crafting Table

### Farmer Wand
- Stick
- Wheat Seeds
- Wheat

### Hunter Wand
- Stick
- String
- Feather

---

## How To Use

### Builder Wand
1. Right-click one block to set the first point.
2. Right-click another block to set the second point.
3. Right-click in the air.
4. Choose a structure preset.
5. Your Builder Gnome starts construction.

### Farmer Wand
1. Right-click one block to set the first point.
2. Right-click another block to set the second point.
3. Right-click in the air.
4. Choose a farm mode.
5. Your Farmer Gnome starts working.

### Hunter Wand
1. Right-click in the air.
2. A Hunter Gnome spawns near you.
3. It patrols, fights, gathers loot, and delivers it to your Ender Chest.

---

## Commands

- `/gnome kit` - gives all three wands
- `/gnome wand builder` - gives the Builder Wand
- `/gnome wand farmer` - gives the Farmer Wand
- `/gnome wand hunter` - gives the Hunter Wand
- `/gnome undo` - reverts the latest builder or farmer action
- `/gnome remove hunter` - removes your active hunter gnomes

---

## Important Notes

- Builder and farmer gnomes **currently do not consume player resources**
- Builder gnomes **clear the selected build area before construction**
- Hunter gnomes deposit loot into the **owner's Ender Chest**
- Requires **Fabric API**
- Designed for **Minecraft 1.21.11**

---

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.11
- **Loader:** Fabric
- **Dependency:** Fabric API
- **Optional compatibility:** Farmers Delight

---

## Why Pocket Gnomes?

Pocket Gnomes is built around a simple idea:

**small magical companions that make survival more fun without turning the game into a full tech mod.**

It is meant to feel readable, flavorful, and charming:
three wands, three roles, three little helpers.

title: Targeting
description: Adds a feature to allow users to execute the command on the target who used the redstone (requires a command block)
body:
# Targeting 🎯

## Execute commands on the actual player who triggered them.

## Overview

Targeting introduces a new selector, @t, designed to solve one of Minecraft’s long-standing limitations: reliably identifying the player who activated a redstone-triggered command.

In vanilla behavior, command blocks triggered by buttons, pressure plates, or other redstone inputs lack direct context about who caused the activation. This mod bridges that gap by dynamically binding the triggering player to command execution.

## Key Feature:
@t Selector
Targets the player responsible for triggering the command block, whether via:
Button press
Lever toggle
Pressure plate
Any redstone interaction linked to a command block

## Why This Matters?

Without Targeting, mapmakers and server developers often rely on:

- Proximity-based selectors (@p)
- Complex scoreboards
- Detection loops

These approaches are unreliable, inefficient, or unnecessarily complex.

@t provides precision, simplicity, and performance in a single selector.

Example Usage
Scenario: Teleport the player who pressed a button

Command Block Command:

/tp @t 100 100 100

What Happens:

Player presses a button connected to the command block
The command executes
Only that specific player is teleported to (100, 100, 100)
Comparison
Selector	Behavior
@p	Nearest player (can be incorrect)
@a	All players
@s	Command executor (not useful in redstone context)
@t	✅ Player who triggered the command

# World Accelerator

Adds a World Accelerator block that increases [Random tick](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Tick#Random_tick) and [Block entity tick](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Block_entity) rates.

## Features

- Increases [Random tick](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Tick#Random_tick) and [Block entity tick](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Block_entity) rates proportionally to redstone signal strength. By default, the World Accelerator is disabled (signal strength `0`) and the maximum speed is `15`.
- Mobs cannot spawn on top of the World Accelerator.
- Accelerates in a 3x3x3 radius, e.g. one block on each side and diagonal.

## Crafting

![Crafting recipe for one World Accelerator. In order, from top left to bottom right: Emerald, Eye of Ender, Emerald, Obsidian, Nether Star, Obsidian, Obsidian, Obsidian, Obsidian.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d679693512e77f28a65b27e08533d87d89b9725.png)

## Config

The following options are available through the config:

- **Enable crafting**: If `false`, disables crafting recipe.
- **Enable particles**: If `false`, disables particles when powered.

## Credits

- [Zokonius](https://github.com/Zokonius/Tile-Accelerators), for some of the TileAccelerator code.

title: Factorial: Nvidium
description: The Nvidium version of the modular Minecraft performance modpack; Factorial, that bundles the best optimization mods for every type of player; whether you prefer Sodium, OptiFine, Nvidium, or anything in between.
body:
# Factorial: Nvidium
### Optimization built for those who refuse to compromise.

![Base Game vs. Factorial](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2428525c5de699fa58e8da0a55509d37f030dbdd.png)

### Factorial: Nvidium performed 1,479% (15.79x) Better than the Base Game
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Before you begin: The Factorial team HIGHLY recommends users to [allocate more RAM](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kaCPKacNwDo) to the game, this helps the game to perform better interms of performance.**

**Factorial: Nvidium** is the cutting-edge version of the Factorial modpack, built around Nvidium as its core rendering enhancement. Designed exclusively for NVIDIA GPU users, this version pushes Minecraft's rendering performance further than any other version of Factorial can.

### Why Nvidium?
Nvidium leverages NVIDIA's mesh shader technology to completely bypass Minecraft's traditional chunk rendering pipeline. The result is a dramatic reduction in GPU draw calls and a massive FPS uplift, especially at high render distances where other solutions start to struggle. If you have the hardware to run it, nothing else comes close.

### Low-End & High-End Friendly
**Factorial: Nvidium** shines brightest on mid to high-end NVIDIA hardware, but it's not just for enthusiasts. Even on older NVIDIA cards that support mesh shaders, the reduced rendering overhead means more frames and smoother gameplay. High-end setups will see the biggest gains, especially when pushing high render distances or dense environments.

### What's Included?
Nvidium sits on top of Sodium, so you get all the benefits of Sodium's rendering engine plus Nvidium's mesh shader acceleration on top. The rest of the pack fills in the gaps: memory, lighting, entity performance, all ready to go out of the box.

### Compatibility
- ✅ NVIDIA GTX 16 series and above (mesh shader support required)
- ✅ Includes full Sodium + companion mod suite
- ⚠️ Iris Shaders **disable** the Nvidium rendered, causing a **massive** reduction in framerate.
- ⚠️ AMD/Intel GPU users should use a different Factorial version. Nvidium will not activate on non-NVIDIA hardware.

### Check out our alternative Factorial versions to suit your needs **(most of these versions support shaders)**:
- [**Factorial: OptiFine**](https://modrinth.com/project/factorial-optifine)
- [**Factorial: Sodium**](https://modrinth.com/project/factorial-sodium)
- [**Factorial: Vulkan**](https://modrinth.com/project/factorial-vulkan)

### Exclusive. Extreme. Unmatched. This is Factorial: Nvidium.

# NullBrand

**NullBrand** is an ultra-lightweight proxy plugin for **Velocity** that removes default proxy branding and provides a clean, configurable MOTD with full HEX color support.

Designed to be minimal, fast, and invisible.

[![promo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b2d8ef29d1458e1b973c60ff87028ecdb507dadf_0.webp)](https://client.teronastudios.com/)

[![discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c97c06e73051a5a1a196babde1652b0cac4b09f4.png)](https://discord.com/invite/88avyryBgt)

---

## ✨ Features

- 🔒 **F3 Branding Override**
  - Replace default proxy branding
  - Fully configurable
  - Supports legacy (`&`) and HEX colors

- 📝 **Custom MOTD**
  - Single or multi-line MOTD
  - HEX (`#RRGGBB`) and legacy color support
  - Applied instantly on ping

- 🔁 **Reload Command**
  - Reload configuration without restarting
  - Command: `/nullbrand reload`
  - Permission-based

- ⚡ **Extremely Lightweight**
  - No schedulers
  - No background tasks
  - No reflection
  - Minimal memory usage

---

## 📦 Requirements

- **Velocity** 3.3.0+
- **WaterFall, BungeeCord** 1.16+
- **Java** 17+

---

## 📂 Installation

1. Download the latest `NullBrand.jar`
2. Place it in your Velocity `plugins/` folder
3. Start the proxy once to generate the config
4. Edit `config.yml` to your liking
5. Reload using `/nullbrand reload`

---

## ⚙️ Configuration (`config.yml`)

```yml
# ---------------------------------------------------
# NullBrand Configuration
# Lightweight MOTD system
# ---------------------------------------------------

# Enables debug logging
debug: false

# ---------------------------------------------------
# MOTD SETTINGS
# ---------------------------------------------------
motd:

  # Enable MOTD control
  enabled: true

  # Active profile
  profile: "default"

  # Favicon file inside /plugins/NullBrand/favicons/
  favicon: "test.png"



# ---------------------------------------------------
# MOTD PROFILES
# ---------------------------------------------------
# NOTE: Hover will only work on Proxies, and it does not support HEX Colors!

profiles:

  # Global fallback profile
  global:
    lines:
      - "&7Welcome to our server"
      - "&fHave fun!"

  # Default server MOTD
  default:
    lines:
      - "&5Null&dBrand"
      - "&7This is line 2"
    hover:
      enabled: false
      lines:
        - "&7Welcome to &5Null&dBrand"
        - "&7Running powerful infrastructure"

  # Example event profile
  event:
    lines:
      - "&6Special Event Live!"
      - "&eJoin today!"
    hover:
      enabled: true
      lines:
        - "&6Limited time event"
        - "&eDon't miss it!"

```

### Power Rings
Enhance your Minecraft experience with powerful, wearable rings that grant unique passive abilities and game-changing active skills.

Power Rings introduces a tiered jewelry system. Whether you're looking for a permanent speed boost, a life-saving invulnerability shield, or a way to boost your AuraSkills XP, there is a ring for every playstyle.


### Key Features
Dual-Tier System: Choose between Silver rings for efficient utility or Golden rings for high-powered, high-risk abilities.

Passive & Active Skills: Every ring provides a permanent buff just by sitting in your inventory, plus a powerful ability triggered by right-clicking.

- Ruby: High speed and "Bloodlust" combat buffs.

- Diamond: Ultimate defense and brief invulnerability.

- Onyx: Mining efficiency and elemental fire resistance.

Survival-ready! Power Rings features a unique crafting progression using Enchanted Blocks.

title: VectorGuard
description: VectorGuard is a 100% server-side anti-cheat plugin focused exclusively on combat detection. It uses packet-level analysis, tick-based telemetry, and multi-signal detection to identify cheaters with high accuracy and minimal false positives.
body:
# VectorGuard

**Production-grade combat anti-cheat for Paper servers.**

VectorGuard is a 100% server-side anti-cheat plugin focused exclusively on **combat detection**. It uses packet-level analysis, tick-based telemetry, and multi-signal detection to identify cheaters with high accuracy and minimal false positives.

Built from the ground up for modern Paper servers (1.20.x–1.21.x) with Java 21.

---

## Product Overview

VectorGuard is a combat-only anti-cheat designed to catch the most common PvP exploits while staying light on performance and fair on legitimate players. Every check uses multiple independent signals (rotation, timing, movement, cooldown usage, and hit validation) and applies buffered violations with decay, so one-off spikes do not punish normal players. Ping-aware thresholds and packet-timing compensation reduce false positives for high-latency players.


Administrators get a fast response workflow: clickable in-game alerts with action buttons, a threat score that aggregates risk across checks, and a visual report command for quick evidence review. A built-in GUI lets staff adjust thresholds, toggle checks, and tune punishments without editing files or restarting the server. Alerts can also be mirrored to Discord for off-server monitoring.

VectorGuard ships as a single jar with no external dependencies. PacketEvents is embedded, and the plugin runs entirely server-side with no client mod required.

---


## Features

### Detection Engine
- **19 combat checks** targeting the most common cheat modules including Mace PvP exploits, crystal PvP automation, bow manipulation, and inventory exploits
- **Multi-signal compound detection** — each check combines multiple independent signals for high confidence
- **Buffered violation system** with configurable decay — prevents single-tick flukes from triggering punishments
- **Latency compensation** — all checks account for player ping to avoid false-flagging high-ping players
- **Tick-based analytics** with per-player position history and rotation profiling

### Admin Experience
- **Clickable chat alerts** with action buttons: `[TP]` `[VL]` `[DBG]` `[RPT]`
- **Threat score system** — composite 0–100% risk assessment across all checks
- **Visual threat reports** via `/vg report <player>`
- **Sound alerts** for online admins (configurable)
- **Discord webhook integration** for off-server monitoring
- **In-game GUI** for editing thresholds, toggling checks, and tuning punishments

### Architecture
- **100% server-side** — no client mod required
- **PacketEvents** embedded and shaded — zero external dependencies
- **Modular check system** — each check is independent and fully configurable
- **Performance profiler** built-in (`/vg profile`)
- **Multi-version support** — Paper 1.20.x through 1.21.x

---

## Checks

### Combat

| Check | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Aimbot** | Detects snap rotations, acceleration spikes, over-smooth curves, and precision patterns consistent with aim assistance |
| **TriggerBot** | Identifies automated attack timing with near-zero reaction delay after crosshair alignment |
| **AutoTotem** | Catches unrealistically fast offhand totem swaps during lethal damage windows |
| **Reach** | Eye-to-hitbox distance verification with ping, sprint, and movement leniency |
| **Velocity** | Detects Anti-Knockback by verifying displacement after server-sent velocity packets |
| **Criticals** | Identifies fake critical hits via spoofed position packets (abnormal crit rate, ground-flag oscillation, tiny Y offsets) |
| **AutoClicker** | Catches robotic click patterns through timing variance analysis (stddev, CPS, coefficient of variation) |
| **KillAura** | Detects multi-target attacks, angle mismatch, wall attacks, and perfect cooldown abuse |
| **Sprint** | Identifies backwards sprinting, KeepSprint, and sprint-toggle patterns around attacks |
| **MaceSpoof** | Detects spoofed fall-distance position packets for fake Mace smash damage (Criticals-Mace exploit) |
| **MaceNoFall** | Catches NoFall + Mace combos: players deal Mace fall-bonus damage but evade fall damage on landing |
| **MaceSwap** | Identifies automated weapon switching to Mace during falls (AttributeSwap / auto-swap patterns) |
| **CrystalAura** | Detects automated crystal place-and-break cycles (superhuman crystal attacks/sec, place→break pairing, fast-break ratio) |
| **BowManipulation** | Catches BowSpam and BowAimbot via charge variance analysis, fire rate, and abnormal hit rates at distance |
| **InventoryCleaner** | Identifies inhuman inventory manipulation speed (AutoTotem swaps, chest stealing, combat inventory use) |
| **AutoWeapon** | Detects automated weapon switching around attacks (pre-attack swap ratio, A→B→A swap-back patterns) |
| **HitboxExpand** | Catches expanded entity hitboxes via lateral offset analysis and edge-hit rate tracking |
| **AutoArmor** | Detects automated armor equipping during combat (rapid armor clicks, anti-break durability swaps) |

### Packet

| Check | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Timer** | Detects game speed manipulation via packet rate analysis (burst, sustained, and average rate monitoring) |

---

## Requirements

- **Java 21+**
- **Paper 1.20.x – 1.21.x** (or forks: Purpur, Pufferfish, etc.)
- No external dependencies — PacketEvents is embedded

---

## Installation

1. Download `VectorGuard-x.y.z.jar`
2. Place it in your server's `plugins/` folder
3. Start or restart the server
4. Edit `plugins/VectorGuard/config.yml` to customize thresholds
5. Use `/vg reload` to apply changes without restarting

---

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/vg reload` | Reload configuration |
| `/vg debug <player\|*>` | Toggle debug output for a player (or all) |
| `/vg vl <player>` | View violation levels |
| `/vg report <player>` | Generate a visual threat report |
| `/vg gui` | Open the in-game config editor |
| `/vg profile [seconds]` | Run performance profiler |

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|------------|---------|-------------|
| `vectorguard.admin` | op | Access to all `/vg` commands and GUI |
| `vectorguard.alert` | op | Receive in-game cheat alerts with action buttons |
| `vectorguard.debug.view` | op | View debug output |
| `vectorguard.report` | true | Allows using `/vg report` to generate threat reports |

---

## Configuration

All settings are in `plugins/VectorGuard/config.yml`.

### Check Configuration
Each check has:
- `enabled` — toggle the check on/off
- `buffer-threshold` — buffer must exceed this to flag
- `buffer-decay-per-tick` — buffer decreases each tick
- `vl-per-breach` — violation level added per flag
- `vl-decay-per-tick` — VL decreases each tick
- `thresholds.*` — check-specific tuning values

### Punishment Stages
```yaml
punishments:
  alert-vl: 2.5      # Send alert to admins
  setback-vl: 6.0     # Teleport player to last safe position
  punish-vl: 12.0     # Execute punishment command
  punish-command: "kick %player% Unfair combat behavior detected by VectorGuard."
```

### Discord Webhooks
```yaml
notifications:
  discord:
    enabled: true
    webhook-url: "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/..."
    min-vl: 5.0
    cooldown-ms: 10000
```

### Admin Alerts
```yaml
notifications:
  admin:
    sound-enabled: true
    clickable-actions: true
    show-threat-score: true
```

---

## GUI Config Editor

Run `/vg gui` to open an interactive GUI where you can:
- Toggle checks on/off
- Edit buffer thresholds and VL values
- Adjust punishment thresholds and cooldowns
- Save changes to config and reload

---

## FAQ

**Q: Does this require players to install anything?**
A: No. VectorGuard is 100% server-side.

**Q: Is PacketEvents required as a separate plugin?**
A: No. PacketEvents is embedded inside the VectorGuard jar.

**Q: Does it work with Purpur/Pufferfish/other Paper forks?**
A: Yes, any Paper fork should work.

**Q: Will it conflict with other anti-cheats?**
A: VectorGuard focuses only on combat. It can coexist with movement-focused anti-cheats, but running two combat anti-cheats may cause duplicate flagging.

**Q: How do I reduce false positives?**
A: Increase the `buffer-threshold` and `ping-cutoff-ms` values for checks that are flagging incorrectly. The defaults are tuned conservatively.

title: Botz Guild Manager
description: A mod for MMO style guild managment
body:
BotzGuildz — In-Depth Guild System for Forge Servers
BotzGuildz is a comprehensive, server-focused guild mod for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1. It goes far beyond simple group management — offering guild wars, arena battles, a fully datapack-driven upgrade shop, raid parties, duels, leaderboards, and deep economy integration. Whether you're running a small survival server or a large factions-style community, BotzGuildz gives your players something to work toward together.

🏰 Guilds
Create a guild with a custom name and tag, recruit members, and build your reputation. Guilds earn XP through logins, kills, and war victories — leveling up to unlock more powerful upgrades. Every action is logged in a persistent activity log so leaders always know what's happening.

Custom name + short tag shown in guild chat
Shared guild home teleport with configurable cooldown
Guild Message of the Day (MOTD)
Guild-only and officer-only chat channels (/gc, /goc)
Persistent activity log (last 50 events)
Level 1–25 progression system (configurable cap)
🎖️ Ranks & Permissions
Go beyond "leader/member" with a fully custom rank system. Create as many ranks as you want, assign them any priority, and grant them exactly the permissions they need — nothing more.

Permission nodes: INVITE · KICK · SET_HOME · MANAGE_RANKS · MANAGE_BANK · MANAGE_UPGRADES · MANAGE_ALLIES · DECLARE_WAR · TOGGLE_FF

Default ranks (Leader, Officer, Member, Recruit) are fully customizable and can be supplemented with as many custom ranks as your server needs.

💰 Guild Bank & Economy
Every guild has a shared bank that funds upgrades, wars, and alliances. The bank integrates with Numismatics if installed, or falls back to a built-in physical-item currency system.

Deposit, withdraw, and check balance at any time
Configurable bank cap (upgradeable to 2× or 3× via upgrades)
War wagers are automatically escrowed — locked until the war resolves
All transactions logged to guild history
⚔️ Guild Wars
Declare war on any guild, stake a currency wager, and fight for dominance. Choose your battlefield:

Open World — PvP happens anywhere. No time limit. First guild to deplete the opponent's total lives wins.

Arena Mode — Both guilds teleport into the dedicated guild_arena dimension. A Roman Colosseum is generated automatically. Fight for 5 minutes (configurable). Highest kill count wins.

Configurable lives per player, wager amounts, and cooldowns
War declarations require the opposing guild to accept within 120 seconds
Forfeit option — with the REDUCED_LOSS upgrade, you keep 25% of your wager even when losing
War wins reward the guild with XP and the full escrow pot
🧪 Upgrade System (Datapack-Driven)
The upgrade shop is a fully interactive GUI — a 6-row chest interface with category tabs, multi-page browsing, and live balance display. All upgrades are loaded from datapacks, making the system completely server-customizable without any code changes.

Built-in upgrade categories:

Category	Examples
⚔️ Combat	Damage Boost I/II, Defense I/II, Arena War
🔧 Utility	Member Cap I/II, Chunk Claims, Home Bypass
💰 Economy	Earn Rate I/II, Bank Cap I/II, War Shield
🛡️ Defense	XP Bonus I/II, Reduced War Loss
🔮 Arcane	Alliance System, Custom Chat Color
Upgrade effect types: passive stat modifiers, one-time item rewards, potion effects on purchase, and server command execution. All defined in JSON — no coding required.

🗂️ Full Datapack Guide is available in the wiki — create your own upgrade categories and upgrades with a few JSON files.

🤝 Alliances
Unlock the ALLIANCE upgrade and start forming partnerships with other guilds. Allied guilds cannot hurt each other and are visible in guild info. Maximum alliance count is configurable.

🐉 Raid Parties
Form a raid party before taking on a powerful boss — then let the system handle the rest. Any mob with 50+ hearts (100 HP) of max health automatically qualifies as a boss target. Works with vanilla bosses and any modded mob tuned to that threshold.

Form a party with /raid party create, invite with /raid party invite <player>
First party member to hit the boss claims it for the group
Damage is tracked per player throughout the entire fight
On boss death: normal drops are cancelled and redistributed proportionally by damage dealt
Each player receives their share directly in their inventory
Full summary message: damage dealt, percentage, and item count received
Use /raid party status to see live damage numbers mid-fight
🤺 Duels
Challenge any player to a 1v1 duel with configurable lives and an optional currency wager. A radius enforcement system keeps both players honest — flee the arena and you auto-forfeit.

Optional currency stakes with automatic pot payout to the winner
Configurable lives (1 to 999), accept timeout, and radius limit
Global duel win leaderboard (/duel top)
📊 Leaderboards
/guild top — Top 10 guilds by bank balance
/guild top wars — Top 10 guilds by war wins
/duel top — Top 10 players by duel wins (resolves offline player names)
🔗 FTB Chunks Integration (Optional)
If FTB Chunks is installed, the CHUNK_CLAIM_I and CHUNK_FORCE_LOAD upgrades automatically sync extra claim and force-load slots to the guild's FTB team.

⚙️ Highly Configurable
Nearly every value is adjustable in botzguildz-server.toml:

Currency name, symbol, and item
XP rates for kills, logins, and war wins
Max guild level, member cap, bank cap
War accept timeout, war cooldown, arena duration
Duel timeout and radius
Alliance cap, home cooldown, and more
📋 Requirements
Minecraft: 1.20.1
Forge: 47.4.16+
Java: 17+
FTB Chunks: Optional — for chunk-claim upgrade integration
📖 Wiki & Documentation
Full documentation is available on the GitHub Wiki, including:

Complete command reference
Datapack guide with JSON examples
Configuration reference
Upgrade system details
Built for server communities that want more than just a /clan command.

title: Gotta Grind 'Em All
description: A mod to grind and farm Cobblemon
body: # Gotta Grind 'Em All A mod to grind and farm Cobblemon *** ## Items & Blocks ### Cobblemon Egg Use on Grass, Dirt, Mycelium, or Farmland to convert a 5x5 area into Cobblemon Dirt. Consumed on use. Does not stack. ### Cobblemon Dirt A block that periodically spawns random Cobblemon when the light level above it is 10 or higher and the space above is clear. Up to 8 mon can exist in an 11x5x11 area before spawning stops. Spawn rarity is controlled by configurable bucket weights (see [Configuration](#configuration)). Stacks to 64. #### Redstone Integration Cobblemon Dirt responds to redstone signals: * **Constant ON signal**: Disables natural spawning. The block will not spawn any mon while powered. * **Rising edge (signal turns on)**: Forces an immediate spawn attempt, ignoring the normal timer. This allows redstone clocks and pulse circuits to control spawn timing precisely. This means you can use a redstone clock to trigger spawns on demand, or power the block to pause spawning entirely. With [Jade](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jade) installed, the tooltip will show "Spawning Disabled via Redstone" when the block is powered. ### Pocket Chow Use on a Cobblemon to trigger an explosive reaction. The mon floats upward for about 1 second, then explodes with a creeper death sound and particles, dropping a **Cobblemon Egg**. Does not stack. #### Recipe The recipe changes depending on whether Mob Grinding Utils is installed. **Without Mob Grinding Utils** (default): | Slot |Ingredient | | ---- |------------------------------------------- | | B |Bottle o' Enchanting | | A |Any Apricorn (from cobblemon:apricorns tag) | | S |Any Seeds (from c:seeds tag) | ``` B A B A S A B A B ``` **With Mob Grinding Utils** installed: | Slot |Ingredient | | ---- |------------------------------------------------- | | B |Experience Fluid (1000 mB, from c:experience tag) | | A |Any Apricorn (from cobblemon:apricorns tag) | | S |Any Seeds (from c:seeds tag) | ``` B A B A S A B A B ``` ![Recipe](https://github.com/BoboFraggins/GottaGrindEmAll/blob/main/wiki/pocket_chow_recipe.gif?raw=true) ### Cobblemon Filter Glass (Inclusion, Any) A glass block that **only Cobblemon can pass through**. Players and other mobs are blocked. Periodically grounds nearby flying Cobblemon so that fans and other forced-movement devices work correctly. #### Recipe ![Inclusion Glass (Any) Recipe](https://github.com/BoboFraggins/GottaGrindEmAll/blob/main/wiki/inclusion_any_recipe.gif?raw=true) | Slot | Ingredient | |------|------------| | G | Vanilla Glass | | A | Any Apricorn (from `cobblemon:apricorns` tag) | ``` G G G G A G G G G ``` Produces 8 Inclusion Filter Glass (Any). --- ### Cobblemon Filter Glass (Exclusion, Any) A glass block that **blocks all Cobblemon** while letting players and other mobs pass through freely. Periodically grounds nearby flying Cobblemon so that fans and other forced-movement devices work correctly. #### Recipe ![Exclusion Glass (Any) Recipe](https://github.com/BoboFraggins/GottaGrindEmAll/blob/main/wiki/exclusion_any_recipe.png?raw=true) | Slot | Ingredient | |------|------------| | I | Inclusion Filter Glass (Any) | | L | Lava Bucket | ``` I I I I L I I I I ``` Produces 8 Exclusion Filter Glass (Any). --- ### Cobblemon Filter Glass (Typed) Type-specific variants of the filter glass blocks. There are 18 types matching Cobblemon's elemental types: Normal, Fire, Water, Grass, Electric, Ice, Fighting, Poison, Ground, Flying, Psychic, Bug, Rock, Ghost, Dragon, Dark, Steel, and Fairy. - **Inclusion (typed)**: Only Cobblemon of the matching type can pass through. All others are blocked. - **Exclusion (typed)**: Cobblemon of the matching type are blocked. Everything else passes through freely. #### Recipe ![Typed Glass Recipe](https://github.com/BoboFraggins/GottaGrindEmAll/blob/main/wiki/typed_glass_recipe.gif?raw=true) | Slot | Ingredient | |------|------------| | G | Inclusion or Exclusion Filter Glass (Any) | | C | Type Gem matching the desired type (e.g. `cobblemon:fire_gem`) | ``` G G G G C G G G G ``` Produces 8 typed filter glass of the corresponding variant (inclusion or exclusion) and type. --- ## Configuration Server-side configuration is found in `gottagrindemall-server.toml`. | Setting |Default |Description | | ------------------------------------- |------- |-------------------------------------------- | | allow_shiny |true |Allow shiny mon to spawn from Cobblemon Dirt | | spawn_weights.common_spawn_weight |100.0 |Weight for common mon spawns | | spawn_weights.uncommon_spawn_weight |10.0 |Weight for uncommon mon spawns | | spawn_weights.rare_spawn_weight |5.0 |Weight for rare mon spawns | | spawn_weights.ultra_rare_spawn_weight |1.0 |Weight for ultra-rare mon spawns | Spawn weights are normalized so the total equals 100%. For example, setting common=2, uncommon=1, rare=1, ultra\_rare=1 means 40% common and 20% each for the other tiers. Set a weight to 0 to disable that tier entirely.

a realism modpack focused on acting like a realism modpack, but not everything being about real life.

# what this modpack brings?
this modpack has a strong leaning towards Tinker's Construct and Create, it is _**Strongly**_ recommended to understand how these mods works first. _(or use TconJEI, Create's Ponder or even Tinker's Construct/Create wiki)_
additionally, other notable mods would be Sophis backpacks, Petite Inventory, First Aid, Paraglider, Parcool, dyeable redstone, hardcore revival co-op, TaCZ, Alternative Earlygame _(affects furnace recipe)_, Chalk, Dye Depot _(adds more dye colors)_, and other mods i thought would possibly fit.

# How is it played?
1. _**(Normally, this mod was made with Hardcore in mind, but i suggest a regular world to learn a bit of the mod yourself.)**_
1. with mods like First Aid, it becomes considerably harder to go just tanking ever.
1. additionally, this mod also contains mods that makes early game stage last longer, since now you cant just punch trees and get wood; you'll now need a **axe** to do that, and a **saw** to cut it into planks.
1. after crafting your first **pickaxe**, mine some iron ores, then use a **Crushing Hammer** to crush them to pieces, later smelt them on a campfire to get **nuggets**, which can be combined with clay to craft **reinforced clay**; then **reinforced bricks**, then finally, the furnace.
1. from the spoken warning early, most of your proggresion is tinkers: but you should also explore and craft other items that will help you, like **Spirit Orbs** that can be used to increase max hp and stamina that is used to do parkour, for example.
1. additionally, with the Thirst mechanic and well, water states, you must clean up the water by boiling it in a campfire or furnace, to avoid obtaining sickness while hydrating.
1. craft a **backpack**, upgrade it so it can include more automation (not for more item slots, sadly.) and a **tool belt** that helps with carrying your unstackable items.

Tired of throwing away Poisonous Potatoes? Bored of the standard Bow and Crossbow? The Potato Cannon Mod introduces a high-quality, 3D-modeled launcher that turns your farm produce into heavy artillery. It fits perfectly into the vanilla style while adding a fun, explosive twist to combat.

title: EasyPortal
description: EasyPortal Mod revolutionizes Minecraft travel by enabling custom-shaped, PIN-secured portals with seamless 1:1 linking through an intuitive in-game GUI.
body:
⚡ EasyPortal

EasyPortal revolutionizes Minecraft travel by enabling custom-shaped, PIN-secured portals with seamless 1:1 linking through an intuitive in-game GUI.

Built for Minecraft 1.21.1 on Fabric — by SoloDev

✨ Features

🎨 Portal Shape Designer

  • 16×16 Grid Editor — Draw any portal frame shape you want, block by block.
  • Left-Click to draw, Right-Click to erase — supports click-and-drag painting.
  • Inventory-Aware — The block palette is sourced directly from your inventory. Choose any block you have as the frame material.
  • Reset Canvas button to start fresh at any time.

🔗 Portal Linking

  • OneWay — Teleport to a saved coordinate destination (one-directional exit).
  • Bidirectional Link — Create a two-way connection between two portals.
  • 1:1 Exclusive Linking — Each portal can only be linked to one other portal at a time. No multi-linking allowed.
  • Automatic Destination Resolution — Link portals by name; the mod resolves coordinates automatically.

🔒 Security System

  • Private Portals — Mark any portal as private to restrict access.
  • PIN Code Protection — Set a numeric PIN that guests must enter via a pop-up GUI.
  • Session-Based Auth — Enter the PIN once per session; no re-entry until you disconnect.
  • Owner Bypass — Portal owners always pass through without being prompted.
  • Admin Bypass — Server operators (OP Level 2+) or players with easyportal.admin can bypass all PIN gates.
  • Shared PIN for Links — When linking two portals, a PIN set on one side is automatically shared with the linked portal.
  • Auth Cooldown — After cancelling the PIN prompt, it won't re-appear instantly. A cooldown triggers before the prompt shows again.

🌈 Portal Colors

  • 9 Built-In Colors: Cyan, Purple, Red, Green, Blue, Magenta, Yellow, Orange, Pink.
  • Hex Color Picker — Use the advanced color picker in the GUI to set any custom RGB hex color for portal particles and gateway blocks.
  • Animated Portal Gateway — Each portal has a custom-rendered, translucent animated block with your chosen color.

👻 Preview & Placement

  • Ghost Preview — After designing your portal, a translucent holographic outline follows your crosshair showing exactly where it will be built.
  • Rotation — Press [R] to rotate the portal (North → East → South → West).
  • Orientation Toggle — Press [Middle Mouse] to switch between Vertical (wall) and Horizontal (floor/ceiling) alignment.
  • Right-Click to Confirm — Place the portal with a right-click.
  • Left-Click to Cancel — Abort placement at any time.
  • Block Requirements HUD — While placing, a live checklist on the left of the screen shows required blocks vs. what you have (e.g., Dirt 4/5). Missing blocks are highlighted.
  • Key Hints HUD — On-screen hints on the right side remind you of all placement controls.

⚙️ Behavior Settings

  • Teleport Cooldown — Set a 0–60 second cooldown between consecutive teleports per portal (slider in the GUI).
  • Entity Teleportation — Toggle "Allow Mobs / Items / Entities" to let non-player entities (mobs, dropped items, etc.) pass through portals.
  • Resistance Buff — Players receive 3 seconds of Resistance V after teleporting, preventing fall damage.
  • Teleport Effects — Particles and ender teleport sound play at both origin and destination.
  • Dimension Overlay — When teleporting across dimensions, a colored screen overlay effect (matching portal color) fades in and out.

📋 Portal Network Dashboard

  • Open with [Right Shift] or /easyportal gui.
  • Portal List — View all your portals in a sleek, searchable table.
  • Search — Filter portals by name, owner, or destination.
  • Delete — Remove portals with a confirmation popup.
  • "+ NEW PORTAL" button to jump directly into the Portal Designer.
  • Admin View — Admins can see and manage all players' portals.

🌍 Cross-Dimension Support

  • Portals work across all dimensions — Overworld, Nether, End, and modded dimensions.
  • Destinations store dimension identifiers and resolve them at teleport time.

🏗️ Survival Friendly

  • Portal frames consume blocks from your inventory in Survival mode.
  • Creative mode bypasses block requirement checks.

🛡️ Frame Integrity

  • Automatic Destruction — If a player breaks a block that is part of a portal's frame, the portal is destroyed and the player is notified.
  • Periodic Validation — When validateFrame is enabled in the config, the server periodically checks portal integrity and removes broken portals.

🗂️ Configuration

The mod generates easyportal.json in the config directory with the following options:

OptionDefaultDescription
defaultPortalLimit5Maximum number of portals per player.
enableClaimProtectiontruePrevents building portals in claimed areas.
validateFramefalseEnables periodic server-side frame integrity checks.

🚀 Installation

  1. Install Minecraft 1.21.1 with Fabric Loader (≥ 0.18.4).
  2. Install Fabric API.
  3. Download easyportal-1.21.1.jar and place it in your .minecraft/mods folder.
  4. Launch the game!

📖 How to Use

1. Open the Portal Dashboard

  • Press the default keybind: [Right Shift]
  • Or run the command: /easyportal gui

This opens the Portal Network Dashboard where you can view all your portals, search, delete, or create new ones.

2. Create a New Portal

Click "+ NEW PORTAL" in the dashboard to open the Portal Designer. The designer has two panels:

Left Panel — Shape Editor

  • Draw your portal frame on the 16×16 grid.
  • Left-Click (or drag) to paint blocks. Right-Click (or drag) to erase.
  • Select your frame block from the Frame Material section (sourced from your inventory).

Right Panel — Configuration

The configuration sidebar has 5 collapsible sections:

1. Identity & Network

  • Portal Name — Give your portal a unique name.
  • Network Mode — Choose Oneway (Exit Only) or Bidirectional Link.
  • Target Destination — Select from available destinations/portals.

2. Gateway Aura

  • Atmosphere Tint — Pick a color for portal particles and blocks using the color picker.

3. Frame Material

  • Browse and select any block from your inventory as the portal frame.

4. Security

  • Private Portal checkbox — Restricts access.
  • Portal PIN — Required when private is enabled. Guests must enter this PIN.
  • When linking to a portal that already has a PIN, the existing PIN is automatically shared.

5. Behavior

  • Teleport Cooldown — Slider from 0 to 60 seconds.
  • Allow Mobs / Items / Entities — Enable entity pass-through.

3. Preview & Place

  1. Click "PREVIEW & PLACE" to close the designer and enter placement mode.
  2. A ghost outline of your portal appears at your crosshair.
  3. Rotate: Press [R].
  4. Toggle Orientation: Press [Middle Mouse Button] to switch between wall and floor/ceiling.
  5. Confirm: Right-Click to build the portal.
  6. Cancel: Left-Click to abort.
Note: In Survival, you must have the required blocks in your inventory. The block requirement HUD on screen shows what you have vs. what's needed.

4. Using Portals

Simply walk into the portal gateway blocks to teleport. The mod detects your position and triggers teleportation automatically.

  • Public portals — Anyone can use them.
  • Private portals — A PIN entry GUI appears. Enter the correct PIN to unlock.
  • Once authenticated, you won't be prompted again until you log out (session-based).

5. Managing Destinations

Create standalone coordinate destinations for OneWay portals using commands:

CommandDescription
/easyportal setDest <name>Saves your current position as a destination.
/easyportal delDest <name>Deletes a saved destination (with tab-completion).

These destinations appear in the Portal Designer's Target Destination dropdown when using OneWay mode.

6. Managing Portals

  • View: Open the dashboard with [Right Shift].
  • Search: Use the search bar to filter by portal name, owner, or destination.
  • Delete: Click the DEL button next to any portal, then confirm.
  • Auto-Destruction: Breaking a frame block in-world destroys the portal automatically.

🤝 Permissions

PermissionLevelDescription
easyportal.adminOP 2+Bypass PIN protection, view & manage all players' portals.

🛠️ Dependencies

DependencyVersion
Minecraft1.21.1
Fabric Loader≥ 0.18.4
Fabric APIAny
Java≥ 21

⌨️ Default Keybinds

KeyAction
Right ShiftToggle Portal Dashboard
RRotate portal during placement
Middle MouseToggle vertical/horizontal orientation during placement
Right-ClickConfirm portal placement
Left-ClickCancel portal placement
ESCClose any GUI

Created by SoloDev ⚡

title: VillagerSociety
description: Revolutionize Your SMP's Economy & Roleplay
body:
🏙️ VillagerSociety

![VillagerSociety](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/876fbc154627e00017154801fb7e3fc61de0012f_0.webp)

Revolutionize Your SMP's Economy & Roleplay

Are you tired of players locking villagers in 1x1 cells? Sick of the "cure-spam" exploit ruining your economy? VillagerSociety transforms villagers from simple vending machines into living, breathing entities with needs, schedules, and standards.
Designed specifically for Survival Multiplayer (SMP) servers, this plugin adds depth, realism, and balance to villager interactions.

**✨ Key Features**

**🕒 Realistic Work Schedules**

![VillagerShift](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b00ade4fc95037b38a4b1a7f3cb25dbbf77c359_0.webp)

Villagers are no longer available 24/7. They now follow a configurable schedule (Default: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM).

- Players must visit during working hours to trade.
- Adds immersion and time-management gameplay.
- Configurable open/close times.

**🏠 Housing Standards (Anti-Trading Hall)**

Stop the abuse! Villagers will refuse to trade if their living conditions are poor.

- Space Requirements: Villagers check for open air blocks around them. No more 1x1 cells!
- Light Access: Villagers require access to light (sky or block light) to feel comfortable enough to trade.
- Encourages players to build actual villages and houses.

**🌑 The Night Market (Illegal Traders)**

When the sun goes down, the Night Market begins.

- Mysterious Spawns: A "Night Market Trader" (Wandering Trader) spawns randomly at night.
- Rare Loot: Configurable trades for rare items or high-level enchanted books.
- Risk vs. Reward: These traders are considered criminals! Iron Golems will actively hunt and attack them, adding dynamic events to your towns.
- Visuals: Traders can glow to be spotted in the dark.

**🧠 Zombie Trauma (Economy Fix)**

Fix the vanilla "Cure Exploit" without removing the mechanic entirely.

- Trauma System: If a player cures a villager too many times (configurable threshold), the villager suffers Trauma.
- Consequences: Instead of lowering prices, prices will skyrocket due to the stress of repeated zombification.
- Balances the economy by preventing infinite 1-emerald trades.

**📜 Trade Licenses**

Add RPG progression to your server.

- Optionally require players to hold a physical Trade License item in their inventory to interact with villagers.
- Great for roleplay servers or locking trading behind a quest/payment.
  
**⚙️ In-Game Admin GUI**

![AdminGui Settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88432a72bf20e01a5a86036547a65786095a46cd.png)
No need to dig through config files for simple changes.

- Run /vs settings to open a sleek GUI.
- Toggle modules (Housing, Night Market, Schedules, etc.) instantly.
Adjust work hours with a click.
- Disable specific professions (e.g., ban Librarians) easily.
  
**📸 Commands & Permissions**

Commands

- /vs settings - Open the Admin Configuration GUI.
- /vs getlicense - Spawns a Trade License item for the player.
- /vs spawnillegal - Force spawns a Night Market trader at your location.
- /vs reload - Reloads the configuration files.

Permissions

- villagersociety.admin - Access to the settings GUI.
- villagersociety.getlicense - Ability to spawn a license.
- villagersociety.spawnillegal - Ability to force spawn the illegal trader.
- villagersociety.reload - Ability to reload the plugin.
- villagersociety.bypass - Bypass work schedule restrictions.
- villagersociety.bypass.housing - Bypass housing requirements.

**📂 Configuration**

- VillagerSociety is highly configurable. You can tweak:
- Schedules: Set exact open and close times.
- Housing: Define how many air blocks are required.
- Trauma: Set the cure threshold and price multiplier.
- Night Market: Customize the items sold, prices, and currency (Emeralds, Diamonds, etc.).
- Messages: Full language file support for custom messages
