title: Spyglass Custom Scopes
description: Сustom Spyglass Scope is a Fabric mod that allows you to change the spyglass scope texture using CustomModelData and resource packs.
body:
## 📘 Description

### 🔭 Custom Spyglass Scope

<details>
<summary>Ru</summary>

**Custom Spyglass Scope** — это лёгкий клиентский Fabric-мод, который позволяет **заменять стандартный скоуп подзорной трубы** на пользовательские текстуры **через CustomModelData**, без конфигов, JSON-файлов и сложной логики.

Мод идеально подходит для:
- ресурспаков
- RPG / PvP серверов
- кастомных предметов
- OptiFine-подобного поведения, но нативно

---

### ✨ Возможности

- 🔁 Замена скоупа по **CustomModelData**
- 🧩 Полностью ванильный рендер (без кастомных шейдеров)
- 📦 Управление через **ресурспак**
- ⚡ Минимальное влияние на производительность
- 🛡 Без конфликтов с другими HUD-эффектами

---

### 🛠 Как пользоваться

#### 1️⃣ Установите мод
- Установите **Fabric Loader >= 0.18.4**
- Поместите мод в папку `mods`

---

#### 2️⃣ Добавьте текстуры в ресурспак

Структура ресурсов:

```

assets/custom_scope/
└── textures/
└── gui/
└── custom_scope/
├── img.png
├── sniper.png
└── example.png

```

---

#### 3️⃣ Назначьте CustomModelData предмету

Мод использует **строковый CustomModelData**, который должен состоять из:

```

<mod_id>_<texture_name>

````

Пример:
- `custom_scope` — **Mod ID**
- `img` — **имя текстуры**

Команда выдачи подзорной трубы:

```mcfunction
/give @p minecraft:spyglass[CustomModelData:{strings:["custom_scope_img"]}]
````

📌 В этом случае будет использована текстура:

```
assets/custom_scope/textures/gui/custom_scope/img.png
```

---

### 🔄 Поведение

* Если CustomModelData соответствует формату `<mod_id>_<texture_name>` → используется **кастомный скоуп**
* Если формат не совпадает → используется **ванильный скоуп**
* Если текстура отсутствует → **краша не будет**

---

### 🎨 Текстура по умолчанию

Мод **уже содержит одну встроенную текстуру скоупа** для примера.

Чтобы получить подзорную трубу с ней, используйте:

```mcfunction
/give @p minecraft:spyglass[CustomModelData:{strings:["custom_scope_img"]}]
```

---

### 💡 Примечание

Мод **не добавляет новые предметы** и **не изменяет механику игры** — он лишь подменяет текстуру скоупа в момент рендера, сохраняя ванильное поведение.

</details>

<details open>
<summary>En</summary>

**Custom Spyglass Scope** is a lightweight **client-side Fabric mod** that allows you to **replace the default spyglass scope texture** using **CustomModelData**, without configs, JSON files, or complex logic.

This mod is perfect for:

* Resource packs
* RPG / PvP servers
* Custom items
* OptiFine-like behavior, but native

---

### ✨ Features

* 🔁 Spyglass scope replacement via **CustomModelData**
* 🧩 Fully vanilla rendering (no custom shaders)
* 📦 Controlled entirely through **resource packs**
* ⚡ Minimal performance impact
* 🛡 No conflicts with other HUD effects

---

### 🛠 How to Use

#### 1️⃣ Install the mod

* Install **Fabric Loader >= 0.18.4**
* Place the mod into the `mods` folder

---

#### 2️⃣ Add textures to your resource pack

Resource structure:

```
assets/custom_scope/
└── textures/
    └── gui/
        └── custom_scope/
            ├── img.png
            ├── sniper.png
            └── example.png
```

---

#### 3️⃣ Assign CustomModelData to the spyglass

The mod uses **string-based CustomModelData**, which must follow this format:

```
<mod_id>_<texture_name>
```

Example:

* `custom_scope` — the **mod ID**
* `img` — the **texture name**

Command example:

```mcfunction
/give @p minecraft:spyglass[CustomModelData:{strings:["custom_scope_img"]}]
```

📌 This will load the texture from:

```
assets/custom_scope/textures/gui/custom_scope/img.png
```

---

### 🔄 Behavior

* If CustomModelData matches `<mod_id>_<texture_name>` → a **custom scope** is used
* If the format does not match → the **vanilla spyglass scope** is rendered
* If the texture is missing → **no crash will occur**

---

### 🎨 Default Included Texture

The mod **includes one default spyglass scope texture** out of the box as an example.

To obtain a spyglass using it, run:

```mcfunction
/give @p minecraft:spyglass[CustomModelData:{strings:["custom_scope_img"]}]
```

---

### 💡 Notes

This mod **does not add new items** and **does not change gameplay mechanics** — it simply replaces the spyglass scope texture at render time while preserving vanilla behavior.

</details>

title: Maykesh’s Fabric RapidWhitelist
description: A zero‑downtime whitelist system with instant updates, configurable command permissions, and full tracking of who added each player for clear staff accountability.
body:
# 📜 Rapid Whitelist

![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Fabric-1.21.x%2B-blue?style=flat-square)
![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-orange?style=flat-square)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-All%20Rights%20Reserved-red?style=flat-square)

**A high-performance, hot-reloadable whitelist system for modern Fabric servers.**

Rapid Whitelist replaces the vanilla Minecraft whitelist entirely, offering asynchronous I/O, hot-reloading, and advanced rate limiting. It is designed for servers that need a robust access control system without the performance hit of the main thread.

---

## 🚀 Why Use This Mod?

- **⚡ Zero Lag**: All whitelist operations (add/remove/check) use async I/O to keep your server TPS high.
- **🔥 Hot-Reloadable**: Edit `whitelist.json` manually or via command, and changes apply instantly without restarting.
- **🛡️ Rate Limiting**: Built-in protection against command spam for adding/removing players and reloading.
- **🔌 Developer API**: Includes a `CustomWhitelistAPI` for easy integration with other mods or plugins.
- **🚫 Complete Replacement**: Fully bypasses the vanilla whitelist logic for total control.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🔒 Core Whitelist
*   **Async Storage**: Player data is stored in `config/customwhitelist/whitelist.json` and loaded asynchronously.
*   **UUID & Name Support**: Whitelists by GameProfile (UUID + Name) for security.
*   **Instant Updates**: Commands update the cache immediately; manual file edits are detected via file watcher.

### ⚙️ Management & Control
*   **Full Command Suite**: `/rapidwhitelist add`, `remove`, `list`, `enable`, `disable`, `reload`.
*   **Configurable Messages**: Customize kick messages and feedback text in `config.json`.
*   **Permission Levels**: Restrict commands to specific OP levels (default: Level 3).

### 🛡️ Protection
*   **Rate Limits**: Configurable limits on how many players can be added/removed per minute.
*   **Logging**: detailed logs for denied joins and administrative actions.

---

## 📜 Commands

### Admin Commands
*(Requires OP Level 3 by default)*

*   `/rapidwhitelist add <player>` - Add a player to the whitelist.
*   `/rapidwhitelist remove <player>` - Remove a player from the whitelist.
*   `/rapidwhitelist list` - List all whitelisted players.
*   `/rapidwhitelist reload` - Reload config and whitelist data from disk.
*   `/rapidwhitelist enable` - Enable the whitelist enforcement.
*   `/rapidwhitelist disable` - Disable the whitelist (allow everyone).

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

The main configuration file `config/customwhitelist/config.json` controls behavior:

```json
{
  "enableWhitelist": true,
  "commandPermissionLevel": 3,
  "storageMode": "json",
  "messages": {
    "kickMessage": "You are not whitelisted on this server.",
    "whitelistEnabled": "Whitelist has been enabled.",
    "whitelistDisabled": "Whitelist has been disabled."
  },
  "rateLimits": {
    "addPerMinute": 10.0,
    "removePerMinute": 10.0,
    "reloadCooldownMs": 5000
  }
}
```

For additional Minecraft version support, contact me at my discord server(link bellow):

[https://discord.gg/BmUZ6jHcJz](https://discord.gg/BmUZ6jHcJz) -- our SMP with all my mods on it...test our server out will ya? thx!

title: Swiftly
description: A smooth, optimized vanilla Minecraft experience with essential performance improvements.
body:
![Swiftly](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/36f494132fd3015e9961c027f4e57e68bbb1333e.png)

A **lightweight Fabric modpack** built for one purpose: **make Minecraft feel smooth** while staying **close to vanilla**.

Swiftly focuses on **high FPS, stable gameplay, and “Minecraft-should-have-this” quality-of-life** — without bloating your instance with unnecessary content mods.  
Perfect for **mid-range and low-end PCs**, and also great as a **clean base** for your own modpack.

---

## ✨ Why Swiftly?
### ✅ Fast & Smooth
- Major FPS improvements and reduced stutter
- Better chunk/tick performance for a more stable experience

### ✅ Vanilla-First
- No gameplay overhaul, no extra progression
- Keeps the vanilla look and feel — just better

### ✅ Shader-Ready
- Full shader support (Iris)
- Runs great both with and without shaders

### ✅ Lightweight & Compatible
- Minimal mod list, maximum impact
- Great as a starter pack for adding your own mods

---

## 🧩 Included Mods (Core)
**Performance / Rendering**
- Sodium
- Lithium
- Iris Shaders

**Quality-of-Life**
- AppleSkin
- Mouse Tweaks
- Zoomify
- Gamma Utils (Fullbright)
- Simple Voice Chat *(optional, multiplayer-ready)*

**Libraries (Required)**
- Fabric API
- Cloth Config API
- Fabric Language Kotlin
- YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)

> The mod list may evolve over time, but the philosophy stays the same: **clean, fast, vanilla-friendly**.

---

## ⚙️ System Requirements
**Minimum (Playable / Vanilla+ Smooth)**
- **RAM:** 4 GB allocated
- **CPU/GPU:** any modern integrated graphics should work fine
- **Works best without shaders**

**Recommended (Smooth 1080p / Optional Shaders)**
- **RAM:** 6 GB allocated
- **Dedicated GPU recommended** for shaders

> Tip: If you play with shaders, start with a lightweight preset and adjust render distance for stable FPS.

---

![Instructions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f48569df9ca45c496a407f2d5355cb275690338a.png)

## 🛠️ Installation
1. Install **Fabric** for your Minecraft version
2. Download **Swiftly** from Modrinth
3. Import the pack into your launcher (Modrinth App / Prism / ATLauncher)
4. Allocate **4 GB RAM minimum** (**6 GB recommended**)
5. Launch and enjoy 🚀

---

## 🚀 Quick Optimization Tips
- Lower **Render Distance** if you get stutters (try **6–10**)
- Turn **Clouds OFF** for free FPS
- Keep **Particles** on “Decreased” for smoother fights
- If shaders are enabled: reduce **Shadow Quality** first

---

## 📌 Notes
- This pack is intentionally **minimal**.
- Suggestions are welcome — performance and stability always come first.

**Minecraft as it should feel: clean, fast, and smooth.**

This resource pack adds the ability to replace all mentions of villagers from Russian and pre-revolutionary Russian translation with one of three options:
- Житель (approximate translation: Resident) (the most popular and most commonly used among players)
- Селянин (approximate translation: Rustic) (as translated in Bedrock Edition)
- Деревенский житель (approximate translation: Country Villager) (as in the [Minecraft Wiki](https://ru.mc.wiki/%D0%94%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%B9_%D0%B6%D0%B8%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8C))

# Usage

- After installing this resource pack, go to Options —> Language —> Translation option (to the left of the Done button; without the resource pack, Font Settings are located instead of this button).
- Select the translation option you need (the selected option is displayed at the top of the screen).
- If you are using a different language, switch it to Russian or pre-revolutionary Russian.
- Have a nice game!


**This resource pack does NOT work with packs that replace the font or add new characters: the selected translation option may stand out. (See gallery)**

title: Shadow
description: Block VPN and Proxy connections on your server with the best antivpn and antiproxy plugin.
body:
Shadow is a lightweight server-side AntiVPN/AntiProxy plugin for Paper/Spigot (1.20+). When a player connects, Shadow checks whether their IP appears to be a VPN, proxy, Tor exit node, or other anonymized connection. If the connection is flagged, the player is denied entry with a configurable kick message.

Shadow can also detect and block hosting or datacenter IP ranges separately from typical consumer VPNs, so you can choose how strict you want to be. Trusted players or staff can bypass checks with a permission, and the plugin supports in-game reloads for quick config changes.

Commands:
/shadow reload (permission: shadow.reload)
Bypass permission: shadow.bypass

Config options: toggle VPN/proxy/Tor blocking, toggle hosting blocking, custom kick message

title: Coins 'n' Guns
description: Intricate and vanilla-friendly ranged weapons and ammo system
body:
![Coins 'n' Guns title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a12abe88675ae990d797eb99677f47cc315d87e0.png)

## Description

This mod adds an intuitive but complex ranged weapon: the gilded pistol, while staying as balanced and vanilla-friendly as possible.

The pistol has 216 unique ways to use it through different mutually exclusive enchantments, ammo types, pistol types and added effects.


<details>
<summary>Pistol</summary>

The core of this mod.

The pistol is a ranged weapon not too dissimilar to crossbows.

It  comes in 2 variants, silver and gilded.

They can hold 2 and 3 projectiles respectively and keep them loaded for later use.

The pistol can use 3 different type of ammo listed in the "Coins" section.

Its projectiles' properties also depend on the coin pouch used, if one is used, detailed in the "Pouches" section.

The silver pistol is crafted with an iron ingot, nugget, coin, a stick and cobbled deepslate.

The gilded pistol is crafted with a gold ingot, nugget, coin, a stick and a netherite scrap.
</details>



<details>
<summary>Coins</summary>

Coins are the ammunition used by the gilded pistol.

There are 3 different coins, each with their own properties.

Copper coins are light and fast but deal the lowest damage at base 2 hearts.

Iron coins are heavy and slow but deal medium damage at base 3 hearts.

Gold coins are slightly slower and heavier than copper, with the same base 2 hearts of damage. However, they possess the ability to bounce off a block once, doubling their damage to base 4 hearts.
</details>



<details>
<summary>Pouches</summary>

Pouches are the way to store coins in bulk and to add effects to them when shot.

They can store up to 27 stacks of any combination of coins.

There are 4 different pouches with different effects:

-   Leather pouch: the base pouch. Doesn't add any effect to coins but is the base for all other pouches
-   Crimson pouch: the nether pouch. Adds 1 heart of base damage to coins and burn targets for 2 seconds
-   Ender pouch: the end pouch. Coins are no longer affected by gravity nor are slowed down by water. Additionally, they break blocks on hit and bring back dropped items on hit
-   Sculk pouch: the deep dark pouch. Coins direct all other shot coins to the hit target on hit
</details>



<details>
<summary>Loot and philosopher's stone</summary>

Most chests will contain coins, the amount and rarity of coin depending on the location.

Additionally, a philosopher stone can be found rarely in chests, with 1% to 30% chance in basion treasures and ancient cities.

Coins can be downgraded at a 1/4 ratio in any crafting interface.

They can also be upgraded at a 4/1 ratio using the philosopher's stone.

Gold coins can be transformed into emeralds that way at the same ratio.

Finally, iron and feathers can be transformed into each other using the philosopher's stone.
</details>



<details>
<summary>Enchantments</summary>

### Gilded pistol enchantments

On top of all crossbow compatible enchantments, the gilded pistol possesses these three unique enchantments:

-   The "Gambling" enchantment provides a chance to not consume pouch coins consumption by 20% per level for up to 3 levels.
-   The "Cash Dash" enchantment provides a small dash in the movement direction when shooting a coin from the gilded pistol. This enchantment is mutually exclusive with the "Tax Evasion" enchantment.
-   The "Tax Evasion" enchantment provides a moderate dash in the movement direction when loading the gilded pistol. This enchantment is mutually exclusive with the "Cash Dash" enchantment.
</details>

## Upcoming

The mod development is not done!

I plan on publishing this mod for other minecraft versions and potentially other mod loaders.

Planned features so far are:

- Modular guns and overhauled crafting
- A minting press to automate coin production
- A rifle
- Some retextures

title: Straighter Than An Arrow
description: Removes random spread from arrows fired by bows and crossbows, and fixes a bug where arrows sometimes embed in incorrect positions after hitting blocks.
body:
Bows and crossbows do not fire arrows exactly where you are looking. They add some randomness to it, so the arrows go slightly off course. This is why when you fire lots of arrows without turning at all, not all the arrows land in the same spot.

This mod removes that randomness so they always go in the exact direction you are looking.

There is also a bug in this version which causes arrows to not land in the right spot when they hit a block, which this mod fixes.

So in total, this mod:
- removes spread from firing arrows out of bows
- removes spread from firing arrows out of crossbows
- Fixes a bug causing arrows to shift to the side slightly when impacting blocks, making it seem like the arrow isn't firing straight

title: TrueDamage
description: A very interesting enchantment that can make your weapon damage feel more realistic
body:
This mod adds a new enchantment to the game called True Damage.
It can be applied to weapons that deal damage.
Once enchanted, the weapon will ignore the target’s defense and deal full damage directly.
In case you don’t fully understand, here’s an example:
Suppose your sword deals 9 damage. If the target has armor, the actual damage dealt will be lower than 9 after calculation.
However, if you apply the True Damage enchantment first,
the weapon will ignore all armor values and deal the full 9 damage to the target.

title: E-Inventory
description: My high-performance inventory management system for Fabric.
body:
# 📦 **E-Inventory**

> ### **My high-performance inventory management system for Fabric.**

I created **E-Inventory** because I wanted a cleaner, faster way to handle item overflow without dealing with bulky menus or laggy sorting. It’s built to be lightweight, stylish, and perfect for anyone who hates inventory clutter.

This mod is especially great for people who love going on **adventures in Minecraft** but get **annoyed** when their inventory fills up with random blocks and items every few minutes. Instead of stopping your journey to clear out your bags, E-Inventory handles the mess for you.

---

### 🚀 **What I built it to do:**

* **Custom Dashboard**
    I designed a modern "tech-style" UI so you can manage your settings without ever leaving the game.
* **Restrict Pickup**
    This stops you from picking up junk in the first place if your inventory is already at the limit I set.
* **Auto-Throw System**
    Most mods fail on big servers like **Hypixel** because the server forces items into your inventory. I built Auto-Throw as a "fail-safe." If a server forces the pickup, E-Inventory detects the item instantly and ejects it back out. **Even if you aren't holding the item, it will throw it automatically without you ever needing to have it in your main hand.**
* **Silent Mode**
    I added a toggle to silence the constant "pop" sound of items being removed, making long sessions much quieter.
* **Theming**
    You can use the slider in the settings to change the UI glow to whatever color you want.

---

### 🛠 **Performance**

I coded this mod to be as small as possible (only **70KB**!) so it won't impact your FPS or TPS. By focusing on clean Java logic and no heavy textures, I kept the footprint as small as possible.

---

### 📖 **Getting Started**

* **Default Key:** Press **'R'** to open the dashboard.
* **Settings:** Use the sub-panel to toggle automation features like **Silent Trash** and **Auto-Throw**.

---

title: Immersive Tools
description: Adds Perks and Tiers to normal and new tools!
body:
# Immersive Tools

### **Stop!**

Stop replacing your tools. Start evolving them. A non-destructive, upgrade system for your vanilla equipment **WITH TIERS**.

---

### **The Mod**

Ever crafted that *perfect* Netherite pickaxe, fully enchanted, only to feel like the progression has stopped?

**Immersive Tools** is an end-game expansion mod that introduces a deep, **non-destructive Perk System** for your tools and weapons. Instead of crafting new items, you apply permanent enhancements to the gear you already love, upgrading them through multiple tiers of power.

## How It Works

The system is simple to use but designed for a long-term survival world.

### **Step 1: Apply the Perk (Tier 1)**

1.  Craft a specific **Perk Gem** (such as the `Lightweight Gem`, `Void Gem`, etc.).
2.  Hold your tool in your main hand and the Gem in your off-hand.
3.  Right-click to permanently apply the **Tier 1** Perk to that item.

### **Step 2: Upgrade the Tiers (Tier 2-5)**

1.  To evolve your Perks, you must craft powerful, universal **Essences**.
2.  Start by crafting the `Refined Essence` (Tier 2 Upgrade).
3.  Hold your tool (which already has a T1 Perk) and the Essence in your off-hand.
4.  Right-click to upgrade **all** eligible Perks on that item to the next Tier!
5.  Continue this process with `Pure Essence` (T3), `Legendary Essence` (T4), and finally the `Divine Essence` (T5) for ultimate power.

## Perks Included (Release 1.0)

This initial release includes three essential Perks:

* **Light Weight:** (Catalyst: `Lightweight Gem`)
    * Increases your mining and attack speed when holding the tool.
* **Reinforced Preservation:** (Catalyst: `Reinforced Gem`)
    * Grants a chance to *not* consume durability when using the tool in combat or breaking blocks.
* **Purifying Touch:** (Catalyst: `Blaze Gem`)
    * Has a chance to automatically **smelt** block drops (e.g., Iron Ore -> Iron Ingot).
    * Has a chance to apply a **Fire Aspect** effect to enemies in combat.
* **Void Leap:** (Catalyst: `Void Gem`)
    * If you hold shift and right click with the tool on your hand, you jump in the direction you are facing.
    * The tier acts as a multiplier, meaning tier 5 will make you jump double the size of tier 1.

## Crafting Your Legend

The path to power is designed for the end-game. These upgrades are expensive, requiring you to master all dimensions—from Nether Stars to End City loot.

**Check out the image gallery to see the crafting recipes** for the three starting Gems and the powerful Refined, Pure, and Legendary Essences!

### Future Plans

* More creative Perks are already in development (Magnetic Pull, Repulsion Strike, and more)!
### Feedback && Support
* If you want to give ideias or report problems, checkout our github repository and open an issue!

title: KOHATS
description: Hats with helmet attributes in pure vanilla
body:
# KOHATS
KOHATS is a datapack and resourcepack. That adds hats and easier system for them using new dialog system. Also it's fully support English and Russian.
## How to use
1. Install and enable both datapack and resourcepack.
2. Hold helmet you want to convert in your hand and open KOHATS menu using button in `Pause Menu` or by pressing `Quick Action` (`G` by default).
![KOHATS Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4b1e275d94f4e6f182cbfb880207fe8b74b0e61.png)
3. Select hat you want (There you can see hat previews). If hat supports dye coloring. You can set color you want. For example you want color #EB4034. Open any hex to decimal converter and convert your color. For #EB4034 it will be 15417396. Press `Ok`.
![KOHATS Select Hat Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/776d9c2e903fbd92696032227685be462ccd8af6.png)
4. Minecraft will ask a confirmation. Press `Yes` and your helmet will be replaced with hat.
![Helmet replaced by hat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a827a52bc03ee1bafd4818a4cd9ace4a2f8a155_0.webp)
## Custom hats
You can use your custom hats. Model and translation key is required, tint is optional. However your hat wont appear in `Select Hat` dialog, but you still can get it in `Select Custom Hat` dialog by manually writing translation key and item model. Take a look at resource pack for examples.
## QA
1. Why use `Leather Horse Armor` instead of `Curved Pumpkin`?
    * `Leather Horse Armor` allow both, changing item model and dye coloring.
2. Why color select so ugly?
    * Currently it's best I can do with dialog limitations.
3. I can't get hat in multiplayer.
    * It's due dialog limitation of running at user permissions. So to use it you must have access to `/function` command.

title: Origins: Proxy
description: Main antagonists of the Slenderverse. They are people who are possessed or under the influence of Slender Man.
body:
# 🪓 Proxy
### (Impact 2)
"I like to stare at the sun and think about what I’ve done. I lie awake in my great escape. I like crossing the line and slowly losing my mind. Are you okay? ’Cause I feel fine."
- I'm Not Alright by Shinedown, the canonical theme song for Tobias Erin Rogers.

Born troubled and pushed to a breaking point, after your sister’s death and the loss of your remaining sanity, you turn to killing. Just as you were about to accept your own death in the flames, a strange, tall, faceless man appeared before you.

### REQUIRES RESOURCE PACK!

> Introducing the **Proxy** origin! An Impact 2 origin themed around proxies from Creepypasta. This was made for a horror jam and is full of movement inspired by games like Dead by Daylight and fun combat mechanics like parrying!

## Powerlist

<details>
<summary>Cognitive Insensitivity</summary>

"My favourite was the one that made me completely numb from any pain.."

When killed, you are placed on a timer; failing to kill a non-undead entity during this timer will result in your death playing out as usual. While achieving allows you to live.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Bludgeoner</summary>

"So anyways, I butchered dear old dad."

You deal +2 damage with axes by default; when you drop below 5 hearts, you enter Adrenaline, which increases this by an additional 2.
You're slightly more skilled with Iron Axes, and you can significantly improve your movement speed with them for a brief period of time.

Hatchet specialties include:
- A chance on crit to lodge the blade in your opponent's neck.
- The ability to parry attacks.
- The ability to move through leaves during your brief period of increased movement speed.

  > Right-clicking an Iron Axe with Redstone Dust will give you a special bleeding texture and item name.
  
  > Dual Wielding your Hatchets like Toby does will result in a small speed boost. You also swing faster with your Hatchets.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Sleeper Agent</summary>

"But then i blacked out. Woke up in the middle of the night in the forest. Next thing I know this thing is standing over me. It has no eyes, no mouth, no nose, nothing."

You cannot sleep on beds, but you may set your spawn wherever you are.
The Tall One will occasionally send you messages in chat, you may also hear screaming or the footsteps of something walking by you. Sometimes you may even see a figure, despite the fact that it is not real.

Hallucinations include:
- Figures, short or tall.
- Animals, like pets.
- Wailing, screams.
- Walking, teleporting.
- Messages, voices.
  > When defeating enemies, they will occasionally drop the Tall Ones Pages.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Troubled Kid</summary>

"And to think those pesky doctors tried to silence them.."

Because of your numerous disorders, you are immune to most potion effects, with the exception of:
- Wither
- Poison
- Mining Fatigue

</details>

<details>
<summary>Exhausted</summary>

"Who the fuck needs a social life."

You naturally exhaust faster when sprinting.

</details>

## Dependencies
This datapack does require the [Origins Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins).

It also requires a resource pack, which is linked with the download.

## Additional
This origin was created for a horror jam by Glitch Productions!

If you encounter any bugs or want to suggest something, dm me on discord!
> @cassettecat

title: RealtimeSynth
description: RealtimeSynth automatically synchronizes Minecraft's day-night cycle with your real-world time
body:
# RealtimeSynth
**RealtimeSynth synchronizes your real-world time with Minecraft's day-night cycle, creating an immersive experience where the game world reflects the actual time of day. Perfect for players who want their Minecraft adventures to match the rhythm of real life!**
# Features

**Real-Time Synchronization:** Your Minecraft world time automatically matches your system clock

**Seamless World Creation:** New worlds spawn with the correct time of day based on when you 
create them

**Automatic Updates:** Time syncs every 10 seconds without any performance impact

**Smart Mapping:** 6:00 AM real time = sunrise in-game, 12:00 PM = noon, 6:00 PM = sunset, 12:00 AM = midnight

**Configurable Notifications:** Toggle sync messages on/off to your preference

**Time Display Commands:** Check both real and in-game time with simple commands

**Server Compatible:** Works perfectly on both singleplayer and multiplayer servers

# How It Works
Once installed, RealtimeSynth runs completely automatically in the background. The mod disables Minecraft's default day-night cycle and takes full control of time progression based on your computer's clock. If you create a world at 7:00 PM in real life, you'll spawn into a world that's already experiencing evening/night time.

# Technical Details

**Performance Optimized:** Uses efficient tick-based updates every 200 game ticks

**Server-Side Logic:** All synchronization happens server-side for multiplayer compatibility

**Non-Intrusive:** Doesn't interfere with other time-related mods or vanilla mechanics

**Memory Efficient:** Minimal memory footprint with smart caching

# Installation

Download the mod file
Place it in your mods folder
Launch Minecraft with Forge 1.16.5
Time synchronization starts automatically!

# License
This mod is released under MIT License.

title: AetherSentiel
description: simple powerful anticheat named AetherSentiel
body:
**AetherSentinel** is a powerful and flexible anti-cheat solution for Minecraft 1.21.x servers running on Java 21. It includes a wide range of detection modules: Horizontal Motion (Speed, LongJump, HClip), Vertical Motion (Fly, Spider, HighJump, VClip, Step), Water Motion (Jesus, WaterSpeed, WaterFly), Balance (Timer), NoSlow (including NoSlowSneak), RayCast (Reach, HitBoxes), Rotation (AimBot, AimAssist), Velocity (AntiKnockBack, NoVelocity), GroundSpoof (NoFall), as well as WrongPlace and WrongBreak detections.

The system is fully configurable via `config.yml`, allowing you to enable or disable checks, define violation thresholds, and set custom punishment commands (e.g., kick or ban). To reduce false positives, AetherSentinel accounts for special conditions: players using elytra, riding boats, being in creative or spectator mode, or moving in water (where separate water-motion checks apply) are excluded from standard movement checks.

When severe violations occur, the anti-cheat applies its setback system — teleporting players back to their last legitimate position. In addition, administrators have access to built-in alerts that can be toggled with `/aethersentinel alerts`, and the configuration can be reloaded at runtime with `/aethersentinel reload`.

By combining advanced detection techniques, customizable punishments, and smart handling of edge cases, **AetherSentinel** provides reliable protection while keeping gameplay smooth and fair for legitimate players.

body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1db2dbaadef4b0f7d7c3702b04ca2f3bd4e6e3a9_0.webp)


# 🌿 What is Cirallyn?

**Cirallyn** is a carefully crafted Vanilla+ modpack for players seeking a balanced experience between **performance, immersion, and quality of life**. It preserves the essence of classic Minecraft while adding dozens of visual, functional, and social improvements that make every session more engaging and fun—without sacrificing performance.

## ⚡ Performance First

The pack’s foundation is built around optimization mods like **Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ModernFix, EntityCulling, Indium, Krypton,** and **ImmediatelyFast**, which reduce memory usage, improve chunk loading, and make gameplay smoother. This ensures that even modest machines can run the modpack stably, whether using shaders or playing on multiplayer servers.

## 🎨 Visual Immersion and Cosmetics

Cirallyn focuses on making the Minecraft world more alive and expressive by adding subtle details that don’t compromise the original aesthetic:

* **Falling Leaves** and **Visuality** bring environmental effects that enhance immersion.
* **Wavey Capes, 3D Skin Layers, Skin Shuffle,** and **\[EMF/ETF]** add personality to your character.
* **Iris Shaders** combined with **Reese’s Sodium Options** allow graphic customization and modern shader support.
* **Camera Overhaul** and **Tiny Item Animations** make movement and items more realistic.

## 🛠️ Quality of Life and Utilities

Various mods simplify everyday tasks and make the interface more informative:

* **JEI** and its addons (**JER, JEP, JEB**) for recipes, professions, and descriptions.
* **Inventory Profiles Next, Chest Tracker,** and **Crafting Tweaks** for organizing chests and inventories.
* **AppleSkin** and **Held Item Info** for quick on-screen information.
* **Better Recipe Book, Paginated Advancements,** and **Better Advancements** make menus and progression clearer.
* **Legendary Tooltips** and **Dynamic Crosshair** modernize the interface.

## 🗺️ Navigation and Exploration

For explorers, the pack includes **Xaero’s Minimap** and **Xaero’s World Map**, ensuring full orientation during adventures. These tools integrate naturally into the game without breaking the Vanilla feel.

## 💬 Communication and Social

Playing solo or on servers is even better with social tools:

* **Simple Voice Chat** for integrated voice communication.
* **Chat Heads** and **Chat Animation**, which make chat interactions clearer and more fun.
* **More Chat History** ensures you never miss important messages.

## 🔧 Flexibility and Compatibility

With key libraries like **Architectury API, Cloth Config, Balm, Bookshelf,** and **Prism**, the modpack ensures compatibility, stability, and support for future updates.

## ✨ Why Choose Cirallyn?

If you’re looking for a modpack that keeps Minecraft’s essence but refines every detail, **Cirallyn** is the right choice. It offers:

* Optimized performance
* More immersive and pleasing visuals
* Tools that simplify gameplay
* Integrated social experience

All of this without making the game heavy or losing its core identity.

Cirallyn is perfect for those who want to rediscover Minecraft in its purest form—modern, smooth, and fun.

title: Mogrul Calendar
description: A simple server-side customisable calendar display for those that want to add a bit more realism to their servers
body:
A fully-customisable server-side calender mod for NeoForge, spicing up your servers with realism - players can see the date on the top of their screen when they sleep or right click on a bed; you can even add your own months and limit the amount of months for a lore server; go wild!

# Example
![Example 1](https://i.imgur.com/J4Y4LcS.png)
![Example 2](https://i.imgur.com/rfqVd4j.png)

# Configuration
When the mod first loads, a mogrulcalender-common.toml file containing customisations will be loaded in your servers config directory - you can change almost every aspect of the calender from here.

```
[Display]
	#In seconds, how long should the text display after waking up.
	# Default: 5
	# Range: > 0
	wakeDisplayTimeoutSeconds = 5

[Calender]
	#Year the server starts at.
	# Default: 2025
	# Range: > 1
	startingYear = 2025
	#Months the server starts at.
	# Default: 1
	# Range: > 1
	startingMonths = 1
	#Days the server starts at.
	# Default: 1
	# Range: > 1
	startingDays = 1
	#List of month followed by days in months for the calender display.
	calenderMonths = [
      "January=31", "February=28", "March=31", 
      "April=30", "May=31", "June=30", 
      "July=31", "August=31", "September=30", 
      "October=31", "November=30", "December=31"
    ]
```

title: MultipleSessions
description: MultipleSessions is a simple Minecraft plugin that lets players have separate gameplay sessions on the same server.
body:
# MultipleSessions

**MultipleSessions** is a simple Minecraft plugin that lets players have separate gameplay _sessions_ on the same server.

A _session_ is like starting over. Different inventory, position, etc. You can create as many as you want and switch between them.

# Commands:
```
    /createsession <id-number>
    Creates a new session with the given ID.

    /changesession <id-number>
    Switches you to the session with that ID.

    /viewsession
    Shows your current session ID.
```


This is useful if you want to start fresh without deleting your current progress, or try different playthroughs without needing a new server.

title: Honest Hardcore
description: No second chances. No fake Hardcore. This mod disables spectating after death in hardcore and invalidates all advancements if you ever cheat.
body:
Honest Hardcore is a gameplay mod that enforces real consequences in Minecraft's Hardcore mode.

It disables the "Spectate World" button after death and replaces it with a "Statistics" button.
You can no longer escape death by switching to Spectator or Survival mode.

In addition, the mod tracks the world's honesty status. If you ever enable cheats or enter Creative mode — the world becomes marked as dishonest. From that moment:

All advancements are permanently blocked

A single crossed-out advancement ("Honesty") remains as a reminder of your actions

For honest players, a chain of special advancements becomes available — one for creating the world, and more for surviving without cheating.

This mod is designed for singleplayer only. No server support.

title: QuestionAndAnswer
description: QuestionAndAnswer is a unique mod for Minecraft (Fabric) that turns your server into an intelligent game show! The mod is perfect for parties, streams, educational projects and just fun gatherings with friends.
body:
If you don't understand how the mod works, go to the **[WIKI](https://t.me/zdev_wiki/5)**

Main functions

- **Quiz with automatic construction:** Players answer questions, and their bridges are built according to the letters of the answer.
- **Flexible setup:** Everything from questions to effects and messages can be configured in a single file.
- **Continuation of construction:** Bridges continue to be built from where they left off until the round is stopped.
- **Reset progress:** Bridges and positions are reset only when the round is stopped or completely cleared.
- **Supports up to 4 players simultaneously** (can be expanded if necessary).

 How to set up

1. **Install the mod** as a regular Fabric mod (place the jar file in the mods folder).
2. **Configure the `config.json` file:**
- Add your questions to the `"questions"` array.
   - Specify the starting positions of the players in the "startPositions".
   - Customize bridge blocks, effects, messages and other parameters to your liking.
3. **Start the server or a single player game with Fabric.**
4. **Use the commands:**
- `/setpos` — each player must set his starting position.
   - `/question [question]` — the moderator asks a question.
   - `/stopround' — stop the round and reset the bridges.

**Download the mod, set up questions and arrange a real intellectual show right in Minecraft!**

title: Allay & Vex Conversion
description: Allows the conversion of allays to vexes and vice versa
body:
It is very simple (kind of?)


<details>
<summary>Allay -> Vex</summary>

1. Give the allay any item
2. _Shift + Right-Click_ with an **Ominous Bottle** on the Allay to give it **Bad Omen**
3. Wait the duration of the effect (4min)
4. When the effect runs out the allay will become a vex

</details>


<details>
<summary>Vex -> Allay</summary>

1. Throw a **splash potion of regeneration and weakness** on the vex (if you are fast enough)
2. Feed the vex **Amethyst Shards**
3. Everytime you feed the vex 3 things could happen: It converts, it dies, or it chokes
   
- 1. If it chokes it takes 1hp of damage (half a heart)
- 2. If it dies, well it dies...
- 3. If it converts it will become an allay
</details>


<details>
<summary>Bonus</summary>

- Allays leave a particle trail that can be stopped by making it hold an **Echo Shard** or giving it **Bad Omen**
- _Shift + Right-Click_ with a **Milk Bucket** on the Allay to remove its effects
- 2 new gamerules ("allowAllayVexConversion" and "allayParticleEffects") both by default true
- Vexes that come from conversion are weaponless (still hostile)

</details>

title: ObsidianVault
description: A simple, easy-to-use Minecraft server backup plugin that offers automated, secure remote backups
body:
# ⚡ ObsidianVault - Automated Cloud Backups

![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.8%2B-brightgreen) ![Server](https://img.shields.io/badge/Server-Paper%20%7C%20Spigot%20%7C%20Purpur-orange) ![Storage](https://img.shields.io/badge/Storage-5GB%20Free-blue)

## 🛡️ Never Lose Your Server Data Again!

**ObsidianVault** is the ultimate backup solution for Minecraft servers. Automatically backup your worlds, plugins, and configurations to secure cloud storage with scheduled backups, instant restores, and enterprise-grade security.

### ✨ Key Features

- 🚀 **Automated Scheduled Backups** - Set it and forget it with cron-based scheduling
- ☁️ **Secure Cloud Storage** - Your backups are stored safely in the cloud with encryption
- 🌍 **World & Plugin Backups** - Backup entire worlds or individual plugins
- ⚡ **Instant Commands** - Create, download, and restore backups with simple commands
- 📊 **Backup History** - Track all your backup versions with detailed history
- 🔒 **Enterprise Security** - Client ID/Secret authentication with secure transmission
- 💾 **5GB Free Storage** - Generous free tier with affordable upgrade options
- 🔄 **Easy Restoration** - One-click restore from any backup point
- 📱 **Web Dashboard** - Manage your backups from any device
- ⚙️ **Flexible Configuration** - Customize backup schedules and world selection

---

## 🚀 Quick Start Guide

### 1. Installation
1. Download ObsidianVault.jar
2. Place it in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server or use `/reload confirm`
4. The plugin will generate `plugins/ObsidianVault/config.yml`

### 2. Get Your Credentials
1. **Create Account** - Visit [obsidianvault.io/auth](https://obsidianvault.io/auth) and sign up (5GB free storage)
2. **Access Dashboard** - Log into your [dashboard](https://obsidianvault.io/dashboard)
3. **Generate Credentials** - Click "Credentials" → "Generate New Credentials"
4. **Copy Values** - Save your Client ID and Client Secret immediately

### 3. Configure the Plugin

Edit `plugins/ObsidianVault/config.yml`:

```yaml
# ObsidianVault Configuration
auth:
  client-id: your-client-id-here      # From your dashboard
  client-secret: your-client-secret-here  # From your dashboard

backup:
  # Daily backups at midnight (cron format)
  cron: "0 0 * * *"
  # Worlds to backup automatically
  worlds:
    - world
    - world_nether
    - world_the_end
```

After configuration, reload with `/reload confirm` and start backing up!

---

## 🎮 Commands

All commands start with `/backup`:

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|

<details>
<summary>Authentication Failed</summary>

**Symptoms:** "Authentication failed" or "Invalid credentials" errors

**Solutions:**
- Verify client-id and client-secret are correct (copy-paste from dashboard)
- Check for extra spaces or special characters in config.yml
- Ensure your ObsidianVault account is active
- Regenerate credentials if needed
- Test credentials by logging into the web dashboard

</details>

<details>
<summary>Upload Failures</summary>

**Symptoms:** Backups fail to upload or timeout

**Solutions:**
- Check server internet connection and DNS resolution
- Verify you haven't exceeded storage quota (check dashboard)
- Ensure firewall allows HTTPS connections on port 443
- Check available disk space on server (need 2x world size temporarily)
- Increase timeout value in config for large worlds
- Enable compression to reduce upload size

</details>

<details>

**Symptoms:** OutOfMemory errors or very slow backups

- Schedule backups during low-activity periods

title: Damage Plugin
description: Supercharge your combat! This plugin introduces a configurable charged attack mechanic, allowing players to hold their attack for increased damage with tiered bonuses and visual HUD feedback.
body:
## DamagePlugin: Unleash Devastating Charged Attacks!

**Transform your server's combat with DamagePlugin!** This highly configurable plugin introduces a dynamic charged attack mechanic, allowing players to strategically power up their strikes for significant bonus damage. Move beyond simple click-spam and add a new layer of skill and timing to melee encounters.

---

### **Key Features:**

* **🔋 Charged Attack System:**
    * Players can hold a configured key combination (default: Sneak + Right-Click) with designated tools to build up a charge.
    * The longer the charge, the greater the potential bonus damage on their next hit!

* **🔧 Fully Configurable Damage Tiers:**
    * Define multiple tiers of charging in `config.yml`.
    * Set custom **charge durations (seconds)** required to reach each tier.
    * Assign specific **bonus damage** amounts for each tier.
    * Damage is **interpolated** if a player releases their charge between defined tier thresholds, providing a smooth damage progression.

* **📊 Visual HUD Feedback:**
    * Players receive real-time feedback via a customizable action bar HUD.
    * Choose between a **"DETAILED"** style (showing a prefix, percentage, and a visual bar) or a **"SIMPLE_PERCENTAGE"** style (showing only the charge percentage).
    * Customize the HUD prefix, percentage color, and the characters/colors used for the visual bar's different states (tier 1, tier 2, tier 3, default fill, empty).
    * Set the total number of segments for the visual bar.

* **🐌 Slowness Effect During Charge:**
    * To add a risk/reward element, players experience a slowness effect while charging.
    * The slowness level (I, II, III) automatically corresponds to the damage tier currently being charged, increasing as the charge gets stronger.
    * This effect is immediately removed upon executing the charged attack or cancelling the charge.

* **⚙️ Customizable Activation & Cancellation:**
    * **Activation Method:** Choose precisely how players initiate a charge via `config.yml`:
        * `SNEAK_RIGHT_CLICK` (Default)
        * `LEFT_CLICK` (Normal left-click, without sneaking)
        * `SNEAK_LEFT_CLICK`
    * **Cancellation Method:** Allow players to cancel an ongoing charge:
        * `LEFT_CLICK` (Default): A single left-click will cancel the current charge.
        * `NONE`: Charge only cancels upon attacking, switching items, or other standard game actions.

* **🗡️ Selectable Chargeable Items:**
    * You have full control over which tools and weapons can utilize the charged attack mechanic.
    * Simply list the Minecraft Material names (e.g., `DIAMOND_SWORD`, `NETHERITE_AXE`) in the `chargeable-items` section of `config.yml`.

* **💬 All Messages Configurable (with Color Codes!):**
    * Tailor every player-facing message to fit your server's theme and language.
    * Customize HUD text, charge cancellation messages, successful attack notifications, permission errors, and command usage instructions.
    * Full support for standard Minecraft color codes using the `&` symbol.

* **🔄 Reload Command:**
    * Easily apply configuration changes without needing a full server restart using the `/chargedattack reload` command.
    * Aliases: `/ca reload`, `/damagecharge reload`.
    * Permission: `damageplugin.command.reload` (defaults to OP).
    * Tab completion for the `reload` subcommand is included.

---

### **Why DamagePlugin?**

* **Enhanced Combat:** Adds depth and strategy to PvP and PvE.
* **Highly Customizable:** Tailor almost every aspect to fit your server's unique needs and balance.
* **User-Friendly:** Clear HUD feedback and configurable messages ensure players understand the mechanic.
* **Server Performance:** Designed to be lightweight and efficient.

---

### **Getting Started:**

1.  Download the latest `DamagePlugin.jar`.
2.  Place it in your server's `plugins` folder.
3.  Start or restart your server. A default `config.yml` will be generated.
4.  Open `plugins/DamagePlugin/config.yml` and customize the settings to your preference.
5.  Use `/chargedattack reload` in-game or via the console to apply your changes.
6.  Grant the `damageplugin.command.reload` permission to any staff members who should be able to reload the config.

---

*We hope you and your players enjoy the new charged attack dimension DamagePlugin brings to your server! Please report any issues or suggestions on our Modrinth page .

🔹 How to Get Endium
 

 

Step 1: Mine Endium Ore

Deep within the End lies Endium Ore, a rare and valuable block that can only be found in the outer islands. It requires a Netherite pickaxe to mine.

Step 2: Smelt into Endium Scrap

Smelting Endium Ore in a furnace or blast furnace yields Endium Scrap, a crucial ingredient in crafting Endium Ingots.
![Smelting Endium Ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d7d24a38142fbbade84ee14616ecb1838ae452f.png)

Step 3: Craft Endium Ingots

In a crafting table, combine 5 Endium Scrap and 5 Eyes of Ender to produce 1 Endium Ingot. This step ensures Endium remains an Endgame resource, both literally and mechanically.

![Crafting Endium Ingots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65ce2257028f7d2d35fe19e8c7cf2c67cc594a01.png)
 

 

 

🔹 Upgrading to Endium Gear
 

 

New Drop: Endium Upgrade Template

Shulkers now have a chance to drop Endium Upgrade Templates upon death. These rare templates are required to upgrade gear.

Smithing Table Upgrade

To upgrade your gear, use:

 

1 Endium Upgrade Template

1 Endium Ingot

Any piece of Netherite armor or tool

 

Place these into a smithing table to create Endium Gear.


 ![Upgrading to Endium tier](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a43736339d18cb75c7cbf1e2ec671fcaaa6bc1df.png)

 

 

🔹 Why Use Endium?
 

 

Endium gear is significantly stronger than Netherite, offering:

 

Higher durability

Increased damage (tools)

Improved protection (armor)

Built-in knockback resistance and more (depending on your configuration)

 

 

This mod maintains vanilla balance by requiring Netherite as a prerequisite and making Endium both resource-intensive and hard to obtain.

# FlameCraft - World-Based Crafting Management for Minecraft 🛠️🌍
FlameCraft is a handy Minecraft plugin that allows server administrators to specifically control crafting in different worlds. It offers an easy way to enable or disable crafting for individual worlds, thus enabling customized gaming experiences. ✨
Perfect for servers that want to enforce specific crafting rules in specific worlds, FlameCraft is the ideal solution for dynamically adjusting game mechanics. 🔧🎮

World-Based Crafting Management 🌍🛠️
FlameCraft allows server administrators to individually enable or disable crafting in each world. Ideal for Adventure, Hardcore, or Skyblock servers where crafting should be restricted or completely disabled in certain worlds. 🚫🛠️

**Easy control via commands ⚡**
With the command /fc <world> <true/false>, you can easily enable or disable crafting in a world.

true – Enables crafting for the specified world ✅

false – Disables crafting for the specified world ❌

Changes to a world's crafting status take effect immediately, without requiring a server restart. You can dynamically adjust the settings during gameplay. ⚡

Place the .jar file in the plugins folder of your Minecraft server. 💾

Restart the server or reload the plugin with /reload (if supported). 🔄

Adjust the settings in config.yml to configure crafting management to your liking. ⚙️

**Commands and Permissions:**
Command: /fc <world> <true/false>
Description: Enables or disables crafting for the specified world. 🛠️
Permission: flamecraft.set

## OfflineClaim

Sending item to players who are not online!

# 📖 What's this plugin?
A player creating a ticket, asking if you can refund their item, then you need to wait them to join the server, throwing that item at their face!

# Command: /senditem <player name>
If they are online, the item should be given to them immediately

```
UUID playerUuid = player.getUniqueId();
ItemStack[] items = new ItemStack[]{ new ItemStack(Material.DIAMOND, 5) };
```

title: Book Binder
description: A small, outdated data pack for generating random books. Mainly meant to be incorporated into other data packs.
body:
Pretty much what the summary says: "A small, outdated data pack for generating random books. Mainly meant to be incorporated into other data packs."

--- ### Functions
`book_binder:book/upload {no arguments}`: Attempts to upload the pages of the currently held book to storage. Fails if the executer isn't a player with a book and quill or written book in their main-hand. Overwrites any previous data if successful. `book_binder:book/add_pages {no arguments}`: Attempts to append the pages of the currently held book to the pages within storage. Fails if the executer isn't a player with a book and quill or written book in their main-hand. `book_binder:book/add_page {page:}`: Appends the data of argument "page" to the pages within storage. Data of argument "page" is treated as a string enclosed in double quotes, even if it wasn't originally. In most cases, I'd suggest using `book_binder:book/add_pages` instead. `book_binder:book/clear {no arguments}`: Removes all pages within storage. Simple as that. `book_binder:book/remove_page {page:}`: Attempts to remove the page at index "page" within storage. Fails if the targeted page doesn't exist. `book_binder:book/output {no arguments}`: Attempts to create a writen book item entity containing a copy of the pages within storage. Note: said item entity despawns in 2 game ticks, to prevent clutter. Fails if there aren't any pages within storage. `book_binder:book/generate {pages:}`: Attempts to create a writen book item entity containing "pages" number of random pages from storage. Note: said item entity despawns in 2 game ticks, to prevent clutter. Each page within storage can occur only once in the generated book, and are randomly arranged in said book. Attempting to generate a book with more pages then what's been stored will result in a book with as many pages as what's in storage. Attempting to use integers less than or equal to one for the argument "pages" results in a book with only one page. Fails if there aren't any pages within storage. `book_binder:construct/add {page:}`: Attempts to append the page at index "page" within storage to a second set of pages within storage. Changes made to one set of pages isn't reflected in the other set. Fails if the targeted page doesn't exist. `book_binder:construct/remove {page:}`: Attempts to remove the page at index "page" from the second set of pages within storage. Fails if the targeted page doesn't exist. `book_binder:construct/output {no arguments}`: Attempts to create a writen book item entity containing a copy of the second set of pages within storage. Note: said item entity despawns in 2 game ticks, to prevent clutter. Fails if there aren't any pages in the second set of pages within storage. `book_binder:construct/clear {no arguments}`: Removes all pages from the second set of pages within storage. --- I'll probably make a simple video to demonstrate these functions.

title: MSMP Console
description: Extends the Minecraft Server Management Protocol (MSMP) by providing additional functions for interacting with the console
body:
# MSMP Console

A server-side Fabric mod that extends the [Minecraft Server Management Protocol](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Server_Management_Protocol) (MSMP) by providing additional functions for interacting with the console.

This mod is designed for tooling, dashboards, automation systems, external monitoring tools, and integrations that need structured access to the server console without relying on RCON or log-file tailing.


## Installation

1. Download the mod `.jar` and place it in your server's `mods/` folder.
2. Enable the Management Server in `server.properties`:
```properties
   management-server-enabled=true
```
3. Start the server. The Management Server will listen on `localhost:25576` by default.


## Configuration

On first start, the mod generates a configuration file at `<server_root_dir>/config/msmp/console/config.yml`:

```yaml
# Main configuration file for MSMP Entity.

# Configuration for log related settings.
log:
  # The minimum log level that gets forwarded as a console:notification/log/event.
  # Events below this level are ignored entirely and never sent to connected clients.
  # @possible: TRACE | DEBUG | INFO | WARN | ERROR | FATAL
  # @default: 'INFO'
  level: INFO
# Configuration for send related settings.
send:
  # Enable logging for the execution of a command in the console, this prevents echoing the send command.
  # @default: true
  log-command-execution: true
```

## RPC Methods

The mod currently provides the following MSMP RPC methods. All of these methods are also automatically discoverable through the standard `rpc.discover` MSMP endpoint.

| Method         | Description                                                                           |
|:---------------|:--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `console:send` | Executes a command on the server console with full permissions and returns its output |

> If you want more methods or notifications for other purposes, please [open an issue](https://github.com/MinecraftPlayground/msmp-console-mod/issues/new?template=new_method_or_notification_suggesetion.yml)


## RPC Notifications

The mod also provides the following MSMP RPC notification that clients can subscribe to:

| Method                           | Description                                                                     |
|:---------------------------------|:--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `console:notification/log/event` | Fired for every server console log event at or above the configured `log.level` |


## Method Reference

### `console:send`

Executes an arbitrary command as if typed by an operator (full permissions) and returns its textual feedback/error output together with a success indicator. The command may be sent with or without a leading `/`.

```jsonc
// Request
{ "command": "say Hello" }

// Response
{
  "command": "say Hello",
  "result": "",
  "success": true
}
```

---

### `console:notification/log/event`

Fired for every server console log event whose level is at or above the configured `log.level`. Events below that level are dropped before ever reaching connected clients.

```jsonc
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "console:notification/log/event",
  "params": [{
    "timestamp": "2026-03-21T15:06:06.146Z",
    "level": "INFO",
    "thread": "Server thread",
    "logger": "net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer",
    "message": "Done (1.019s)! For help, type \"help\"",
    "throwable": ""
  }]
}
```

```jsonc
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "console:notification/log/event",
  "params": [{
    "timestamp": "2026-03-21T15:06:07.212Z",
    "level": "ERROR",
    "thread": "Server thread",
    "logger": "net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer",
    "message": "Encountered an unexpected exception",
    "throwable": "java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke ...\n\tat net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer..."
  }]
}
```

## License

[LGPL-3.0](LICENSE)

_Please note that a handful of the powers above will receive a revamp when the time comes, I'm currently a solo-dev, so all customized content within the mod originates from me, including but not limited to: Models, Icons, GUIs/HUDs, Code, etc. With that in mind, please understand if some things seem to be low-quality, I can only do so much, but you can be assured that anything of poor quality will not remain so in the coming updates._



As for other content currently in the mod, there is:



Barrier-block reflection damage. Unique to Barrier users. Should the barrier user activate their shield & another player (or entity) attacks the shield, it should deal recoil damage towards the attacker.
![Barrier Power being used](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/060e3892bb756e39de0c184ee836c13054c8fbd2.png)

Custom HUDs/GUIs:

Aura Bar (top left corner)

Custom Ability Menu (overlay's Palladium's default ability menu)

The Aura bar, as you might've guessed, serves as your UnOrdinary-equivalent of an Energy bar, or maybe Mana bar, whichever suits your taste. The value of your Aura goes up as you progress your Power level, another concept we'll cover in a moment.

![Photo of Aura bar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc14ddcb1164f5d81165ed0dc7f52519a54cd9c9.png)

Custom Ability Menu holds several aspects of the game. Which includes: PowerName, PowerLevel, Description of Power, Stat Pentagon (currently not developed), Mastery bar, Stat-by-stat viewer (currently not developed). The non-developed aspects of the GUI will become functional as we start moving towards update 2.0, depending on how initial release turns out.

![Image of the updated ability menu for Palladium](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7da43a70b988eb92eb210b7284583a0856fab7d8.png)

Fate (RNG). The (canon) mechanic where your power is essentially determined by fate (RNG) when you join the game, as well as your starting PowerLevel (max-borne is 5.0). You are, for now, guaranteed an UnOrigin power no matter what when you join. Some aspects are expected to undergo change in the future.

![Photo of how the mod will fire once joining a world](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f45be1432021b95b615ba21d5d06ee23bb45c655.png)

PowerLevels. So far, they only scale your minecraft base stats, such as speed, jump boost, defense, health, damage, etc. Each power has their respective field of stat scaling. Barrier will obviously have a higher scale of defense points compared to Regeneration, in contrast Regeneration will have more HP scaling compared to Barrier. Leveling/gaining Mastery (the giant yellow bar in your ability menu) will increase your PL by +0.1 everytime the bar is completed, maxing out at 10.0. Some powers may serve as an exception to the minecraft-base stat scaling, an example being Explosion, where it's damage output is also scaled. This occured because of my testing, sorry for the imbalance :) .



Mob Powers. Grants mobs copy-able powers. This was really only added to assist single-player Aura Manipulation players and so far has no other function. Any humanoid-like entity can carry a power tag, such as: Villagers, Zombies (all variations), Skeletons (all variations), Piglins (all variations), Pillagers (all variations), Witches, and Endermen.



Aura Manipulation. This power is drained by the triangular method; 1 power copied is 3 drain/s, 2 powers copied is 6 drain/s, 3 is 10 drain/s, 4 is 15 drain/s, so on and so forth. There is no set cap on how many powers can be copied, that just depends on the Aura value of what the AM player can handle. It also allows the player to copy powers within a 20 block radius. Holding the copy wheel will show the available powers in the area, including Mob Powers. 

![Photo of Aura Manipulation's copy wheel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/130decacf1a712244bd024a8c6e13028268cb02a.png)

title: Music to my Ears
description: A mod that lets you play music of your choice in-game!
body:
# Music to my Ears

**A mod that lets you play custom music in-game!**

#### Commands (/mtme):

- queue [song_name/all] -> queue a song/all songs
- queue [song_name] remove -> remove a song
- list -> list all queued songs
- skip -> skip to the next queued song
- stop -> stop the current song and clear the queue

## HOW TO ADD SONGS

#### Windows:

- Press "Win + R"
- Type "%APPDATA%\\.minecraft\config\Music to my Ears\music"
- Press "Enter"
- Drag your music files into that folder

#### macOS:

- Open "Finder"
- Press "Cmd + Shift + G"
- Type "~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/config/Music to my Ears/music"
- Press "Enter"
- Drag your music files into that folder

#### ONLY SUPPORTS .OGG FILES & FILE NAMES MUST BE IN LOWERCASE!

**Additionally, when adding new songs, you DO NOT have to leave the server/re-open minecraft. You can simply add a new song file and play it right away!**

title: PokémonTCG
description: This project adds Pokémon TCG to Minecraft.
body:
!! LAGRE REWORK UPDATE COMING NEXT WEEK !!
Sorry for delay..

Bring the excitement of collecting Pokémon Trading Cards into Minecraft!

Open booster packs, collect cards, complete sets, trade with friends, and build your ultimate collection. The mod includes different card rarities, secret cards, advancements, and exciting pulls rates inspired by the real Pokémon Trading Card Game.

A brand-new set is released every other week!

The next set is chosen by community voting through Google Polls, giving players a chance to decide what expansion gets added next. Sometimes the winning set will be selected directly from community requests, while other weeks may be chosen by a random wheel spin.
[Google Form](https://forms.gle/4UwRXyqFAwQEHWhQ6)

How to get Pokémon TCG Products

A TCG Collector villager can be found in villages or be created by placing a chest near an unemployed villager. Once assigned, the TCG Collector offers a variety of Pokémon TCG products, including Booster Packs, Booster Bundles, and Elite Trainer Boxes that can be purchased through trading.

Binders

TCG Binders are now available through the TCG Collector villager. Binders now allow players to store, organize, and display their collections in customizable binders while tracking progress toward completing sets and master sets. Apprentice TCG Collector villagers offer small binders with a capacity of 150 card slots, while Master TCG Collector villagers offer large binders that have 300 tcg card slots.

Pack pull rates

A file for each set's odds is available at the [Github](https://github.com/domm-f/pokmontcg/) project page.

Found a bug? Have a suggestion?

Please report issues and leave feedback on [Github](https://github.com/domm-f/pokmontcg/) so they can be tracked and fixed.

(Future plans) 
- Bug Fixes

I plan on fixing the glitched texture lines that are visible on cards with the enchant glint. 
- TCG Battles 

A dedicated play mat system is planned for future updates. Until then, players can use item frames and storage blocks to create their own tabletop battle setups. I also plan on adding Theme decks and battle decks 

- Coins and Sleeves

Coins would be obtained from booster products or elite trainer boxes and will serve as decorative collectibles, with potential future use in TCG Battles. Sleeves will allow players to protect and customize the appearance of their cards while also adding an extra layer of rarity to their collection.
- Card grading

Cards would be able to receive item durability conditions acting as grades. Higher grades will increase a card's value and make rare pulls even more collectible.
- International Language Sets

Future updates may include Pokémon TCG sets from other regions and languages, including Japanese expansions and promotional cards.


Thank you for playing Pokémon TCG Mod and supporting the project!

This mod is not affiliated with Pokémon or Nintendo.
Pokémon is a trademark of Nintendo, Creatures Inc. and GAME FREAK inc.

title: Prefix Tag
description: Fully configurable mod that adds a prefix for your server for roleplay and pvp tier
body:
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1486306690390560798?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&label=Discord&labelColor=FFFFFF&color=5865F2)](https://discord.gg/https://discord.gg/zN84wm2Avh)
![Modrinth Version](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/v/alIqocl4?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&labelColor=FFFFFF&color=%2327A157)
![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-active-20B2AA?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=FFFFFF)
[![Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ko--fi-support%20me-FF5E5B?style=for-the-badge&logo=kofi&labelColor=FFFFFF)](https://ko-fi.com/cursedbee21)

**PrefixTag** adds a dual tier system to your Minecraft server. Every player carries two independent ranks - one for Roleplay (R1–R5) and one for PvP (P1–P5) (or whatever u want xd) - always displayed as a combined prefix next to their name in chat and above their head in the world.

---

## ✦ How it works

When a player joins the server for the **first time**, a selection screen appears. They choose their **Rol tier** and then their **PvP tier**. From that moment on, their prefix - for example `[R2|P3]` - is permanently visible in chat and above their head, with colors that reflect their tier level.

Admins can reassign, reset, recolor or clear the custom name of any player at any time using simple commands.

---

## ✦ Features

- **Rol tiers** — chosen by the player on first join
- **PvP tiers** — chosen by the player on first join
- **Configurable tier count** — set between 2 and 10 tiers independently for Rol and PvP
- **Tier colors** — each tier has its own configurable color
- **Name color** — admins can set a custom color for each player's name
- **Custom display name** — players can replace their username with a custom name
- **Prefix in chat and nametag** — always visible, always up to date
- **First-join GUI** — clean two-step selection screen, can't be skipped
- **Admin commands** — override, reset, recolor or clear any player's data at any time
- **Config file** — customize tier count, labels, GUI texts and colors via `prefixtag-server.toml`
- **NBT persistence** — all data survives restarts and reconnections

---

## ✦ Commands


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

### Admin — requires op level 2

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/tier setrol <player> <1-10>` | Set a player's Rol tier |
| `/tier setpvp <player> <1-10>` | Set a player's PvP tier |
| `/tier setcolor <player> <color>` | Set the color of a player's name |
| `/tier clearname <player>` | Remove a player's custom display name |
| `/tier online <player> <true\|false>` | Toggle the online indicator (●) on a player's prefix |
| `/tier check <player>` | View a player's current prefix and display name |
| `/tier reset <player>` | Reset a player's tiers — they'll see the GUI on next login |

### Player — no permissions required

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/tierself setname <name>` | Set a custom display name (no color codes allowed) |
| `/tierself clearname` | Remove your custom display name |

</details>



**Available colors:** `black`, `dark_blue`, `dark_green`, `dark_aqua`, `dark_red`, `dark_purple`, `gold`, `gray`, `dark_gray`, `blue`, `green`, `aqua`, `red`, `light_purple`, `yellow`, `white`

---

## ✦ Configuration

On first launch, PrefixTag generates a `prefixtag-server.toml` file in the `world/serverconfig` folder where you can customize:

- Number of active tiers for Rol and PvP independently (2–10)
- Tier labels (e.g. change `R1` to `Novice`)
- GUI titles and descriptions
- Tier colors for each level
- Tier tooltips shown when hovering over each tier button

---

**You are free to include this mod in any modpack**

title: Challenge Timer
description: Server-side challenge timer that shows your playtime and in-game day in the action bar. Optional challenge mode: on death the run fails, the death screen is skipped and everyone goes spectator. Restart into a fresh world with one command.
body:
# Challenge Timer

**A lightweight, server-side challenge timer for Minecraft.** Track your playtime and in-game day right in the action bar, run death-is-failure challenges, and start fresh worlds on demand — all through simple `/ct` commands.

Perfect for speedruns, hardcore-style challenges, "how many days can you survive" runs, and multiplayer challenge servers.

---

## ✨ Features

- **⏱️ Live action-bar display** — shows your played time and the current in-game day, always visible while you play.
- **🎛️ Three display modes** — show the timer only, the day only, or both side by side.
- **💀 Challenge mode** — when a player dies, the challenge counts as **failed**: the timer freezes, the death screen is **skipped**, and everyone is instantly put into **spectator mode** with a bold *"Challenge failed"* title.
- **🌍 One-command world restart** — `/ct reset` deletes the world and generates a brand-new one with a **fresh random seed**. As a safety guard, it only runs when **all players are in spectator mode**.
- **🌐 Automatic language** — every message appears in **German** or **English**, automatically based on each player's game language. No config needed.
- **🪶 Server-side & lightweight** — runs entirely on the server. Players don't need to install anything.

---

## 🎮 Commands

All players can view info; changing settings requires operator/gamemaster permission (op level 2).

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/ct help` | Everyone | Show all commands |
| `/ct status` | Everyone | Show elapsed time, in-game day and all settings |
| `/ct mode both` | Operator | Display day **and** time |
| `/ct mode timer` | Operator | Display the time only |
| `/ct mode days` | Operator | Display the day only |
| `/ct challenge on` / `off` | Operator | Toggle: on death the challenge counts as failed |
| `/ct reset` | Operator | Restart the world with a new seed *(only if everyone is in spectator)* |

---

## ⚠️ Important: `/ct reset`

`/ct reset` **permanently deletes the current world** and regenerates it with a new seed — this **cannot be undone**. It is intentionally locked behind the requirement that **all online players are in spectator mode** (which naturally happens after a failed challenge). After the reset the server stops; simply re-open / rejoin the world to drop into the freshly generated world.

---

Works on dedicated servers and in singleplayer. Since it's server-side, only the server (or the world host) needs the mod.

---

title: FlameCraft - Explore The Unknown
description: New mechanics, QoL patches, more adventures, many new features
body:
FlameCraft pack takes Minecraft to a whole new level of adventure gameplay, emphasizing exploration, narrative, and character development. The world has been significantly expanded with new biomes, structures, and randomly generated dungeons that hide unique items, puzzles, and powerful bosses. Each expedition becomes a unique experience, allowing players to discover forgotten ruins, mystical kingdoms, and dangerous dungeons brimming with secrets.

The pack also introduces revamped gameplay mechanics, including an improved combat system, more complex crafting, [corpses](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/corpse) so as not to lose your progress, and expanded equipment progression. With new tools and special abilities, players can tailor their playstyle to their preferences, creating heroes capable of overcoming the most challenging challenges.

One key element of the pack is deeper and more dynamic interaction with settlers. NPCs have their own roles, dialogue, and needs, and building relationships with them unlocks special quests, unique goods, and support during expeditions. Settlements become living places that respond to player actions and can grow with them.

Despite its rich content, the pack maintains excellent optimization, ensuring the world runs smoothly even on low-mid-end computers. Advanced configuration tools allow you to tailor performance to your individual hardware capabilities without sacrificing gameplay quality.

This is the perfect option for players who dream of a full-fledged Minecraft adventure—full of discovery, challenges, and an immersive atmosphere.
