title: stasisrod
description: where u have to craft it and link it to a pearl and u can pull ur pearl through the fishing rod then it breaks.
body:
## Stasis Rod

**Stasis Rod** is a Paper plugin that adds a craftable **Unstable Stasis Rod** to Minecraft. Players can link the rod to an ender pearl, then cast and reel the fishing rod to pull themselves to the linked pearl.

The rod is unstable, so it breaks after use to keep it balanced for survival, SMP, and PvP servers.

## Features

* Adds a custom craftable **Unstable Stasis Rod**
* Link the rod to an **Ender Pearl**
* Pull yourself to the linked pearl by casting and reeling the rod
* Rod can break after use
* Configurable messages
* Configurable recipe
* Configurable pearl lifetime
* Configurable max link distance
* Optional permission requirement
* Admin command for giving rods
* Reload command for config changes
* Made for Paper **1.21.11**

## Crafting Recipe

```text
Air    | Ender Pearl | Air
String | Blaze Rod   | String
Air    | Fishing Rod | Air
```

Result:

```text
1 Unstable Stasis Rod
```

## How To Use

1. Craft the **Unstable Stasis Rod**
2. Put an **Ender Pearl** in your offhand
3. Hold the rod and **Sneak + Right Click** to link the pearl
4. Cast the rod
5. Reel it back to pull yourself toward the linked pearl
6. The rod breaks after being used

## Commands

```text
/stasisrod give <player>
```

Gives a player an Unstable Stasis Rod.

```text
/stasisrod reload
```

Reloads the plugin config.

## Permissions

```text
stasisrod.use
```

Allows players to use Stasis Rods.

Default: `true`

```text
stasisrod.admin
```

Allows access to the Stasis Rod admin commands, including giving rods and reloading the config.

Default: `op`

## Server Version

* Minecraft: **1.21.11**
* Server Software: **Paper**
* Java: **21**

## Installation

1. Download the plugin jar.
2. Put it into your server’s `plugins` folder.
3. Restart your server.
4. Edit the config if needed.
5. Players can now craft and use Stasis Rods.

## Notes

This plugin adds a custom stasis-style movement item inspired by pearl stasis mechanics. It is meant to be useful but not overpowered, since the rod is unstable and can break after use.

title: The Cartographer's Grief
description: The world remembers your deaths. Grief Skulls mark every place you fell, upgrading to Obelisks after 7 in-game days. Craft Memory Shards into exploration tools and watch your Wanderlust bar fill as you discover new chunks.
body:
## What's new in v1.1.1

- Fixed direction arrows now pointing correctly from player to location for both Memory Orb recall and Grief Map entries. Fixed Memory Orb named label display when using a custom-named orb.

## The Cartographer's Grief

The world remembers your deaths.

Every time you die, a glowing **Grief Skull** block is placed at your exact death location. Right-click it to read who died there and how. After **7 in-game days** (168,000 ticks), it silently upgrades into a taller, brighter **Obelisk** — a permanent monument to that moment.

Break a Grief Skull to collect **Memory Shards**, the currency of this mod.

---

### Items

**Memory Shard** — drops from Grief Skulls and Obelisks. Used in all crafting recipes.

**Memory Orb** (Memory Shard + Ender Pearl) — right-click once to save your current position. Right-click again anywhere to see the exact coordinates and distance back. Works across dimensions with a warning.

**Wanderer's Compass** (Compass + 4 Memory Shards) — points toward the nearest uncharted structure: villages, ruins, outposts, shipwrecks, and more. Prints the direction and distance in chat.

---

### Wanderlust HUD

A slim bar at the top of your screen fills as you explore new chunks, up to 500 unique chunks tracked. It pulses with a soft glow when full. Persisted per world and server.

---

### Required on both sides

This mod registers custom blocks and world data, so both client and server need it installed.

# Enchanted Lucky Blocks  
Introducing a new Minecraft mod: Enchanted Lucky Blocks! There are two types of these blocks: green and yellow. The green blocks are similar to normal lucky blocks and offer resources and effects, while the yellow blocks present a challenge: if you fail, you will lose 3 health points (6 hearts) permanently.  

On the top left corner of each block, there is a lucky coin, which is the currency in the lucky block universe. Breaking a green lucky block gives you +3 lucky coins, while a yellow lucky block grants you +9 lucky coins.  
In your inventory, there is also a leveling menu where you can use your lucky coins to improve your health, armour, and luck, as well as unique perks such as being able to fly without elytras.  
Good luck on your journey with the lucky blocks!

description: Oma's Metalworks - is a technical Minecraft Fabric mod focused on metallurgy, advanced alloys, and industrial-style processing.
body:
# **🛠️ Metalworks**

**Metalworks** is a technical expansion for Minecraft Fabric that bridges the gap between basic vanilla survival and advanced metallurgy. This mod introduces a tiered progression system focused on specialized metals, unique alloys, and realistic environmental hazards.

### **✨ Core Features**

**🏗️ Advanced Metallurgy**
Unlock the potential of new materials found deep within the earth. Metalworks introduces a logical progression path for refining raw ores into high-grade industrial materials.

* **Steel Alloys:** Master the art of carbon-strengthening to create **Steel**. It provides a significant upgrade over Iron, offering superior durability and efficiency.
* **Heavy Lead:** Utilize **Lead** for specialized applications. While heavy and durable, this metal requires careful handling due to its toxic nature.
* **Bronze Crafting:** Combine metals to create **Bronze**, a versatile material for tools and defense.

**⚔️ Specialized Equipment**
Expand your arsenal with full sets of tools and protective gear.

* **Steel Tier:** A reliable middle-ground between Iron and Diamond. Perfect for players who need rugged, long-lasting equipment.
* **Lead Tier:** Heavy-duty equipment with unique physical properties.
* **Bronze Shield:** A custom-engineered defense tool with its own sound effects and balancing.
* **Custom Tools:** Includes **Pickaxes**, **Axes**, **Swords**, **Shovels**, and **Hoes**.

**🛡️ Protective Armor Sets**
Forge complete suits of armor from the mod's signature metals.

* **Steel Armor:** High-protection plating that keeps you safe in the most dangerous environments.
* **Lead Armor:** Dense, protective layering designed for specialized defense.

**🧪 Unique Gameplay Mechanics**
* **Toxicity System:** Beware! Handling certain raw materials like **Lead** can have adverse effects on your health.
* **Vanilla+ Integration:** Every item and block is designed to feel like it belongs in the base game.
* **Custom Shield Durability:** I spent over **3 hours** trying to implement the shield's durability logic using official Mojang mappings, but couldn't get it to work properly. As a result, I've implemented a **custom workaround** to ensure the shield breaks as intended. It might look a bit **"janky"**, but it works! Sorry for any extra trouble during the review.

### **🌐 Supported Languages**
* 🇺🇦 **Ukrainian** (Native)
* 🇺🇸 **English** (Full support)
* 🇵🇱 **Polish** (Added in v1.1.0)

**If you want to help with translations, feel free to contact me!**

### **📥 Installation & Requirements**
1. Install the **Fabric Loader**.
2. Download and install **Fabric API** and **Cloth Config API** (**Required**).
3. Drop the **Metalworks** jar into your mods folder and start forging!

**For bug reports, please join our Discord.**

title: Ordinal
description: Track unique player join order and recognize your veteran community members! Assigns sequential member IDs with full PlaceholderAPI support for custom tablists and scoreboards.
body:
Ordinal

Track unique player join order and recognize your veteran community members! Assigns sequential member IDs with full PlaceholderAPI support for custom tablists and scoreboards.

*** **Ordinal** is a lightweight **utility plugin** designed to assign persistent, **sequential join IDs** (Ordinal Ranks) to every player on your server. This plugin is ideal for servers wanting to implement a **seniority system** to recognize long-time members, display distinct ranks in chat, or simply maintain an organized player database. ### Features Ordinal handles seniority tracking with a focus on these core functions: * It assigns unique **sequential IDs** (e.g., `#1`, `#67`) based on strict join order. * It includes a **smart migration** system that automatically calculates and backfills seniority for existing players based on historical join dates. * It features native **PlaceholderAPI** support to display seniority ranks using `%ordinal_rank%`. * It supports fully configurable messages using [MiniMessage](https://docs.papermc.io/adventure/minimessage/format) formatting. ### Prerequisites To use this plugin, your server must be running **Paper**, **Purpur**, or **Folia** on `1.21` or higher. It requires **Java 21**. #### Dependencies * [PlaceholderAPI](https://placeholderapi.com/) ### Documentation & Support For a complete guide on features, commands, and configuration, please visit our [Wiki](https://docs.maboroshi.org/). If you have questions or need to report a bug, join our [Discord server](https://discord.maboroshi.org) or open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/MaboroshiKobo/Ordinal/issues). ### Statistics This plugin utilizes [bStats](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/Ordinal/28615) to collect anonymous usage metrics. ![bStats Metrics](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/Ordinal.svg)

body:
# Sweeper Can / 垃圾桶 **Sweeper Can** is a 1.20.1 Fabric port inspired by the Sweeper Maid mod. It periodically clears dropped items to reduce lag and features a global trash can, allowing players to retrieve items that have been swept away. **垃圾桶 (Sweeper Can)** 参考了Sweeper Maid模组，进行了1.20.1的Fabric移植，可以定期清理掉落物，内置了一个全局垃圾桶，方便玩家拿取被清理的掉落物。 ----- ## Features | 功能特性 ### English * **Periodic Item Sweeping**: Automatically clears dropped items on the ground at customizable intervals. * **Cleanup Countdown Broadcasts**: Sends chat warnings at 60s, 30s, and a final countdown before the sweep occurs. * **Global Trash Can**: A shared trash can (up to 10 pages) accessible via an inventory button or commands, allowing players to retrieve cleared items. * **Item Blacklist**: Open the cleanup blacklist through the command or control interface to record items that you do not want to be automatically cleaned up. * **In-Game Configuration**: Full support for in-game configuration via **Cloth Config** and **Mod Menu**. title: PackreloadFix
description: PackreloadFix fixes an unnecessary resource reload after leaving the Resource Packs screen when nothing effectively changed.
body:
# PackreloadFix

PackreloadFix is a small client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11.

It fixes an unnecessary resource reload after leaving the Resource Packs screen when nothing effectively changed.

Reload is skipped when:
- the enabled resource-pack list is unchanged
- the active order is unchanged when strict order checking is enabled

Reload is still allowed when:
- a pack is enabled or disabled
- the active pack order changes
- packs are added or removed while the screen is open
- the mod cannot compare the old and new state safely

The mod is client-only and does not need to be installed on servers.

Mod Menu support is optional.
The built-in config screen works through Mod Menu without YACL.
YACL is optional and only replaces the built-in config screen with a YACL-based one.

title: EpitaphMC
description: All players deserves a tombstone...
body:
# 🪦 Epitaph ### *Etched in stone, never forgotten.* ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.0-darkgrey) ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.19%20→%201.21-green) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Paper%20%7C%20Spigot%20%7C%20Purpur-blue) ![Ecosystem](https://img.shields.io/badge/CivCraft-Suite-orange) **The world remembers.** ![Banner](https://iili.io/BUyubNn.md.png)
--- ## 🕯️ The Concept Items despawning on the floor is a tragedy. **Epitaph** replaces loot drops with a **physical gravestone** built at the exact location of death. Each grave stores the player's items safely in a locked chest, carves their last chat message in stone, and records the full context of their passing — creating an organic, ever-growing graveyard wherever battles occur. --- ## ✨ Features **🪦 Physical Graves** A stone structure with the player's head is automatically built at death. Graves hold all the player's items and XP (converted to bottles) in a locked chest — only the owner can open it. **💬 Last Words** If the player typed anything in chat within the last 60 seconds before dying, it's automatically engraved on their grave as their last words. **🌿 Decay System** Graves age over time through four states: **Fresh → Ancient → Ruin → Gone**. Each stage changes the grave's appearance. Configure exactly how long each stage lasts — or disable decay entirely. **📍 Grave Finder** Lost track of where you died? `/grave find` points you toward your active grave — no more wandering. **📖 Death Records** Every death is logged permanently. Use `/grave list` to browse the server's full death history, or `/grave history ` to look up a specific player's past deaths. Generate a physical **Book of the Dead** with `/grave book `. **📊 Server Stats** `/grave stats` displays server-wide death statistics — most dangerous locations, most common causes, total graves spawned. **🏛️ Cemetery (Optional)** Define an official cemetery with `/grave cemetery-set`. Graves can be automatically relocated there, organized in rows, with passive epitaph messages shown to players who walk nearby. --- ## 🔗 CivCraft Suite Integration Epitaph enriches every grave with context from the other plugins of the suite — automatically, with no configuration needed. | Plugin | What gets added to the grave | |--------|------------------------------| | ⚔️ **ReanimateMC** | No grave on KO — only on real death. Grave notes if the player was previously knocked out. | | 🏹 **BountyBoard** | Grave displays the active bounty and the hunter's name if killed for a reward. | | 🕵️ **Witness** | Grave links to the Witness crime report ID and notes the number of witnesses present. | | 🪪 **Reputation** | The player's reputation tier at time of death is carved onto the grave. | | ⚖️ **Tribunal** | Judicial executions generate a permanent **obsidian grave** with the charge, judge and tribunal name. | > All integrations are **soft dependencies** — Epitaph works perfectly with none of them installed. --- ## 💻 Commands All commands are also available as `/grave` and `/graves`. | Command | Permission | Description | |---------|------------|-------------| | `/grave find` | `epitaph.use` | Points you toward your active grave | | `/grave list [page]` | `epitaph.use` | Browse the server's full death records | | `/grave history ` | `epitaph.use` | View a specific player's death history | | `/grave visit ` | `epitaph.use` | Teleport to a player's grave (Cemetery mode) | | `/grave book ` | `epitaph.use` | Generate a physical Book of the Dead | | `/grave stats` | `epitaph.use` | Display server-wide death statistics | | `/grave retrieve` | `epitaph.retrieve` | Retrieve your grave items from anywhere | | `/grave remove ` | `epitaph.admin` | Remove a player's grave from the world | | `/grave restore ` | `epitaph.admin` | Restore a previously removed grave | | `/grave cemetery-set` | `epitaph.admin` | Set the cemetery location | | `/grave cemetery-info` | `epitaph.admin` | Display cemetery status and stats | | `/grave reload` | `epitaph.admin` | Reload the plugin configuration | --- ## 🔑 Permissions | Permission | Default | Description | |------------|---------|-------------| | `epitaph.use` | ✅ Everyone | Access all public commands | | `epitaph.retrieve` | ✅ Everyone | Retrieve items from your own grave remotely | | `epitaph.open.others` | ⚙️ OP | Open and loot other players' graves | | `epitaph.immune` | ❌ Nobody | Prevent grave generation on death | | `epitaph.lastwords.bypass` | ❌ Nobody | Prevent chat messages from becoming last words | | `epitaph.admin` | ⚙️ OP | Access all admin commands | --- ## ⚙️ Configuration Highlights ```yaml epitaph: chest_expiry_hours: 48 # How long items stay in the grave last_words_window_seconds: 60 # Chat window captured for last words proximity_radius: 18 # Blocks before proximity alert triggers degradation: fresh_hours: 24 ancient_hours: 168 # 7 days ruin_hours: 720 # 30 days auto_delete: false # Graves never fully disappear by default ``` ---
*Part of the **CivCraft Suite** — Building better societies, one block at a time.* [ReanimateMC](https://modrinth.com/plugin/reanimatemc) • BountyBoard • Witness • Reputation • Tribunal • **Epitaph**

title: Multiple Dragon Eggs
description: Drops an extra dragon egg each time a player kills the Ender Dragon for the first time.
body:
In addition to the first egg that vanilla Minecraft spawns, each time a player unlocks the "Free the End" advancement, this mod drops an addional egg for them. 

Intended for use on multiplayer servers to prevent players from being locked out of having a dragon egg just because they were a bit late to the party. Unlike other mods that spawn an egg every time the dragon is killed, this mod keeps eggs as a finite, valuable trophy by only spawning an egg when a player gets the "Free the End" advancement, limiting it to only one extra egg per player.

title: BlackMarket
description: Advanced GUI-based rare/illegal item shop plugin.
body:
# BlackMarket Plugin

## Overview
BlackMarket is an exclusive, highly customizable GUI-based black market shop plugin for your Minecraft server. It brings a unique dynamic economy experience by offering randomly opening shops or fixed-duration black markets. With built-in purchase tracking and an integrated Admin GUI Editor, managing rare or illegal item sales has never been easier or more immersive!

## Features
- **Dynamic Shop Availability**: Choose between an `always-open` shop, or a thrilling `random-open` system that alerts players when the market appears!
- **Random Pick Mode**: Want a rotating shop? Enable `random-pick` and define how many items to showcase! The plugin will organically select items and display them neatly.
- **Stock Market Mode**: Items are restricted by a global stock limit. If `stock-market` is enabled, an item's price will dynamically double when it completely sells out!
- **Strict Purchase Limits**: Prevent economy abuse by setting a `player-purchase-limit` per opening phase, tracked reliably via SQLite.
- **In-Game GUI Editor**: Admins can easily add, edit, or adjust items (prices, GUI slots, and stocks) directly in-game without touching config files.
- **Advanced GUI Effects**: Smooth custom animations (like `slide` in the config) and stylized UI menus.
- **Immersive Alerts System**: When the market opens, alert your entire server using Titles, Broadcasts, Fireworks, and Sounds.
- **Discord Integration via Webhooks**: Automatically notify your Discord community precisely when the in-game black market opens, complete with custom Bot names and avatars!
- **Robust Economy Integration**: Soft-depends on Vault to securely handle all transactions. Also supports PlaceholderAPI and Citizens!

## Commands
- `/blackmarket` - Opens the BlackMarket GUI (if it is currently open).
- `/blackmarket editor` - Opens the Admin Control Panel GUI to build and edit your shop inventory.
- `/blackmarket reload` - Reloads all configuration files instantly!

## Permissions
- `blackmarket.use` - Allows players to open the shop menu. (Default: true)
- `blackmarket.editor` - Allows opening the admin GUI editor. (Default: op)
- `blackmarket.reload` - Allows reloading the plugin manually. (Default: op)

## Configuration
The plugin generates a pristine `config.yml` on first run:

### `config.yml` Options:
- **Shop Settings**:
  - `always-open` / `random-open` switches the style of your black market.
  - `random-pick`: Set to true to display a rotating shop of random items! Control the quantity with `random-pick-amount`.
  - `stock-market`: Set to true to automatically double an item's price when its stock reaches zero.
  - `open-duration`: Timer indicating how long players have to buy items when it opens (e.g. `30m`).
  - `player-purchase-limit`: Limits the total slots of items a player can buy in one session!
- **GUI & Effects**:
  - `gui-effects` handle animations like sliding items.
  - Toggles for `firework`, `sound`, `title`, and `broadcast` precisely control how the server reacts when the shop goes live.
- **Discord Alerts**:
  - Enter your `webhook-url`, `bot-name`, and `channel-id` to automatically sync notifications to your Discord Server.

## Author Information
- **Developer**: KakashiPlayz!
- **Created By**: KakashiPlayz!
- **Portfolio Website**: https://kakashiplayz.vercel.app
- **Discord Server**: https://discord.gg/QdTN4BFkTv

## Plugin Version
1.0.2

## Compatibility
Works natively with the following Minecraft server versions:
- **1.13.x, 1.14.x, 1.15.x, 1.16.x**
- **1.17.x, 1.18.x, 1.19.x, 1.20.x**
- **1.21.x**
- **26.1, 26.1.1** *(new Minecraft versioning scheme)*

Compatible with Spigot, Paper, Purpur, and Bukkit-based servers.
Requires Vault & a valid Economy plugin to process purchases!

## Installation
1. Ensure you have installed Vault and an Economy Plugin (e.g. EssentialsX)
2. Place the `BlackMarket.jar` file in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server
4. The plugin will generate configuration files in the `plugins/BlackMarket` folder
5. Configure your settings, MySQL/SQLite database in the files, and you're good to go!

## Support
For issues or questions, join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/QdTN4BFkTv

title: ChatNext
description: The next generation of Minecraft chat management. Multilingual, private, and highly customizable. Build the chat your community deserves with ChatNext.
body:
# ChatNext

The definitive chat management solution for modern Minecraft servers. ChatNext is a lightweight, efficient, and highly customizable chat plugin designed to replace cumbersome, outdated chat managers. Built from the ground up for compatibility with Spigot 1.20+, it offers the perfect balance between professional features and simplicity.

## Features

ChatNext launches with a robust core set of features designed to improve communication.

### Languages
ChatNext is multilingual. Out of the box, we support English (en), Spanish (es), and Portuguese (pt). All messages are separated into language files in the `/idiomas/` folder. This allows administrators to easily change the server language in the `config.yml` or create translations.

### Format
* **Placeholders:** Define your chat structure using `{prefix}`, `{player}`, and `{message}`.
* **Configurable:** Control exactly how the chat looks via the `config.yml`. Example: `&8[&bPrefix&8] {player} &8» &f{message}`.

### Private
* **System:** Includes native `/msg` (aliases: `tell`, `w`, `m`) and `/reply` (`r`) commands.
* **Tracking:** Conversations use player UUIDs, preventing memory leaks.
* **Toggleable:** Messaging can be disabled entirely via the config.
* **Block:** A clean prevention system stops players from messaging themselves.

### Alerts
* **Silent:** Completely disable Minecraft's default yellow join/quit messages.
* **Custom:** Define unique, colorful, and localized messages in the `config.yml` that appear when a player enters or leaves.

## Commands

### Core
* `/chatnext` (Alias: `/cn`): Base command.
* `/chatnext reload`: Reloads `config.yml` and language files instantly. Permission: `chatnext.admin`

### Messages
* `/msg <player> <message>`: Send a PM. Permission: `chatnext.msg`
* `/reply <message>`: Reply to the last conversation. Permission: `chatnext.msg`

## Installation

1. Download the `ChatNext-1.0.0.jar`.
2. Place it in your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Restart your server.
4. Edit the generated `config.yml` to set your desired language.

```yaml
# Available languages in the 'idiomas' folder: en, es, pt
language: "en"

# Default Chat Format
chat-format: "{prefix} {player} &8» &f{message}"

private-messages:
  enabled: true
  format-send: "&8[&dMe &5-> &d{receiver}&8] &f{message}"
  format-receive: "&8[&d{sender} &5-> &dMe&8] &f{message}"

join-quit-messages:
  enabled: true
  join: "&8[&a+&8] &7{player} joined the server."
  quit: "&8[&c-&8] &7{player} left the server."

title: Skull Piercer (Critical Hit)
description: Master the art of precision with 'Skull Piercer', a new primary enchantment supported by various complementary enchantments to maximize your bow's lethality.
body:
# Skull Piercer (Critical Hit)

**Redefine Archery in Minecraft. Master the Art of the Headshot.**

For too long, archery in Minecraft has simply been about pulling the string and hoping your arrow hits the target's general hitbox. **Skull Piercer** completely overhauls ranged combat by introducing a highly rewarding, skill-based headshot mechanic. This mod rewards precision, patience, and accuracy with devastating damage output and incredible visual feedback. 

Whether you are defending your base from a nighttime raid or delving into the darkest dimensions, Skull Piercer provides you with a brand-new arsenal of specialized enchantments designed to turn a simple bow into a lethal sniper rifle.

---

## The Core Mechanic: Precision Rewarded

### Deadshot (Levels I - IV)
**The Foundation of a True Marksman**
* **Acquisition:** Easily obtainable through the standard Enchanting Table.
* **Mechanic:** This is the essential enchantment that unlocks the true potential of this mod. Deadshot allows your arrows to recognize head hitboxes. Striking an enemy directly in the head triggers a massive critical damage multiplier, scaling significantly with each level of the enchantment.
* **Visual Feedback:** A true sniper deserves to see the impact of their perfect shot. Every successful headshot triggers a distinct skull particle effect. As you upgrade Deadshot from Level I to Level IV, these skull particles become increasingly intense and elaborate, giving you immediate, satisfying visual confirmation of your critical hits.
* **Technical Note on Precision:** Unlike other mods that calculate hits based on where a mob is looking, Skull Piercer utilizes a "True Hitbox" system. A headshot is registered only if your arrow physically intersects with the eye-level segment of the entity's hitbox (the red square visible when pressing F3+B). This ensures that your skill is the only factor—if you see the shot land on the head, it counts.
---

## The Arsenal: Legendary and Utility Enchantments

To truly master the battlefield, you will need to explore the world and conquer its most dangerous structures to find these exclusive, loot-only enchantments.

### King Crimson
**Unstoppable Momentum**
* **Acquisition:** Found exclusively within Nether Fortress chests (Rare).
* **Mechanic:** Combat in the Nether is fast and brutal, and King Crimson turns you into a relentless force. When you secure a kill via a headshot, this enchantment instantly grants you temporary Regeneration and Speed buffs. This allows you to quickly reposition, heal through incoming damage, and string together multiple headshot kills without ever losing your momentum. It is the perfect tool for taking on large hordes of enemies.

### Executioner
**The Ultimate Finisher**
* **Acquisition:** Located in Bastion Remnant Treasure Rooms (Uncommon - typically requires looting 2 to 3 Treasure Bastions to acquire).
* **Mechanic:** Some enemies simply refuse to go down quietly. Executioner is designed to end fights swiftly. When a target's health drops below the 20% threshold, your headshots will deal an unimaginably powerful critical strike. 
* **The Lethal Strike:** Furthermore, every headshot landed on an enemy below 20% health carries a flat 5% chance to trigger an Instant Kill. This incredibly potent effect applies to all entities in the game—including Bosses. 

### Golden Aim
**The Sniper's Sixth Sense**
* **Acquisition:** Highest drop rate in Buried Treasure chests; also rarely found in Shipwreck loot.
* **Mechanic:** True marksmen leave nothing to chance. Golden Aim provides a powerful tactical advantage by overlaying a targeting system onto your vision. The moment you draw your bow, this enchantment reveals glowing golden crosshairs locked directly onto the headshot hitboxes of all mobs currently visible on your screen. This allows for pinpoint accuracy in chaotic fights or pitch-black environments.

### Concussion (Levels I - II)
**Debilitating Precision**
* **Acquisition:** Found deep within Ancient Cities. The drop rate is rare, but thoroughly exploring the chests will yield results (unless you have exceptionally terrible luck).
* **Mechanic:** A headshot doesn't always have to be instantly lethal to end a fight. Concussion is designed for crowd control and debilitating powerful foes. Hitting a headshot inflicts severe status effects, turning the enemy into a sitting duck for your follow-up attacks.
  * **Level I:** A successful headshot inflicts Nausea and Slowness I, disorienting the target.
  * **Level II:** The impact is drastically increased, inflicting Nausea II and Slowness III. Enemies struck by Concussion II are practically immobilized, ensuring your next shot will not miss.

---

**Download Skull Piercer today, string your bow, and make every single shot count.**

title: Hollower
description: Hollower is a mod made for builders. It helps hollowing any build easily and efficiently.
body:
# Hollower

A simple Fabric mod for Minecraft that lets you easily select, highlight, and hollow out large builds.

## Before/After hollow demonstration

![showcase hollow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qYjEdw9s/images/848440d07401b8f7b1cbac25fc12203551b06852.png)

## What does Hollower do?

- **Select an area**: Mark two corners to define a box in your world.
- **Cast**: Instantly highlight all visible blocks inside your selection.
- **Hollow**: Remove the inside of your selection, leaving only the outer shell.
- **Undo**: Restore the last hollowed area if you make a mistake.
- **Multi-level undo**: Undo multiple hollow or cast actions, not just the last one.
- **Fast and smooth**: Designed for large builds and big selections.

## Why use Hollower?

- **Save time**: No more breaking blocks one by one.
- **Perfect for builders**: Quickly create hollow structures, clear out interiors.
- **Easy to use**: Simple commands, no technical setup needed.
- **Safe**: Undo mistakes with a single command.
- **Client-side only**: No need to install on servers.

## How to use

`/hollower pos1` — Set the first corner of your selection (where you are standing).

`/hollower pos2` — Set the opposite corner of your selection.

`/hollower cast <depth>` — Highlight all visible blocks in your selection. You can use this multiple times to add more blocks. (Optional: `depth` set how much layer to keep)

`/hollower undocast` — Undo the last cast action. Use this if you want to remove the most recently highlighted blocks.

`/hollower clear` — clear all the casted blocks.

`/hollower unselect` — remove selection and clear all casts.

`/hollower hollow` — Hollow out everything inside your selection, leaving only the outer shell.

`/hollower undo` — Undo the last hollow or restore action. You can use this multiple times to go back further.

## Troubleshooting

- If the mod doesn't show up, make sure it's in your `mods` folder and you're using Fabric.
- For crashes or issues, please include your `latest.log` and any `crash-reports` when reporting a bug.

body:
# Dungeon Keys & Loot

**Dungeon Keys & Loot** is a simple exploration-focused Minecraft mod that adds **locked caches** and **collectible keys**.

While exploring caves and underground areas, you can find special caches that can only be opened with the right key. Each key tier gives different loot quality, making exploration more rewarding and exciting.

## Features

- **3 key tiers**
  - Copper Key
  - Iron Key
  - Gold Key

- **Locked Cache block**
  - Can only be opened with a valid key
  - Consumes the key on use
  - Drops loot based on the key tier

- **Tiered loot system**
  - **Copper** = basic survival loot
  - **Iron** = better exploration rewards
  - **Gold** = rare and valuable loot

## Current Version

**v0.2.0: The Visual & Content Update**

- Added 3 lock cache tiers (copper, iron, gold)
- Lock cache retexture
- Bug fix
- Added particles and sound when open with a key

## Planned Features

- Natural generation in caves and structures

title: toows
description: Toows is a modification for Minecraft 1.12.2 (Forge) that adds tools for convenient construction and editing structures. With this mod, you can easily move, copy and stack blocks, as well as extrude areas without having to place them manually.
body:
Toows is a modification for Minecraft 1.12.2 (Forge) that adds tools for convenient construction and editing structures. With this mod, you can easily move, copy and stack blocks, as well as extrude areas without having to place them manually.


**Hold** down **TAB** to open the tools menu.
![The image shows a menu with a choice of four tools.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8657386533fdc46d66583e0ef492daaa288be6a9.webp)


 

![move tool](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c25c68691118373d9ef5fba155ce7380262595ae.png)**Move** Tool:

Left Mouse Button: Mark the first corner of the area.
Right Mouse Button: Mark the second corner, defining the block cuboid.
Mouse Wheel: Adjust the offset (where to move the area).
Right Mouse Button (Apply): Confirm the move.


![stack tool](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e160942a205b5017075f66f6e0379a0cb639097d.png)**Stack** Tool:

Left Mouse Button: Mark the first corner of the area.
Right Mouse Button: Mark the second corner
Mouse Wheel: Determine the number of copies and direction.
Right Mouse Button (Apply): Create the specified number of copies in a row.


![clone tool](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b8cfc59311a3954ae3e98b6ae6a441e0a04c0556.png)**Clone** Tool:

Similar to "Move," but the original is not deleted.
Left Mouse Button: Mark the first corner of the area.
Right Mouse Button: Mark the second corner, defining the block cuboid..
Mouse Wheel: Set the offset for the copy.
Right Mouse Button (Apply): Create a copy. You can right-click multiple times to create multiple copies.

![extrude tool](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/492f18c58a978e4bd0020904376adac5522da390_0.webp)**Extrude** Tool:

Hover the cursor over a block or its face. The face's direction determines the extrusion axis.
Left Mouse Button: Shrink (compress the area, removing a layer in the direction away from you).
Right Mouse Button: Extrude (add a layer of blocks in the direction away from you).


**Undo** **and** **Redo**:


Ctrl+Z: Undo the last action.
Ctrl+X: Redo the undone action.


The **_/toows_** help command: Displays a brief instruction on using the mod in chat.

 

**The mod is under development.**

title: Shuffler
description: A polished version of Dream's Block Shuffle gamemode
body:
# Shuffler (Block Shuffle Reimagined)
I tried numerous of the other public block shuffle plugins before deciding none of them were particularly well balanced. You can even see this in the videos of big content creators playing block shuffle - no one wants to hunt down Mangrove Logs when they're far away from a swamp. Shuffler fixes this, while expanding on the game by adding crafting recipes, mob drops and considering items in your inventory. It even plays a nice animation while shuffling for your next item!

![Demonstrating the shuffling animation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7f66229c13586000bdef94a9c08fdce862b99fe.gif)

## Commands
```
/game start
/game check <player> - see what items a player is looking for
```

## 🧠 How the Algorithm Works

This plugin doesn't just guess; it calculates. Every round, the engine performs a scan of a sample of chunks loaded near players.

    Proximity Scanning: The plugin indexes blocks within a playable radius of the players.

    Crafting Tree Analysis: It doesn't just look for blocks; it looks for potential. If you are standing in a forest, the game knows that Oak Log is available. It also calculates that Oak Planks, Stick, Crafting Table, and Wooden Pickaxe are now valid.

    Weighted Probability: The block pool is weighted. Common blocks nearby have a higher chance of appearing than rare blocks found deep in caves.

        Example: If you are in a Desert, you are highly likely to get Sand or Cactus. You will not get Lily Pad unless a Swamp is actually nearby.

description: RealTimePlugin is a lightweight plugin that displays time on the action bar. Supports real and Minecraft time, seconds display, and saves each player's settings.
body:
A simple and lightweight plugin for that displays the current time on the action bar (above the hotbar) for players. The plugin supports two time modes: real (system) time with customizable timezone and Minecraft time. Each player can individually customize the display, and all settings are automatically saved and restored when reconnecting to the server.

✨ **What's New in v2.0**

🌍 Timezone Support - Choose your own timezone! Perfect for players from different regions

🇺🇦 Ukrainian Timezones - Europe/Kyiv, Europe/Uzhgorod, Europe/Zaporozhye included

🕐 Automatic DST Handling - Summer/winter time changes are handled automatically

📋 Timezone List - See all available timezones with /realtime timezone list

⭐ **Main Features**

⏰ Time display on the action bar (above the hotbar)

🌍 Two modes: real time (with timezone support) or Minecraft time

⏱️ Seconds toggle: enable/disable seconds display

🗺️ Multiple timezones: Europe, America, Asia, UTC, and more

💾 Settings saving: each player has their own settings that persist after reconnection

🔧 Flexible configuration: all messages, colors, and prefix can be changed in config.yml

🔄 Hot reload: /realtime reload command to apply config changes without server restart

🎮 **Commands**

/realtime help	Show command list

/realtime	Show your current settings

/realtime toggle	Enable/disable time display

/realtime mode <real/minecraft>	Switch between real and Minecraft time

/realtime seconds	Toggle seconds display

/realtime timezone <name>	Set your timezone

/realtime timezone list	Show all available timezones

/realtime reload	Reload configuration (OP only)

🌐 **Available Timezones**

**Ukraine**: Europe/Kyiv, Europe/Uzhgorod, Europe/Zaporozhye

**Europe**: Europe/London, Europe/Berlin, Europe/Paris, Europe/Rome, Europe/Madrid

**America**: America/New_York, America/Chicago, America/Denver, America/Los_Angeles

**Asia**: Asia/Tokyo, Asia/Shanghai, Asia/Dubai, Asia/Singapore

**Other**: UTC, Australia/Sydney, System (server time)

title: Simple Custom Portal
description: Allows you to create custom portals, designed for packdev
body:
# Simple Custom Portal

Add custom portal **blocks** to your pack: each block teleports to a dimension you choose (e.g. custom dimensions, Nether, End) at the same x, y, z.

**For pack creators:** define portals in JSON (id, destination, optional base/capsule blocks, sound, usable dimensions, default return). Files go in a configurable directory — default: `kubejs/external_scripts/simp_cm_portal_portals/` under the game directory. The path can be changed in the mod config. When the game loads, the mod also writes a **PORTALS.md** in that folder with the same documentation below. No KubeJS required; the path name is just the default.

**Features:** optional safe-zone building at destination, one-way portals via `usableIn`, `/simp_cm_portal_reload` for live reload without restart.

---

The rest of this page is the **full documentation** (same as the auto-generated PORTALS.md, which is created in the same folder where you put the portal JSON scripts).

---

## Config path

Portal definitions are loaded from JSON files in: `<game dir>/<externalScriptsPath>/simp_cm_portal_portals/`.

`externalScriptsPath` is set in mod config (default: `kubejs/external_scripts`). Only `.json` files are read.

## JSON format

Each JSON file can contain one or more portal definitions. Root structure:

- **type** (required): `"simp_cm_portal:portals"` or `"iska_utils:portals"`.
- **overwritable** (optional): currently unused.
- **portals** (required): array of portal objects. Each entry must have a unique **id**.

### Portal object

- **id** (required): unique identifier (e.g. `"custom_dimensions-portal_void"`). Used for the block registry; only portals loaded at game startup get a block. After a reload, only the logic of existing ids is updated.
- **destination** (required): dimension resource key the portal sends to (e.g. `"minecraft:overworld"`, `"custom_dimensions:void"`).
- **baseBlock** (optional): block id for the floor of the safe-zone capsule (e.g. `"minecraft:stone"`). If empty, floor is not replaced.
- **capsuleBlock** (optional): block id for walls and ceiling of the capsule (e.g. `"minecraft:glass"`). If empty, walls/ceiling are not built.
- **box** (optional): hitbox (collision and visual) as a variable-size box centered in the block. Format: `"width height depth"` as fractions from 0 to 1, space or comma separated. Example: `"1 1 1"` or omit = full block; `"0.5 1 0.5"` = half width and depth, full height; `"0.5"` = cube 0.5×0.5×0.5. Invalid or empty = full block.
- **usableIn** (optional): array of dimension keys. If non-empty, the portal can only be used when the player is in one of these dimensions. Use for one-way portals (e.g. only `["minecraft:overworld"]` so the return portal in the destination does not work).
- **defaultReturn** (optional): when the player is already in **destination** and uses a portal without a stored return, they are sent to this dimension. If empty, using the portal from the destination does nothing.
- **sound** (optional): block sound type for the portal block (place, break, step). Default is `glass`. See "Supported sounds" below. Example: `"rock"`.

### Supported sounds

Valid values for **sound** (default if omitted or unknown: `glass`). Examples: `rock`, `glass`, `wood` — full list in the PORTALS.md generated in the same folder as the scripts.

JSON can contain `//` and `/* */` comments; they are stripped before parsing.

## Examples

**Minimal (two-way, no safe-zone styling):**

```json
{
  "type": "simp_cm_portal:portals",
  "portals": [
    {
      "id": "my_portal_void",
      "destination": "custom_dimensions:void"
    }
  ]
}
```

**Two-way with safe-zone, default return and custom sound (e.g. overworld ↔ void):**

```json
{
  "type": "simp_cm_portal:portals",
  "portals": [
    {
      "id": "portal_void",
      "destination": "custom_dimensions:void",
      "baseBlock": "minecraft:stone",
      "capsuleBlock": "minecraft:glass",
      "sound": "rock",
      "usableIn": [],
      "defaultReturn": "minecraft:overworld"
    }
  ]
}
```

**One-way (only from overworld to void; return portal does not work):**

```json
{
  "type": "simp_cm_portal:portals",
  "portals": [
    {
      "id": "one_way_void",
      "destination": "custom_dimensions:void",
      "baseBlock": "minecraft:stone",
      "capsuleBlock": "minecraft:glass",
      "usableIn": ["minecraft:overworld"],
      "defaultReturn": ""
    }
  ]
}
```

**Custom hitbox (thin pillar, half width/depth, full height):**

```json
{
  "type": "simp_cm_portal:portals",
  "portals": [
    {
      "id": "slim_portal",
      "destination": "minecraft:the_nether",
      "box": "0.5 1 0.5"
    }
  ]
}
```

Other `box` examples: `"1 1 1"` full block; `"0.5"` small centered cube.

**Multiple portals in one file:**

```json
{
  "type": "simp_cm_portal:portals",
  "portals": [
    {
      "id": "portal_overworld",
      "destination": "minecraft:overworld",
      "baseBlock": "minecraft:grass_block",
      "capsuleBlock": "minecraft:oak_planks",
      "defaultReturn": "custom_dimensions:void"
    },
    {
      "id": "portal_void",
      "destination": "custom_dimensions:void",
      "baseBlock": "minecraft:stone",
      "capsuleBlock": "minecraft:glass",
      "usableIn": ["minecraft:overworld"],
      "defaultReturn": "minecraft:overworld"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Behaviour

- **Click:** right-click on a portal block to teleport. The target dimension is: the block’s stored **return** dimension if it has one, otherwise **defaultReturn** when already in **destination**, otherwise **destination**.
- **Same coordinates:** the destination portal (or capsule) is created at the same x, y, z as the portal you clicked.
- **Return portal:** when the mod builds a capsule in the destination, it places a portal block of the same type with a stored **return** dimension (where you came from). That block then always sends you back.
- **Capsule only if needed:** if in the destination dimension there is already a portal at the same position or with the same return dimension in a 32-block radius, the player is teleported there and no capsule is built.
- **Safe zone:** when built, the capsule has interior 3×3×4, with floor (baseBlock), walls and ceiling (capsuleBlock), and the return portal at the centre.

## Validation before building

Before building the capsule, the mod checks that no block in the zone has:

- the vanilla tag `minecraft:features_cannot_replace`
- the block is bedrock
- explosion resistance ≥ 3,600,000 (indestructible)

If any of these fail, the player gets an action-bar message (e.g. "Invalid position for portal") and no build/teleport happens.

## Command

- **/simp_cm_portal_reload** (permission level 2): reloads portal definitions from all JSON files in the portals folder (same path where you put the scripts) and refreshes the destination map. Only logic is updated; new ids in JSON do not get new blocks until the game is restarted.

## Portals removed from JSON

If a portal block still exists in the world but its **id** was removed from every JSON (e.g. after a reload), the block does nothing and does not crash: click returns `PASS`. After a game restart, that block type may no longer exist depending on registration.

title: TradeChest
description: A Minecraft Fabric mod that adds automatic trading chests with a 9x5 inventory layout. Set up vending machine-style shops where customers place buy items and automatically receive sell items in return.
body:
# TradeChest Mod

A Minecraft Fabric mod that adds automatic trading chests with a 9x5 inventory layout. Set up vending machine-style shops where customers place buy items and automatically receive sell items in return.

![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20.1-green)
![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Fabric-0.15.7-blue)
![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-17+-orange)

## Features

- **Automatic Trading System**: Place buy items, get sell items automatically delivered to pickup zone
- **9x5 Inventory Layout**: Dedicated areas for buy items, pickup, configuration, owner collection, and sell storage
- **Ownership System**: Secure your trade setups with username-based ownership
- **No Normal Chest Usage**: Trade chests can only be used when properly configured
- **Item Movement**: Buy items automatically move to owner collection area after trades

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Fabric Loader 0.15.7+
- Fabric API
- Java 17 or higher

## Installation

### For Players

1. **Install Fabric Loader**
   - Download and run the [Fabric Installer](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/)
   - Select Minecraft 1.20.1 and install Fabric

2. **Download Dependencies**
   - Download [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 1.20.1
   - Place the Fabric API JAR in your `.minecraft/mods` folder

3. **Install TradeChest Mod**
   - Download the latest TradeChest mod JAR file
   - Place it in your `.minecraft/mods` folder

4. **Launch Game**
   - Start Minecraft with the Fabric profile
   - The Trade Chest item will be available in the Functional Blocks creative tab

### For Developers

1. **Clone Repository**
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/rodortega/mc-tradechest.git
   cd mc-tradechest
   ```

2. **Build from Source**
   ```bash
   ./gradlew build
   ```

3. **Run in Development**
   ```bash
   ./gradlew runClient
   ```

## How to Use

### Crafting

Craft a Trade Chest using this recipe:

![Trade Chest Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rodortega/mc-tradechest/refs/heads/main/screenshotss/recipe.png)

```
[Planks] [Planks] [Planks]
[Planks] [Paper ] [Planks]
[Planks] [Planks] [Planks]
```

### Basic Setup

1. **Place the Trade Chest** - Cannot be used until configured with an owner

2. **Set Ownership** (Slot 18):
   - Rename a paper with your exact username using an anvil
   - Place it in slot 18 (first slot of third row)
   - You are now the owner and can manage the chest

![Setting Owner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rodortega/mc-tradechest/refs/heads/main/screenshotss/set_owner.png)

3. **Configure Buy Requirements** (Slot 19):
   - Rename a paper: `10 minecraft:iron_ingot`
   - Place in slot 19
   - This determines what customers must provide

![Setting Buy Requirements](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rodortega/mc-tradechest/refs/heads/main/screenshotss/set_buy.png)

4. **Configure Sell Items** (Slot 20):
   - Rename a paper: `5 minecraft:diamond`
   - Place in slot 20
   - This determines what customers receive

![Setting Sell Items](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rodortega/mc-tradechest/refs/heads/main/screenshotss/set_sell.png)

5. **Stock Sell Items**:
   - Place diamonds in the bottom row (slots 36-44)
   - Only the configured sell item type can be placed there

![Restocking Supplies](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rodortega/mc-tradechest/refs/heads/main/screenshotss/restock_supplies.png)

6. **Ready to Trade**:
   - Customers place iron ingots in top row (slots 0-8)
   - Diamonds automatically appear in pickup zone (slots 9-17)
   - Iron ingots move to your collection area (slots 27-35)

### Inventory Layout (9x5)

```
Row 1: [Buy Items Input Area - Customers place buy items here]           (Slots 0-8)
Row 2: [Pickup Zone - Traded items appear here automatically]           (Slots 9-17)
Row 3: [OWNER] [BUY] [SELL] [----LOCKED CONFIGURATION AREA----]         (Slots 18-26)
Row 4: [Owner Collection - Buy items go here after trades]              (Slots 27-35)
Row 5: [Sell Items Storage - Owner stocks sell items here]              (Slots 36-44)
```

### How Trading Works

1. **Customer Action**: Places 10 iron ingots in row 1
2. **Automatic Processing**: System detects complete trade
3. **Item Movement**: 
   - 5 diamonds move from row 5 to row 2 (pickup zone)
   - 10 iron ingots move from row 1 to row 4 (owner collection)
4. **Customer Pickup**: Customer takes diamonds from row 2
5. **Excess Handling**: If customer placed 15 iron, 5 excess remain in row 1 for pickup

### Example: Automatic Diamond Shop

1. **Setup Phase**:
   - Rename papers: `YourUsername`, `10 minecraft:iron_ingot`, `5 minecraft:diamond`
   - Place papers in slots 18, 19, 20 respectively
   - Stock 64 diamonds in bottom row (slots 36-44)

2. **Customer Transaction**:
   - Customer places 20 iron ingots in top row
   - System automatically processes 2 trades (20 ÷ 10 = 2)
   - 10 diamonds appear in pickup zone (5 × 2 = 10)
   - 20 iron ingots move to owner collection area
   - Customer takes 10 diamonds from pickup zone

3. **Owner Benefits**:
   - Collect 20 iron ingots from row 4 anytime
   - Restock diamonds in row 5 as needed
   - No manual intervention required

## Permissions

| Slot Range | Area | Customers Can | Owner Can |
|------------|------|---------------|----------|
| 0-8        | Buy Items Input | Place buy items, take excess | Full access |
| 9-17       | Pickup Zone | Take any items | Full access |
| 18-20      | Configuration | None | Place/remove papers |
| 21-26      | Locked Area | None | None |
| 27-35      | Owner Collection | None | Full access |
| 36-44      | Sell Storage | None | Stock sell items |

## Paper Formats

- **Owner Paper**: Just your exact username (e.g., `Steve`)
- **Buy Paper**: `[amount] [item_id]` (e.g., `10 minecraft:iron_ingot`)
- **Sell Paper**: `[amount] [item_id]` (e.g., `5 minecraft:diamond`)

## Troubleshooting

- **Can't use chest at all**: You need to place an owner paper in slot 18 first
- **Can't remove owner paper**: Make sure the paper name exactly matches your in-game username
- **Can't place buy/sell papers**: You must be the owner (have your name paper in slot 18)
- **Trading not working**: Ensure both buy and sell papers are configured in slots 19-20
- **Can't place items in bottom row**: Only the configured sell item type is allowed in slots 36-44
- **Items not moving automatically**: Check that you have sell items stocked and pickup zone isn't full

## Building

This mod uses the Fabric toolchain:

```bash
# Clean and build
./gradlew clean build

# Run client for testing
./gradlew runClient

# Generate sources jar
./gradlew sourcesJar
```

## Development

### Project Structure

- `src/main/java/com/rodmod/tradechest/` - Main mod code
- `src/main/resources/` - Assets and data files
- `build.gradle` - Build configuration
- `gradle.properties` - Project properties

### Key Classes

- `RodMod` - Main mod initializer
- `TradeChestBlock` - Block implementation
- `TradeChestBlockEntity` - Block entity with inventory logic
- `TradeChestMenu` - Container menu for GUI
- `TradeChestSlot` - Custom slot with placement restrictions

## License

This mod is available under the CC0 license. Feel free to learn from it and incorporate it in your own projects.

- Silly mining machine

Fig is a key to many things in this mod. Fig itself is a food that provide health boost for a limited time. it is required item in most crafting recipes. Figs can not be planted. instead, fig can be looted from the fig entities. 

fig entities are passive mobs that drops fig. fig entitiy has two special attacks: charged jump and fig projectile. A chest or any other storage blocks should be placed on top of the silly miner to store the resources, otherwise, it will drop the mined resources on top of it. 

figification status effect: overtime it has a chance to randomly spawn fig entities that will attack you. the lower the health, the less likely to spawn a fig.

title: HeartRevive
description: Multiplayer Hardcore Miencraft, but easier! When you die, people can give you some hearts to bring you back to life!
body:
# HeartRevive, Hardcore co-op with heart sharing



## Concept

HeartRevive is a hardcore Minecraft plugin that turns death into a collective decision.

When a player dies, they are removed from active gameplay.

However, instead of being gone forever, other players can choose to sacrifice part of their own maximum health to bring them back.

Every heart matters. Survival is no longer individual, but shared.


## How it works

### Player death:

When a player dies, they are switched to Spectator mode, they can't move anymore and they have a darkness effect.

They cannot return to the game on their own.


### Revival:

Alive players can donate their maximum hearts.

Donating hearts permanently reduces the donor’s max health.

Once the dead player receive a donation, he is revived at his spawnpoint.

The player is returned to Survival mode.

A global message announces their return.

_Example:_

Player A: 20 HP

Player B: 20 HP

Player C: 20 HP

------------------------------------

Player A: 20 HP

Player B: 20 HP

Player C: dead

------------------------------------

Player A gives 3 hearts → 17 HP

Player B gives 1 heart → 19 HP

Player C returns with 4 hearts


### Command

/donatehp <player> <hearts>

Donate a portion of your maximum health to a dead player.


### Features

- Compatible with Paper / Spigot 1.20.1
  
- Dynamic maximum health system

- Hardcore revival mechanic

- Encourages teamwork and difficult choices

- No free revives: every action has a cost

- Perfect for

- Hardcore SMPs

- Co-op survival servers

- Friend groups

- Challenge servers

- Content creators and events

# Note

**For the plugin to work, the server must NOT be in hardcore mode. Otherwise, the dead player will be automatically banned.**


I did this with ChatGPT because it originally seemed like it would just be a server with friends, but I thought it could be cool to share it with other people.

body:
# TempElytra
Minecraft Java Plugin for WorldGuard that adds a flag allowing players to start flying without an elytra! Compatible with 1.21+.

## Installation
1. Download WorldEdit, WorldGuard, and TempElytra for your preferred version.
2. Place the `.jar` files into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Start the server and enjoy!

## Requirements
- WorldGuard (requires WorldEdit)
- Minecraft version 1.21 or higher

## How to use
1. Mark a region using WorldEdit's wand (right-click one corner, left-click the opposite corner).  
2. Create a region using WorldGuard: `/rg create <region> <player>` or use an existing one.  
3. Set the flag: `/rg flag <region> start-glide-without-elytra allow`.  
4. Fall at least 1.1 blocks in the region to start gliding.  
5. Press "Switch Hotbar" to boost.

## Important notice
- Make the region slightly larger than the intended area so players cannot jump out without entering glide mode.

## Config Options
- `boost` — Boost multiplier applied when launching or boosting.  
- `max-boosts` — Maximum free boosts available (use by pressing Switch Hotbar).  
- `allow-sneak-cancel` — Allow players to cancel flying with TempElytra midair.  
- `min-fall-distance` — Define which falldistance to trigger Elytra
- More options coming...

## Reload config
- `/tempelytra reload`


## Future additions
- More configurable options

title: TickScheduler API
description: A library for managing tick scheduling
body:
# TickScheduler is a lightweight Tick library for mods:
- run code in the future
- repeat actions every N ticks
- execute logic when conditions become true
- persist tasks across world reloads
- offload heavy work to async threads

## FULL INFO ON GITHUB:
- https://github.com/Vacuoss/TickScheduler-API

## You can use it to:
- temporary effects
- cooldown timers
- delayed world events
- repeating logic loops
- async computations
- persistent timers
- condition-triggered routines
- modular systems requiring precise tick control

**Commands:**
- /scheduler debug
- /scheduler profiler on
- /scheduler profiler off
- /scheduler profiler stats
- /scheduler save
- /scheduler load
- /scheduler tasks
- /scheduler test <- for test lib


**API classes:**

```
SchedulerAPI - High-level scheduling interface
TickScheduler - Internal engine
Types - Task types, context, builder, priorities
PersistentStorage - Save & load persistent tasks
ConditionScheduler- Condition-based logic
TaskRegistry - Restore persistent task types
```

**Example: Custom persistent task**
```java
SchedulerAPI.builder()
    .delay(60)
    .repeat(10)
    .maxRuns(5)
    .priority(Types.Priority.HIGH)
    .persistent()
    .type("regenerate")
    .submit(ctx -> {
        System.out.println("Regenerating at " + ctx.tick);
    });
```
Persistent tasks survive world reloads.
Profiler measures real execution time of scheduled tasks.

--------------------------------------------------

title: Force Nether
description: Unstoppable Nether Portal Creation - No Mod Can Stop It!
body:
# ForceNether

**Unstoppable Nether Portal Creation - No Mod Can Stop It!**

## 🔥 What is ForceNether?

ForceNether is a **server-side only** mod that **forces** Nether portal creation to work, even when other mods try to disable it. Using powerful Mixin technology, it bypasses all restrictions and ensures portals can always be created when you have a valid obsidian frame.

## ✨ Key Features

- ✅ **Force-Enable Portal Creation** - Portals WILL be created if the frame is valid
- ✅ **Bypass All Restrictions** - Works even when other mods cancel portal events
- ✅ **Server-Side Only** - No client installation required
- ✅ **Dimension Agnostic** - Works in any dimension (Overworld, Nether, End, custom)
- ✅ **Event Bypass** - Injects before Forge events fire, making it impossible to cancel
- ✅ **No Configuration** - Just install and it works
- ✅ **Status Command** - Check if mod is working with `/forcenether status`

## 🎯 Why Use ForceNether?

### Problem
Some modpacks or server plugins disable Nether portals for various reasons:
- Dimension restrictions
- Custom progression systems
- Server performance rules
- Compatibility issues

### Solution
ForceNether **overrides** these restrictions at the core level, ensuring portals always work when players have built a valid frame.

## 🔧 How It Works

ForceNether uses **Mixin injection** to intercept the flint and steel usage at the deepest level:

```
Player uses flint & steel on obsidian
↓
FlintAndSteelItem.useOn() called
↓
FORCENETHER MIXIN RUNS HERE ← Before everything else!
↓
Valid portal frame found?
  ├─ YES → Create portal → Success (vanilla code never runs)
  └─ NO → Continue to vanilla code
```

**Technical Details:**
- Injects at `@At("HEAD")` - executes FIRST
- `cancellable = true` - can stop vanilla logic
- Direct call to `PortalShape.createPortalBlocks()`
- **Forge events never fire** = other mods can't interfere

## 📦 Installation

### Server
1. Download the mod JAR for your Minecraft version
2. Place in your server's `mods/` folder
3. Restart server
4. Done! No client installation needed.

### Verification
Run this command in-game:
```
/forcenether status
```

Expected output:
```
=== ForceNether Status ===
Version: 0.1.0
Minecraft: 1.20.1
Mod Loaded: ✓ YES
Mixin Status: ✓ APPLIED

✓ Mod is working correctly!
Nether portals will be force-enabled.
```

## 🎮 Usage

### Creating Portals
1. Build obsidian frame (4 wide × 5 tall minimum)
2. Use flint & steel on any obsidian block
3. Portal will **ALWAYS** create if frame is valid

### Status Command
```
/forcenether status
```
Shows mod status and whether Mixin is active.

**Permission:** Requires OP level 2+ (operators only)

## ⚙️ Technical Requirements

- **Minecraft:** 1.20.1
- **Forge:** 47.3.0 or higher
- **Java:** 17 or higher
- **Side:** Server-side only (optional on client)

## 🔍 Compatibility

### Works With
- ✅ Any mod that tries to disable portals
- ✅ Custom dimension mods
- ✅ Progression mods
- ✅ Server management plugins
- ✅ Performance optimization mods

### Potential Conflicts
- ⚠️ Mods that also Mixin `FlintAndSteelItem`
- ⚠️ Some anti-cheat mods (may need whitelisting)

If you experience conflicts, please report on the issue tracker!

## 🐛 Troubleshooting

### Command Not Found
**Issue:** `/forcenether` doesn't work

**Solution:**
- Check mod is in `mods/` folder
- Verify Forge version is 47.3.0+
- Check server logs for loading errors

### Mixin Not Applied
**Issue:** Status shows "✗ NOT APPLIED"

**Solution:**
1. Enable debug logging: `-Dmixin.debug=true`
2. Check logs for mixin errors
3. Test without other mods to isolate conflicts

### Portal Doesn't Create
**Issue:** Valid frame but portal doesn't appear

**Steps:**
1. Run `/forcenether status` - must show "✓ APPLIED"
2. Ensure frame is exactly 4×5 minimum (14 obsidian blocks)
3. Click ON obsidian block (not air inside frame)
4. Check server console for errors

## 📊 Performance

**Minimal Impact:**
- Only runs when flint & steel is used on obsidian
- No background tasks or timers
- No configuration file processing
- Lightweight Mixin injection (~9KB mod size)

## 🔐 Security

- **Server-side only** - no client modifications
- **Open source** - all code is visible on GitHub
- **No network requests** - except for update checks (Modrinth API)
- **No data collection** - completely privacy-friendly

## 📈 Version Support

| Minecraft | Forge | Status |
|-----------|-------|--------|
| 1.20.1 | 47.3.0+ | ✅ Supported |
| 1.21+ | TBD | 🔜 Planned |
| 1.19.x | - | ❌ Not planned |

## 🤝 Support & Links

[//]: # (- **Issues:** [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/skyx/forcenether/issues))
[//]: # (- **Source Code:** [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/skyx/forcenether))

- **Discord:** [Join Server](https://discord.gg/qJAVtSHUTF)
- **Modrinth:** [Mod Page](https://modrinth.com/mod/force-nether)

## 📄 License

MIT License - Free to use, modify, and distribute.

## 🌟 Credits

- **Author:** SkyX
- **Mixin Framework:** SpongePowered
- **Inspired by:** The need for reliable portal creation in restricted environments

## 💡 FAQ

**Q: Do players need to install this mod?**  
A: No! Server-side only. Clients can join without the mod.

**Q: Will this break progression systems?**  
A: Possibly. Use only if you want portals to work unconditionally.

**Q: Can server owners disable this?**  
A: Remove the mod JAR. There's no config (by design).

**Q: Does this work in modded dimensions?**  
A: Yes! Works in any dimension where obsidian exists.

**Q: Is this compatible with X mod?**  
A: Test it! If there's a conflict, report it and we'll investigate.

**Q: How do I know it's working?**  
A: Use `/forcenether status` command in-game.

---

**Download now and never worry about portal restrictions again!**

**🐬Dolphin riding**
DolphinRide -- Allows you to ride dolphins with a high custom Speed. Dolphins can now be mounted like regular animals and ridden on the water🌊

**💨Speeds:**
Dolphin speed can be adjusted in Minecraft. By default, the speed is:
22 blocks per second

base: 1.1 #1.1 * 20 = 22 Speed

(The dolphin has automatic acceleration.)
- To slow down while riding the dolphin, look down.
- To completely stop the dolphin in one place, after coming to a complete stop at 0 blocks per second, look at the floor at a -90-degree angle for 2 seconds.
- To release the dolphin's handbrake, look as far up as possible for 2 seconds.
- To make the dolphin swim where you want, simply aim in that direction.

title: Item Access Restrictor
description: Added a block used to restrict item transportation.
body: # Item Access Restrictor | [物品存取限制器](https://github.com/fgtank123/ItemAccessRestrictor/blob/main/README.md) ## Introduction This is a Minecraft mod that adds a functional block: Item Access Restrictor. It has no inventory itself, but when attached to a container, it can serve as the surface for inserting and extracting items. You can configure input blocking, retain a certain number of items, etc. You can also use a comparator to read redstone signals. ## Configurations | Name | Additional Information | Scope | Default Value | | :----------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------- | | Blocking input if target is not empty | Disabled slots and retained items are not included in the target. | Enabled, Disabled | Enabled | | Blocking input if receiving redstone signal | None | Enabled, Disabled | Enabled | | Comparator Output Mode | When set to 'Only count effective items and slots', it uses the same calculation method as typical containers like chest or hopper, with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 15. | Only count effective items and slots, Same with facing block | Only count effective items and slots | | Input Stacking Limit | Once the number of items inserted in a slot reaches the configured limit, no more items can be inserted to this slot; It will affect the calculation of the redstone signal output by a comparator. | Unlimited, 1–64 | Unlimited | | Number of items retained | Once the number of items in a slot is reduced to the configured number, items can no longer be extracted from this slot; It will affect the calculation of the redstone signal output by a comparator. | No retain, 1–64 | No retain | | Enable or disable insertion and extraction of the slot | When the number of slots facing the container changes, it will automatically switch back to the enabled; Disabled slots cannot be inserted into or extracted from, and they will not be included in the calculation for comparator output redstone signals. | Enabled, Disabled | Enabled | ## Features * Cannot be used nested. * Unable to insert or extract items from the contact face. * After enabling 'Blocking input if target is not empty', it supports inserting multiple types of items at once. The behavior of mods verified so far: AE2 can successfully send multiple items at once when crafting. ## Screenshot ![screenshot_en](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https://github.com/fgtank123/ItemAccessRestrictor/blob/main/docs/screenshot_en.png?raw=true&n=-1)

title: Apocalypse Monsters
description: Apocalyptic monsters that try to take over your world.
body:
**WARNING! Do not "install and forget". This mod can cause irreversible damage to your world's environment. See details below.**

# Features
## Parasite Spawn
Currently the mod features one type of monster not found in the vanilla game and that is the **Parasite Spawn.** It resembles a pink silverfish except this nasty little creature is the reason that your world will become a catastrophic mess over time.

Parasites will spawn naturally in the overworld unless you disable it in the config (Mod Menu is recommended.)

When a parasite spawns in it will seek the nearest mob and attempt to infect it, turning it into an infected variant.

## Infectious Moss
Infectious Moss or Brain Moss or Infectious Brain Moss is a nasty pinkish block that will generate naturally in the world and try to overtake all natural blocks around it, eventually depleting your natural resources like trees. It will also spawn parasites on it from time to time leading to an overall bigger problem!

The moss can be contained with unnatural blocks such as wooden planks or glass.

Moss generation can be turned off in the config but you should do this before entering or creating a world. (Always be sure to restart your game after applying any setting)

## Infected Mutation
Certain infected mobs will mutate the mobs they infect, giving them overall greater stats as the infected mobs survive longer and create larger hoards.

# Will you port this to xyz version?
As time allows the mod is planned to be available for all versions leading up to the latest version. 1.16.5 is the oldest version of the game the mod will support, so please do not ask for ports to older versions.

# Can I use this in a modpack?
Absolutely. Credit is appreciated but not mandatory.

# Will there be more features added later?
Absolutely. As I see more time there will be more non-vanilla monsters and even air and aquatic variants to make sure nowhere is truly safe.

Now go and try to hold out for as long as you are able!

title: RNGHearts
description: Add randomized heart counts to players! Features animated heart rolling, craftable Heart Dice items, and per-player persistence. Perfect for hardcore survival servers.
body:
# 🎲 RNGHearts

Add excitement and challenge to your Minecraft server with **randomized player health**! Each player gets a random heart count when they first join, creating unique survival experiences.

## ✨ Key Features

### 🎰 Random Heart System
- New players receive random hearts (1-20 configurable) on first join
- Beautiful animated rolling sequence with sounds and titles
- Per-player persistence - hearts saved across server restarts

### 🎲 Heart Dice Item
- Craftable item (Nether Star) for rerolling hearts
- Right-click to reroll your heart count
- Configurable cooldowns and consumption
- Perfect for server shops and rewards

### ⚙️ Highly Configurable
- **FULL mode** (1-20 full hearts) or **HALF mode** (2-40 half-hearts)
- Customize min/max ranges, recipes, and messages
- Toggle animations, broadcasts, and item behavior
- Preserve health percentage or cap at new maximum

### 🎮 Admin Commands
```
/heartroll reroll [player]  - Reroll hearts with animation
/heartroll set <player> <hearts>  - Set exact heart count
/heartroll reset <player>  - Reset to default health
/heartroll info [player]  - Check current hearts
/heartroll reload  - Reload configuration
```

### 🔒 Smart Permissions
- Granular permission nodes for each command
- `heartroll.info` - Default for all players
- `heartroll.trigger-item.use` - Use Heart Dice (default: true)
- Admin permissions for set/reset/reload

## 🎨 Default Recipe

Crafts **1x Heart Dice** (Nether Star):
```
D E D
E G E
D E D
```
*D = Diamond, E = Emerald, G = Gold Block - Fully customizable!*

## ⚡ Performance Optimized
- Async data saving (no server lag)
- Thread-safe cooldown system
- Auto-save every 5 minutes
- Smart task cleanup on disable

## 📦 Requirements
- **Minecraft:** 1.21 or higher
- **Server:** Spigot, Paper, or forks
- **Dependencies:** None required!

Perfect for hardcore survival servers, SMP challenges, or adding variety to your gameplay!

MoreDanger is a lightweight difficulty enhancer for Minecraft that lets you crank up the chaos with three escalating modes: Hard, Nightmare, and Hell. Mobs get tougher, faster, and meaner — and they might even curse you with nasty effects when they land a hit! (Nightmare and Hell modes only)

    Mode-Based Follow Range: Mobs can detect and chase players from farther away in higher modes.

    Simple Config System: All settings are saved to a JSON file and reload automatically. In creative or with cheats on convenient mode commands as well (see below if interested.)

    No Bloat: No mob coordination, no performance drag — just pure difficulty.

Commands

**Dark’s Redeemable Code** is a versatile Minecraft plugin for server owners and admins to create redeemable codes that give players custom rewards. Compatible with Minecraft 1.20.4 and tested on 1.21, it ensures smooth operation on recent server versions.

Admins can manage codes through an intuitive GUI inventory, setting rewards, usage limits, and expiration times. Players redeem codes to receive pre-set rewards, while the plugin tracks usage and automatically cleans up expired codes.

- Create and manage redeemable codes easily.

- Automatic cleanup of expired codes.

/redeem <code> – Redeem a code. No permission required.

/redeem delete <codeName> – Delete a code. Permission: darks.redeem.admin

title: Headlamps
description: ...No, not that kind of headlamp.
body:
![A banner of an Ancient Hunt from Minecraft Dungeons, featuring a lantern with a Magma Cube.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3bc3faf53562e2f8d4a6839625d4e1e657660953_0.webp)
# 🏮 Decorative Lanterns
First and foremost, **Headlamps** adds Lanterns with Magma Cubes and Slimes, inspired by the Nether decorations in Minecraft Dungeons (as shown above). You can craft those lanterns by surrounding a Magma Block or Slime Block with 8 Iron Nuggets in a Crafting Table.

You can place the lanterns down anywhere, although be aware that they might break if updated while not supported by a block. If you place one underneath a block, it'll hang from the bottom of said block by an iron chain. If you're playing the Copper Age drop (1.21.9) or later and the block above the lantern happens to be made of copper, the chain of the lantern (although not the lantern itself) will turn to copper matching the oxidization level and waxed state of the block above it.

Bored with Slimes and Magma Cubes? Looking for some more decor options? This is where the fun begins.
## 💀 Heads in Lanterns
If you've got a mob head from Wither Skeleton farming, Charged Creeper shenanigans, or End busting, you can craft it together with 8 Iron Nuggets to make a lantern with that same head. Alternatively, you can place down your Lantern with Magma Cube or Slime and throw the mob head on top of it -- the new head will be placed in the lantern, and you'll get your Magma or Slime Block back. If you don't like the new look, just throw the block back onto the lantern and the Magma Cube or Slime will take the head's place.
### 🙂 Player Heads
While you can't craft Lanterns with Player Heads, you can create them by throwing a Player Head onto an already placed lantern. Just like with mob heads, the Player Head will replace the previous head in the lantern, which will get dropped as an item. (Note: This only works with Player Heads attached to a profile, not the default Steve head in the Creative inventory.)

To supplement this pack, I'd recommend any one of the multitudinous Player Head data packs available on Modrinth, or the [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/datapacks/) option for Player Head Drops. Have fun decorating!

title: Player Pinger
description: A simple plugin for locating players using sounds! Fully customizable
body:
# Pinger

**Pinger** lets players **ping locations** in the world using directional note block sounds.  
The pitch of the sound changes with distance, helping players estimate how far away the ping is.  
Players can also mute or unmute pings from others, and server owners can fully customize behavior in the configuration file.  

---

## Features
- 🎵 **Directional note block pings** – sounds come from the correct direction relative to the player.  
- 📏 **Distance-based pitch** – closer pings are higher pitch, farther ones are lower.  
- 🔇 **Mute system** – toggle pings from other players.  
- ⚙️ **Fully configurable** – adjust cooldowns, repeat count, sound type, pitch scaling, and more.  

---

## Commands
- `/ping <player|@a>` – Send a ping to another player (or everyone).  
- `/pingmute` – Toggle pings from other players.  

---

## Configuration (`config.yml`)

```yaml
ping:
  # Cooldown between pings in seconds
  cooldown_seconds: 15

  # Number of times a ping sound is played
  repeat_count: 7

  # Interval between each ping sound (20 ticks = 1 second)
  interval_ticks: 20

  # Sound effect used for the ping
  sound: BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_PLING

  # Volume of the ping sound
  volume: 7.0

  # How much the pitch changes per chunk of distance
  pitch_per_chunk: 0.1
