[CoreSpawnX - SpigotMC](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/new-1-21-6-paper-corespawnx-the-new-generation%E2%9A%A1-comeback.123286/updates)

**CoreSpawnX – Powerful & Lightweight Spawn Management Plugin**

**CoreSpawnX** is a **modern**, **lightweight**, and **performance-optimized spawn management plugin for your Minecraft server**. Whether you're running a **survival server**, **hub**, or **minigames** – **CoreSpawnX** gives you full control over the player's spawn behavior with a **clean, configurable system and reliable execution**.

**Perfectly suited for both small and large servers, it combines simplicity and flexibility. Forget clunky, bloated plugins – this one does just what it should and does it well.**

### ✨ Main Features

## Custom Global Spawn Point 
Set a spawn point that applies to all players.

## ⏱️ Warm-up Delay 
Optionally delay the teleportation to prevent abuse.

## Cancel On Move 
If enabled, teleportation is cancelled if the player moves.

## Cooldown Timer 
Prevents command spamming by enforcing a cooldown period.

## Teleport on Join 
Automatically teleport players to the spawn on login.

## Spawn Info Command 
See the exact coordinates, rotation, setter and timestamp.

## Fully Customizable Messages 
All messages are editable in the config and support & color codes.

## Reload Command 
Apply config changes instantly with /corespawnx reload.

## ️Permission-Based Access 
Every command is protected with permissions.


<details>
<summary>Commands-Spoiler</summary>

## Command Description

 /spawn Teleport yourself to the configured spawn point.
 /corespawnx setspawn Set your current location as the global spawn.
 /corespawnx delspawn Delete the current spawn point.
 /corespawnx spawninfo Show full information about the set spawn.
 /corespawnx reload Reload the plugin configuration without restart.

</details>




<details>
<summary>Permissions-Spoiler</summary>

## Permission Access

 corespawnx.spawn Use the /spawn command
 corespawnx.setspawn Use /corespawnx setspawn
 corespawnx.delspawn Use /corespawnx delspawn
 corespawnx.spawninfo Use /corespawnx spawninfo
 corespawnx.reload Use /corespawnx reload
 corespawnx.admin Bypass all restrictions and access all commands

</details>

title: LagSpike Guardian
description: Your Server's Silent Protector.
body:
# LagSpike Guardian
### Your All-in-One Solution for Server Stability
---
As a developer and server enthusiast, I know the biggest challenge for any server owner is lag. It can come from anywhere—a forgotten mob farm, a massive item spill, or a broken redstone machine. I created **LagSpike Guardian** to be a smarter, all-in-one solution. Instead of just blindly clearing entities, this plugin actively monitors your server's health and provides you with the tools to both automatically prevent lag and diagnose it yourself. It's powerful, lightweight, and designed to give you peace of mind.

---
### ⭐ Features
- ✅ **Automatic TPS Monitoring:** Intelligently clears entities only when your server's TPS drops below a configured threshold, preventing lag without disrupting gameplay.
- ✅ **Scheduled Item Sweeper:** Proactively cleans up dropped items on a timer, with configurable warnings and a protected-item list so valuable gear is never deleted.
- ✅ **Smart Redstone Limiter:** Detects and temporarily disables hyperactive redstone clocks that cause server lag, with whitelisted worlds to protect player builds.
- ✅ **Powerful Diagnostic Tools:** Use `/lagspike topchunks` to instantly find the 5 laggiest chunks on your server, helping you pinpoint the exact source of entity-based lag.
- ✅ **Full Admin Control:** Manually clear items or mobs on demand, and reload the entire plugin configuration without a server restart using `/lagspike reload`.
- ✅ **100% Configurable:** Every message, color, timer, and setting can be changed in the `config.yml`.
- ✅ **User-Friendly Commands:** All commands feature full tab-completion for ease of use.

---
### 📙 Commands & Permissions
| Command | Permission | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/lagspike status` | *(none)* | Shows the server's current TPS, entities, and memory. |
| `/lagspike reload` | `lagspike.admin` | Reloads the entire plugin configuration. |
| `/lagspike clear <items\|mobs>` | `lagspike.clear` | Manually clears all items or configured mobs. |
| `/lagspike topchunks` | `lagspike.diagnostics` | Shows the top 5 chunks with the most entities. |

*(All permissions default to OP)*

---
### ⚙️ Default Configuration
This plugin is fully customizable. See how much control you have by viewing the default `config.yml` below.

<details>
<summary>Click to view the default config.yml</summary>

```yaml
# LagSpike Guardian Configuration
tps-threshold: 18.5

entity-clearing:
  mobs-to-clear:
    - ZOMBIE
    - SKELETON
    - SPIDER
    - CREEPER
    - PHANTOM
    - CHICKEN
    - COW

item-clearing:
  enabled: true
  clear-interval-minutes: 15
  warning-times-seconds:
    - 60
    - 30
    - 10
  dont-clear-items:
    - DIAMOND
    - DIAMOND_BLOCK
    - NETHERITE_INGOT
    - NETHERITE_BLOCK
    - BEACON
    - ELYTRA

redstone-limiter:
  enabled: true
  pulse-threshold-per-second: 15
  disabled-worlds:
    - "skyblock_world"
    - "creative"
  disable-duration-seconds: 30

messages:
  prefix: "&8[&cGuardian&8] "
  no-permission: "&cYou do not have permission to use this command."
  reload-success: "&aLagSpike Guardian configuration reloaded!"
  unknown-command: "&cUnknown sub-command. Use /lagspike status, reload, clear, or topchunks."
  
  status-header: "&8--- &6LagSpike Guardian Status &8---"
  status-tps: "&eTPS: &a%tps%"
  status-entities: "&eTotal Entities: &a%amount%"
  status-memory: "&eMemory Usage: &a%used%MB / %max%MB"
  
  entity-clear-broadcast: "&eCleared %amount% entities to improve server health."
  
  item-clear-warning: "&eClearing ground items in %time% seconds!"
  item-clear-broadcast: "&aCleared %amount% ground items."

  topchunks-header: "&8--- &6Top 5 Laggiest Chunks &8---"
  topchunks-format: "&e%rank%. &bWorld&f: %world% &bX&f: %x% &bZ&f: %z% &8- &a%amount% entities"
  topchunks-calculating: "&eCalculating, please wait..."
  
  manual-clear-items: "&aSuccessfully cleared %amount% items."
  manual-clear-mobs: "&aSuccessfully cleared %amount% mobs."

title: Harder Elytras
description: A simple mod that makes elytras harder to obtain!
body:
# About

This is a simple mod made to make obtaining elytras harder.

### Why?

I think many of us would agree that the Elytra is pretty OP, and they're quite easy to obtain once you get good at the game. You just have to beat the Ender Dragon (which isn't that hard), and then just run around and suddenly you have an Elytra! 

For some people this is too easy, and for me this meant that me and my friends had an Elytra Within the first day that we opened a new server. So i decided to fix it!


### How?

The first way elytras are harder to obtain is by making the recipe for Eyes of Ender a little harder. It still not too hard, but it slows the process of getting to the end a bit.

The main way elytras are harder to obtain are that elytras in end ships are replaced by a new item called an elytra core. This item can be used to craft an elytra, but you will need some additional resources (the recipe can be found in gallery along with the eye of ender recipe).

# Q&A

### Q: Is it just serverside (e.g. can i use it on a server without users having to install the mod)?

A: No, because the mod adds an item, both the client and the server has to have it installed. If you want to add it to a server without the user installing anyting you can find the datapack version [here.](https://modrinth.com/datapack/harder-elytras-datapack)

### Q: Can i change the recipes?

A: Yes, by making a datapack.

The recipes are located under ```data/harder-elytras/recipe/elytra.json``` and ```data/minecraft/recipe/ender_eye.json```.
For making the recipes i recommend using [TheDestruc7i0n's crafting recipe generator](https://crafting.thedestruc7i0n.ca/).

**CTotem** is a mod that helps ease the early days of survival.

If you don’t want to lose all your resources before you get your hands on a real Totem of Undying, you can use CTotem.

When your HP drops below a certain threshold, CTotem will either automatically send a command in chat (such as `/lobby` or `/spawn`) or disconnect you from the world — depending on your settings.


# Using

You can configure everything through the mod menu: 
- Enable/disable the mod 
- Choose the CTotem mode: send command or disconnect
- Set the HP threshold at which CTotem will activate
- Define the command that should be sent

## Command

CTotem also includes a simple command to toggle the mod on or off without opening the mod menu: 

```
/ctotem toggle
```

### **Vanilla Renow – A Refined Vanilla Experience!**  

**Vanilla Renow** is a carefully curated modpack that enhances the **classic Minecraft experience** by improving structures, optimizing performance, and adding quality-of-life tweaks—while keeping the game true to its vanilla roots. This modpack is perfect for players who love **the original Minecraft feel** but want a **more polished, immersive, and enjoyable experience**.  

---

Vanilla Renow improves the world generation and exploration experience with **upgraded structures and dungeons**, making every adventure feel fresh and rewarding.  
- **[Dungeons & Taverns](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeons-and-taverns)** – Adds new dungeons, taverns, and settlements for a richer world.  
- **[Better Ruined Portals](https://modrinth.com/mod/hopo-better-ruined-portals)** – More detailed and varied ruined portals.  
- **[Better Underwater Ruins](https://modrinth.com/mod/hopo-better-underwater-ruins)** – Enhances underwater ruins with more depth and detail.  
- **[Stronghold Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/dnt-stronghold-overhaul-lite-edition)** – Revamps strongholds for a more exciting End journey.  
- **[Ancient City Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeons-and-taverns-ancient-city-overhaul)** – Makes ancient cities more immersive and rewarding.  
- **[Swamp Hut Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeons-and-taverns-swamp-hut-overhaul)** – Adds detail and variety to swamp huts.

1. Download the datapack and place it in the `datapacks` folder of your world.
2. Reload the world or use the `/reload` command.

description: Amplified Dimension but the water level is really high.
body:
Basics

Adds a dimension that mirrors the overworld, but it uses the amplified terrain generator, except the water level is way higher! This dimension is as close as can be to the overworld in terms of biome placement, structure placement, and feature placement. 

Terrablender biomes seem to work in the amplified dimension.

Important Notes
This datapack/mod does not provide a way to enter the dimension! I recommend using the Datapack Portals Mod to make a datapack that allows you to construct a portal that leads to the dimension. The Dimension's namespace is "amplidimflooded:overworld" in case you want to use the execute command to teleport into it.

It does rain in the dimension, but for the /weather command to work, you have to execute it in the default overworld. The weather is synced between both dimensions, as well as time.

Other Recommendations
Any datapack that makes the overworld taller. It will apply to the amplified dimension too and allow you to build on the taller mountains, which stretch very close to build limit!
Also goes with my other datapack: Amplified Dimension! (Its just like this but without the extreme water level)

Tested on 1.20.1 but also might work on other versions.

Usage In Modpacks
You're more than welcome to put this in a modpack, just credit me if the modpack is public!

Note to Modpack Authors: since this dimension isn't exactly the overworld, some mods might need extra configuring to recognize it as a valid overworld dimension for some of their features!

title: KcCommandBridge
description: Fix issues with command execution across servers in MultiPaper.
body:
## The plugin only supports MultiPaper 1.20.1 server.
### ​Plugin Introduction
- This is a command forwarding plugin developed specifically for MultiPaper servers, offering highly customizable features and compatibility with the majority of plugins.

### Reason for Development
- Many MultiPaper server owners may have encountered a situation where two players are on different sub-servers, and one player sends a TPA request to the other. While the recipient can see the request prompt, they receive a message stating there are no requests to accept when entering the accept command.
- This plugin aims to solve this issue. By defining commands in the configuration file, the plugin automatically forwards command requests to the target player's MultiPaper sub-server, ensuring normal execution.

### Command & Permissions
- **/commandbridge** - **kccommandbridge.reload** - Reload the configuration file.

### Configuration File

```
# Output debug logs
debug: false

# List of commands to forward
# Asterisks represent custom content
commands:
  - "cmi tpa *"
  - "trade *"
```

title: Fence Knot
description: Makes it easier to put knots on your fences by using commands!
body:
# FenceKnot

![FenceKnot banner](https://github.com/El-Kavio/FenceKnot/assets/140896938/6af00ba2-08e2-4daa-bd72-20d27649e13e)

**FenceKnot** is a **datapack** that **allows** you to put **knots** on your **fences** in an **easier** way than normal! (<abbr title="Usually you leash mobs and get rid of them :c">no more sacrifices!</abbr>)

## Commands

`/trigger FenceKnot` puts a knot on the fence you're hugging.

`/trigger Switch_FK` enables or disables the capacity to put a knot on every fence you're hugging until you redo the command.

title: areamonitor
description: A Minecraft Forge mod for monitoring specific areas and automatically switching player game modes.
body:
# AreaMonitor — Zone Monitoring & Automation Mod

AreaMonitor is a Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge server-side mod that lets you define zones of any shape and control exactly what happens inside them — auto-switch game modes, protect blocks, and trigger custom actions.

---

## What It Does

**Define a zone and it just works.** Player walks in → switches to creative. Walks out → back to survival. Supports rectangle, circle, and polygon boundaries.

**Nine protection rules.** Block breaking, placing, interacting, PVP, explosions, entity damage, container access, fluid placement, item drops — each independently toggleable per zone.

**Programmable triggers.** Play a sound and show a title on enter. Execute commands and teleport on leave. Supports cooldown, debounce, and conditions (hold a specific item, specific weather, minimum online players).

**Time scheduling.** A PVP arena during the day, automatically disabled at night — zones can enable/disable based on in-game time, with cross-midnight ranges.

**Zone chaining.** Enter zone A → auto-teleport to B → teleport to C… funnel players through a sequence of zones.

**GUI management.** No commands needed — open a panel and click to edit zones, protections, triggers, and whitelists.

**And more:** Item blacklist, global/per-zone whitelists, selection tool (wooden axe + polygon mode), particle boundary display, config hot-reload, one-click backup, usage statistics, Chinese/English localization.

---

## Compatibility

- Server-side only — no client installation required
- Requires Minecraft 1.20.1 + Forge 47.4.0+
- Compatible with server plugins (LuckPerms, EssentialsX, etc.)

title: GUY2 Commands
description: Client-side mod that helps in normal survival world scenarios and on servers
body:
# **GUY2 Commands**

**GUY2 Commands** is a **quality-of-life client mod for Minecraft** that bundles everyday utilities, automations, and quick command workflows into one mod.

It's designed to **save time, reduce repetitive actions, and simplify common tasks** without requiring a large collection of separate mini-mods.

Inspired by **ClientCommands**, GUY2 Commands goes a step further by **automating in-game actions**, not just running commands.
For example, it can automatically **reroll villagers for specific enchants** or **execute commands directly from the inventory**.

Overall, it's a **personal-use automation mod focused on automating boring tasks.**

---

# **Main Menu (F6)**

Open the **F6 menu** to manage everything in one place:

* Toggle modules **on/off quickly**
* **Instantly search** for modules
* Use organized tabs:

  * **All**
  * **Toggles**
  * **Misc**
  * **Configs**
* **Right-click modules** to open configuration screens (when available)

This interface keeps all tools **accessible, organized, and easy to configure**.

---

# **Features**

## **Barrier Visualizer**

Highlights **barriers** around the player.

**Features**

* Adjustable radius
* Visual overlay for restricted areas
* Helpful for server spawn zones and protected regions

---

## **Auto Smelt**

Automates common furnace workflows.

**Benefits**

* Quickly takes out items from furnaces within the player's reach

---

## **Mass Cut (`/g2masscut`)**

Improves **stonecutter workflows**.

**Features**

* Set preferred **input and output items**
* Includes **"set held item" shortcuts**
* Faster batch cutting

---

## **Simple Reply (`/r`)**

Adds quick DM reply functionality.

Tracks the last message sender from:

* `/msg`
* `/w`
* `/tell`

Allows instant replies using `/r` instead of `/minecraft:msg username message` since vanilla minecraft does not have a reply feature and some servers simply don't want to add plugins for it.

---

## **PayAll (`/g2payall`)**

Creates **payment batches to online players**.

**Features**

* Manage player lists
* Configure delays
* Use payment templates
* Choose **per-player or total amount handling**
* Quickly message every player

---

## **AutoShop (`/g2shop`)**

Runs **saved buy/sell shop profiles automatically**.

**Features**

* Simple **start / stop commands**
* Supports automated trading flows

---

## **Inventory Macros (`/g2macro`)**

Save and execute **repeating inventory actions**.

**Features**

* Multiple macro profiles
* Fast start/stop controls
* Ideal for repetitive commands and the lack of more keyboard shortcuts

---

## **Chest Sort / G2Chest (`/g2chest`)**

Advanced container management.

**Capabilities**

* Assign containers to specific items
* Deposit matching items automatically
* Retrieve specific item counts
* Clear assignments by:

  * Scope
  * Item
  * Container

**Modes**

* Simple assign mode
* Mass assign mode
* Single assign mode
* **Litematica material support**

---

## **G2Inv (`/g2inv`)**

Inventory snapshot system.

**Features**

* Save full inventory states
* Restore snapshots
* Per-world / per-server scope
* Remove named snapshots

Great for **loadout or kit switching**.

---

## **G2Villager (`/g2villager`)**

Automated **librarian villager rerolling**.

**Features**

* Target specific enchantments
* Multi-target matching (OR logic)
* Level and price limits
* **Legit mode** and **instant mode**
* Command support:

  * help
  * list
  * stop

Perfect for automatically obtaining **desired enchanted books**.

---

## **Hopper Helper (`/g2hopper`)**

Utility for **hopper sorters**.

**Features**

* Quick toggle
* Built-in help command

---

## **Item Drop (`/g2itemdrop`)**

Smart item dropping system.

**Features**

* Whitelist / blacklist behavior
* Full configuration UI
* Useful for automated inventory cleanup

---

## **OG F3 Screen**

Restores the **classic debug overlay style**.

Provides an **old-school F3 layout and information display**.

---

## **Auto Lunge**

Automates attribute swapping with a spear to dash very quickly.

Includes configurable settings.

---

## **Phrase Disconnect**

Monitors chat for a **custom trigger phrase**.

**Features**

* Sender filtering:

  * whitelist
  * blacklist
* Custom message templates:

  * `{user}`
  * `{myUser}`
* Automatic disconnect
* Optional **auto-rejoin after timer**
* Countdown UI with cancel button

* Example phrase "test", example message "test 1m" - you will disconnect and rejoin after 1 minute

---

## **Disable Feedback**

Reduces chat clutter by **suppressing module feedback messages** when enabled.

---

# **Purpose of the Mod**

GUY2 Commands is built as a **personal automation toolkit** for Minecraft players who want to:

* Automate **repetitive gameplay actions**
* Execute commands **faster and smarter**
* Manage inventories and containers efficiently
* Reduce **manual clicking and micromanagement**

Instead of installing many small mods, **GUY2 Commands bundles everything into a single streamlined system.**

title: BzzBzzClientHelper
description: A client-side quality-of-life mod for Minecraft featuring waypoints, a Skyrim-style compass, fullbright, inventory/container helpers, death markers, durability warnings, an inspector HUD, and an in-game config.
body:
# Bzz Bzz Client Helper

**Bzz Bzz Client Helper** is a client-side quality-of-life mod for Minecraft.
The mod adds practical convenience features without completely destroying the vanilla feel of the game.

The focus is on better navigation, faster inventory handling, and small helpful HUD features for survival, multiplayer, and longer adventures.

## Features

### Skyrim-like Compass

A subtle compass at the top of the screen shows cardinal directions, waypoints, and known player positions, as far as Minecraft provides this information client-side.

### Waypoints

Create your own waypoints, manage them in-game, and display them in the compass or as beacon/marker indicators.

### Fullbright

Enable a brighter view without having to change the video settings every time.

### Inventory and Container Helpers

Sort inventories and containers faster. Additional useful buttons are included, such as Sort, Matching, and Container Search.

### Container Search

Search opened containers for specific items to find things more quickly in large chests.

### Locked Hotbar Slots

Lock specific hotbar slots so important items do not accidentally get moved around while sorting or transferring items.

### Durability Warning

Receive a warning when tools, weapons, or armor pieces are about to break.

### Death Marker

After death, a marker can be placed so you can more easily find your last death location.

### Inspector HUD

Shows helpful information about blocks or entities you are looking at.

### Ingame Config

Many features can be enabled or disabled directly in-game through a dedicated config screen.

## Client-only

Bzz Bzz Client Helper is a **client-side mod**.
It does not need to be installed on the server.

Some information, such as exact player positions outside the normal server tracking distance, cannot be reliably displayed client-side only. Because of this, the mod only shows data that Minecraft actually provides to the client.

## Default Keybinds

* **G** — Toggle Fullbright
* **N** — Create new waypoint
* **M** — Open Waypoint Manager
* **O** — Open Bzz Bzz Config

Additional features can be freely assigned through Minecraft’s controls menu.

## Goal of the Mod

Bzz Bzz Client Helper is designed to make Minecraft more comfortable to play without feeling overloaded.
Many features are disabled by default and can be enabled as needed.

title: HMCue
description: A quality-of-life mod for HydronixMC that improves visuals, performance, and overall gameplay experience.
body:
HMCue is a quality-of-life mod created for HydronixMC.
It improves various graphical elements, such as smooth texture fading and hiding player name tags under specific conditions.
Each feature can be enabled or disabled individually through the Mod Menu.

## Current Features
### Player Name Tag Hiding

This feature hides player name tags when a player is behind a wall or riding an entity.

### Optimized Model Loading

This feature works especially well in combination with our server.
Normally, entities are loaded within a fixed radius around the player. With this feature, the server can detect the player's location and dynamically load or unload certain entities for that player, which can improve FPS and overall performance.

### Smooth Texture Fading

This feature improves how Minecraft handles alpha cut-outs in transparent textures.
In vanilla Minecraft, transparent textures often have a harsh edge due to a high alpha cut-out threshold. This feature replaces that effect with a smoother alpha fade for a cleaner and more natural look. (See screenshots)

- **Per-minecart speed control** — each minecart can have its own speed
- **Persistent** — custom speeds survive server restarts and chunk unloads
- **Server-side only** — clients don't need to install this mod
- **Simple commands** — easy-to-use slash commands with entity selectors
- **Multi-platform** — supports Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge

## Installation

Download the JAR for your mod loader:

| Mod Loader | JAR File |
|------------|----------|
| Fabric | `minecart_speed-fabric-1.0.0.jar` |
| Forge | `minecart_speed-forge-1.0.0.jar` |
| NeoForge | `minecart_speed-neoforge-1.0.0.jar` |

Place the JAR file in your server's `mods/` folder and start the server.

**Note:** This mod only needs to be installed on the server. Clients connecting to the server do not need to install anything.

## Commands

All commands require **OP level 2** (admin) permission.

### Set Speed

```
/minecartspeed set <targets> <speed>
```

Set the maximum speed for one or more minecarts.

- `<targets>` — entity selector (e.g. `@e[type=minecraft:minecart,limit=1]`)
- `<speed>` — speed in blocks per second (vanilla default is 8.0)

**Examples:**

```mcfunction
# Set the nearest minecart to 20 blocks/s (2.5x vanilla speed)
/minecartspeed set @e[type=minecraft:minecart,limit=1,sort=nearest] 20

# Set all minecarts within 10 blocks to 50 blocks/s
/minecartspeed set @e[type=minecraft:minecart,distance=..10] 50

# Set a specific minecart by tag
/minecartspeed set @e[type=minecraft:minecart,tag=express] 100
```

### Get Speed

```
/minecartspeed get <targets>
```

Query the current custom speed of one or more minecarts.

**Example:**

```mcfunction
/minecartspeed get @e[type=minecraft:minecart,limit=1,sort=nearest]
```

Output: `Minecart [a1b2c3d4] custom speed: 20.00 blocks/s (1.0000 blocks/tick)`

### Remove Custom Speed

```
/minecartspeed remove <targets>
```

Remove custom speed and revert to vanilla speed (8 blocks/s).

**Example:**

```mcfunction
/minecartspeed remove @e[type=minecraft:minecart,limit=1,sort=nearest]
```

## Speed Reference

| Blocks/s | Description |
|:---------|:------------|
| 8.0      | Vanilla default |
| 16.0     | 2x speed |
| 32.0     | 4x speed |
| 64.0     | 8x speed |
| 100.0    | 12.5x speed (very fast!) |

## Supported Minecart Types

This mod works with all vanilla minecart types:

- `minecraft:minecart` — Regular Minecart
- `minecraft:chest_minecart` — Minecart with Chest
- `minecraft:furnace_minecart` — Minecart with Furnace
- `minecraft:tnt_minecart` — Minecart with TNT
- `minecraft:hopper_minecart` — Minecart with Hopper
- `minecraft:command_block_minecart` — Minecart with Command Block

## Building from Source

Each platform has its own directory with its own build system:

```bash
# Fabric
cd fabric && ./gradlew build

# Forge
cd forge && ./gradlew build

# NeoForge
cd neoforge && ./gradlew build
```

The compiled JAR will be in `build/libs/` under each platform directory.

## Technical Details

- Custom speed is stored in the minecart's NBT data under the key `MinecartSpeedModSpeed`
- Speed is stored in blocks per second and converted to blocks/tick internally (÷20)
- The mod uses a Mixin on `AbstractMinecart.getMaxSpeed()` to override vanilla speed limits
- Compatible with other mods that don't modify minecart speed behavior

## License

MIT

title: Create OBB Collision Crash Fix
description: Fixes a server crash in Create 6.0.10 caused by a NullPointerException in contraption collision code (ContinuousOBBCollider.collideMany).
body:
When moving contraptions collide in certain degenerate or exact-overlap cases, Create's collision manifold fails to record a separation axis, leaving it null. The game then tries to read .x on that null Vec3 and the server crashes:

java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot read field "x" because "mf.axis" is null
  at ...ContinuousOBBCollider.collideMany(ContinuousOBBCollider.java:153)
This mod uses a Mixin to intercept the two null-prone field reads (axis and normalAxis) and substitutes Vec3.ZERO when they're null. A zero vector makes that frame's collision contribution 0 — harmless — instead of crashing the server tick thread.

Details:

Lightweight — single mixin, no runtime overhead beyond a null check
Doesn't modify Create's logic, just prevents the null dereference
Works server-side (install on server only is fine, but safe on both sides)
For Create 6.0.10 on NeoForge / Minecraft 1.21.1

Summoning Eggs Being Created

This mod adds balanced crafting recipes for spawn eggs. No dirt-and-sticks nonsense — each egg requires a Name Tag, a Soul Stone (custom item), and mob-specific materials that actually make sense.

Currently craftable mobs:

Cow

Pig

Sheep

Chicken

Zombie

Skeleton

Spider

Creeper

Villager

Wolf

Horse

Only a handful of recipes are available, and there are no plans to add every mob in the game. This is a small, balanced addition to your survival toolkit.

How to get a Soul Stone
The Soul Stone is the core ingredient for every spawn egg in this mod. Getting one takes a bit of work — here's the full chain.

Step 1: Craft a Soul Stone Base (Blank)

You need:

1 Netherite Scrap

1 Soul Sand

1 Nether Quartz

6 Cobblestone (or Stone)


This gives you 1 Soul Stone Base.

Bulk crafting: Replace the Netherite Scrap with a Netherite Ingot to craft 4 Soul Stone Bases at once.

Step 2: Upgrade in Smithing Table

Take the Soul Stone Base to a Smithing Table and combine it with:

Cobblestone (any amount, consumed once)

Nether Quartz

The result is a fully charged Soul Stone, ready for spawn egg crafting.

Extra: This mod also backports the Name Tag crafting recipe from version 1.26 to 1.20.1. Now you can craft Name Tags in survival without hunting dungeon loot.

title: Create: Extended Filters
description: Simple create addon that adds more filters settings
body:
Addon for Create's **List Filter** on **Minecraft 1.21.1** (NeoForge).

Vanilla Create with **Respect Data** treats items as different if *any* data component differs. That's fine until one field you don't care about — like baby vs adult axolotl in a bucket — blocks everything else from matching.

This mod adds **Exclude components** to the filter GUI. Turn on Respect Data,
![image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c8aa7e3f9b88724310031535ec2e2658eab7df10_0.webp)
add your reference items, then choose which components (or nested fields inside them) to skip when matching. The rest still counts.

**Example:** whitelist adult axolotl bucket, exclude `Age` → baby buckets pass too.

Works in contraptions — funnels, deployers, the usual logistics stuff. Filtering runs on the server side.

### Setup
- Minecraft **1.21.1**
- **NeoForge** 21.1+
- [**Create** 6.0.10+](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)
- Multiplayer: install on **client and server**

### How to use
1. Open a List Filter, enable **Respect Data**
2. Put reference items in the filter slots
3. Click **Exclude components** at the bottom
4. Hover the text, scroll the list, click to toggle exclusions (red strikethrough = ignored)
5. Save with the checkmark

Polish UI included.

---

Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/PL-VIP/create-extended-filters-source)

title: Flatulence
description: Assert dominance without saying a word
body:
This mod gives players a chance to fart whenever they sneak, playing a sound audible to nearby players. Players near a fart accumulate "exposure"; once exposure reaches 100%, they're hit with Nausea and their exposure resets. It is **required** on the server. Clients that don't have it installed won't hear the fart sound, but will still see the fart particles and be affected by Nausea. ## Features ### 💨 Farts - Sneaking has a configurable chance to make a player fart - A cooldown limits how often the fart chance roll can trigger per player - Nearby players accumulate exposure with each fart they're close to - Once a player's exposure reaches 100%, they're hit with Nausea and their exposure resets ### 🤢 Exposure - Exposure accumulates per fart within a configurable radius - Exposure slowly decays over time as players catch some fresh air ### 🍖 Food Bonuses - Certain foods can temporarily increase a player's fart chance - Each food has a configurable bonus and decay rate - Eating the same food again refreshes the bonus _The truly dedicated may one day experience the Forbidden Fart_... ## Configuration
Settings Settings can be edited in-game via [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) if installed, or directly in `config/flatulence.json`. | Field | Default | Description | |--------------------------|:-------------:|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | `fartChance` | `0.3` (`30%`) | Chance per sneak that a player farts. | | `fartCooldownTicks` | `10` | Minimum time between fart chance rolls for the same player. | | `exposureRadius` | `5.0` | How close other players must be to gain exposure when someone farts, in blocks. | | `exposureIncrement` | `0.5` (`50%`) | How much a nearby player's exposure increases per fart. | | `exposureDecayPerSecond` | `0.1` (`10%`) | How much exposure decreases per second. | | `nauseaDurationSeconds` | `10` | How long Nausea lasts once a player's exposure reaches 100% (`1.0`). | | `foods` | `[]` | List of foods that temporarily boost fart chance. |
--- _Fart sounds by [Blackstar](https://www.myinstants.com/en/profile/Blackstar/uploaded/) and [Ilikebreathingair](https://www.myinstants.com/en/profile/ilikebreathingair/uploaded/)._ --- _**Note**: If you encounter any issues, please report them on the [GitHub Issues page](https://github.com/Pemiridosa/flatulence/issues)._

It catches things like autoclickers, killaura, silent aim, and antiknockback on the combat side. For inventory it handles cheats like chestsealers, autoarmor, and autototem. It also has a nuker check, instabreak detection, jesus, and strafe/orbit killaura patterns.

40 checks covering what GrimAC doesn't:

Combat: AutoClicker, KillAura (6 sub-checks), AimAssist, SilentAim, Triggerbot, AntiKnockback, Criticals, Reach, FightBot, KillPotion, TPAura
Inventory: ChestStealer, AutoArmor, AutoTotem, FastInventory, AutoEat, AutoPotion, FastEat
World: Nuker, InstaBreak, VeinMiner, AutoFarm, AutoFish, AutoRespawn, AutoSwitch, AutoMine
Movement: Jesus, Strafe, Blink, InvWalk, AntiAFK, HighJump, FastLadder, NoWeb, Regen, AntiHunger, AntiCactus, AntiPotion, Parkour, SneakSpam
GrimAC integration:

Players with grim.staff get full StoneAC admin access without extra config

Duplicate admin features (freeze, spectate, GUI, broadcast) auto-disable when GrimAC is detected

title: Confluent
description: Confluent is the connected texture pack version of [Clean]({{projects.clean.url}})
body:
# Available with 26.2 Delectability! Confluent gives you minecraft in a clear, no-nonsense way. Very low noise, very high visibility. Confluent is the connected texture pack version of [Clean](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/clean-pack). Playing with Confluent is a much calmer experience than vanilla, or even many simplified packs. When there is less visual noise, there are fewer things calling for your attention. When differences are clear, information you need is easily in your grasp. The visual world demands less of you, and you play with less distraction and more confidence.

The design guidelines are: * Cleanliness balanced with elegance. * Low noise. * Fidelity with vanilla: If you use blocks to create a certain feel in vanilla, the feel should be similar in Clean. * Recognizability: You should be able to naturally know what's what. * What is different looks different, what is related looks related. * Important details are clear. For example, each side shows you which way a furnace is pointing. ![grass block design](https://cleanpack.art/grass_design.png) The pack is quite complete, all blocks, mobs, items, GUI, paintings, effects... Almost all are 16x16, but a few are larger where it reduced noise a lot (such as curved rail). Some particles (such as lava sparks) are left untouched on purpose. (And versions going back to Minecraft 1.16 are available.)



Confluent is a resource pack built on making the world less noisy. The textures are designed to be clear and simple. It is easy to see what things are, visual noise is reduced, and clutter is taken away. When this Is used across a landscape ... _so much less noise!_ ![Comparison of the several variants of Clarity with vanilla.](https://cleanpack.art/comparison.gif) As shown here, Confluent is part of the Clean family of resource packs. The main other packs are: [Clean](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/clean-pack), with borders on blocks for orderly building and [Creamy](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/creamypack), which eliminates the block borders for landscape blocks. Although visually simplified, the colors and tones are pretty faithful to vanilla. Things that look good visually in vanilla ought to look similarly good in Confluent. This is a very complete pack. Pretty much everything has been smoothed, cleaned up, and reworked. The Clean family [has its own web site](https://cleanpack.art), so come on over and [check it out!](https://cleanpack.art) One way to check it out is via my RestWorld resource pack test world, which is also on [this site](https://modrinth.com/world/restworld) and [on my own site](https://cleanpack.art/restworld/index.html). Check it out! (Note to the detail geeks: This is only 99% 16x; I have prioritized simple clean look over adherence to 16x, and for a few blocks I had to choose.) ***Older versions available for download on the [Clean Website.](https://cleanpack.art/#Downloads!)***

title: Spud Mod
description: Adds spuds and gripper tools and items to the game from the AETHER
body:
# Spud Mod

A feet-themed Aether addon with a full progression system, tameable rats, custom fluids, and multi-mod crafting chains. Equal parts serious modded content and absurd comedy.

## What does this mod add?

### Chudington Ore
A glowing ore found only in the Aether dimension. Mining it drops Raw Spud — and has a 10% chance to spawn a hostile **Spud Rat** that wants to nibble you to death. Supports Fortune and Silk Touch.

### The Spud Progression
Raw Spud → Spud → Spudding → Spuddington → Spuddington Block

Each tier unlocks new recipes and capabilities. Spud is a fast-eating snack that grants **Gripper Feet** (speed + jump boost + wall climbing). Spuddington is a superfood with massive buffs.

### Spud Rats
Small hostile mobs that spawn from Chudington Ore. Kill them for **Toe Jam**, or tame them with Spud for a loyal companion that:
- Follows you and fights for you
- Rides on your head (invulnerable while riding)
- Sniffs out nearby Chudington Ore and marks it with particles
- Heals when fed Spud

### Gripper Feet Effect
A custom potion effect that gives:
- Speed (scales with level)
- Jump Boost (scales with level)
- Wall Climbing — walk into any wall and climb straight up like a spider

### Griptium — Endgame Material
A multi-step crafting chain requiring both Create and Ars Nouveau:

1. Toe Jam → **Create Crushing Wheels** → Crushed Toe Jam
2. Crushed Toe Jam + Lava → **Create Superheated Mixer** → Molten Grip Fluid
3. Molten Grip Fluid → **Create Compacting (Superheated)** → Grip Plate
4. Grip Plate + Spudding → **Ars Enchanting Apparatus** → Griptium

### Molten Grip Fluid
A pink lava-like fluid. Burns on contact. Can be bucketed, piped, and stored in tanks.

### Tools & Equipment
- **Griptium Pickaxe** — Only mines Chudington Ore (useless on everything else), but mines it fast with 50% bonus drops
- **Spuddington Block** — Wearable on your feet slot. Pure drip.
- **Spud Familiar** — Endgame Ars Nouveau item. Passively grants Mana Boost III and Mana Regen III while in your inventory.

### Throwable Raw Spud
Right-click to yeet a Raw Spud at your enemies. 2 damage on hit with a custom death message: *"Player was spudded to death"*

### Create Integration
- Crushing: Chudington Ore → Raw Spud
- Crushing: Toe Jam → Crushed Toe Jam
- Pressing: Raw Spud → Spud
- Mixing (heated): Raw Spud + Water → Spud
- Mixing (superheated): Crushed Toe Jam + Lava → Molten Grip Fluid
- Compacting (superheated): Molten Grip Fluid → Grip Plate

### Ars Nouveau Integration
- Enchanting Apparatus: Raw Spud → Spudding (500 source)
- Enchanting Apparatus: Grip Plate → Griptium (1000 source)
- Enchanting Apparatus: Spuddington → Spud Familiar (2000 source)

### Loot
All Spud items can appear in dungeon chests and loot containers (including Lootr). Rare items like the Griptium Pickaxe and Spud Familiar have very low drop rates.

### 20+ Advancements
Hidden achievements, puns, and challenges including:
- *"It's Chudding Time"* — Mine your first Chudington Ore
- *"I Got Spud On My Grippers"* — Wear a Spuddington Block as boots
- *"Ratatouille"* — Put a tamed Spud Rat on your head
- *"You've Been Chudded"* — Mine the ore with your bare fist
- *"Spud Gun"* — Hit something with a thrown Raw Spud
- *"Best Friends Forever"* — Tame a Spud Rat
- And many more...

### Item Tooltips
Every item has a funny description. Highlights include:
- Toe Jam: *"Dropped by Spud Rats. Don't ask where it comes from."*
- Griptium: *"Forged through feet, fire, and forbidden magic."*
- Spuddington Block: *"9 Spuddingtons compressed into pure drip. Wearable on feet."*

## Dependencies

| Mod | Required? |
|-----|-----------|
| The Aether | Required |
| Create 6.0+ | Optional (for processing recipes) |
| Ars Nouveau 5.11+ | Optional (for enchanting recipes) |

## Compatibility

Built for NeoForge 1.21.1. Designed to work in large modpacks (200+ mods). Recipes only load when their respective mod is present.

title: ModularPacks-Resources

body:
# ModularPacks Resources
ModularPacks Resources is the official resource pack for the ModularPacks Paper plugin. Instead of leaving backpacks and upgrades as generic vanilla-looking items, this pack gives them a consistent visual identity with custom models and themed textures. The goal is to make backpack progression and installed modules easier to read at a glance while keeping all gameplay logic on the plugin side. This pack is built to complement ModularPacks, not replace it. The plugin handles backpack identity, storage, module behavior, and data. The resource pack handles visual presentation. ## Features - Custom backpack item visuals - Custom module and medallion visuals - Model mapping designed around ModularPacks item definitions - Improved visual clarity for module-heavy backpacks - Vanilla-client friendly resource-pack workflow - Designed to stay in sync with ongoing ModularPacks development
Requirements and installation ## Requirements - Minecraft Java Edition with resource packs enabled - A server running the ModularPacks plugin - Recommended: matching versions of plugin and resource pack ## Installation 1. Download the resource pack. 2. Place it in your client resource packs folder, or let your server distribute it. 3. Enable the pack in Minecraft. 4. Join a server running ModularPacks. 5. Verify that ModularPacks CustomModelData values are configured as expected. If models do not appear correctly, check: - Pack load order - Resource pack conflicts - Server-side ModularPacks config values for model data
Design goals and compatibility ## What this pack is for Many server plugins focus on features first and visuals later. ModularPacks Resources is meant to close that gap by giving backpacks and upgrades a cohesive in-game look that matches the plugin’s modular design. The intention is not to force one style, but to provide an official baseline that feels intentional, readable, and expandable. ## Compatibility notes - This is a resource pack, not a gameplay plugin - No client mod loader is required - Works alongside the ModularPacks plugin on vanilla clients Intended for servers that want the full visual ModularPacks experience
Related project ## ModularPacks plugin This resource pack is made for the ModularPacks plugin, which can be found [here](https://modrinth.com/plugin/modularpacks).

title: ExpandedChests
description: Add huge vanilla-compatible paged storage chests to Paper servers, with crafting, names, sorting, and optional StorageWorkbench support.
body:
# ExpandedChests

![Paper plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-Paper-5fbf6a?style=for-the-badge)
![Server side](https://img.shields.io/badge/Side-Server--side-2f855a?style=for-the-badge)
![No client mod](https://img.shields.io/badge/Client%20mod-Not%20required-2563eb?style=for-the-badge)
![Geyser friendly](https://img.shields.io/badge/Geyser-Friendly-06b6d4?style=for-the-badge)
![MIT License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-f59e0b?style=for-the-badge)

> Huge storage chests for Paper servers, without client mods or resource packs.

ExpandedChests adds craftable high-capacity storage blocks that still feel at home on a vanilla-compatible server.

Players place an expanded chest, open it like normal storage, move through paged inventory screens, sort the whole storage from inside the GUI, and see a clean label above the block with its name and used slot count.

It is built for survival servers that want bigger storage rooms without turning the server into a client modpack.

## Why It Exists

| Storage pain | ExpandedChests answer |
| --- | --- |
| Double-chest walls get huge fast. | Replace rows of boxes with compact tiered storage. |
| Players forget what each storage block contains. | Each placed expanded chest can show a custom name and `used/total` slots. |
| Giant inventories often need client mods. | ExpandedChests uses server-side vanilla inventory screens. |
| Big containers get messy. | Built-in page controls and full-storage sorting keep items manageable. |
| Java and Bedrock players share one server. | No client mod, no resource pack, no custom client UI. |

## Storage Tiers

| Tier | Capacity | Slots | Visible vanilla block |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 3x | 3 double chests | 162 | Light gray shulker box |
| 5x | 5 double chests | 270 | Yellow shulker box |
| 10x | 10 double chests | 540 | Light blue shulker box |
| 100x | 100 double chests | 5400 | Black shulker box |

The placed block is a vanilla shulker-box anchor. The real storage is saved server-side in the plugin data and opened through paged vanilla inventory menus.

## Crafting Recipes

ExpandedChests is meant to feel earned in survival. Every tier is craftable, every higher tier uses the previous tier, and every recipe includes a sign because these storage blocks are meant to be named and readable in-world.

`S` means any vanilla sign: oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry, bamboo, crimson, or warped.

### 3x Expanded Chest

```text
C S C
C I C
C I C
```

| Symbol | Ingredient |
| --- | --- |
| `C` | Chest |
| `S` | Any sign |
| `I` | Iron block |

Output: `3x Expanded Chest`, 162 slots.

### 5x Expanded Chest

```text
C S C
U P U
C U C
```

| Symbol | Ingredient |
| --- | --- |
| `C` | Chest |
| `S` | Any sign |
| `U` | Gold block |
| `P` | 3x Expanded Chest |

Output: `5x Expanded Chest`, 270 slots.

### 10x Expanded Chest

```text
C S C
U P U
C U C
```

| Symbol | Ingredient |
| --- | --- |
| `C` | Chest |
| `S` | Any sign |
| `U` | Diamond block |
| `P` | 5x Expanded Chest |

Output: `10x Expanded Chest`, 540 slots.

### 100x Expanded Chest

```text
C S C
U P U
C N C
```

| Symbol | Ingredient |
| --- | --- |
| `C` | Ender chest |
| `S` | Any sign |
| `U` | Netherite block |
| `P` | 10x Expanded Chest |
| `N` | Nether star |

Output: `100x Expanded Chest`, 5400 slots.

If [StorageWorkbench](https://modrinth.com/plugin/storageworkbench) is installed, these recipes can appear in its storage crafting menu when the ingredients are available in the player inventory, nearby vanilla chests, or nearby expanded chests.

## Features

| Feature | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Four storage tiers | 3x, 5x, 10x, and 100x double-chest capacity. |
| Survival progression | Higher tiers require the previous expanded chest. |
| Vanilla-compatible blocks | Placed storage uses vanilla shulker-box anchors. |
| Paged inventory GUI | Large storage opens through normal server inventory screens. |
| Built-in sorting | Sort the whole expanded chest from inside its GUI. |
| Visible labels | Shows storage name and occupied slots above the block. |
| Naming support | Look at a placed expanded chest and run `/ec name <name>`. |
| Admin item menu | Use `/ec items` or `/ec creative` when you need the custom items directly. |
| Safety guards | Protects non-empty expanded chests from accidental breaking by default. |
| World protection | Blocks explosions, pistons, and hopper movement on expanded chest anchors. |
| Fast lookup | Indexed by block and loaded chunk for companion-plugin access. |
| Server-side only | No client mod, no resource pack, no custom packets. |

## Works With The Storage Suite

ExpandedChests can run by itself, but it is designed to sit neatly beside the other storage plugins:

| Plugin | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [StorageWorkbench](https://modrinth.com/plugin/storageworkbench) | Craft from nearby vanilla chests and ExpandedChests through a vanilla-compatible storage crafting menu. |
| [OpenChestSorter](https://modrinth.com/plugin/openchestsorter) | Automatically sorts ordinary single and double chests when players open them. |

The responsibility split is intentional:

- OpenChestSorter handles ordinary vanilla chests.
- ExpandedChests owns expanded storage and its own page-aware sort controls.
- StorageWorkbench can craft from both vanilla chests and expanded chests when both plugins are installed.

All three plugins can also run separately.

## Compatibility

| Target | Support |
| --- | --- |
| Platform | Paper |
| Minecraft versions | 1.21.x and 26.1.x |
| Java for 1.21.x servers | Java 21 |
| Java for 26.1.x servers | Java 25 or newer |
| Client-side install | Not required |
| Resource pack | Not required |
| Required dependencies | None |
| Optional companions | [StorageWorkbench](https://modrinth.com/plugin/storageworkbench), [OpenChestSorter](https://modrinth.com/plugin/openchestsorter) |
| Geyser/Floodgate | Designed around vanilla blocks, vanilla inventory screens, and vanilla particles. |

ExpandedChests is a server-side Paper plugin. It is not a Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, or client-side mod.

## Commands

| Command | Permission | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/ec status` | `expandedchests.admin` | Shows plugin status and stored expanded chest count. |
| `/ec items` | `expandedchests.admin` | Opens an admin menu with expanded chest items. |
| `/ec creative` | `expandedchests.admin` | Opens the same vanilla-compatible creative/admin item menu. |
| `/ec info` | `expandedchests.use` | Shows information about the expanded chest you are looking at. |
| `/ec name <name>` | `expandedchests.use` | Renames the expanded chest you are looking at. |
| `/ec name clear` | `expandedchests.use` | Resets the visible expanded chest name. |
| `/ec give <3x\|5x\|10x\|100x> [player]` | `expandedchests.admin` | Gives an expanded chest item. |
| `/ec reload` | `expandedchests.admin` | Reloads config and data. |

## Permissions

| Permission | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `expandedchests.use` | Everyone | Allows normal expanded chest usage, info, and naming. |
| `expandedchests.admin` | Operators | Allows admin commands and item menus. |

## Installation

1. Stop the Paper server.
2. Back up the server folder, especially `world`, `world_nether`, `world_the_end`, `plugins`, and config files.
3. Copy `expanded-chests-1.0.0.jar` into the server `plugins` folder.
4. Start the server.
5. Adjust `plugins/ExpandedChests/config.yml` if needed.

<details>
<summary>Default configuration</summary>

```yaml
enabled: true

display:
  holograms: true
  open-particles: true
  open-particle-count: 18

behavior:
  prevent-breaking-non-empty: true
  save-on-close: true
  save-interval-ticks: 6000
  protect-from-explosions: true
  protect-from-pistons: true
  protect-from-hoppers: true

debug-logging: false
```

</details>

## Performance

ExpandedChests is designed to keep large storage predictable:

- Placed expanded chests are indexed by block position.
- Nearby lookups use loaded chunk indexes instead of scanning every stored chest on the server.
- Storage pages are loaded into vanilla inventories only when players open them.
- Open pages are saved back to plugin data before external lookup or item movement.
- No database, telemetry, external network calls, or world data migrations.

## Safety

ExpandedChests stores contents in `plugins/ExpandedChests/data.yml`.

The plugin does not generate chunks or rewrite world files, but it does manage item storage. Treat first installation like any storage-plugin rollout:

1. Make a full server backup.
2. Test on a copied world or separate test server.
3. Place each expanded chest tier.
4. Put items inside and restart the server.
5. Verify the contents survive restart.
6. Test breaking empty and non-empty expanded chests.
7. Test companion plugins only after standalone behavior looks correct.

## Known Limitations

- A server plugin cannot reliably add custom items to the client-side creative inventory list without a client mod or resource pack. Use `/ec items`, `/ec creative`, or `/ec give` instead.
- Expanded storage uses server-side paged inventory screens, so it does not look like a single giant vanilla chest screen.
- OpenChestSorter intentionally does not sort expanded chests. Use the built-in expanded chest sort button instead.

## License

ExpandedChests is released under the MIT License.

title: CritIndicator
description: Flashes a big "CRIT!" on screen on every critical hit and tracks your crit streak + personal best in a bottom-right HUD. Toggle with V, reset with Shift+V.
body:
**CritIndicator** turns vanilla's nearly invisible crit sparkle into something you can actually feel. When you land a critical hit on a living entity, a large yellow **CRIT!** flashes in the upper-third of your screen and fades out over 1.5 seconds — and a small bottom-right counter ticks up your current streak. Miss a crit and the streak resets; nail a clean run and you'll watch your personal best climb.

### What it shows
```
Crit streak: 7
Best:        21
14/26 (54%)
```

- **Crit streak** — consecutive crits since your last non-crit attack on a mob.
- **Best** — highest streak this session.
- **`hits/total (%)`** — running crit ratio: how many of your attacks were crits.

### How it detects crits
Same conditions vanilla uses when computing critical hits, evaluated the moment you swing at a living entity:

- Player is falling (`fallDistance > 0`)
- Player is **not** on ground, climbing, in water, in a vehicle or sprinting
- Player is **not** under Blindness
- Attack cooldown is at least ~90% recharged
- Target is a `LivingEntity`

This means the indicator agrees with the server's actual crit calculation — if vanilla would crit, **CRIT!** flashes; if not, nothing fires and your streak breaks.

### Controls
- **V** — toggle the HUD on / off
- **Shift + V** — reset streak, best, and ratio counters

Both keys are read via raw GLFW polling, so they work the same on every supported Minecraft version without a rebind UI.

### Compatibility
Works on **Minecraft 1.21.8, 1.21.9, 1.21.10, and 1.21.11** (Fabric Loader 0.16+). One JAR for all four versions — install with Fabric API and drop into your `mods/` folder.

- Pure client-side — install on the client only, works on any server, no game-state changes, no anti-cheat impact.
- Hides automatically when you press **F1** to hide the rest of the HUD.
- Counters live in memory only — they reset when you quit (this is a session streak, not a lifetime stat).

### Why
Critical hits in vanilla are subtle: a small particle puff and a slightly higher damage number. CritIndicator gives you instant, glanceable feedback that your timing was right — and a streak counter you can chase.

title: SyPVP
description: A PVP control plugin for Minecraft Purpur 1.21.x
body:
# SyPVP

A PVP control plugin for Minecraft Purpur/Paper 1.21.x

## Features

- **PVP Toggle Control** - Players can freely enable or disable PVP status
- **GUI Interface** - Use `/pvp` command to open an intuitive settings interface
- **Combat Cooldown** - Cannot disable PVP for 1 minute after engaging in combat
- **Invite System** - Invite players who haven't enabled PVP to battle
- **PVP Arena System** - Admin can create PVP arenas and players can host PVP matches
- **Broadcast Invite** - Players can send server-wide PVP invites
- **Queue System** - Auto queue when all arenas are occupied
- **Multiple Game Modes** - Free-for-all, 1vMany, 2vMany, Random 2 Teams, Random 3 Teams

## Commands

### Player Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/pvp` | Open PVP settings GUI | `sypvp.use` |
| `/sypvp` | Alias for `/pvp` | `sypvp.use` |
| `/pvpinvite <player>` | Invite a player to enable PVP | `sypvp.use` |
| `/svp send <count>` | Send server-wide PVP invite | `sypvp.use` |

### Admin Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/sypvp set pvp <id>` | Create PVP arena with stone hoe selection | `sypvp.admin` |
| `/sypvp remove pvp <id>` | Remove a PVP arena | `sypvp.admin` |
| `/sypvp list` | List all PVP arenas | `sypvp.admin` |

## Permissions

- `sypvp.use` - Allow using PVP related commands (default: true)
- `sypvp.admin` - Allow using admin commands (default: op)

## Usage

### Enable/Disable PVP

1. Type `/pvp` to open the settings interface
2. Click the green wool to enable PVP
3. Click the red wool to disable PVP

### Invite Players

When attacking a player who hasn't enabled PVP:
1. The system will prompt "The other player has not enabled PVP"
2. Click the "[Invite player to enable PVP]" button to send an invitation
3. The recipient will receive an invitation message and can click "[Click to open PVP settings]" to enable

### Create PVP Arena (Admin)

1. Hold a **stone hoe**
2. **Left-click** a block to set corner 1
3. **Right-click** a block to set corner 2
4. Type `/sypvp set pvp <arena-id>` to create the arena

### Host a PVP Match (Player)

1. Type `/svp send <invite-count>` to send a server-wide invite
2. Other players can click "[Accept]" or "[Reject]" in the chat message
3. When enough players accept, the team will be teleported to a random arena
4. The host selects the game mode from the GUI
5. Fight until one team remains!

### Queue System

If all arenas are occupied when a match starts:
- Players will see a "Queueing..." message with a "[Stop Queueing]" button
- The system will automatically check for available arenas every 5 seconds
- Click "[Stop Queueing]" or type `/sypvp queue stop` to cancel

## Game Modes

- **Free-for-All** - Every player fights alone, last one standing wins
- **1vMany** - One player vs all others
- **2vMany** - Two players team up against all others
- **Random 2 Teams** - Players are randomly split into 2 teams
- **Random 3 Teams** - Players are randomly split into 3 teams

## Configuration

Edit `plugins/SyPVP/config.yml`:

```yaml
# Max invites per hour per player
max-invites-per-hour: 5

# Max players per PVP game
max-players-per-game: 10
```

## Technical Specifications

- **Supported Version**: Purpur/Paper 1.21.x
- **JDK**: Java 21

## Installation

1. Download `SyPVP-1.1.0.jar`
2. Place the JAR file into your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart the server or load the plugin

## Data Storage

- `plugins/SyPVP/data.yml` - Players' PVP status settings
- `plugins/SyPVP/regions.yml` - PVP arena definitions

## Author

Shiyuan

title: ModVerifier
description: A mod that scans player's mods and sends the list to your Discord server
body:
**ModVerifier🔍**

**a server and client side Fabric mod** for Minecraft servers that allow both Java besides Bedrock Edition players to connect. For server administrators, this tool verifies the mods that Java players use while it allows Bedrock players to join without any interference. 

To avoid large amounts of data in the server console, ModVerifier sends connection information to Discord webhooks. With those webhooks, staff members can see in real time which players are joining and which modifications the players are using.

On servers that use Geyser or Floodgate for cross play, administrators must manage different types of users. Java players can use powerful client side mods that might break server rules. In contrast Bedrock players use mobile devices or consoles that do not have mod folders.

ModVerifier manages those two environments in specific ways

For Java Players - It checks the list of client side mods when a player connects so that the server remains fair and the mod usage is clear.

For Bedrock Players - It identifies the platform and does not perform a check, which allows the players to join immediately. By doing this the mod avoids sending extra data packets or causing players to lose their connection.

ModVerifier exists within the network login pipeline of the server so that it can manage connections

The Handshake & Platform Check
When a player starts a connection, ModVerifier intercepts the login event. It

**Who is this for?** (Important Note)  
ModVerifier is specifically **designed for small**, private servers and tight-knit friend groups.  

It is not meant for large public networks with hundreds of players at once. Since it uses direct Discord webhooks and external avatar APIs for each connection, using this on a big public server could quickly hit Discord's rate limits and create unwanted network congestion.  

If you run a friendly survival server, a private SMP, or a community hub for your friends to play Java and Bedrock together, this mod is perfect for you!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Setting up ModVerifier on your private server only takes a few minutes. Follow these simple steps to get it running:

Step 1: Install the Mod
Download the ModVerifier .jar file.

Drop the file into your server's mods folder and your client's mods folder.

Note: Make sure you also have Fabric API and Floodgate (if you are running a cross-play server) installed in your mods folder.

Start your server once to let it generate the configuration files, then stop it.

Step 2: Create a Discord Webhook
Open your Discord server and go to the channel settings where you want the connection reports to appear.

Navigate to Integrations -> Webhooks -> Create Webhook.

Customize the default name if you like, and click Copy Webhook URL.

Step 3: Configure the Mod
Go to your server files and open the config folder.

Locate and open the file named mod_verifier.json.

Paste your Discord Webhook URL inside the quotation marks next to "discordWebhookUrl". It should look like this:

JSON
{
  "discordWebhookUrl": "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/your-copied-url-here"
}

- Balancing - The total soulbound levels in a inventory can be more than 3 but then your max health is less.
- Enchanting Table Integration - Configurable chances to obtain Soulbound during normal enchanting
- Soul Sand Bonus - Increased enchantment odds when soul sand is placed beneath enchanting tables
- Reincarnation Totems - Custom craftable items offering alternative protection methods
- Admin Commands - Full control with /sb apply, /sb reload, and /sb totem commands
- Fully Configurable - Customize recovery rates, XP requirements, item appearance, and more

- Balanced difficulty customization

Features:

## 🇷🇺 Описание

Надоело копить горы ресурсов, которые тебе никогда не понадобятся? **XP Shop** позволяет продавать их за очки опыта прямо в игре — через удобное GUI-меню.

* 🔒 **Защита от абузов** — бутылочки с опытом, элитры и Nether Star продавать нельзя.

> Long ago, there was a time where prosperous civilizations ruled the Overworld, whose ruins we can excavate today as archeological sites. A common companion of these citizens was the SP1D3R, the Supply Protector-v.1 Defender-v.3 Robot.

> Powered by a redstone core, SP1D3Rs hovered above the ground and followed their owners, ready to execute a variety of tasks at a moment’s notice. Having a SP1D3R around made everyday life much easier, as they were designed to transport objects in their redstone cores and could traverse difficult terrain with ease. Additionally, the SP1D3R had the capability to defend their owners and themselves from various threats. Smaller units were even implemented in mining shafts to access hard to reach ores! Many believe that the assistance of the SP1D3R greatly helped these lost civilizations flourish.

> That was, until… something… happened, and the SP1D3Rs turned against their creators.

Some speculations include sudden sentience, redstone corruption, or a magic ritual gone wrong, but what is true is that the SP1D3R is a terrifying remnant of an age long past.

> Adventurers must be prepared to defeat these monsters, especially those still roaming the mineshafts below the surface - their advanced oxidation resulted in a deadly poison administered when they attack. title: Lamp's Utils
description: A library mod primarily for my mods
body: # Lamp's Utils A lightweight utility and library mod for Fabric (Minecraft 1.21.11). ## Features - **Error Block** — A decorative/utility block registered under `lamps-utils:error_block` - **HTTP Command** — `/http get ` fetches data from a URL and displays it in chat, with configurable safety warnings and text length limits - **Config System** — In-game configuration via ModMenu powered by OWO-Lib ## Configuration | Option | Default | Description | |--------|---------|-------------| | `showHttpWarning` | `true` | Show a security warning when using the HTTP command | | `maxTextLimit` | `300` | Max characters displayed from HTTP responses (100–5000) | ## Using as a Library Lamp's Utils is available via [JitPack](https://jitpack.io/#lamps-dev/lamps-utils). Add the following to your `build.gradle`: ```groovy repositories { maven { url 'https://jitpack.io' } } dependencies { modImplementation 'com.github.lamps-dev:lamps-utils:v1.5.0' } ``` ### Available APIs **Block Registration** (`ModBlocks`) ```java // Register blocks with automatic item registration ModBlocks.register("my_block", Block::new, properties, true); // Access built-in blocks ModBlocks.ERROR_BLOCK ``` **Configuration** (`ConfigManager`) ```java // Access config values ConfigManager.CONFIG.showHttpWarning(); ConfigManager.CONFIG.maxTextLimit(); ``` **Command Registration** (`ModCommands`) ```java // Commands are registered via Fabric's command event ModCommands.register(dispatcher); ``` ## Dependencies | Dependency | Purpose | |------------|---------| | [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) | Required — Core Fabric hooks | | [OWO-Lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/owo-lib) | Required — Configuration system | | [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) | Optional — In-game config GUI | ## Building from Source ```bash git clone https://github.com/lamps-dev/lamps-utils.git cd lamps-utils ./gradlew build ``` The built jar will be in `build/libs/`. ## License [CC0-1.0](LICENSE) — Public Domain ## Credits: Fix icons created by Freepik - Flaticon Claude AI - Created this README.md and helped me code the mod (its not fully vibecoded don't worry).

title: InventorySaves+
description: Adds a better saving system compared to the normal vanilla hotbar saves
body:
# Inventory Saves+ 🎒✨
![inventory saves pic](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7b202cbced9eb3f9101e4607a766815dab8e5cb.png)
A full inventory management system for PvP players that goes far beyond vanilla hotbar saves — store, load, and switch complete loadouts in seconds.

## Loadout System 🧠
Save and restore your entire inventory with a single keypress.
How It Works

Save your full inventory to any of 18 available slots
Load any slot to instantly restore your hotbar, armor, offhand, and main inventory
Works exclusively in Creative Mode to keep things server-safe
Async save system means zero lag when writing to disk


## Loadout Manager 🖥️
A clean in-game UI for managing all your saved loadouts.
Features

Scrollable list of all 18 slots with names and status
Inline name editor — rename slots without extra menus
Save, Load, and Delete from one screen
Real-time slot preview with empty/filled state indicators
Scrollbar for navigating large slot lists
Accessible via keybind or ModMenu


## Preset Kits ⚔️
Jump straight into combat with one click using built-in preset loadouts.
PresetDescriptionPot PvPClassic potion PvP kitAxe KitAxe-based combat setupSMP KitGeneral survival multiplayer loadoutMace KitMace-focused combat buildSword KitSword PvP standard kitUHC (Old)Classic UHC-style setupUHC (New)Modern UHC buildNethPotNether potion kitVanilla (Drain)Drain-focused vanilla kitVanilla (Eval)Evaluation vanilla kit
All presets are available directly inside the Loadout Manager.

## HUD Display 🔰
A lightweight, non-intrusive HUD that keeps you informed without cluttering your screen.
Features

Shows active profile name and currently selected slot
Fades in on change, fades out after inactivity — never in your way
Smooth opacity animation with gold accent bar
Text is only generated when something changes, keeping frame impact near zero


## Keybinds ⌨️
Everything is a single keypress away.
ActionDefault KeySave LoadoutKLoad LoadoutLNext Slot]Previous Slot[Open Loadout MenuM
All keybinds are fully remappable in the vanilla Controls menu.

## Save System 💾
Built for speed and reliability.

Batched async I/O — saves never block the main thread
Debounced writes — rapid changes queue into a single disk write
Sparse JSON format — empty slots are skipped entirely, keeping save files small and fast to parse
Saves automatically on every change; loads automatically on world join


## Commands ⚙️
(Coming in a future update — config GUI and command support are on the roadmap)

Why Use Inventory Saves+? 💡
🎒 Save your full inventory — not just your hotbar
⚔️ Switch between PvP kits instantly
🏗️ Keep building, mining, and combat setups ready to go
🎨 Name and organise your slots your way
🔥 Built for competitive Creative Mode PvP and kit testing

Compatibility

Minecraft: 1.21.11
Loader: Fabric
Environment: Client-side only
Optional: ModMenu for settings screen integration
