body:
NoItemBurn is a Minecraft plugin that prevents items from burning in fire or lava, featuring a command-based system to toggle this protection per world. Built on Java 21, it ensures compatibility across Minecraft versions 1.19.4 through 1.21+

To add a world:

```
/noitemburn worldadd <name>
```

To remove a world:
```
/noitemburn worldremove <name>
```

Suggestions are open in the [discord](https://discord.gg/tabjev2y4x)

title: Yo's Trade Post
description: 为《我的世界》添加了新的交易方块 - Adds a new trading block for Minecraft
body:
### 为我的世界添加类似星露谷物语出货箱的新交易方块。 Adds a new trading block similar to Stardew Valley selling bin for Minecraft.
### 出货箱(Selling Bin) yostradepost:tradepost 在创造模式下位于原版实用方块栏，可使用红色羊毛、白色羊毛、橡木木板和木桶合成。 Selling Bin (yostradepost:tradepost) is located in the original crafting bar in creative mode and can be synthesized using red wool, white wool, oak planks, and wooden barrels.
### 玩家将需要交易的物品放入后，出货箱会在新的一天处理交易，将指定的物品转换成另一种指定的物品（可在config文件夹内yostradepost.json中配置）。 After the player puts in the item to be traded, the Selling Bin will process the transaction on a new day, converting the specified item into another specified item (Configurable in the yostradepost.json in the config folder).
### 提供高度可自定义且简洁的配置方式。 Provides a highly customizable and clean way to configure. - 出货箱在新的一天会瞬间执行3次处理（视为1次交易），单次交易支持货币三级转换（物品-货币1-货币2-货币3）。
The Selling Bin will perform 3 processing times on a new day (considered as 1 transaction), and a single transaction supports three-level currency conversion (item - currency 1 - currency 2 - currency 3). - 配置格式 Configuration format： ["输入物品ID", "输入数量", "输出物品ID", "输出数量"]（数字可不用双引号） ["Input Item ID", "Input Quantity", "Output Item ID", "Output Quantity"] (Numbers can be used without double quotation marks) - 示例 Example： 8 铁锭（minecraft:iron_ingot）-> 1 绿宝石（minecraft:emerald） ["minecraft:iron_ingot", 8, "minecraft:emerald", 1] - 完整配置示意 Full text： 
{
  "trades": [
    ["输入物品ID", "输入数量", "输出物品ID", "输出数量"],
    ["minecraft:iron_ingot", 8, "minecraft:emerald", 1],
    ["minecraft:gold_ingot", 2, "minecraft:emerald", 1],
    ["minecraft:emerald", 8, "minecraft:diamond", 1]
  ]
}
- 以上配置中玩家输入的铁锭和金锭会被转换成绿宝石（第一次处理），若输入铁锭/金锭的数量能兑换超过8个绿宝石，则自动转换为1个钻石（第二次处理），无第三次处理。
In this configuration, the iron and gold ingots entered by the player will be converted into emeralds (first processing), and if the number of iron/gold ingots entered can be exchanged for more than 8 emeralds, it will be automatically converted to 1 diamond (second processing) without a third processing. ### 目前支持的版本： Fabric 1.20.1（需要 Fabric Loader 0.16.14 以及上版本，Fabric API任意版本）。 (requires Fabric Loader 0.16.14 or higher, any version of Fabric API).

title: Sun Compass
description: A vanilla-friendly survival tool that uses the sun's position and time to find North
body:
# Sun Compass
[![GitHub - Source](https://img.shields.io/static/v1?label=GitHub&message=Source&color=2ea44f&logo=github)](https://github.com/FireFingertips/SunCompassMod "Open mod source on GitHub")

**A vanilla-friendly survival tool for finding your way.**

The Sun Compass is a utility item that uses the position of the sun to cast a shadow on the board, helping you navigate during the day without relying on "magic" coordinate systems or debug screens.

![Sun Compass Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/xBV5bzNr/images/37742e12b9d1cc8d281385527eb7fe2205fd2992.png)

## 🧭 Manual & Usage Guide

**The Sun Compass is not a magic item.** Unlike a standard compass that points to World Spawn, the Sun Compass works similarly to a real-world sun dial. It is a navigational tool that requires you to understand the position of the sun and the time of day.

### The Core Concept
The compass displays a shadow cast by the central stick. This shadow is **fixed to the world's sun position**. As you turn or as time passes, the shadow moves around the board. To find North, you must align the shadow correctly based on the current time.

### How to Find North

#### 1. The Sunrise Baseline (6:00 AM / Tick 0)
Vanilla Minecraft days start at **6:00 AM**. At this specific time:
* The Sun is rising in the **East**.
* **Instruction:** Rotate yourself until the shadow points to the **East** marker on the compass board.
* **Result:** You are now facing **North**.

#### 2. Compensating for Time (The Clockwise Shift)
As the day progresses, the sun moves across the sky. To keep finding North, you must manually compensate for the time passed since 6:00 AM.
* **The Rule:** For every in-game hour that passes, you must **shift the compass by 1 hour clockwise**.
* **Example:**
    * **Time:** 8:00 AM (2 hours after sunrise).
    * **Action:** Align the shadow to East, then rotate yourself (and the compass) roughly **30 degrees clockwise** (2 "hours" on a clock face) to find True North.

### Summary Table
| In-Game Time | Shadow Alignment for North |
| :--- | :--- |
| **6:00 AM** (Sunrise) | Align shadow to left 6 hour mark or **East** (E) |
| **12:00 PM** (Noon) | 6 hours has passed, so align shadow to the upper 12 hour mark, or **North** (N) |
| **6:00 PM** (Sunset) | 12 hours has passed, so align shadow to right 6 hour mark or **West** (W) |

*Note: This tool requires practice. Direction accuracy is entirely based on time estimation. To find other directions than north, simply rotate by some degrees after finding north. For example, west would be 90 degrees, or 6 hours right, from north.*

## 📦 Obtaining
**There is 4 ways to craft this item in survival**

![gif showing all crafting options](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/xBV5bzNr/images/9929633ca10e12981a5cf3d52d0e6e74423771b5.gif)

To craft the Sun Compass, align any of these 4 different layouts from **bottom to top**:
- Any plank + torch
- Any plank + coal + stick
- Any plank + charcoal + stick
- Any plank + ink sac + stick

## Why is East and West swapped?
This serves the function of time shifting easier than if it was the other way around. For example, at noon (tick time 6000, or 12 PM), to find North you simply point to N (or the upper 12) then to find west you would also simply move the shadow to point W (or the right 6).
This way, shifting clockwise perserves directionality. Having it the "correct" way around would introduce extra mental calculations for no reason.

## ⚠️ Compatibility & Status
* **Version:** 0.2.0 (Pre-release)
* **Loader:** NeoForge (1.21.1)
* **Possible issues:** potentially might fail in situations where there is no sun or otherwise time logic has been modified.
* **Mod Compatibility:** There has no tests with other mods yet. Please suggest mods to pair this with and I will do my best to add compatibility (currently looking to add compatibility with TerraFirmaCraft).

## 🤝 Acknowledgements
**Special thanks to David Canterbury** for the original concept and for naming the "Sun Compass.".
* This is the video by him that specifically inspired this project: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7EfDYFDCl14&t=131s

## Final note
I'm new to modding, github, and while I'm familiar with programming, this is an entirely new level for me. But I'm looking to improve and hopefully keep adding new mods in the future!

---
*Built with NeoForge for Minecraft 1.21.*

title: 世界存档优化器(自动异步保存)
description: 世界存档优化器，可以自动保存您的服务器世界，采用异步保存。World Archive Optimizer, can automatically save your server world using asynchronous saving. Bukkit 1.21
body:
# WorldSaveOptimizer

## 概述Overview
专为bukkit 1.21+服务器设计的插件，优化世界保存功能。
A plugin designed specifically for Bukkit 1.21 servers, optimizing world-saving functionality.

## 功能特性Features
- 异步自动保存：每5分钟自动保存，减少卡顿
- 可禁用原版自动保存机制
- 手动保存支持
- 灵活配置系统
- 完整命令和权限系统
- Asynchronous auto-save: automatically saves every 5 minutes to reduce lag
- Option to disable the original auto-save mechanism
- Manual save supported
- Flexible configuration system
- Complete command and permission system

## 系统要求System Requirements
- bukkit 1.21+
- Java 21+
- 建议2GB RAM Recommended 2GB RAM

## 安装方法Installation method
1. 将WorldSaveOptimizer.jar放入plugins目录-Place WorldSaveOptimizer.jar into the plugins directory
2. 重启服务器或使用/reload命令-Restart the server or use the /reload command

## 配置文件Configuration File
首次启动后在plugins/WorldSaveOptimizer/config.yml生成配置The configuration will be generated in plugins/WorldSaveOptimizer/config.yml after the first launch:

`yaml
save-interval-minutes: 5
save-message: "&aWorld has been auto-saved"
disable-default-autosave: true
log-saves: true
save-on-stop: true
`

可能出现配置文件不生成、内容空白等错误，这时，你只需到
```
https://github.com/ABC114514114514114514/WorldSaveOptimizer/blob/main/%E7%A4%BA%E4%BE%8B%E9%85%8D%E7%BD%AE%E6%96%87%E4%BB%B6.yml
```
_
复制初始配置内容到**config.yml**

Errors such as the configuration file not being generated or appearing empty may occur. In this case, you just need to go to
```
https://github.com/ABC114514114514114514/WorldSaveOptimizer/blob/main/ExampleConfig.yml
```
and copy the initial configuration content into **config.yml**

## 命令使用
需要worldsaveoptimizer.admin权限（OP默认拥有）

| 命令 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| /s reload | 重载插件配置 |
| /s save | 手动保存世界 |
| /s status | 查看保存状态 |
| /s info | 查看插件信息 |

## Command Usage
Requires worldsaveoptimizer.admin permission (OPs have it by default)

| Command | Description |
|---------|------------|
| /s reload | Reload the plugin configuration |
| /s save | Manually save the world |
| /s status | Check the save status |
| /s info | View plugin information |

**注意**：使用前请备份世界数据。
**Note**: Please back up your world data before use.

title: Better Belarusian
description: Зьменены й адаптаваны беларускі пераклад гульні, які не ўлічвае правіла перакладу ад Mojang Studios.
body:
# ⚔️ Minecraft: Taraskievica Edition ### Вярні гульні жывую мову. Глыбокая атмасфэра і аўтэнтычны правапіс. ![Banner](https://placehold.co/1200x300/121212/ececec?text=Майнкрафт+па-беларуску!&font=Montserrat) **BelMods Better Belarusian** — гэта глыбокая лінгвістычная перапрацоўка лякалізацыі Minecraft. Мы адмовіліся ад афіцыйнага «канцылярыту» і трансьлітарацыі на карысьць **клясычнага беларускага правапісу (Тарашкевіцы)** і поўнага паглыбленьня ў фэнтэзі-атмасфэру. Гэта ня проста пераклад. Гэта спроба адказаць на пытаньне: *«Як бы гучаў Minecraft, калі б яго перакладалі, абапіраючыся на беларускую міфалёгію і літаратурную традыцыю?»* --- ## 🕯️ Філязофія праекту > Наяўнасьць правілаў — патрэба. Але наяўнасьць сьпісу «забароненых для перакладу» словаў — гэта памылка. У афіцыйным глясарыі многія назвы проста перапісаныя кірыліцай (Крыпер, Энд, Незер). Гэта забівае дух дасьледаваньня. Мы лічым, што назвы павінны перадаваць сутнасьць, а не гучаньне. * Калі істота падкрадаецца ціха — гэта **Ціхун**. * Калі вымярэньне поўнае лавы і агню — гэта **Пекла**. * Калі гэта канец сьвету — гэта **Мяжа**. Мы абралі **Тарашкевіцу**, бо гэта гістарычная, жывая сыстэма правапісу з багатай традыцыяй, якая найлепш перадае фанэтычную мяккасьць і мэлёдыку нашай мовы. --- ## ✨ Асноўныя зьмены ### 1. Сапраўдная Тарашкевіца Мы прытрымліваемся правілаў клясычнага правапісу: * Зьмякчэньне зычных (*сьнег, зьмена, цьвердзь*). * Правільная перадача запазычаньняў (*блёк, лямпа, лязурыт*). * Вяртаньне традыцыйнай лексікі (*ральля, варштат, куфар*). ### 2. Аўтарскі "Лорны" Глясарый Мы цалкам перапрацавалі назвы мобаў, вымярэньняў і рэдкіх прадметаў, каб яны гучалі як частка сусьвету, а не як тэхнічны тэрмін. #### 📖 Прыклады перакладу: | Арыгінал (EN) | Афіцыйны (Be_by) | **Better Belarusian** | Тлумачэньне | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Creeper** | Крыпер | **🧟‍♂️ Ціхун** | Той, хто ціха падкрадаецца. | | **The Nether** | Незер | **🔥 Пекла** | Міталягічнае падзямельне. | | **The End** | Энд | **🌌 Мяжа** | Край сусьвету, мяжа быцьця. | | **Enderman** | Эндэрмен | **👁️ Мяжовец** | Жыхар Мяжы. | | **Wither** | Візэр | **💀 Зьмора** | Дух, які высушвае і нясе сьмерць. | | **Ghast** | Гаст | **👻 Вый** | Гучны, лятучы прывід (адсылка да міталёгіі). | | **Phantom** | Фантом | **🦇 Здань** | Начны прывід. | | **Redstone** | Рэдстоўн | **🔴 Чырвань** | Аўтэнтычная назва рэчыва. | | **Bedrock** | Бедрок | **🪨 Цьвердзь** | Непарушны камень асновы. | --- ## 🛠️ Што зроблена? На дадзены момант перакладзены асноўны інтэрфейс, меню, дасягненьні (ачыўкі) і ўсе гульнявыя прадметы/блёкі.
Націсьніце, каб убачыць больш прыкладаў * **Netherite** → Пякеліт * **Deepslate** → Сланец * **Warden** → Сьцярож * **Pillager** → Рабаўнік * **Ravager** → Пагромнік * **Allay** → Спакаёўка * **Totem of Undying** → Татэм неўміручасьці * **Elytra** → Элітры (або Крылы)
--- ## 📥 Як усталяваць? 1. Спампуйце файл рэсурспака (`.zip`). 2. Зьмясьціце яго ў тэчку `resourcepacks` вашай гульні. 3. У наладах Minecraft абярыце **BelMods Better Belarusian**. 4. **Важна:** У меню "Мова" (Language) абярыце **Беларускую (Беларусь)**. Рэсурспак заменіць стандартны тэкст. --- *(c) Зроблена зь любоўю да мовы і кубасьвету.*

title: AFKGuard
description: AFKGuard is a powerful AFK detection plugin designed for modern Minecraft servers. It rewards true inactivity, not macros, not exploits, and not accidental movement while remaining fair, configurable, and Bedrock-friendly.
body:
**AFKGuard** is a lightweight and reliable AFK detection plugin built for modern Minecraft servers that want fair rewards without abuse. It accurately distinguishes real inactivity from macro use, environmental movement, and accidental player input, ensuring only legitimate AFK time is rewarded. Designed with performance and compatibility in mind, AFKGuard works seamlessly on Java servers with Bedrock support.

This plugin provides precise state tracking, moving players through ACTIVE, IDLE, and AFK states based on configurable rules. Rewards can be granted globally, per world, or within specific regions, allowing server owners full control over where and how AFK rewards apply. WorldGuard integration enables advanced region-based behavior without adding unnecessary overhead.

AFKGuard includes flexible UI options for displaying AFK countdowns, supporting either a BossBar or a Subtitle-based display. The Subtitle mode is optimized for Java & Bedrock players and avoids flickering issues common with other plugins. All UI behavior, thresholds, and reward logic are fully configurable and can be reloaded without restarting the server.

Built to be efficient, AFKGuard runs on a lightweight one-second tick loop and includes clean handling for player joins and quits to prevent memory leaks or stale data.

**Commands**

* `/afkguard reload` — Reload the configuration without restarting the server

**Permissions**

* `afkguard.reload` — Allows use of the reload command

**Optional Dependencies**

* WorldGuard — Enables region-specific AFK rules

**Configuration Highlights**

* Separate AFK rules for worlds and regions
* Customizable AFK time thresholds
* Fully configurable reward commands
* Intelligent movement filtering that ignores mob pushes
* Choice between BossBar or subtitle countdown displays

**Ideal For**

* Survival servers
* AFK pool setups
* Economy-focused servers
* Bedrock-compatible networks

title: Vanilla Mob Remake
description:
## Overview

The Vanilla Mob Remake mod enhances the AI of various Minecraft mobs. Currently, the AI systems for zombies, spiders, and witches have been completed, with more mob AI systems under development.
body:
Vanilla Mob Remake Mod — Breathe “Familiar Yet Unknown” Life Into Your Survival!

▌ Current Version: Alpha | Supports Minecraft Java 1.21.10, Forge 60.1.0+
▌ Mod Type: Server‑side only — no client installation needed!

---

Tired of vanilla mobs moving like they’ve had too much ale? Don’t want to overhaul the whole game with tons of new content?
Vanilla Mob Remake is made for you — we only tweak the mobs’ AI, adding zero new items or models, yet making every encounter fresh, dangerous, and tactical.

🔧 What’s working right now:

🧟 Zombies Awaken!
Zombies no longer just shamber mindlessly — they actually use what they hold:

· Crossbow Zombies keep their distance and shoot (but reload slower than a sloth)
· Potion Zombies throw buffs or debuffs your way
· Shield Zombies block and resist knockback
· Tool Zombies break blocks to reach you (not very efficiently, though)
· TNT Zombies toss explosives with a tell‑tale wind‑up — no prediction here
· Mace Zombies & Elytra Zombies don’t spawn naturally yet; wait for the full release to find them hidden in trial chambers

🧙 Witches & Their “Deals”
Witches have “traded” potions for zombie minions — now you might face not just a potion‑slinger, but a small squad of enhanced undead. Even mobs are networking these days…

🕷 Spider Traps
Spiders shoot webs to slow you down — but only once per target. Unless a Mace Zombie is around… then it’s a deadly combo.

📦 Death Chests
Upon death, your items are neatly packed into a chest that spawns where you fell. Worried about the 27‑slot limit? Don’t — if you’re carrying more, we’ll spawn a second chest.
(Note: void death still destroys your items — gravity doesn’t forgive!)

---

⚙️ Design Philosophy:

We follow the “strong but not OP” rule.
Every enhanced mob has a weakness: TNT Zombies telegraph their throws, spiders web only once, crossbow zombies are slow to reload…
But danger never comes alone — when mobs start teaming up in unexpected ways, that’s when your real survival skills are tested.

🎮 Who’s this for?

· Veteran players bored with vanilla mob behavior but who still love the core game
· Survivalists who want higher challenge without installing content‑heavy mods
· Server squads looking for smarter threats to tackle together

📖 For all detailed changes and the three debug commands, check the changelog inside the mod.

More AI refinements and mob combos are in the works — like the Elytra Spear Zombie currently on the drawing board. Stay tuned!

---

Vanilla Mob Remake — Original Mobs, New Soul.
The challenge is live. Ready to face the night again?

(Follow updates for more madness. Notch bless you.)

You complained that the game was too easy. You optimized the fun out of survival. Now, **That's Unfair!** is here to optimize the suffering back in.

This mod doesn't just add tougher monsters. It is a comprehensive assault on your game knowledge, your muscle memory, and your sense of security. While the mod is constantly evolving (check the **Changelog** for the newest additions), expect to face:
*   **Environmental Treachery:** Acid rain, unstable ground that vanishes beneath you, and torches that burn out.
*   **Psychological Warfare:** Hallucinations, paranoia, and clumsiness that forces you to drop items.
*   **Physical Burdens:** Inventory weight limits that crush you with slowness.

title: StarMCLib
description: A library that contains utilities for Minecraft made by StarDevLLC.
body:
# Warning
**Do not use this plugin with StarCore. They are mutually exclusive and StarCore already provides StarMCLib**

This is a plugin meant solely for preventing to have to depend on StarCore and the heavier things that it provides.

## Requirements
Java 21

## Features
- **Actors**: This is a feature that allows for more of a generic way of referencing things like players, console and plugins. They can be expanded upon if desired. The Actors class is the entry-point to using this
- **CmdFlags**: This allows for an easy way to parse flags that are denoted with a "-" character. This supports both presence flags, where they are effectively booleans. Or a more complex type that can have a valid proved after it. See below the Features Section for more information
- **Mojang Profiles**: This provides a way to get player profile information from the Mojang API including skin information
- **Enum Names**: These are classes that format names of enums like EntityType, Material and PotionEffectType to be more human friendly. Child classes can be created to add custom names for consistency. The default instance does not allow changing these
- **Plugin**: This provides several things. An ExtendedJavaPlugin that interfaces with more of the utilities from StarLib and a PluginEventBus type that does similar things.
- **Cuboid**: A simple class that defines a cuboid shape.
- **Position**: A position that is not linked to a world. Provides methods to convert to and from Locations
- **StarColorsV2**: This is a class that uses the Adventure Text API
- **StarThread**: This is a thread class that extends from BukkitRunnable and provides timing and performance tracking and metrics

## CmdFlags
These are best used in conjunction with commands. You define each flag by creating new instances of the Flag Types (ComplexFlag or PresenceFlag) or you can create your own class that either implements the Flag interface, or extends the AbstractFlag class. Then you instantiate the CmdFlags class providing the flags that you defined. Then when a command is run, you call the CmdFlags#parse(String[]) method passing in the arguments from the command. This returns a FlagResult which consists of the modified args that remove the flags and a Map of FlagValues to their Flag. It is recommended that you reassign the args variable. The FlagResult allows you to chain results together using the addFrom(FlagResult) method and has two helper methods to deal with the flags directly. An isPresent method to return if the flag is present. And a getValue method that returns the value of the flag

## Command
The base command is /starmclib with the base permission node:
starmclib.command

### /starmclib actors <args>
- Permission: starmclib.command.actors

### /starmclib actors list [page]
- Permission: starmclib.command.actors.list
- Description: Lists all actors that have been created. This is only applies when any of the static creation methods in Actors is called for one. so not all online players or plugins will have an instance of an Actor

### /starmclib actors sendmessage <message>
- Permission: starmclib.command.actors.sendmessage
- Aliases: sendmsg and sm
- Description: Allows you to send a message to an actor of your choosing. This does support colors.
- **⚠️ Warning: Only give those that you trust this permission. This is a powerful command as you can pretty much fake any message if you know the formatting. This is mainly used as a debug command to test message formatting. You could probably use it as a troll feature, but be careful with it**

### /starmclib profiles <args>
- Permission: starmclib.command.profiles

### /starmclib profiles list [page]
- Permission: starmclib.command.profiles.list
- Description: Lists all profiles that have been fetched from the MojangAPI since the server started.

## Provided Libraries
- [StarLib](https://github.com/StarDevelopmentLLC/StarLib) v0.22.0
- [SMCVersion](https://github.com/StarDevelopmentLLC/SMCVersion) v0.1.1
- [SMaterial](https://github.com/StarDevelopmentLLC/SMaterial) v0.1.0
- [config](https://github.com/StarDevelopmentLLC/config) v0.2.1
- [Gson](https://github.com/google/gson) v2.13.1 (Relocated to com.stardevllc.gson)
- [Kyori Adventure API](https://github.com/KyoriPowered/adventure) v4.25.0 (Relocated to com.stardevllc.kyori.adventure
- [Kyori MiniMessage](https://github.com/KyoriPowered/adventure) v4.25.0 (Relocated to com.stardevllc.kyori.adventure.text.minimessage)

---

*This plugin is provided free of charge and under the MIT Open Source License. I will never sell this library anywhere. If you see it being sold, it is not by me and please report any of these cases to me directly.*

title: WSC World Save Chunks
description: Record and restore chunks instantly — build, destroy, reset at will.
body:
# World Save Chunks  
**Version 1.0 Beta Update**

**World Save Chunks (WSC)** is a Forge 1.16.5 mod that introduces a GTA‑style world reset mechanic. When enabled, the mod records the original state of chunks as they load. Any changes you make—breaking blocks, building structures, or experimenting—are temporary. Once the chunk unloads or you disable WSC, the world restores itself to the saved snapshot, just like revisiting a street in GTA and finding everything reset.

---

## ✨ Features

1. **Chunk Recording**  
   - Use `/wsc on` to start recording.  
   - Snapshots are taken automatically when chunks load.  

2. **Restoration System**  
   - Chunks are restored when they unload or are rewatched.  
   - Ideal for testing builds or destructive experiments.

3. **Manual Commands**  
   - `/wsc off` restores all recorded chunks and disables recording.  
   - `/wsc off nsc` disables recording but keeps changes.

4. **TileEntity Support**  
   - Snapshots include block entities like chests and furnaces.  
   - Inventories and NBT data are fully restored.

5. **Performance Optimizations**  
   - Only changed chunks are restored.  
   - Multi-dimension support: Overworld, Nether, End.

6. **Forge Compatibility**  
   - Works with Forge 36.2.42 on Minecraft 1.16.5.  
   - Commands and events are registered automatically.

---

## 🛠️ Commands

- `/wsc on` → Start recording chunks  
- `/wsc off` → Restore all recorded chunks and stop recording  
- `/wsc off nsc` → Stop recording but no keep changes  (No Save Changes)
  
  ---

## 🧠 What Makes WSC Unique

- **Snapshot-based restoration** — WSC records the exact block and TileEntity states when chunks load.
- **Automatic rollback** — Chunks revert when unloaded or rewatched, without needing manual commands.
- **Dimension-aware** — Prevents cross-world restoration bugs.
- **No seed dependency** — WSC doesn’t rely on terrain generation; it restores what was actually there.

body:
# Hellfire
**_Hellfire is currently a work in progress!_**

Welcome to Hellfire! A heavily crafted modpack designed to make Minecraft just a slighly bit harder. This modpack introduces a tweaked progression system, as well as new advancements, buffed mobs, and more!

Keep in mind, the modpack is not currently finished. This means a lot of things may be unbalanced, too unfair, or too unforgiving. While I have playtested it myself, and deemed it to be currently playable, I have not tested everything.

## Q&A
### What Features are in the Modpack?
I have coded my own Datapack to tweak everything even further. This introduces things like Acid Rain, Achievements, tweaked progression in your world, removal of items and mobs, as well as buffed mobs and bosses.

There is also no **Natural Health Regeneration**, and crop growth has been slowed heavily.

I would not say everything is finished at the moment, and some of my buffs may be a little too unforgiving.

### What Mods are in the Modpack?
I'll list a few. I don't want to ruin the surprise, after all.

- No Tree Punching
- Tough As Nails
- Body Health System
- Limited Lives
- Improved Mobs
- Enhanced Celestials

### What have you not tested yet?
I have not currently tested Enchaned Celestials fully. I only added it because I believe it adds Blood Moons, but I have yet to see it occur in my playtesting. I do not know if it is balanced or fair enough for the changes I already made using my datapack.

### Why is it called Hellfire?
I just thought it sounded cool, no real reason. It was meant to be temporary, but I really don't want to go back in to my Datapack and change the name for everything.

### Do you have any future plans?
Yes! If the modpack gets decently popular (messured by how many people are in our Discord), and if I can collect enough Donations (if I even set those up, I may just end up doing this for free), I will host a Anarchy Hellfire Minecraft Server!

### Can I give suggestions?
Yes! You can join the Discord Server [here](https://discord.gg/jb6gNntBqP).

title: Creeper Extended
description: Extends upon creeper functionality, making them more fun to interact with. Also adds several effects and items.
body:
# Creeper Extended  

**Creeper Extended** takes Minecraft’s already-chaotic creepers and cranks the dial up past eleven. Expect flashbangs, stun potions, custom effects, music discs, and creepers that beep and spin like they’re auditioning for an action movie. This is an early version of the mod — features are still being added, and feedback is welcome on GitHub.

## Features  

- **Flashbangs**  
  Craftable throwable items that blind and disorient both mobs and players.  
  - Recipe:
  
  ![Flashbang recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef233e2023855e1290bf31453f59696f33196c72_0.webp)
    ```
    i i  
    i F  
    i C  
    ```  
    *(i = iron ingot, F = firework rocket, C = coal)*  
  - Configurable radius, fade timing, color, and sound.  
  - Optional: creepers can also flashbang when they blow up, because why not.  

- **New Status Effects**  
  - Flashbang effect — exactly what it says on the tin.  
  - Stun effect — brewable with water + flashbang. Comes with potion support for creative combat tricks.  

- **Music Disc: “Sember”**  
  Adds a new disc with the track *Sember*.  
  - Vocals by [ProjectSNT](https://x.com/ProjectSNT) | [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/user/ProjectSNT)  
  - Audio mixing by [AutisticYui](https://x.com/Nickireda) | [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEjfzVX2kk5Azd7_TCWs0Og)  

- **Creeper Rework**  
  Creepers don’t just hiss and pop anymore:  
  - They spin like a top and beep like a countdown timer.  
  - Beeping gets faster until detonation.  
  - Every part of this behavior can be tweaked in the config.

  <iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/LGjUWOb2kAY" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Configuration  

Creeper Extended has a few configuration options, some of which are server-enforced options, so you can keep things fair in multiplayer.  

- Explosion delay (1–10 seconds).  
- Spin animation and particle toggle.  
- Flashbang visuals (color, fade timing) and volume.  
- Beep frequency and escalation.

title: Vanilla AFK
description: A simple and lightweight AFK plugin with custom overhead messages and sandclock animation for Paper servers.
body:
# VanillaAFK Plugin

A simple and lightweight AFK plugin with custom overhead messages for Paper servers.

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the `VanillaAFK.jar` file
2. Place it in your server's `plugins/` folder
3. Restart the server

## 🎮 Usage

### Basic Commands:
- `/afk` - toggle AFK mode
- `/afk [text]` - enter AFK with custom text
- `/afk reload` - reload configuration

### Examples:
- `/afk` - AFK with default text
- `/afk Gone for lunch` - AFK with custom text
- `/afk &cBe back soon` - AFK with colored text

## ⚙️ Configuration
All settings are located in `plugins/VanillaAFK/config.yml`:

### Messages:
```yaml
messages:
  afk-enabled: "&aYou entered AFK mode with text '&f<text>&a'"
  afk-disabled: "&aYou exited AFK mode"
  default-afk-text: "&7AFK"
```

## 🎨 Text Formatting
Supports standard Minecraft color codes:

### Colors:
&0 - Black

&1 - Dark Blue

&2 - Dark Green

&3 - Dark Aqua

&4 - Dark Red

&5 - Purple

&6 - Gold

&7 - Gray

&8 - Dark Gray

&9 - Blue

&a - Green

&b - Aqua

&c - Red

&d - Pink

&e - Yellow

&f - White

### Formatting:
&k - Obfuscated

&l - Bold

&m - Strikethrough

&n - Underlined

&o - Italic

&r - Reset

## 🔐 Permissions
vanillaafk.customtext - use custom AFK text

vanillaafk.reload - reload plugin configuration

## 📋 Features
Custom overhead messages with color formatting

Animated sandclock emoji (configurable)

Movement detection to exit AFK mode

Support for both Bukkit colors and HEX colors

Easy configuration reload

Lightweight and optimized

## 🐛 Support
If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please create an issue on GitHub.

title: Mutagenic Menagerie
description: A datapack that adds a wide variety of Cow, Pig, and Chicken variants.
body:
![Mutagenic Menagerie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b04041eae8a16c124c8d6c6f077bbe2111656740.png)

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/8WblluxhWW8" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

This datapack adds several unique variants of Cows, Chickens, and Pigs. These new variants can be unlocked by breeding animals using special **Mutagenic Foods**, then crossbred to unlock even more variants.

# Overview
There are three main categories of variants added in this datapack: **Chromatic**, **Luminous**, and **Mythical**. Each category has 16+ mob variants, as well as a set of custom foods (Seeds, Carrots, and Wheat) required to breed mobs of those variants.  

In general, breeding any two mobs with on tier of food will result in a child of that tier. Breeding mobs with ordinary wheat, seeds, or carrots will result in a child with the same variant as one of the parents.  

Unlocking new variants does more than give you a fun looking variant - each new variant also has new mechanics. Chickens lay unique new eggs, Cows give new types of milk, and Pigs gain a variety of buffs when ridden in different environments.  

# Mutagenic Crops
There are three tiers of **Mutagenic Crops** which are required to breed the new variants. These foods can be found by growing and harvesting the previous tier of crop in a specific location.  

If you want to make the process of finding these biomes less tedious, check out my [Biome Scanner](https://modrinth.com/datapack/biome-scanner) datapack!

## Chromatic Crops
Normal wheat and carrots harvested in a _Flower Forest_ have a chance to drop **Chromatic** seeds and carrots. Once found, these crops can be planted and grown in any biome. They grow like normal crops, and can be fed to mobs to unlock **Chromatic** variants!

## Luminous Crops
Harvesting **Chromatic** wheat and carrots in the _Deep Dark_ has a chance to drop **Luminous** seeds and carrots. These crops glow in the dark, and once found can be planted and grown in any biome. Feeding mobs these crops will result in a **Luminous** child!

## Mythical Crops
When you reach the _End_, growing and harvesting **Chromatic** wheat and carrots has a chance to drop **Mythical** seeds and carrots. Once found, these crops can be grown in any biome.

# Breeding
When you breed mobs using any of the **Mutagenic Crops**, the result will be one of the 50+ new variants, depending on a number of factors. Each variant has a tier (Chromatic, Luminous, or Mythical) and a base color (One of the 16 dye colors).

If either parent is fed a non-mutagenic crop, the variant of the child will be randomly chosen from one of the parents. Otherwise, the following process is used to determine the child's variant:

1. The tier of the child is determined based on the lowest tier food used to feed a parent.  
2. If both parents are a vanilla variant, the base color of will be Red, Yellow, or Blue.  
3. If one of the parents is a vanilla variant, the base color will be Red, Yellow, Blue, or the base color of the Mutagenic variant.  
4. If both of the parents are a Mutagenic variant:  
  a. If the child will be Chromatic, the child color will be determined from the parent colors using dye mixing rules (i.e. a Yellow and a Blue parent will have a Green child).  
  b. If the child will be Luminous, the child color will be determined from the parent colors using light mixing rules (i.e. a Red and a Green parent will have a Yellow child).
  c. Otherwise, the child color will be randomly chosen from one of the parent colors.
5. For Mythical variants, the Dimension the mob is born in may also impact their final variant.

# Variants
## Chromatic
![The Chromatic Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4761d764342f9bd459b7ddf26eb1bb66d79f76e.gif)  

The Chromatic variants are colored variants for the 16 dye colors in Minecraft.  
Chromatic pigs will travel faster on dyed blocks that match their color, and have an added bonus that they can be halted by pressing `jump` while riding them, to prevent them from running off of cliffs!
Chromatic Chickens lay colored eggs that can be used to change the color of dyeable blocks when thrown. They can also be fired from a dispenser to create redstone contraptions with color changing blocks!  
Chromatic Cows give Dyed Milk. Instead of removing all status effects, dyed milk only removes specific status effects when consumed. 

## Luminous
![The Luminous Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a73bac4bdd7ff997f41fa6d797a036057802aa00.gif)

The Luminous variants are glowing variants for the 16 dye colors in Minecraft. Luminous mobs have a permanent Glowing effect and will glow with their color. If the player has [VESE](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/vanilla-entity-shader-effects) installed, Luminous variants will have emissive textures in addition to the glowing outline.  
Luminous pigs will travel faster than their Chromatic counterparts on dyed blocks, and will give their passenger Night Vision while they are being ridden. Like Chromatic pigs, they can be halted by holding `jump`.  
Luminous Chickens lay glowing eggs that can be thrown at blocks or entities. When hitting most blocks, a glowing colored outline will appear for a couple of seconds. When hitting dyeable blocks, the outline will remain until the block is removed. When hitting entities, the entity will gain a glowing outline in the color of the egg for 15 seconds.  
Luminous Cows give Glowing Milk. Glowing milk will make a player who drinks it glow with the color of the milk for 15 seconds.  

## Mythical
There are 21 Mythical Variants, divided into a handful of subtypes.

### Ore Variants
![The Ore Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/61a26d081b9dbdd68ba334103b325071d2541de2.gif)  
There are 7 Ore Variants: Coal, Copper, Iron, Gold, Redstone, Emerald, and Diamond.  
Ore pigs travel faster on stone. Like other pigs, they can be halted by tapping `jump`. They can also mine the two blocks in front of them if their passenger taps `sprint`. When mining an ore that matches their variant, the drops are calculated as though they were mined with Fortune.  
Ore chickens will lay a mix of stone eggs, which can be thrown at entities to hurt them, and ore eggs, typically a retextured raw version of a resource.  
Ore cows give mineral enriched milk. Drinking mineral enriched milk will cause all nearby ores of that type to glow through walls, making mining more efficient.

### Dessert Variants
![The Dessert Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/379ba1fd55d81678038379ae896c2cddd9fbb1a3.gif)  
There are 3 Dessert Variants: Chocolate, Vanilla, and Berry.  
Dessert pigs will harvest and replant crops when walking over them.  
Dessert chickens lay cake eggs, which are a good source of food.  
Dessert cows give ice cream, which completely restores hunger but also gives the player slowness.  

### Nether Variants
![The Nether Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34ab6dc6821abe7bdf3b2b912f66c8335ae5a001.gif)  
There are 3 Nether Variants: Crimson, Warped, and Crying.  
All Nether variants are fireproof.    
**Crimson**  
Crimson pigs travel faster on common Nether blocks, crimson wood blocks, and crimson nylium.  Crimson chickens lay crimson eggs, which will cause the level of status effects on targets to increase, while causing the remaining duration to decrease. Crimson cows give crimson milk, which does the same thing to status effects on the player that drinks it.  
**Warped**  
Warped pigs travel faster on common Nether blocks, warped wood blocks, and warped nylium.  
Warped chickens lay warped eggs, which will cause status effects on targets they hit to be inverted. Warped cows give warped milk, which inverts status effects on the player that drinks it.  
**Crying**  
Crying pigs can teleport between the Nether and the Overworld when their passenger taps `sprint`.  
Crying chickens lay a mix of obsidian eggs, which can be thrown at entities to hurt them, and crying eggs, which will teleport entities they hit between the Nether and the Overworld.  
Crying cows give crying milk, which teleports the player that drinks it between the Nether and the Overworld.

### Elemental Variants
![The Elemental Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8f4a6c20afb9cfe130316e678694f7ea89268ea.gif)  
There are 8 Elemental Variants: Water/Ice/Steam, Earth/Sand/Gravel, Fire, and Void.

**Water**  
Water pigs move very fast in water and don't sink.  
Water chickens lay water eggs, which function as splash water bottles with the range of a thrown egg.  
Water cows give buckets of water.  

**Ice**  
All Ice mobs are immune to powdered snow.  
Ice pigs move fast on snow and ice.  
Ice chickens lay egg-shaped snowballs.  
Ice cows give buckets of powdered snow.  

**Steam**  
Steam pigs can levitate by holding `space` while riding them.  
Steam chickens lay egg-shaped wind charges.  
Steam cows give buckets of steam, which when placed creates a cloud of levitation.  

**Earth**
Earth pigs move faster on dirt and grass blocks.  
Earth chickens lay dirt eggs, which can be thrown at entities to hurt them.  
Earth cows give buckets of dirt, which can be used to place a dirt block without triggering block updates.  

**Sand**  
Sand pigs move faster on sand and sandstone.  
Sand chickens lay sand eggs, which can be thrown at entities to hurt them and summon a large cloud of particles. Pocket Sand!  
Sand cows give buckets of sand, which can be used to place sand without triggering block updates.  

**Gravel**  
Gravel pigs move faster on gravel.  
Gravel chickens lay gravel eggs, which can be thrown at entities to hurt them and summon a large cloud of particles.
Sand cows give buckets of gravel, which can be used to place sand without triggering block updates.  

**Fire**  
All Fire mobs are immune to fire damage.  
Fire pigs swim on the surface of lava and give their passengers fire resistance.  
Fire chickens lay flaming eggs, which light entities they hit on fire.  
Fire coes give buckets of lava.  

**Void**
All Void mobs are immune to falling into the void, but take damage and teleport randomly when they touch water.  
Void pigs can teleport in the direction their passenger is looking when they tap `sprint`.  
Void chickens lay void eggs, which teleport entities they hit to the location the egg was thrown from.  
Void cows give buckets of air, which can be used to place air without triggering block updates.

title: MC Looper
description: Tasker-like automation framework for Minecraft
body:
# MC Looper

**MC Looper** is a Fabric automation mod for Minecraft 1.20.4 that brings Tasker-style scripting into the game.  
Build loops made of actions and conditions that run when triggers fire.

---

## Features
- **Loop automation** — workflows built from blocks, run top to bottom.  
- **Chat parsing** — detect messages with regex and extract values.  
- **GUI clicking** — automatically interact with GUI items by ID or name.  
- **HTTP requests** — send POST data to external servers or webhooks.  
- **Variables** — store, modify, and reuse captured values.  
- **Configuration** — in-game UI (Right Shift) and JSON support.  

---

## Technical
- **Minecraft:** 1.20.4  
- **Fabric Loader:** 0.15.7+  
- **Fabric API:** 0.91.2+1.20.4  
- **Java:** 21+  

---

## Setup
1. Install Fabric Loader and Fabric API.  
2. Download the JAR from the Files section.  
3. Place it in your `mods` folder.  
4. Launch Minecraft and press **Right Shift** to configure Looper.  

---

## Hotfix
**v1.0.1 changes:**  
- Guarded clipboard access for restricted environments.  
- Fallback export to Fabric config directory when clipboard unavailable.  
- Exported file paths are now clickable in chat.  
- Improved error messages and logging.  

---

## Notes
- Regex is powerful but may be confusing at first — examples are included.  
- Check your server’s rules before using automation.  
- Feedback and feature requests are welcome on GitHub.

title: Buro
description: A simple, client-side visual mod that plunges your world into an endless, atmospheric night.
body:
# Buro

*A client-side mod for a world of atmospheric darkness.*

---

### Overview

**Buro** is a lightweight, client-side utility mod that gives you control over the world's atmosphere, allowing you to create a perpetual, moody darkness. If you've ever wanted a spooky setting for an adventure map or the perfect backdrop for cinematic shots, this mod is for you.

---

### Features

The mod combines two key visual effects to create its unique atmosphere, which can be enabled or disabled with a single click in the config menu:

*   **Pitch Black Fog:** Replaces the default distance fog with a solid, oppressive black void. What lurks in the darkness is for you to find out.
*   **Void Sky:** The sky is rendered as a pure black canvas. The sun, moon, and stars are completely hidden, creating a sense of timeless, endless night.

---

### Configuration

*   You must have **Mod Menu** and **Cloth Config API** installed.
*   Navigate to the Mods list from the main menu or pause screen.
*   Find **Buro** and click the config button (the gear icon).
*   Toggle the "Enable Mod" switch to turn the effects on or off instantly. *(A world reload may be required for all changes to apply correctly).*

This datapack makes it rain much more often than in vanilla Minecraft, creating a wetter, moodier, and cozier atmosphere. Perfect for building, survival, or roleplay worlds where rain is part of the immersion.

✨ Features

✔️ Rain happens more frequently than vanilla
✔️ Lightweight — no mods required
✔️ Works in singleplayer & multiplayer
✔️ Fully vanilla-friendly

📥 Installation

Download the .zip file.

Place it into your world’s datapacks folder:

.minecraft/saves/<your_world>/datapacks/


Open your world and run:

/reload
/function more_rain:setup


That’s it — the world will now have more frequent rain! 🌧️

⚙️ How It Works

Every ~10 seconds, the datapack checks the weather.

With a 33% chance, it forces a short rain.

Result: rain comes around much more often than normal.

(You can tweak the rain duration or chance by editing check_weather.mcfunction if you want even stormier worlds.)

✅ Compatibility

Minecraft 1.21+

Works in 1.20.6 if you change pack_format in pack.mcmeta to 15

Works on both singleplayer and servers

Safe to add/remove anytime

title: Auto Team Chat
description: This client mod allows you to use shortcuts for switching between team and global chat
body:
# Auto Team Chat

A lightweight Fabric mod that automatically redirects your chat messages to your team channel by default, while still letting you drop a message in global chat with a single character.

---

## 🎯 Overview

On team‑based servers - Factions, Bed Wars, SkyBlock co‑op, and more - mis‑sent messages can cost you victories and spoil strategies. **Auto Team Chat** solves this by:

- **Defaulting** every message to your team chat command (e.g. `/teammsg`)  
- **Reserving** a single‑character override (`!`) to send global chat  

No more typing long commands or worrying if you slipped into the wrong channel!

---

## ✨ Features

- **Automatic Team Chat**  
  Every chat you type (e.g. `Hello team!`) is sent to `/teammsg Hello team!` by default.

- **Global Chat Override**  
  Start your message with `!` (e.g. `!Hello everyone!`) to send it as a normal global chat message; the `!` is stripped automatically.

- **Client‑Side Only**  
  No server plugin required - install on the client and go.

- **Lightweight & Fast**  
  Written in pure Fabric, minimal impact on performance.

- **Broad Compatibility**  
  Works on Minecraft **1.16.5 → 1.21.x** with Fabric Loader & Fabric API.

---

## 🚀 Why You'll Love It

- **Zero Mistakes**  
  Avoid accidentally broadcasting private team tactics to the whole server.

- **One‑Key Global Chat**  
  No need to reach for `/msg`, `/say`, or chat toggles - just `!`.

- **Focus on Gameplay**  
  Spend less time typing and more time building, fighting, or looting.

---

## 📥 Installation

1. **Install Fabric Loader** (any recent version) and **Fabric API**.  
2. Download `AutoTeamChat‑<version>.jar` from the [Modrinth page](https://modrinth.com/project/auto-team-chat).  
3. Move the JAR into your `mods/` folder.  
4. Launch Minecraft on the Fabric profile.

title: View Jar Signing
description: View jar signing info in NeoForge's mod list
body:
## View Jar Signing

This mod enables the ability to view JAR signing info in NeoForge built-in mod list screen.

It is highly recommended that you have some understanding of JAR signing related details,
and **its caveats in a modding environment**.

If you have doubts about a particular signed mod, please verify it
using [jarsigner](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/specs/man/jarsigner.html#synopsis) beforehand.
This mod only exposes the result produced by NeoForge and does not perform any JAR verification.

## How to read its output

_Only signed mod will have signing information displayed._

Status: self-explanatory [[_see note_]](#note)

Leaf signer fingerprint: SHA256 fingerprint for the first signer's leaf certificate.

Signer(s) Format: `<CodeSignerN>.<CertificateN> [Type]: <Signer Info> (CertAlg)`

- `CodeSigner` - [Signer that present in the manifest.](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/security/CodeSigner.html)
- `Certificate` - Certificate in signer's certificate path.
- `Type`: `CA`- Certificate Authority `Self`- Self-signed.
- `Signer Info`: [distinguished name information.](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/javax/security/auth/x500/X500Principal.html#getName(java.lang.String,java.util.Map))
- `CertAlg` - algorithm name that used to create the certificate.

`*` will prefixed for each leaf signer's certificate, except for JAR that has only one signer certificate.

By default, only leaf certificate will be shown. Configuration is provided to enable listing of all certificate chain.

## Note

This mod mixin and uses some internal NeoForge and SecureJarHandler APIs to obtain, display the signers' certificate
details. Therefore, stability of this mod is not guaranteed.

- It only verifies `.class` files, other files is ignored.
- Mod can be **modified in runtime and still be valid**, since verification take place in actual JAR file.
- Minecraft will always show `Invalid` status since its installation occurred during install-time.

<details>
<summary>Background</summary>

The display is mostly based on
[NeoForge's ModListScreen](https://github.com/neoforged/NeoForge/blob/1.21.1/src/main/java/net/neoforged/neoforge/client/gui/ModListScreen.java#L428-L436).

---

It is first introduced in 1.16 but disabled in mod list screen due to it not perform actual checks,
shortly after implemented. https://github.com/MinecraftForge/MinecraftForge/issues/7500

In 1.17 onwards, verification of .class is performed.
https://github.com/neoforged/NeoForge/blob/1.17.x/fmlloader/src/main/java/net/minecraftforge/fml/loading/moddiscovery/AbstractJarFileLocator.java#L57

In 1.21, it remains unchanged, although it has moved to a different package.
https://github.com/neoforged/FancyModLoader/blob/1.21.1/loader/src/main/java/net/neoforged/fml/loading/moddiscovery/ModFile.java#L152-L153

</details>

title: FancyChairs
description: A simple Spigot plugin that adds the ability to sit on and add carpet to stairs and slabs
body:
# FancyChairs

FancyChairs is a plugin that adds the ability to make chairs and to sit on them.

A chair is a staircase or a slab that has a carpet on it.

Right click a carpet on a slab or a stair to place the carpet on it.

This plugin can be configured to disable the carpets, or to allow players to sit on staircases and slabs without carpets. And it can also be configured to require both hands to be empty to sit on a staircase or slab.

To remove all fancy chairs (the armorstands that hold the carpet): 
- `/kill @e[tag=FancyChair]`

To remove all seats (the armorstand that the player actually rides, one of these is created whenever a player sits on a block, and it gets reused if that block has been sat on):
- `/kill @e[tag=TempChair]`

# echoes
*A sanity-based horror mod for Minecraft 1.21.5 using NeoForge*

---

## What is echoes?

**echoes** is a psychological horror mod that introduces a sanity mechanic into Minecraft. As your sanity decreases, your perception of the world begins to shift.

> If your sanity drops too low, *it* appears.  
> It whispers to itself, and just... watches.

---

## Features

- **Sanity System**  
  Your sanity is affected by light levels and specific events.

- **Audio Cues**  
  Distorted whispers and chilling sounds follow you as your mind breaks.

- **Low Sanity Event**
  Special event that only occurs when sanity is low.

---

## Installation

1. Install [NeoForge](https://neoforged.net/) for Minecraft **1.21.5**
2. Drop the latest `echoes-<version>.jar` into your `mods` folder
3. Launch the game and descend into madness.

---

echoes is best played alone, in the dark, with headphones.

Every mob turns into Withers. Except for Endermen, Blazes, and the Dragon. The goal is to beat the game.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/x9gLFgzYxnw" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

title: Quill
description: A feature-filled library to streamline Minecraft plugin development.
body:
# Quill
[![](https://jitpack.io/v/xLevitate/Quill.svg)](https://jitpack.io/#xLevitate/Quill)

Quill is a comprehensive utility library for Paper plugins, providing a wide range of tools and systems to simplify plugin development. It offers everything from configuration management to advanced item creation, all with a clean and intuitive API.

## Features

- 🔧 **Configuration System** - Annotation-based configuration with automatic updating
- 💬 **Chat System** - Advanced message handling with MiniMessage support
- 💾 **JSON Storage** - Flexible and type-safe data storage system
- 📦 **Item Management** - Powerful item creation and manipulation
- 📋 **Scoreboard System** - Simple yet flexible scoreboard creation
- 🎮 **Events System** - Streamlined event handling with filtering
- 🛠️ **Utility Classes** - Comprehensive collection of utility methods
- 🔌 **Plugin Hooks** - Built-in integration with PlaceholderAPI and Vault

## Installation

### 1. Server Installation
First, download and install the Quill plugin on your server:
1. Download the latest version from [Releases](https://github.com/xLevitate/Quill/releases)
2. Place the JAR file in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server

### 2. Development Integration

#### Gradle (Kotlin DSL)
```kotlin
repositories {
    maven("https://jitpack.io")
}

dependencies {
    compileOnly("com.github.xLevitate:Quill:2.6.0")
}
```

#### Gradle (Groovy)
```groovy
repositories {
    maven { url 'https://jitpack.io' }
}

dependencies {
    compileOnly 'com.github.xLevitate:Quill:2.6.0'
}
```

#### Maven
```xml
<repositories>
    <repository>
        <id>jitpack.io</id>
        <url>https://jitpack.io</url>
    </repository>
</repositories>

<dependencies>
    <dependency>
        <groupId>com.github.xLevitate</groupId>
        <artifactId>Quill</artifactId>
        <version>2.6.0</version>
        <scope>provided</scope>
    </dependency>
</dependencies>
```

## Quick Start

### Chat System
```java
// Send formatted message
Chat.sendMessage(player, "<gradient:green:blue>Welcome to the server!</gradient>");

// Send title
Chat.sendTitle(player, "<gold>Welcome!", "<gray>Enjoy your stay");
```

### Configuration
```java
@Configuration("config.yml")
public class MyConfig {
    @Comment("Enable or disable the plugin")
    private boolean enabled = true;

    @Comment("Custom message")
    private String message = "<green>Hello!</green>";
}
```

### Item Creation
```java
ItemStack item = new ItemWrapper()
    .plugin(plugin)
    .material(Material.DIAMOND_SWORD)
    .name("<gradient:blue:purple>Mystic Blade</gradient>")
    .lore(Arrays.asList(
        "<gray>A legendary weapon",
        "<blue>Damage: +50</blue>"
    ))
    .build();
```

### Event Handling
```java
Events.listen(plugin, PlayerJoinEvent.class)
    .filter(event -> !event.getPlayer().hasPlayedBefore())
    .handle(event -> {
        Player player = event.getPlayer();
        Chat.sendMessage(player, "<green>Welcome to the server!");
    });
```

## Documentation

For detailed documentation, please visit our [Wiki](https://github.com/xLevitate/Quill/wiki).

## Requirements

- Java 17 or higher
- Paper 1.20.4 or higher
- (Optional) PlaceholderAPI for placeholder support
- (Optional) Vault for economy support

## Support

If you encounter any issues or have questions:
1. Check the [Wiki](https://github.com/xLevitate/Quill/wiki)
2. Open an [Issue](https://github.com/xLevitate/Quill/issues)

body:
# SkyePerms v0.7.1
## The Minecraft Tag-Based Datapack Permission Manager by NobleSkye
![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/SkyePerms?style=for-the-badge&logoSize=12&label=Modrinth) ![GitHub Downloads (all assets, all releases)](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/NobleSkye/SkyePerms/total?style=for-the-badge&label=Github)

# 1.20.6+ Version Coming Soon!

### Overview
SkyePerms is a Minecraft datapack designed to manage permissions using tags. It allows players to easily switch gamemodes, manage permissions, and execute functions. This is mainly designed for ```play.legitimoose.com``` which is a datapack creation network to share datapacks. 

### Installation
1. Download the `SkyePerms-v[version].zip` file from the [releases page](https://github.com/NobleSkye/SkyePerms/releases).
2. Extract the contents of the zip file.
3. Place the extracted folder in the `datapacks` directory of your Minecraft world. \
```/.minecraft/saves/world/datapacks/EXTRACT HERE```
3.5. Make sure the datapack files looks like ```datapacks/skyeperms/assets``` and other files. 
4. Play the world

### Usage
- Use `/tag [target] add [tag]` to add tags to players.
- Use the provided functions to kick or smite players.
- Utilize triggers to switch gamemodes if permitted.

### Tags
- `gmc`, `gmsp`, `gma`, `gms`: Allows players to switch gamemodes.
- `is_trusted`: Combination of all gamemode tags.
- `force.[gamemode tag]`: Forces the specified gamemode.
- `is_banned`: Bans the player.
- `whitelisted`: Adds player to the whitelist

### Functions
- `/function skye:kick {"player":"username"}`: Kicks the specified player.
- `/function skye:smite {"player":"username"}`: Smites the specified player with lightning.
- `/function skye:whitelist/enable`: enables whitelist
- `/function skye:whitelist/disable`: disables whitelist
- `/trigger [gamemode]`: Switches to the specified gamemode if permitted.

### Environment Variables
- `whitelist`: 0:false 1:true ; weather the whitelist is working

### Feedback and Contributions
Feedback and contributions are welcome! Feel free to open issues or submit pull requests on the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/NobleSkye/SkyePerms). 

### Credits
- [@NobleSkye](https://github.com/NobleSkye), creator of SkyePerms.
- [@loglot](https://github.com/loglot) For alot of changes and ideas

title: TTY-Client
description: A terminal-themed Minecraft client for those who live in the shell.
body:
# TTYClient

**A terminal-themed Minecraft client for those who live in the shell.**

TTYClient is built around one idea: your Minecraft client should feel as scriptable and customizable as your Linux system. Type client commands starting with a `;` prefix, bind keys to chat messages, Minecraft commands, or literal bash scripts, and configure everything through plain JSONC text files - all live-reloaded, no restarts needed.

---

## Requirements

- Minecraft **26.1.2** with [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) ≥ 0.19.1
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) 0.150.0+26.1.2
- [Kotlin for Fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin) 1.13.9+kotlin.2.3.10

## Installation

Drop `ttyclient-*.jar` alongside Fabric API and Kotlin for Fabric into your `mods/` folder. On first launch, TTYClient creates its config directory at `~/TTYClient/`.

---

## Usage

Type `;` followed by a command in chat. Commands are intercepted client-side and **never sent to the server**.

Available commands:
```
;help (alias: ?)                         list all commands
;mcfetch                                 neofetch-style game info
;info [--name|-n] [--version|-v] ...     show TTYClient information
;config                                  open the in-game config editor
;hud (alias: hudeditor)                  open the HUD editor
;module --trigger <module>               trigger a module
;module --toggle <module>                enable or disable a module
;screenshot <copy|upload> <path>         copy/upload screenshot
;debug --toggle <keys>                   toggle key visualizer
;debug --trigger spam <n>                send n test messages
```

The command prefix (default `;`) can be changed in `~/TTYClient/config/general.jsonc`.

---

## Keybinds

Keybinds live in `~/TTYClient/config/keybinds.jsonc` and support multiple execution types:

```jsonc
{ "bind": "ALT+C",    "type": "client",  "exec": "config" },
{ "bind": "C",        "type": "client",  "exec": "module --trigger zoom" },
{ "bind": "CTRL+F1",  "type": "command", "exec": "gamemode creative" },
{ "bind": "F9",       "type": "bash",    "exec": "notify-send 'test notify'" },
{ "bind": "DELETE",   "type": "action",  "exec": "Disconnect" }
```

Types: `client`, `command`, `chat`, `bash`, `sequence`, `action`, `noop`

**Actions:** `QuitGame`, `Disconnect`, `ShowMultiplayer`

---

## Modules

| Module | Default bind | Description                                     |
|---|-----|-------------------------------------------------|
| **Zoom** | `C` | Smooth animated FOV zoom, scrollable, hold or toggle |
| **Freelook** | `X` | Detach camera from look direction in third-person |
| **Fullbright** | `B` | Remove darkness via gamma boost or Night Vision |
| **Custom Crosshair** | -   | 15x15 pixel grid crosshair, fully configurable in JSONC, inverted colors support |
| **Custom Chat** | `I` | Resizable chat window, drag to resize, unlimited history, toggleable chat |
| **AutoReconnect** | -   | Auto-reconnect with countdown after disconnect  |
| **RenderUtils** | -   | Custom shield/totem model transforms, low fire overlay |
| **Screenshots** | -   | F2 screenshot with copy/open/upload actions in chat, resolution scaling up to 8k |
| **Utils** | -   | Durability warning: flashing action-bar alert + pling sound |
| **Notifications** | -   | Toast-style notifications in screen corners with animations and sounds |
| **Performance** | -   | HUD throttle for improved FPS during gameplay |

All module configs are in `~/TTYClient/config/modules/`, with live-reload on save.

---

## Editors

### Config Editor
Press `ALT+C` or run `;config` to open the built-in in-game config editor - JSONC syntax highlighting, inline hex color swatches, undo/redo, and much more.

### HUD Editor
Press `ALT+H` or run `;hud` to open the HUD editor - drag to reposition the HUD elements with a visual interface.

title: Ck7 - Be My Sword
description: Let the guards protect your life
body:
Be My Sword is a Minecraft mod inspired by Guard Villagers, but expanded and redesigned to better fit a more interactive and RPG-like experience.

The mod introduces human guardians to Minecraft villages that function as recruitable personal bodyguards. Recruit them with a Golden Apple, manage their equipment and inventory, and watch them grow stronger through combat.

## Key Features

- **Leveling system** — guardians start at Level 1 (20 HP) and grow up to Level 10, with stats (health, attack, armor, speed) and inventory capacity scaling as they level up.
- **Full equipment & inventory management** — armor, main hand, offhand, and a leveled inventory of items/potions, managed through a dedicated GUI.
- **Combat AI** — guardians proactively fight nearby monsters once tamed, block hits with a shield if equipped, switch to bow or (from level 5+) thrown tridents depending on what's in their hand.
- **Potion-savvy in combat** — guardians drink Strength/Speed/Regeneration potions from their own inventory when a fight starts, eat food to heal, and throw Regeneration splash potions at wounded allies.
- **Dialogue system** — guardians talk to you, tame or not.
- **Natural village spawning**, plus a dedicated `guardian_house` structure that can generate in villages.
- **Reproduction** using Glistering Melon Slices.
- **Follower behavior** with a sit/follow toggle, and they hold still while you manage their inventory so you don't have to chase them.
- Real player skins — each guardian gets a random skin (male/female) instead of a generic reskinned mob.

## Coming Soon (Version 3 roadmap)

- **Class system** for guardians, giving each one a distinct combat/support role instead of one-size-fits-all stats.
- **Deeper dialogue system**, building on the current one with more context and personality.
- **Visual feedback improvements** — clearer in-world indicators of what a guardian is doing at any given moment (eating, drinking a potion, about to attack, following, etc.), so you don't have to guess from the animation alone.
- **Attribute balance pass** across the level 1–10 curve.

title: Player-to-Player Trade Mod
description: A server-side Fabric trading mod that lets players trade items safely through a dedicated UI.
body:
# TradeMode

TradeMode is a **server-side trading mod for Fabric** that lets players safely **exchange items through a shared 6×9** (54-slot) trade GUI.

## How it works

- Send a request: ```/trade <player>```
- The target receives clickable buttons: [Start Trade] / [Deny]![clickable buttons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f8701d7b94cfe959560962c71d966fa5feef764.png)
- A 5-second countdown opens the trade window![6×9 (54-slot) trade GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94c2f26f5bfd1a1debf0232dfeef350a4e690865.png)
- Each player places items in their own offer area
- When both players confirm, a 3-second commit countdown completes the trade
- Any item change during countdown cancels the countdown automatically

### Safety & Rules

- One active request/trade per player (prevents spam and conflicts)
- **Requests expire** after **60 seconds**
- Closing the GUI before **completion cancels** the trade and returns items
- _Shift-click_ (Quick Move) **is blocked to prevent bypass/duplication issues**
- Before committing, the mod checks if both players can fully receive items in main inventory + hotbar
→ If **not enough space**, the **trade does not complete** (no forced drops)

### Language

- ```/trade language <en|kor|jp>```to set your personal language for messages.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.1+
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/server/)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/versions) (required)
- **Server-side only (clients do not need to install the mod)**

To help us develop a more convenient and better mod, please share any bugs, issues, or feature ideas you have! -> [Bug Report](https://forms.gle/HuWC5xxnuioxgDoy8)

title: Cobblemon KubeJS
description: Cobblemon KubeJS exposes Cobblemon data and events to KubeJS scripts.
body:
# Cobblemon KubeJS Bridge

Bring Cobblemon data, events, storage queries, administrative utilities, and
client-side Pokedex displays into KubeJS.

Cobblemon KubeJS Bridge lets modpack developers build custom progression,
quests, rewards, commands, interfaces, battle systems, and server mechanics
using JavaScript.

## Features

### Cobblemon events

Listen to server-side events such as:

- Pokedex progress changes
- Pokemon scans and captures
- Pokemon sent, recalled, fainted, gained, healed, or released
- Experience gain and level-up
- Evolution completion
- Battle victory and defeat
- Battle escape and forfeit

```js
CobblemonEvents.pokemonCaptured(event => {
  event.player.tell(
    `You caught ${event.species} at level ${event.level}!`
  )
})
```

### Pokedex API

Query a player's Pokedex progress:

- Check whether a species was seen or caught
- Count total seen or caught species
- Count progress by elemental type
- Read individual species progress

```js
var caughtFire = CobblemonJS.pokedex.countCaughtByType(
  player,
  'fire'
)
```

### Species API

- Validate species IDs
- List implemented species
- Read species types
- Validate elemental types
- Find all species of a type

Both short and namespaced IDs are supported:

```js
CobblemonJS.species.exists('charizard')
CobblemonJS.species.exists('cobblemon:charizard')
```

### Party and PC API

Read safe Pokemon snapshots from a player's party and PC:

- Search Pokemon by UUID
- Count Pokemon by species or type
- Keep party, PC, box, and slot information
- Read level, HP, nature, ability, moves, IVs, EVs, status, held item, and more

```js
var party = CobblemonJS.pokemon.getParty(player)
var pokemon = CobblemonJS.pokemon.getByUuid(player, pokemonUuid)
```

### Administrative utilities

Trusted server scripts can:

- Give a Pokemon to a player
- Heal a player's party
- Spawn a Pokemon near a player
- Spawn a Pokemon at explicit coordinates without assigning an owner

```js
CobblemonJS.admin.givePokemon(
  player,
  'charizard level=50 shiny=true'
)

CobblemonJS.admin.spawnPokemon(
  player.serverLevel,
  'rayquaza level=70',
  100,
  80,
  -50
)
```

### Client-side Pokedex synchronization

The server synchronizes a read-only Pokedex cache to the owning client. Client
scripts can use it for live tooltips and other interfaces without requesting
data from the server every frame.

```js
CobblemonClientJS.pokedex.countSeen()
CobblemonClientJS.pokedex.countCaught()
CobblemonClientJS.pokedex.countCaughtByType('fire')
```

The included examples contain a tested dynamic spyglass tooltip.

## Requirements

- Cobblemon
- KubeJS
- Rhino, as required by KubeJS
- Java 21

Install the bridge on both the client and server when using the synchronized
client Pokedex API.

## Loader support

NeoForge is currently supported.

Fabric support is not available yet. The Fabric module is only a compile-time
stub and does not expose events, APIs, or client synchronization.

## Documentation and examples

The project includes:

- Complete API documentation
- Every function's parameters and return values
- Full event field reference
- Pokemon and move data model reference
- Server and client script examples
- Troubleshooting instructions

# Links

- [Documentation](https://rapidmesck.gitbook.io/cobblemon-kubejs/)
- [Source Code](https://github.com/RapidMesck/cobblemon_kubejs)
- [Issue Tracker](https://github.com/RapidMesck/cobblemon_kubejs/issues)

## Notes

- Pokemon snapshots returned to scripts are read-only.
- Administrative methods mutate gameplay state and should only be exposed
  through trusted scripts with appropriate permission checks.
- Pokedex counts represent unique implemented species, not duplicate captures.
- Unknown species, types, malformed UUIDs, and invalid spawn properties produce
  descriptive script errors.
- Replacing the mod jar or networking code requires a full restart.
