title: Even Better Whitelist
description: A professional whitelist workflow with Discord actions, dual VPN/Proxy detection, GeoIP, optional captcha, Discord account linking, and statistics. Built for production servers.
body:
# EvenBetterWhitelist - Plugin

[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-Project-green?style=flat-square&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/even-better-whitelist)
[![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.x-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://papermc.io/)
![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Integration-5865F2?style=flat-square&logo=discord)

A modern whitelist system for Minecraft Paper 1.21.x with Discord integration. When a player attempts to join and is not whitelisted, a structured request is posted to your Discord channel. Admins can accept, deny, or ban directly from Discord using buttons.

![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.x-green?style=flat-square&logo=minecraft)
![Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper-API-blue?style=flat-square)
![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Integration-5865F2?style=flat-square&logo=discord)
![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-orange?style=flat-square&logo=openjdk)


### Installation Steps

1. Place `WhitelistPluginButBetter-1.0.0.jar` in your server's `plugins/` folder
2. Start/restart your server
3. Edit `plugins/WhitelistPluginButBetter/config.yml`
4. Download [GeoLite2-City.mmdb](https://dev.maxmind.com/geoip/geolite2-free-geolocation-data) and place it in the plugin folder
5. Reload with `/wlp reload` or restart the server

## 🤖 Discord Bot Setup

### 1. Create a Discord Application

1. Go to [Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications)
2. Click "New Application" and give it a name
3. Go to "Bot" section and click "Add Bot"
4. Copy the **Bot Token** (keep this secret!)
5. Enable these **Privileged Gateway Intents**:
   - Message Content Intent

### 2. Invite the Bot

1. Go to "OAuth2" → "URL Generator"
2. Select scopes: `bot`, `applications.commands`
3. Select permissions: `Send Messages`, `Embed Links`, `Read Message History`
4. Copy the generated URL and open it to invite the bot

### 3. Get Your IDs

Enable Developer Mode in Discord (Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode)

- **Server ID**: Right-click your server → Copy Server ID
- **Channel ID**: Right-click the channel → Copy Channel ID
- **Admin User ID**: Right-click yourself → Copy User ID

### 4. (Optional) Create a Webhook

1. Right-click your channel → Edit Channel
2. Go to Integrations → Webhooks
3. Create a webhook and copy the URL

## ⚙️ Configuration

```yaml
discord:
  bot-token: "YOUR_BOT_TOKEN_HERE"
  webhook-url: "YOUR_WEBHOOK_URL_HERE"
  server-id: "YOUR_SERVER_ID_HERE"
  channel-id: "YOUR_CHANNEL_ID_HERE"
  admin-user-ids: "USER_ID_1,USER_ID_2"
  ping-admins: true

cooldowns:
  deny-cooldown: 60        # Minutes before denied player can try again
  pending-cooldown: 5      # Minutes between join attempts while pending
  ip-cooldown: 10          # Minutes before same IP can make new request

geoip:
  enabled: true
  database-path: "plugins/WhitelistPluginButBetter/GeoLite2-City.mmdb"
```

See the full [config.yml](src/main/resources/config.yml) for all options!

## 📝 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/wlp accept <player>` | Accept a pending whitelist request |
| `/wlp deny <player>` | Deny a pending whitelist request |
| `/wlp pending` | View all pending requests |
| `/wlp list [page]` | View whitelisted players |
| `/wlp add <player>` | Manually add a player to whitelist |
| `/wlp remove <player>` | Remove a player from whitelist |
| `/wlp info <player>` | View detailed player info |
| `/wlp status` | View plugin status |
| `/wlp reload` | Reload configuration |

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `whitelistplugin.admin` | Access to all commands | OP |
| `whitelistplugin.bypass` | Bypass whitelist check | OP |

## Discord Embed Preview

When a player tries to join, admins receive an embed like this:

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ New Whitelist Request                   │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Player: Steve                           │
│ UUID: 069a79f4-...                      │
│ IP: ||192.168.1.1||                     │
│ Location: New York, United States       │
│ Client: fabric                          │
│ Language: en_US                         │
│ Requested: 2024-01-15 14:30 UTC         │
│                                         │
│ Same IP as: Alex (1 other request)      │
│                                         │
│ [Accept]  [Deny]  [Ban]                 │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 🗂️ File Structure

```
plugins/WhitelistPluginButBetter/
├── config.yml              # Main configuration
├── whitelist.json          # Whitelisted players
├── pending-requests.json   # Pending requests
├── denied-players.json     # Denied players (for cooldowns)
├── requests.log            # Action log
└── GeoLite2-City.mmdb      # GeoIP database (you provide this)
```

## Troubleshooting

### Bot not responding to buttons?
- Make sure the bot token is correct
- Ensure the bot has permissions in the channel
- Check console for connection errors

### GeoIP not working?
- Download GeoLite2-City.mmdb from MaxMind
- Place it in the plugin folder
- Check the path in config.yml

### Players not being kicked?
- Make sure the plugin is loaded (`/plugins`)
- Check if player has `whitelistplugin.bypass` permission
- Look for errors in console

### Seeing Private IP (10.x.x.x, 192.168.x.x)?
This happens when using a **reverse proxy** (BungeeCord, Velocity, TCPShield, etc.)

**For BungeeCord:**
1. Set `bungeecord: true` in `spigot.yml`
2. Restart the server

**For Velocity:**
1. Edit `config/paper-global.yml`
2. Set `proxies.velocity.enabled: true`
3. Set the `secret` to match Velocity's forwarding secret
4. Restart the server

**For TCPShield/Other:**
Follow your proxy's documentation for IP forwarding.

### Client/Language shows "N/A (Pre-login)"?
This is expected! The plugin intercepts players **before** they fully connect, so client brand and locale data isn't available yet. This is a Minecraft limitation, not a bug.

The data we DO capture (IP, UUID, GeoIP location) is still very useful for identifying players and alts!

` | `/forcelogout` | Administrative link termination. | `boosterrewards.admin` | **Visual Reward Definition** Define rewards through a direct-manipulation interface. title: ChestMarket
description: Simple item-based chest shops with native holograms and GUI management.
body:
# ChestMarket
ChestMarket is a lightweight and intuitive plugin allowing players to create item trading shops using simple chests. Designed for ease of use and performance, it is ideal for Survival, Faction, or Semi-RP servers that want an economy based on item exchange without relying on complex virtual currency.

## Key Features
- Simple Item Trading : Exchange one item for another (e.g., 1 Diamond for 32 Dirt). No virtual currency required.
- Native Holograms : Automatically displays the selling item and its price above the chest. No external dependencies (like DecentHolograms or HolographicDisplays) are needed.
- Intuitive GUI : Manage your shops and view your sales through a clean and polished menu ( /cm shops ).
- Quick Creation : Create a shop in just a few clicks. Select the item to sell, then the price, and click on a chest.
- Admin & Test Mode : Administrators can use "External" mode to test shops as a regular player or moderate existing ones.
- Built-in Protection : Shops are protected against theft and destruction by other players.
- Customizable : All messages and the plugin prefix are configurable.
## Commands
- /cm create : Enables creation mode. Click a chest to set up your shop.
- /cm remove : Enables removal mode. Click one of your shops to remove it.
- /cm shops : Opens a menu listing all your active shops with their sales statistics.
- /cm external : (Admin) Toggles external mode to interact with your own shops as a customer.
## Permissions
- chestmarket.create : Allows shop creation (Default: OP).
- chestmarket.remove : Allows shop removal (Default: OP).
- chestmarket.admin : Grants access to admin commands and external mode (Default: OP).
## Installation
1. Download the .jar file.
2. Drop it into your server's plugins folder.
3. Restart your server.
4. The config.yml file will be automatically generated for you to adjust settings as needed.

title: FoodSize
description: The plugin tracks what players eat and automatically changes their size. All edible items in the game affect the player's size - some increase it, some decrease it, and it's fully customizable
body:
# FoodSizePlugin

**A Minecraft Paper plugin that changes player size based on eaten food!**

## Functionality

The plugin tracks what food players eat and automatically changes their size. All edible items in the game affect player size - some increase it, some decrease it.

Key features:
- **Automatic size change**: Every time a player eats food, their size changes
- **All food works**: Both increasing and decreasing food items are included
- **Cumulative effect**: Multiple food items stack (can become 30%-500% of normal size)
- **Configurable**: Food effects can be customized in config.yml
- **Custom messages**: Text messages can be changed in messages.yml

## Commands
/size - Show current size

/size [percent] - Set size in percent (30-500)

/resetsize - Reset size to 100%

/sizereload - Reload configuration

## Configuration

**config.yml**
Contains food effects. Each item has a value:
- Positive value = increases size
- Negative value = decreases size
- Zero = no change

Example:
```yaml
GOLDEN_APPLE: 0.20     # +20% size
APPLE: -0.10           # -10% size
settings:
  min-scale: 0.3       # Minimum 30%
  max-scale: 5.0       # Maximum 500%
```

**messages.yml**
Contains customizable text messages that players see when size changes.

## How it works

When enabled: Loads configuration files and registers events
Player tracking: When a player eats food, the plugin checks the food type and calculates the new size
Size application: Uses vanilla `/attribute` command to change player size
Data storage: Current size is stored in memory and persists while player is online

title: VanillaFih: Origins
description: A lightweight idiot-proof origins modpack optimized for multiplayer/smp usage.
body:
An easy to use, optimized, multiplayer vanilla plus modpack centered around origins and exploration. 

## VanillaFih: Origins

### About
  I made this modpack to play with my stupid chungus friends. I tried as hard as I could to make sure this pack can run on basically any PC and has as little initial set up as possible. Even the modded keybinds, texture packs, and video settings have been preconfigured to have no conflicts on startup and run smoothly. Feel free to change them as you please, but this is for those people who spend an hour in the options screen (lowkey me).

### Origins

  This modpack is balanced around vanilla, so origins have a great impact on your gameplay. A ton of origins haven't been added over the base ones so feel free to add your own custom datapacks and addons for this.

### World Generation

  A combination of [terralith](https://modrinth.com/datapack/terralith) and [tectonic](https://modrinth.com/datapack/tectonic) creates a lush and dynamic world that's fun to explore and build in. [Hookshots](https://modrinth.com/mod/hookshot) and [airships](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-aircraft) have been added to help traverse this terrain.

![terratonic mountains](https://i.imgur.com/rQWmoRh.jpeg)
![terratonic oceans](https://i.imgur.com/jvsRzCv.jpeg)
![terratonic mirage isles](https://i.imgur.com/OEqSvmW.jpeg)

  The nether has also been revitalized with [cinderscapes](https://modrinth.com/mod/cinderscapes) and [amplified nether](https://modrinth.com/datapack/amplified-nether)

### Dungeons and Exploration

  Several beautifully designed dungeons andstructures from [moog's](https://modrinth.com/user/FinnSetchell), [yung's](https://modrinth.com/user/YUNGNICKYOUNG), and more are scattered around the world, with lootr so you don't have to fight over loot. World gen can be a little slow sometimes, but should NOT cause any lag. Airships and hookshots should also make traversing the extreme terrain easier.
  
### Bosses and Combat

  Tons of new bosses to fight from [BMD](https://modrinth.com/mod/bosses-of-mass-destruction), [ultris](https://modrinth.com/mod/ultris), and [aquamirae](https://modrinth.com/mod/aquamirae), along with a remastered enderdragon fight! A ton of new ranged and melee weapons have also been added.

### Performance and QOL

  I have put in a TON of effort into making the game run smoothly while also looking as pretty as possible. There are also a lot of QOL changes like [graves](https://modrinth.com/mod/yigd), waystones, crafting changes, and backports that make the game less annoying and more fun. 

### Multiplayer

  [Simple radio](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-radio), [figura](https://modrinth.com/mod/figura), and a ton of other mods enhance the social aspect of gameplay! Simple voice chat does need [some setup](https://modrepo.de/minecraft/voicechat/wiki/server_setup), but it shouldnt be that bad I pawmise. You can find figura avatars over at their discord server.

### Building

  [Chipped](https://modrinth.com/mod/chipped), [rechiseled](https://modrinth.com/mod/rechiseled), and several other building and decoration mods will take your builds and interiors to the next level and feel more homey and personal. 

### Food

  A psychotic amount of food has been added through [farmer's delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-fabric) and some hand selected addons for it. [Spice of frabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/spice-of-fabric) has been configured to reward you with more hp (up to 40) for cooking a diverse and balanced diet, while not punishing players who can't be asked.
  
### A Lil Magic

  A tiny bit of magic from [enchanted: witchcraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchanted-witchcraft) and [extra alchemy](https://modrinth.com/mod/extraalchemy/) for the witches out there :3

### hampter

title: DemonPlugin
description: Make the night scarier, can your server survive?
body:
# Demons — Holy Blade vs Hellspawn

Project Page / Modrinth Listing Info

---

## Summary

**DemonPlugin** is a survival plugin that turns every zombie into a deadly demon that can only be slain using a sacred weapon — the Angelic Sword. Designed to pair with a custom resource pack, this plugin makes nights terrifying and rewards players for surviving hell’s invasion.

---

## Features

Supernatural Zombie Overhaul:

* Every zombie becomes a Demon automatically
* Custom name & behavior
* Optional fire resistance
* Increased movement speed
* Configurable health & damage
* Only damageable by Angelic Sword
* Fully resource-pack compatible

Angelic Sword:

* Uses Heart of the Sea as the item base (for custom textures)
* Only weapon capable of harming demons
* One-hit demon kills
* Breaks after configurable uses
* Recipe fully configurable in config.yml

Vault Rewards:

* Earn money per demon kill
* Configurable min/max rewards
* Chat message showing exact earnings
* Automatically disables if Vault is missing (no errors)

---

## Permissions

| Permission    | Description              |
| ------------- | ------------------------ |
| demons.reload | Reload the plugin config |

(No admin abuse commands — fully survival-focused)

---

## Dependencies

Required:

* **Paper / Spigot 1.20+**
* **Vault** *(optional but recommended for rewards)*

Soft-depend:

* Vault is detected automatically.
  If not installed, demon rewards are safely skipped and plugin still runs normally.

---

## Compatibility

✔ Paper 1.20.x
✔ Paper 1.21.x
✔ Works with custom resource packs
✔ No mods required for players

---

## Configuration Example

```yaml
demon:
  damage: 8                # Demon hit damage in half-hearts (8 = 4 hearts)
  bypass-armor: true       # Whether to bypass the players amor and always deal that amount of hearts
  health: 2                # Demon health in half-hearts (2 = 1 heart)
  speed-multiplier: 1      # How fast the demon should go (default = 1 defaults to speed of zombie)
  fire: true               # Whether or not the demons die to fire (True = do die to fire false = don't die to fire)

angelic-sword:
  max-uses: 10             # How many times it can be used before breaking
  recipe:
    row1: ["", "", "NETHER_STAR"]
    row2: ["", "NETHERITE_BLOCK", ""]
    row3: ["STICK", "", ""]

vault-reward:
  min: 50
  max: 100
```

---

## Installation

1. Drop **Demons.jar** into `/plugins`
2. Install Vault *(optional for rewards)*
3. Start server to generate config
4. Add your demon resource pack (optional but recommended)
5. Restart and survive the night 👹

title: 经济系统（AccountManeger）
description: Account Manager is a core economic system module specifically designed for Minecraft servers.
body:
**Account Manager** is a core module for Minecraft servers designed to provide an economic system. It offers a stable and user-friendly economic framework, allowing other functional modules (such as shops, quests, and territories) to interact with this economic system through API interfaces, thus achieving unified currency transactions and management.

# Key Features
Complete Economic System‌: Supports player accounts, transfers, deposits, withdrawals, and more.
**API Interface‌**: Provides a full API for developers of other modules.

**Event System‌**: Allows listening to events such as transactions and balance changes.

**Administrator Tools‌**: Offers comprehensive management commands and permission controls.

**Data Persistence‌**: Supports data storage in JSON/NBT formats.

**Highly Configurable‌**: Currency name, symbol, initial balance, and other settings are fully customizable.

## Account System

**Automatic Account Creation‌**: Accounts are automatically created for players when they first join the server.

**Player Accounts‌**: Each player has an individual account storing balance and transaction history.

**Global Account‌**: A server-level bank account used for taxes, fees, and other purposes.

**Transaction History‌**: Records details of every transaction for auditing purposes.

## Currency Operations

**Deposit/Withdrawal‌**: Users can deposit or withdraw money from their accounts.

**Transfer‌**: Players can transfer money to one another.

**Balance Inquiry‌**: Real-time balance checks for accounts.

**Balance Limits‌**: Configurable minimum/maximum balances, with options to allow negative balances.

## Management Functions

**Balance Management‌**: Administrators can set, increase, or decrease player balances.

**Wealth Leaderboard‌**: View the wealthiest players on the server.

**Data Backup‌**: Automatically saves account data to prevent loss during server restarts.

**Configuration Reload‌**: Supports hot-reloading of configuration files.

title: Worlds Resourcepack Setter
description: A mod for embedding resource packs into the current local world.
body:
# Worlds Resourcepack Setter

![Mod Loader](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mod%20Loader-Fabric-lightyellow?logo=data:image/png;base64,)
![Static Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Enviroment-Client_and_Server-purple)
![Static Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Language-Java_21-orange)

## How to use?

Using the /setResources command packs all your currently enabled resource packs into a single pack and stores it in the current world folder.
This command also supports parameters:

- ```force``` - include resource packs that are incompatible with the current game version

- ```compatible``` - include only resource packs that are compatible with the current game version

- ```everything``` - include both player resource packs and built-in packs from mods and loaders

- ```external``` - include only resource packs provided by the player

The command without parameters (/setResources) is equivalent to: ```/setResources force external```

## Configuration

The mod includes a configuration file: ```.minecraft/config/wrs_config.json```


### Available options:

- "pendingWorlds": String Array -> _Recommended to ignore. Used internally for the resource pack replacement system when many packs are present._

- "includeVanilla": boolean -> _Whether to include vanilla Minecraft textures._

- "savePath": String -> _Path where the resource pack will be saved if you only want to collect packs and store them elsewhere._

- "customFileName": String -> _Custom filename prefix for the generated resource pack._

- "customDescription": String -> _Custom resource pack description inside pack.mcmeta._

title: Glyphastic!
description: By far the best implementation of the Glyph-based magic system from The Owl House!
body:
## The Purpose
The mod adds new items called Glyph Scrolls, that on use do different abilities/actions that can be used in pvp, traveling, or just for utility

## ➕ Additions:
- **Blank Glyph**: A template for creating usable **Glyph Scrolls** on the **Glyph Inscriber
**
- **Glyph Scroll**: When used, does an action dependant on what glyph combination is inscribed on it
- A full _Glyph Combo_ system, 13+ Total handcrafted actions, _Imperfect Combination_ system
- An easy to use Glyph Inscriber block, with a cool GUI

## Usage
- Craft Blank Glyphs by surrounding amethyst shards with paper
- Craft a glyph inscriber block
- Use the glyph inscriber's GUI to write a glyph combination to the Blank:
  - Place The Blank in the center slot of the GUI
  - Drag and Drop the glyphs from the "palette" at the left onto the bigger surrounding slots
  - A written Glyph Scroll should appear at the output slot if there is any glyphs to write
  - The Imperfect Combination System makes it much easier to search for usable glyph sets
  - The Output Scroll dynamically shows what ability it has depending on the glyphs written
  - _Note: Glyph order in the GUI doesn't matter, what matters is what glyphs are written_
  - 1 Scroll craft costs 1 Experience level, to craft a scroll - just take it
  - To Bulk-Craft scrolls - Shift + Click the output scroll
- Use the outputted glyph scroll item to use the written action (1 out of 13), this also removes the used scroll

## Registry
For all the glyph combinations there are 13 different actions to match, here are they (without the combination)
- Overgrowth - Acts a giant bone meal
- Ember - Creates a ring of fire around you
- Frost Cover - Covers natural blocks around you with ice
- Illumination - Gives the user Night Vision
- Regeneration - Gives the user Regeneration
- Launch - Propells the user in their look direction
- Shockwave - Propells entities in range from the user, ignites affected entities
- Explosion - Creates an explosion roughly the same power as regular TNT
- Invisibility - Gives the user a new effect: "Pure Invisibility" - Hides both the player and the held item
- Ascension - Massively launches the user upwards, when on the top - gives Slow Falling
- Nature's Strength - Gives the user Sterngth 2
- Iceful Raise - Creates an ice pillar below the user
- Flash - Flashes White the screen of players in range, has a massive delay

Most of the actions have a delay/cooldown for balance reasons

## Coming Soon
I plan on making certain additions in the future mod versions, here are the current ideas so you know what to expect:
- Glyph Placement System - Activates the scroll's ability when walked over
- Per-World Glyph Combinations - Will determine the glyph combinations for hardcoded actions dynamically based on the world seed (So no memorizing!)

title: Cozy Campfire
description: Turns campfires into configurable healing stations with smart range detection
body:
> **⚠️ Compatibility Note:** This plugin is built for **Minecraft 1.21.5 Purpur**. I tested it on Purpur 1.21.5 and Spigot 1.21.1. It should work on 1.21.1-1.21.5 Spigot/Purpur/Paper/Bukkit.

If you want to report a bug or suggest a new plugin, join my [Discord server](https://discord.gg/A7WVnYj3BP).

This is a cut-out and improved fragment of my **[SmpMechanics](https://modrinth.com/plugin/smpmechanics)** plugin and forms a harmonious whole with **[CustomDayNightTime](https://modrinth.com/plugin/customdaynighttime)** and **[BetterSleep](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bettersleep)**.

# 🔥 CozyCampfire

**Turn Campfires into Healing Stations: Configurable AOE Regeneration, Potion Effects, and RPG Buffs.**

CozyCampfire transforms ordinary Minecraft campfires into strategic resting spots. Instead of just cooking food, lit campfires now provide warmth, healing, and other configurable buffs to nearby players! Perfect for RPG servers, Survival lobbies, or just making your base feel more alive.

### ✨ Key Features

* **❤️ Dynamic Healing:** Automatically grants configurable potion effects (e.g., Regeneration) to players resting near a lit campfire.
* **🧠 Smart Logic:** The plugin respects existing potion effects. It will **never** overwrite a player's effect if they already have a stronger amplifier or longer duration (e.g., it won't ruin a God Apple effect).
* **🧱 Smart Raytracing:** Includes a configurable `through-blocks` system. You decide if warmth penetrates walls or requires a direct **Line-of-Sight**.
* **📏 3D Area Control:** Fully customizable detection range. Configure the circular `radius`, `height-up`, and `height-down` independently.
* **🌍 Multi-Language (Per-Player):** Full support for **English** and **Polish**. Players can switch their own interface language anytime via command!
* **☠️ Realistic Fire:** Standing directly on a lit campfire sets the player on fire (configurable).
* **🛡️ Spectator Safety:** Players in Spectator mode are automatically ignored by the system.

---

### ⚙️ Configuration

The plugin is fully configurable via `config.yml` or in-game commands:

* **Effects:** Add multiple effects (Speed, Regeneration, Resistance) with custom power and duration.
* **Radius & Height:** Define the exact "warmth zone" around the campfire.
* **Raytracing:** Toggle `through-blocks` to true or false depending on your server style.
* **Burning:** Enable or disable fire damage when stepping on the campfire.

---

### 📜 Commands and Permissions

Main command: `/cozycampfire` or `/cp`

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/cp help` | Shows the list of available commands. | `cozycampfire.help` |
| `/cp lang [en/pl]` | Switches your personal message language. | `cozycampfire.language` |
| `/cp add <effect> <amp> <time>` | Adds a new effect to campfires. | `cozycampfire.add` |
| `/cp remove <effect>` | Removes an effect from the config. | `cozycampfire.remove` |
| `/cp radius <value>` | Sets the horizontal radius. | `cozycampfire.radius` |
| `/cp height-up <value>` | Sets the detection height upwards. | `cozycampfire.height` |
| `/cp height-down <value>` | Sets the detection height downwards. | `cozycampfire.height` |
| `/cp tb` | Toggles "Through Blocks" (Raytracing) mode. | `cozycampfire.throughblocks` |
| `/cp fire` | Toggles burning players on contact. | `cozycampfire.fire` |
| `/cp reload` | Reloads the configuration and messages. | `cozycampfire.reload` |

**Wildcard Permission (Full Admin):** `cozycampfire.*`

---

### 🚀 Installation

1.  Download the `.jar` file.
2.  Place it in the `/plugins/` folder of your server (Spigot/Paper/Purpur **1.21+**).
3.  Restart the server.
4.  Done! Campfires now provide regeneration by default.
    * *Tip: Use `/cp lang pl` in-game if you prefer Polish messages!*

---

### 📂 Generated Files

1.  `config.yml` - Main settings.
2.  `messages_en.yml` - English translation file.
3.  `messages_pl.yml` - Polish translation file.

Crops Wants 5x30 is a revolutionary quality-of-life (QoL) plugin for Minecraft servers designed to drastically enhance and streamline the farming experience. Tired of waiting for slow crop growth or constantly expending bone meal? The heart of Crops Wants 5x30 is its unique and intuitive activation method:

* **Tactical Instant Growth:** Pressing and holding the **SHIFT (Sneak) key** activates the growth boost. This mechanic mimics the effect of applying bone meal repeatedly, but to a massive area simultaneously.

* **Comprehensive Crop Support:** The plugin affects all standard growable plants, including:
    * **Crops:** Wheat, Carrots, Potatoes, Beetroots, Melons, Pumpkins.
    * **Trees:** All types of Saplings.
* **Seamless Integration:** The feature works naturally alongside existing game mechanics, requiring no special items or complicated commands.

1.  **Massive Time Saver:** Eliminate the downtime of traditional farming. Mature entire fields in seconds, making food and resource gathering efficient and painless.

3.  **Farming Economy Boost:** On economy servers, players can quickly cycle harvests, leading to a more dynamic and active in-game market for farm goods.
4.  **Lag-Friendly Design:** Developed with performance in mind, the plugin is optimized to handle rapid block updates within the defined area of effect without creating unnecessary server load or "tick lag."

### ⚙️ Installation and Usage

#### **Installation**

1.  Download the `CropsWants5x30.jar` file.
2.  Place the `.jar` file into the `plugins` folder of your Spigot or Paper server.

#### **Usage (For Players)**

1.  Stand near your planted crops or saplings.
2.  **Fast click the SHIFT (Sneak) key.**
3.  Observe as all plants within 3 blocks instantly jump to their final growth stage!
4.  Release the SHIFT key and proceed to harvest your bounty.

title: MCS3-Backup
description: Back up your world data with cron(UNIX) format config and uplaod them to AWS S3(optional).
body:
## MCS3-Backup

A Spigot plugin that can back up Minecraft server worlds and upload them to S3.

### Features
- Create backups of worlds (schedules configurable using cron format)
- Automatic deletion of old backups (number of backups to keep configurable in config.yml)
- Upload backups to S3 (authentication and enable/disable configurable)

### Installation
1. Download the latest .jar file from [Releases](https://modrinth.com/plugin/mcs3-backup/versions)
2. and place it in the `plugins` folder.
3. Restart the server. 
4. Edit `plugins/MCS3-Backup/config.yml` and configure the settings as needed.

### Configuration
```yaml
backup-time: "0 0 * * *" # Schedule backups using cron format
backup-worlds: # List of directories to back up (relative to the root directory)
- world
- world_nether
- world_the_end
backup-keep-count: 1 # Number of backups to keep

S3: # See S3 setup instructions below
enabled: false # Enable or disable uploading to S3
bucket: "your-bucket-name"
region: "ap-northeast-1"
storage-class: "STANDARD"
upload-prefix: "backups/" # Slash at the end is optional

access-key: "your-access-key"
secret-access-key: "your-secret-access-key"
```

### S3 Setup
1. Create an IAM user with `s3:PutObject` permissions and obtain the Access Key and Secret Access Key.
2. Create a S3 bucket and note the bucket name and region.
3. Edit the S3 section in `config.yml` and enter the obtained credentials.
4. Optionally, configure the `storage-class` and `upload-prefix`.
5. Restart the server.

### Commands and Permissions ( /mcs3 )
All /mcs3 commands can be executed with the `MCS3Backup.commands.mcs3` permission.

- reload : Reloads all configuration items from `config.yml`.
- help : Displays a list of available commands.
- next : Shows the scheduled time for the next backup.

### Planned Features
- Manual backup via command
- List and delete backups
- Generate download links for backups
- Automatic deletion of backups in the S3 bucket
- ~~Reload configuration via command~~

### License
MCS3-Backup is released under the MIT License.

title: Echo Rifts
description: Adds a new way to get around in the world using specialized portals
body:
Echo Rifts are a new feature that's sure to make Minecraft's endgame more fun!
Echo Shards now drop from Sculk Shriekers, and Reinforced Deepslate drops when mined with a Netherite Pickaxe.

Echo shards and eyes of ender can be crafted into an **Eye of Echo**, a brand new item that has a unique, endgame-convenient use for those who have lots of far away structures and are tired of flying or using nether highways!


When it lands, it creates an **Echo Rift**, which links to your **CURRENT** spawnpoint at the moment of its creation. This can be an easy way to dump your items if your inventory is full, or a quick way to get back home! **Ender pearl stasis chambers are no longer needed!**


Echo Rifts are naturally unstable, and so **only last a minute** before they disappear. But by **stabilizing** them with Reinforced Deepslate (Bedrock works as well), they will remain for as long as they are needed!

The best part is, you can link any two areas of the world together, by **setting on rift to your home base, and set your spawn at that location, then go back home through the rift and place another rift**! You can even make several rifts in your home base that link all over the world, meaning **Nether Highways are no longer needed.**

### NOTES
These are **dimension specific**, so overworld rifts will only spawn if you have an overworld spawnpoint, and vice versa for the Nether. If you don't have a spawnpoint in that dimension, you will be given back your Eye of Echo. As for the End, it links back to the Obsidian Platform.
Additionally, if thrown onto another player, the placement will also fail, and you will also be given back the Eye of Echo. This is to avoid making your spawnpoint into a trap and instantly forcing players into it

The plugin analyzes chat messages for emotional content, responding to positive and negative language naturally. Players expressing joy or frustration will see their emotions shift accordingly.

title: Payout
description: A simple mod that allows server admins to automatically give players items at definable intervals. This mod is highly-configurable.
body: # Payout **A simple mod that allows server admins to automatically give players items at definable intervals.** ### Introduction Payout is a simple yet highly-configurable mod that allows server owners and admins to routinely pay items to the server's playerbase. ## Configuring Payout Payout's config is located at `world/serverconfig/payout-server.toml`. ### What you'll see when you first open the config. ```` [general] #The item to give players item = "minecraft:diamond" #How many items to give #Range: 1 ~ 64 count = 1 #Interval in milliseconds between payouts #Range: 1000 ~ 9223372036854775807 intervalMillis = 60000 #Sound event ID to play on payout payoutSound = "minecraft:entity.player.levelup" #Volume of payout sound #Range: 0.0 ~ 10.0 payoutVolume = 1.0 #Should payout play a sound? playPayoutSound = true #Should the server send a toast packet to connected clients during payout? showToast = true #What should the title of the toast say? toastTitle = "You got paid!" #What should the title of the toast say? toastDescription = "Thanks for playing!" ```` ### Definitions | Name | Type | Required | Description | Default Value | Example Value | |-------------------|----------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------|------------------------------| | `item` | String | No | The item to give players. Must be a valid item ID. | `"minecraft:diamond"` | `"minecraft:emerald"` | | `count` | Integer | No | How many items to give. Range: **1 ~ 64** | `1` | `5` | | `intervalMillis` | Long | No | Interval in **milliseconds** between payouts. Range: **1000 ~ 9223372036854775807** | `60000` (60 seconds) | `120000` (2 minutes) | | `payoutSound` | String | No | Sound event ID to play on payout. Must be a valid sound resource location. | `"minecraft:entity.player.levelup"` | `"minecraft:entity.cat.purr"`| | `payoutVolume` | Float | No | Volume of the payout sound. Range: **0.0 ~ 10.0** | `1.0` | `0.5` | | `playPayoutSound` | Boolean | No | Whether the payout should play a sound. | `true` | `false` | | `showToast` | Boolean | No | Whether the server should send a toast packet to connected clients during payout. | `true` | `false` | | `toastTitle` | String | No | The title text of the toast shown on payout. | `"You got paid!"` | `"Daily Reward!"` | | `toastDescription`| String | No | The description text of the toast shown on payout. | `"Thanks for playing!"` | `"Come back tomorrow!"` | ## Commands | Command | Syntax | Description | |--------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------| | **Set Reward Item** | `/payout setItem ` | Sets the item and quantity given to players on each payout. | | **Set Interval** | `/payout setTime ` | Sets the payout interval using hours (`h`), minutes (`m`), or days (`d`). | | **Debug Trigger** | `/payout debug trigger` | Manually triggers a payout immediately. | | **Debug Reset** | `/payout debug reset` | Resets the config back to defaults. | | **Debug Config Path** | `/payout debug config` | Shows the current config file path and active values. | | **Reload Config** | `/payout reload` | Reloads the `payout-server.toml` config file. | | **Status** | `/payout status` | Shows current payout settings (reward, interval, time remaining, sounds, toasts). | | **Set Payout Sound** | `/payout setPayoutSound ` | Sets the sound event ID and volume for payout notifications. | | **Toggle Sound** | `/payout setPlayPayoutSound ` | Enables or disables payout sound playback. | | **Toggle Toasts** | `/payout setShowToasts ` | Enables or disables showing toast notifications to clients. | | **Set Toast Title** | `/payout setToastTitle ` | Sets the title text of the toast notification. | | **Set Toast Description**| `/payout setToastDescription ` | Sets the description text of the toast notification. |

title: Synkai IPFilter
description: Synkai IPFilter is a Velocity plugin that whitelists both IPs and domains from a config. Non-whitelisted connections and pings are dropped, making the server appear offline instead of sending a kick.
body:
This Plugin was Originally made for https://synkaimc.in
## Synkai IPFilter — Velocity Plugin
What it does

Synkai IPFilter is a lightweight but powerful connection + ping filter for Velocity proxies.

It only allows connections and server-list pings if the client’s IP address or domain/hostname matches entries in the config file.

If the client is not whitelisted:

The server appears offline (no MOTD, no players shown).

Direct connections are silently denied, instead of sending a rejection message.

Configuration is handled through a simple config.yml file (auto-generated on first run), where you can easily add or remove ips and domains.

Why it’s unique

Unlike other plugins that:

Block with a kick message → Synkai IPFilter avoids advertising that the server exists.

Rely on TCPShield / external firewalls → This plugin works natively inside Velocity, giving server owners more control.

Filter only IPs or only hostnames → Synkai IPFilter handles both IPs and domains together, meaning you can whitelist by network infra or by the actual hostname players use.

In practice, this means:

To unapproved users (or bots), your server looks as if it doesn’t exist at all.

To approved domains/IPs, the server works normally.

Works nicely alongside services like NeoProtect or TCPShield, but removes the missing piece: domain/IP-based whitelisting at the proxy level.

Key Features

✔️ Domain + IP whitelisting in a single plugin
✔️ Offline appearance for unapproved connections (invisible server)
✔️ Easy config (config.yml auto-generated on first run)
✔️ Zero dependencies — just drop the JAR into Velocity plugins folder
✔️ Java 21 + Gradle build system (modern setup, future-proof)
✔️ Unique positioning → not just security, but stealth (hide your server from unwanted pings/bots/scanners)

**Issues? dm me on discord at sirrocking or join https://synkaimc.in/discord**

title: Tailwind Enchantment - faster happy ghasts & boost by sprinting
description: An enchantment for the harness that allows a balanced system of faster flight and sprinting on friendly ghasts
body:
# Tailwind Enchantment

Is your happy ghast too slow?  
This datapack allows to speed up happy ghasts in a balanced, non-game-breaking way!

## Balancing

The speed of happy ghasts is questioned by many players, and many solutions are being made.
This enchantment offers more effecient way of travelling than walking in a balanced way.  
  
It was important for me to make this datapack balanced with vanilla features.  
For that reason, I ensured that the friendly ghasts do not overshadow other means of transport, like horses (which are still faster).  
  
Unlike other datapacks and mods, this one does not change the default behaviour of the harness (keeping the vanilla default speed). The boost isn't presented at the start of the game, and the player will have to to put effort for getting a better option. It was designed specifically so that the best option would not be easy to obtain.  

## How does it work?

Instead of changing the speed by default, the datapack adds an optional Tailwind enchantment for the harness.  

The enchantment slightly increases the ghast base speed, and also allows to boost your flight it while using the **sprint key** (default: `ctrl`)

* **No Tailwind**: normal speed (3.6b/s), no sprint
* **Tailwind I**: +1% speed (3.68b/s), +10% spint boost (4.45b/s)
* **Tailwind II**: +2% speed (3.75b/s), +20% sprint boost (5.37b/s)
* **Tailwind III**: +3% speed (3.82b/s), +25% sprint boost (5.9b/s)
* **Tailwind IV**: +4% speed (3.9b/s), +30% sprint boost (6.48b/s)
* **Tailwind V**: +5% speed (3.98b/s), +40% sprint boost (7.59b/s)

The datapack is fully compatible to the [Speedy Flying Mobs Datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/speedy-flying-mobs), which makes swiftness potions work with happy ghasts.

## How to obtain

The enchantment can be obtained by trading with a **master leatherworker villager**.  
Once the leatherworker reaches level 5, *two additional trades* will be added to its list.  

Each trade can be:
- a harness of random color (no enchantment)
- a harness of random color with Tailwind I-IV enchantment
- an enchanted book with Tailwind I-II enchantment

The prices are celected randomly according to enchantment levels

> **IMPORTANT!**
> Two enchanted harnesses **can not be combined on an anvil**.  
> You can combine a harness with a book or two books together.  
>  
> Once a harness is enchanted, its color **can not be changed**.  
> Attempting to repaint an enchanted harness will remove the enchantment from it.

## Installation

Put the datapack file into your `datapacks/` folder inside your Minecraft world save directory.  
Then reload the datapacks with the command `/reload` in the game or restart the world.  


## Credits & links:

GitHub: https://github.com/parar020100/Tailwind-Enchantment-Datapack  
Modrinth: https://modrinth.com/datapack/tailwind-enchantment  
Made by Artiom Parygin (parar020100)  
License: MIT  


  


---

# Зачарование "Попутный ветер"

Твой счастливый гаст слишком медленный?  
Этот датапак позволяет ускорить радостных гастов, не ломая баланс и механики игры!  

## Баланс игры

Скорость счастливых гастов не устраивает многих игроков, и для данной проблемы создаётся много решений.  
Это зачарование создаёт более эффективный способ передвижения, чем пешком, не нарушая баланса игры.  
  
Для меня было важно сделать этот датапак сбалансированным и не портящим возможности ванильной игре.  
Для этого я убедился, что дружелюбные гасты не имеют сильного преимущества перед другими средствами передвижения, к примеру, лошадьми (которые всё ещё быстрее).  
  
В отличие от других датапаков и модов, этот не меняет поведение упряжи по умолчанию (сохраняя ванильную скорость по-умолчанию). Ускорение не доступно в начале игры, и игроку придётся приложить усилия, чтобы получить самый лучший вариант. Датапак специально был создан таким, чтобы лучший вариант было нелегко получить.

## Как это работает?
Вместо изменения скорости по-умолчанию, датапак добавляет зачарование «Попутный ветер» для упряжи.  

Зачарование немного повышает базовую скорость гаста, а также позволяет ускоряться во время полёта при нажатой **клавише бега** (по умолчанию: `ctrl`).  

* **Без зачарования** — обычная скорость (3.6 б/с), спринт невозможен
* **Попутный ветер I** — +1% скорости (3.68 б/с), +10% ускорения со спринтом (4.45 б/с)
* **Попутный ветер II** — +2% скорости (3.75 б/с), +20% ускорения со спринтом (5.37 б/с)
* **Попутный ветер III** — +3% скорости (3.82 б/с), +25% ускорения со спринтом (5.9 б/с)
* **Попутный ветер IV** — +4% скорости (3.9 б/с), +30% ускорения со спринтом (6.48 б/с)
* **Попутный ветер V** — +5% скорости (3.98 б/с), +40% ускорения со спринтом (7.59 б/с)

Датапак полностью совместим с датапаком [Speedy Flying Mobs](https://modrinth.com/datapack/speedy-flying-mobs), позволяющий использовать зелья стремительности на счастливых гастов.

# Как получить
Зачарование можно получить у жителя-кожевника уровня "мастер".  
После того как кожевник достигнет 5 уровня, в его список торгов добавятся два дополнительных предложения.

Новые предложения выбираются случайно из списка:
- упряжь случайного цвета (без зачарования)
- упряжь случайного цвета с зачарованием «Попутный ветер» I–IV
- зачарованная книга с «Попутный ветер» I–II

Цена выбирается случайным образом в зависимости от уровня зачарования.

> **ВНИМАНИЕ!**
> Две зачарованные упряжи нельзя совместить на наковальне.  
> Можно совместить упряжь с книгой или две книги между собой.  
>  
> После зачарования упряжи её цвет нельзя изменить.

title: BrainF**k In Minecraft
description: This is a Minecraft mod that adds four new blocks, allowing you to run simple Brainf**k programs — a Turing-complete programming language.
body:
## 📦 Mod Description
This mod adds four blocks to help you run _Brainf**k_ programs in Minecraft — a minimalist yet Turing-complete programming language.

## 🧠 Brainf**k Overview
_Brainf**k_ programs are made up of only 8 symbols:

`<` and `>`: Move the pointer left and right across memory. In this mod, this is visualized as the pointer block moving left or right.

`+` and `-`: Increment or decrement the value at the current memory cell.

`[` and `]`: Create loops. When the program reaches `[`, if the current cell is 0, it skips to the command after the matching `]`. When it reaches `]`, it jumps back to the matching `[`.

`.`: Outputs the value of the current memory cell as an [ASCII](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ASCII) character.

`,`: Reads a single character of input and stores its [ASCII](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ASCII) value in the current memory cell (not yet implemented in this mod).

## 🔧 Mod Features
Pointer Block
Simulates the pointer in Brainf**k. Right-click to open the GUI and edit the program; Shift + Right-click to run it. The block the pointer is facing represents the current memory unit. Output is displayed above the block. It might explode.

Memory Unit:
The basic memory block. Its value can be modified by the pointer. Supports negative numbers.

Chance Block:
Get random number(1-6 or (-1)-(-6)).

Boolean Unit:
Has two states: True and False. Can be toggled using `+` and `-`.

Color Unit:
Displays a color. The `+` and `-` commands adjust RGB values. By default, they modify red. Use `.` to cycle between which color is being modified (e.g., first press affects green, next affects blue, etc.).

## 🐛 Bug Reports & Suggestions
This mod may contain many bugs. You can report them or suggest new features at [Github](https://github.com/Sihuai2412/Brainf-k-in-Minecraft)

The source code is not open yet, but I plan to release it in the future.

title: ExisCraft
description:
Hey, it’s me, Exis! ^^

It’s nothing too fancy, but I wanted to mix some cool mods together for a fun and chaotic experience.
Whether you like exploring, fighting monsters, or just collectin
body:
# 🟦 Exis Craft

Created by: Exis
Minecraft Version: 1.20+
Mod Loader: Forge / Fabric (choose your version)
Category: Adventure • Exploration • RPG • Combat
Multiplayer Support: ✅ Yes

## 💬 Description

Hey, it’s me — Exis! ^^
I’m a German YouTuber and this is my first Minecraft mod.
It’s nothing too crazy, but I wanted to make something fun — a little mix of new ores, weapons, mobs, and some surprises!

Exis Craft expands your Minecraft world with fresh content and a bit of humor.
If you enjoy exploring, crafting new stuff, or fighting weird creatures, you’ll probably have a good time here.


# ⚙️ Main Features


## 🪨 New Ores & Materials
Discover mysterious underground resources — each with unique crafting uses.


## 🗡️ New Weapons & Equipment
Forge powerful tools, blades, and armor sets that give you a fighting chance against new enemies.


## 👾 New Mobs (Good & Evil)
Meet friendly creatures that might help you — and dangerous ones that definitely won’t.


## 🏆 Custom Advancements
Earn new achievements and rewards as you explore everything the mod has to offer.


## 🌍 World Additions
Some biomes, structures, and loot tables have been slightly updated to fit the new content.


# 🎮 Why You Should Play

To be honest… I don’t really know 😅
But if you like chaotic fun, exploration, and new gear, this mod might be exactly what you need!
It’s not about realism — it’s about having fun and trying something new.


# 🔧 Compatibility & Requirements

Works with Minecraft 1.20+

Available for Forge and/or Fabric (depending on release)

Fully compatible with most other adventure / exploration mods

Can be used in singleplayer or multiplayer worlds


# 📦 Installation

Download and install Forge or Fabric for your game version.

Drop the Exis Craft .jar file into your mods folder.

Launch Minecraft and enjoy!

Optional but recommended:

Install JEI (Just Enough Items) to see crafting recipes easily.

Combine with worldgen mods for more exploration fun.


# 💙 Credits

Created and developed by Exis
Thanks to everyone supporting my small YouTube channel and testing early versions!

If you make videos or share the mod, please credit “Exis Craft” and link back to this page ❤️


# ✨ Final Words

This is my first mod — it’s not perfect, but I hope it makes you smile or gives you something new to explore.
Have fun mining, crafting, and fighting your way through the world of Exis Craft! 🐑⚔️

description: Adds a variety of new enchantments, QOL features, and reworks to existing enchantments and items.
body:
# The Recrafted

## Items

### Beetroot Soup
beetroot soup can now be crafted with any amount of beetroots, with more beetroots providing more nutrition bars but taking longer to eat.

### Cake
Crafted cakes can now be eaten without being place down taking much longer to eat than other foods.

### Smelting
- Smelting armors and tools will now give you an ingot instead of a nugget. 
- Smelting blocks is now possible at a less efficient rate.
- Smelting cobblestone into stone is now possible in a blast furnace.

### Shields
Iron Shields now have reduced durability. (336 -> 125)

## Enchantments

### Aqua Affinity 
Aqua Affinity has 2 levels now. Level 1 provides slightly less. (+400% -> +300%) Level 2 provides even faster mining than above water. (+450%)

### Bane of Arthropods 
Bane of arthropods now works on any entity with the "Infested" Effect.

### Feather Falling 
Feather falling provides less fall damage protection. (3 -> 2 per level) But now gives safe fall distance. (+2 per level)

### Frost Walker 
Frost walker 2 now gives a large enough range to sprint-jump

### Impaling 
Impaling now works like it does on bedrock. Dealing extra damage to any entity in water, with a slight nerf on damage. (+12.5 -> +7.5 max level)

### Mending 
Mending gives less durability per level. (2 -> 0.5)

### Projectile Protection 
Projectile protection provides more protection from projectiles. (2 -> 3 per level)

### Smite 
Smite now Gives weakness 2 to undead.

# The Crafted Anew

## Items

### Shields
Diamond and netherite shields can now be crafted with much more durability.
- Diamond - 731
- Netherite - 1016

## Enchantments

### Cleaving III
An enchantment for the axe, provides equal damage to sharpness as well as giving 10% armor reduction.
- Mutually exclusive with sharpness, smite, bane of arthropods, life steal, illager's bane, and rampage

### Cowardice IV
Leggings enchantment, gives speed after being attacked.
- Mutually exclusive with Thorns

### Curse of Fragility
halves the durability of an item.
- mutually exclusive with unbreaking

### Curse of Fatigue
halves the players mining speed when equiped.
- mutually exclusive with efficiency

### Guarding
Enchantment for Shields, Provides massive damage reduction while sneaking.

### Illager's Bane V
Weapon enchant that deals more damage to these mobs:
- Pillager
- Vindicator
- Ravager
- Witch
- Evoker
- Illusioner
 
- Mutually exclusive with sharpness, smite, bane of arthropods, life steal, cleaving, and rampage

### Life Steal III
weapon enchant, provides slight healing upon attack.
- mutually exclusive with sharpness, smite, bane of arthropods, cleaving, illager's bane, and rampage

### Keeping IV
Armor enchant that gives more xp from mobs.

### Paralizing III

title: SuperAsks
description: ✅ NEW | A great plugin for the question system
body:
The [PlaceholdeAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/) is required for SuperAsks to work​

[![Discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3b4f22cfd533362883c44e7bbe542adfa445a57e.png)](https://discord.gg/huvEtpz7EY)

## Overview

The SuperAsks plugin is designed to send administration/moderation questions, as well as their answers. The plugin can be useful for servers where there is no "Question - answer" section, or just for other information about the server/something else.

## Information


<details>
<summary>Commands</summary>

- **/ask {question}** - This command sends a question on behalf of the player. Instead of "{question}", you need to write your question, and then press Enter to send it to the administrators/moderators so that they answer it

- **/asks** - This command is designed to open a list of questions, as well as answer/clear them. You can set up word filters (search) and also delete all questions. In order to access the command, you need the permission "superasks.asks"

</details>

<details>
<summary>Permissions</summary>

- **superasks.asks** - A permission that allows the user to open a menu of questions, as well as answer them, but not receive notifications about new questions, as well as deleting questions. It also does not allow you to delete questions
- **superasks.delete** - A permission that allows the user to delete questions individually, as well as all questions at once
- **superasks.notify-deleted** - A permission that allows the user to delete questions individually, as well as all questions at once
- **superasks.notify-ask** - A permission that allows the user to receive notifications when a new question arrives

</details>


<details>
<summary>config.yml</summary>


```
database:
 # The type of database to be used for connection (Allowed: H2, MySQL, Fortgres)
  type: "MySQL"
  # Database address
  url: "localhost"
  # Connection port
  port: "3306"
  # The name of the database (not the tables!)
  name: "database"

  # Data for authorization in the database

  # Username
  username: ""
  # Password
  password: ""

on-question-solved:
 - 'msg %asker%, you get reply from %admin%: %reply%'
  # Change this if you don't have EssebtialsX installed or something similar.

messages:
  ask-timed-out: "&6&lSuperAsks &8» &7The timeout of &630 seconds &7for the response has expired. The question has been returned to the menu, the chat restrictions have been lifted"
  ask-await-reply: "&6&lSuperAsks &8» &7Your next chat message will be counted as an answer to the selected question. Question: &c%question%&f."
  ask-sent: "&6&lSuperAsks &8» &7Your question has been submitted to moderation."
  ask-deleted: "&6&lSuperAsks &8» &7The question has been deleted."
  ask-deleted-by-admin: "&8[&c!&8] &6&lSuperAsks &8» &7The question from &c%sender%&7 is addressed by the administrator &c%admin%! &8(ASK ID: %ask_id%)"
  notify-new-ask: "&6&lSuperAsks &8» &c%sender% &7has sent a new question!"

  deleted-all-asks: "&6&lSuperAsks &8» &c%count%&7 of questions have been deleted."
  notify-deleted-all-asks: "&8[&c!&8] &6&lSuperAsks &8» &7Admin &c%admin%&7 deleted all questions! &8(Total: %count%)"

  action-not-allowed: "&6&lSuperAsks &8» &7You can't do this right now!"

  filter-set: "&6&lSuperAsks &8» &7The filter is installed: &c%filter%"
  filter-reset: "&6&lSuperAsks &8» &7The filter has been reset."
  await-filter: "&6&lSuperAsks &8» &7Your next message will be counted as a new value for the question filter."

  # Item Management

  # name - name of the item
  # amount - item quantity
  # lore - description of the item
  # type - the material of the item (for example, STONE)
  # enchantments - enchantment of an item (in MENDING:2 format)
  # hideEnchantments - hide enchantments (the glow remains)
  # hideAttributes - hide attributes
  # hideItemFlags - hide other item flags (for example, what is being set or potion effects)
  # hideUnbreakable - hide the inviolability of an object
  # hideAll - hide the 4 above parameters together

  items:
    ask-item:
      name: "&7Question from &6%name% &6(%time% ago)"
      amount: 1
      type: PAPER
      lore:
       - "&r "
        - "&f%question%"
        - "&r "
        - "&7Answer the question - &6LBM"
        - "&7Delete a question - &6RMB"
    asks-prev-page:
      name: "&fBack &c#%page%"
      amount: 1
      type: ARROW
    asks-next-page:
      name: "&fForward &c#%page%"
      amount: 1
      type: ARROW
    asks-clear-all:
      name: "   &c&lClear everything   "
      amount: 1
      type: RED_TERRACOTTA
      lore:
       - "              &c&m   "
        - "&r"
        - "  &fCompletely clears all  "
        - "  &fexisting issues  &f"
        - "&r"
    asks-filter:
      name: "   &e&lFilter out questions  &f"
      amount: 1
      type: SPYGLASS
      lore:
       - "                &e&m   "
        - "&r"
        - "  &fFilters questions by"
        - "  &fthe given word/words    &f"
        - "&r"
        - "  &fCurrent filter:"
        - "  &c%filter%"
        - "&r"
        - "  &fReset the filter - &eRMB"
        - "&r"
```

title: Localised Wither Remover
description: This minecraft datapack is geared toward protecting specific areas in your world from wither grief. It will allow you to kill automatically any wither from specific locations of your world.
body:
# Localised Wither Remover v1.0.0

- Creator : Marghost
- Email : marghost[@]protonmail.com
- Website : https://thegeekghost.com
- Project's Github : https://github.com/marghost/localised_wither_remover/

## Description

This minecraft datapack is geared toward protecting specific areas in your world from wither grief.  It will allow you to kill automaticly any wither from specific locations of your world.  By default it is configured to protect your world spawn and the main end island.  

This mod dispose of the wither in a way that prevent player to get Nether Star or Wither Heads.  It help reduce abuse of this datapack mecanics.  

Tested on minecraft java version **1.20.4**.

## Installation
- Download the zip file named localised_wither_remover-1.0.0.zip from the project release page : [localised_wither_remover-1.0.0.zip](https://modrinth.com/datapack/localised-wither-remover/versions)
- Drop localised_wither_remover-1.0.0.zip in the .\world\datapack\ directory of your server
- Reboot your server or run the /reload command

## Protected Areas

### Overworld
The default mecanic of this datapack protect a range of 300 blocks centered on x=0 y=64 z=0 in the overworld.  
This correspond to SPAWN on most servers.  

### The End
The default mecanic of this datapact protect a range of 200 blocks centered on x=0 y=63 z=0 in the end.  
This protect the main island but also prevent wither skulls to go through the end portal and destroy your world spawn.   

## Protected Area Customization

Take a look at this section if you have custom world spawn coordinates. 

By default this datapack take for granted that your spawn is located ad x=0 y=64 z=0.  If you edited this value on your server, you need to modify this datapack to make it compatible and cover your actual spawn.

### How to modify Spawn coordinates
- Unzip this datapack to make the modifications
- Open .\data\localisedwitherremover\functions\localisedwitherremover.mcfunction
- The spawn coordinate values can be modified by editing line 4 and line 7
- Drop the edited datapack in the \world\datapack\ directory of your server

**Line 4**
```
execute in minecraft:overworld run tp @e[type=wither,x=<SPAWN_X_COORD>,y=<SPAWN_Y_COORD>,z=<SPAWN_Z_COORD>,distance=..<RANGE>] -15 -65 -15
```

**Line 7**
```
execute in minecraft:overworld run kill @e[type=wither,x=<SPAWN_X_COORD>,y=<SPAWN_Y_COORD>,z=<SPAWN_Z_COORD>,distance=..<RANGE>]
```
**Values description**
- <SPAWN_X_COORD> : Spawn X value.  Default value = 0
- <SPAWN_Y_COORD> : Spawn Y value.  Default value = 64
- <SPAWN_Z_COORD> : Spawn Z value.  Default value = 0
- < RANGE > : Range of the area protected.  Default value = 300

### EXTRA
- To disable Spawn protection you need to put a # in front of lines 4 and 7.
- To disable End protection you need to put a # in front of lines 10 and 13
- This script is made to run every 5 seconds, you can adjust this value in ticks by adjusting `100t` line 17.

# ⚔️ HoldToAttack
**HoldToAttack** is a simple, lightweight client-side Quality of Life mod that perfects your combat experience. No more spam-clicking or mistiming your hits! 
With this mod, you can simply **hold down your attack button** (left-click by default), and the game will automatically strike at the exact moment your weapon's attack cooldown is fully reset (100% strength). 
### ✨ Features
* **Perfect Timing:** Always deals maximum damage by waiting for the attack cooldown indicator to fill up before swinging.
* **Save Your Mouse (and Fingers):** Say goodbye to carpal tunnel and broken mice from intense PvP or mob farming.
* **Fully Client-Side:** Works on **any** multiplayer server or realm without needing to be installed on the server! 
* **Smart Targeting:** The mod intelligently checks if you are actually looking at a valid target before swinging, preventing random air attacks.
* **Seamless Vanilla Feel:** Doesn't add any new items, blocks, or messy GUIs—just improves the vanilla combat mechanics.
### ❓ FAQ
**Can I use this on a multiplayer server?**
Yes! Since this is a 100% client-side mod, it works perfectly on any server, regardless of whether the server has the mod installed or not. *(Note: Always check the rules of competitive servers like Hypixel to ensure auto-attackers/macros are allowed!)*

**Which mod loader does this require?**
Currently, Fabric and Neoforge.

**Will there be others?** You are free to contribute.

# Vanilla by ItsRomik
![Modpack Vibe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6554b53008b1f5db14c28d149efd7a5e8c936591.jpeg)

## 🌿 The Idea

**Vanilla by ItsRomik** started as a personal modpack made just for me and my friends.  
The goal was simple — show how great **Minecraft** can look and feel with the right **client-side mods**, while keeping the original vanilla gameplay.

This modpack doesn’t try to change Minecraft.  
Instead, it carefully improves the experience with **quality-of-life features, visual enhancements, and performance optimizations**.

The result is a **clean Vanilla+ experience** that feels familiar, but smoother, prettier, and more comfortable to play.

[Creating a custom resource pack](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/)
---

## ⚙️ Performance

The modpack includes multiple performance improvements to make the game run **much smoother**:

- 🚀 **Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore** — major FPS and memory optimizations  
- 🌐 **Krypton, Packet Fixer** — network optimizations  
- 👁 **EntityCulling, MoreCulling, SmartParticles** — reduce unnecessary rendering  
- 📦 **ImmediatelyFast** — faster UI rendering  

---

## 🎨 Visual Improvements

Minecraft becomes more alive and atmospheric with many subtle visual upgrades:

- ☁️ **Better Clouds** — beautiful dynamic clouds  
- 🌧 **Particle Rain** and **Particular** — improved particles and weather  
- 💥 **Explosive Enhancement** — new explosion animations  
- 🌬 **Windy** — wind particles in the sky  
- 💡 **LambDynamicLights** — dynamic lighting  
- 🎭 **Entity Model Features** & **Entity Texture Features** — dynamic entity models and textures  

Shader support is also included via **Iris**.

---

## 🧭 Interface & Information

Several mods improve the interface and provide useful gameplay information:

- 📊 **Better Statistics Screen** — expanded statistics  
- 🎯 **Advancements Reloaded** — improved advancements screen  
- 🍎 **AppleSkin** — hunger and saturation information  
- 🔎 **Jade** — information about blocks and entities  
- 📋 **BetterF3** — customizable debug screen  

---

## 🧰 Quality of Life

Many small improvements make everyday gameplay much more comfortable:

- 📦 **Inventory Profiles Next** — inventory sorting and tools  
- 🖱 **Mouse Tweaks** — better inventory mouse controls  
- 📦 **Shulker Box Tooltip** — preview shulker contents  
- 🔍 **Chest Tracker** — search through containers

## 🗺 Exploration

Navigation and exploration are easier with:

- 🗺 **Xaero's Minimap**  
- 🌍 **Xaero's World Map**  
- 🔭 **Zoomify**  

---

title: Ultimate AntiCrasher
description: It prevents all possible Minecraft crashes caused by server plugins.
body:
A client-side Minecraft mod that protects you from "crasher" servers — servers
that try to freeze or crash your game on purpose, usually to grief you or
troll you. It works quietly in the background: you won't see it doing
anything, you'll just notice your game *doesn't* crash when it normally
would.

Works with **Fabric and Quilt**, on every major Minecraft version from
**1.16.5 up to the current 26.2**.

[![Available for Fabric](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/513035d1231a86dff137c74e04a5e64633593f10.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/ultimate-anticrasher/versions?l=fabric)
[![Available for Quilt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9ee492fd1a5fcbcc14d4105aa27be63f2518529.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/ultimate-anticrasher/versions?l=quilt)

## What it protects you from

**Crash packets.** Some malicious servers send fake "explosion" or "particle
effect" messages with broken, absurd values (like an explosion happening a
billion blocks away, or a firework spawning thousands of particles at once).
A normal client tries to process this and freezes or crashes. This mod
recognizes when a packet like that is clearly not a real, normal explosion or
particle effect, and quietly throws it away before it can cause any trouble.
You'll never notice — actual explosions and actual particle effects always
look completely normal.

**Giant nametags.** Some servers try to crash you by giving a player or a mob
an absurdly long name — thousands of characters — hoping your game will choke
trying to draw it above their head. This mod caps any nametag at 64
characters; anything longer gets cut off with `...` at the end, so it's still
readable but can never be used to freeze your game.

**Advancement spam.** Some servers try to freeze you by granting and revoking
every advancement over and over in a tight loop, flooding you with rebuilds
and toast popups all at once. This mod holds those updates back while the
flood is happening and only lets them through once the server goes quiet for
a few seconds, so nothing is lost — it's just applied smoothly instead of all
at once.

That's it — the mod doesn't change how you play, doesn't add any items,
settings, or keybinds, and doesn't affect servers that behave normally.

No configuration needed — it just works.!

title: SpaceFrog's Real Pet Frogs
description: You can tame & make frogs your pets similar to wolves & cats. They get power-ups, they'll teleport to you on your adventures, or summon them as a mighty Frog Squad! They'll even defend you from hostile mobs (see details).
body:
Have you ever wanted to tame a frog, making them a pet the way you can wolves and cats? Well now you can! This datapack lets you take ownership of frogs using a name tag, the frog will get some great power-ups, they'll always remember they're your beloved pet, ant they'll teleport to you just like tamed wolves. And if you have [***SpaceFrog's Hungry Hungry Frogs***](https://modrinth.com/datapack/spacefrogs-hungry-hungry-frogs) datapack running alongside this datapack, **they'll also defend you from monsters!**

![A powered-up pet frog](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b230442ae8ebe556a46458ff46fe69b08cd1e9d5.jpeg)
<hr>

### How to Tame a Frog
To tame a frog, just rename a frog "pet" using a name tag while you hold the adoption fee in your off-hand. The adoption fee is 1 diamond (this fee is adjustable by creative-users & server-ops, you can change this fee to any other item in the game or turn off the adoption fee all together making adoption free). The name tag will not get used up, so you can reuse it as many times as you want to adopt as many frogs as you want. When you adopt a frog, they'll be automatically given a special frog name, but you're also free to rename your pet frog to anything you'd like.

### Pet Frog Power-Ups
Love is a powerful thing - when a frog becomes your pet, they'll get **regeneration, resistance, and fire resistance effects** permanently. They'll also gain the ability to **teleport** to you like tamed wolves do. They'll roam around up to 20 blocks (user adjustable to 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, or 30 blocks) and then teleport back to you. If you want your pet frog to stay put, just attach a lead to them and then unleash them, that tells them not to teleport to you any more – you do **not** need to keep the lead attached, just the act of interacting with the frog using a lead will trigger them to stay put. If you want your pet frog to resume teleporting to you, **hold a slime ball in your off-hand while you attached a lead** – again, you don't need to keep the lead attached, just briefly leashing them while also holding a slime ball triggers them to resume teleporting. Frogs, however, aren’t exactly like tamed wolves, they have minds of their own and will wander around like typical frogs if you disable their teleportation.

### Compatibility with Hungry Hungry Frogs
This datapack is compatible with [***SpaceFrog's Hungry Hungry Frogs***](https://modrinth.com/datapack/spacefrogs-hungry-hungry-frogs), which allows all frogs in the world the ability to **eat any hostile mob** in the game. Some mobs will take more than one "bite" like Wardens and Ravagers, but typical hostiles like zombies, skeletons, and creepers will go down with a single hit from a frog. You can keep your pet frogs around your base for protection or if you let them teleport, you can bring them on your adventures to keep the hostile mobs at bay. **If you're injured by a mob, your frogs will instantly teleport to your location to defend you!** Who needs tamed wolves or human friends when you've got a Frog Squad! It's highly recommended you install both this datapack and Hungry Hungry Frogs to get the full experience of having a your pet frogs devour hostiles while caving or take on a Warden or Wither; otherwise, without Hungry Hungry Frogs, your pet frogs will mostly just be there to keep you company and serenade your with gentle frog sounds, which is still nice. However, even without Hungry Hungry Frogs running, your pet frogs will now be able to eat **ALL SIZES** of slimes and magma cubes, so they can at least defend you from those hostiles.

### Mass Frog Teleportation
In case you've lost track of your pet frogs or you want to summon all of your pet frogs to a specific location regardless of their teleportation setting (see above), you can use one of two methods: The easiest one is to use an Eye of Ender – just hold a slime ball in your off-hand and throw an Eye of Ender, this will teleport all your pet frogs from any loaded chunks to your exact location as a mighty Frog Squad. The other method is to activate a beacon while holding a slime ball in your off-hand – this will teleport all of your pet frogs to the beacon. Note that the frogs must be in loaded chunks in order for them to teleport. These mass teleportation methods could also come in pretty handy if you have the Hungry Hungry Frogs datapack running and you want to summon an army of frogs to help you take on a boss or a horde of zombies.

### Multi-Player/Server Compatibility
A pet frog database is maintained in the world data folder where all pet frogs are recorded for each player on a server (up to 256 players). Pet frogs will never be forgotten.

### Bucket-of-Frog Compatibility
This datapack is mostly compatible with the [***Bucket of Frogs***](https://modrinth.com/mod/bucket-of-frog) mod, which, as the name implies, allows you to put frogs in buckets like a number of other mobs in the game. A lot of information about the mob is lost when you put them in a bucket, so once you dispense your pet frog from a bucket, the ownership data needs to be re-written to the frog. This is normally not a problem, and in single-player worlds you'll never notice a problem, but in multi-player worlds, if another play happens to be standing closer to the frog than you are when you dispense them, the frog will be assigned to the other player as their pet. To ensure you stay their owner, just make sure to dispense the frog close to you if there are other players nearby. 

### Configuring the Datapack
There are configs you can adjust in this datapack either using commands or special configuration files you drop into your datapacks folder (coming soon, will be available under additional file downloads). This will let you adjust the pet frog adoption fee, disable the adoption fee (making adoption free), adjust the distance from the play that pet frogs will roam before teleporting back to the player, and disable pet frog teleportation altogether.

title: Pala's Item Clear
description: Server-side item cleaner that removes dropped items on a timer with colored warnings, powerful filters, and a recovery bin to undo mistakes. A modern, configurable ClearLag alternative for Forge, Fabric, and NeoForge from Minecraft 1.20.1 to 26.2.
body:
# Pala's Item Clear

![Colored chat warnings counting down before a clear, then a "Cleared 7 dropped items" confirmation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Palawizard/PalasItemClear/main/docs/assets/screen%201.png)

**Pala's Item Clear** is a lightweight, **server-side** mod that automatically **clears dropped items** on your Minecraft server to **reduce lag** and keep the ground clean. It is a modern, fully configurable alternative to classic **clear-lag / ClearLagg** mods, and it runs on **Forge, Fabric, and NeoForge** across every Minecraft version from **1.20.1 to 26.2**.

Players do **not** need to install anything: the mod is server-side only, and vanilla clients can connect normally.

## Why Pala's Item Clear

- **Reduce server lag** caused by piles of dropped item entities on the ground.
- **Fair warnings** so players can pick up loot before a clear: colored chat messages at 60, 30, and 5 seconds (all configurable).
- **Recovery bin** to undo mistakes: recently cleared items are kept briefly in memory and can be restored through a vanilla chest interface, with optional per-player filtering.
- **Precise control** with filters by item, dimension, item age, custom name, and player ownership.
- **No client mod required.** One less thing for your players to install.

## Features

- Automatic item clearing on a configurable timer (five minutes by default)
- Colored, configurable warning messages (MiniMessage-style formatting)
- Filters: excluded items, excluded dimensions, minimum age, named items, player-owned items
- In-game admin commands: status, next clear, clear now, pause, resume, reset, reload, live settings
- Recovery bin: `/palasitemclear bin [player]` opens a chest to restore recently cleared items
- Safe by design: runs on the server thread, only touches loaded levels, and never removes inventories, blocks, or non-item entities

## Commands

`/palasitemclear` (permission level 2) — help, `status`, `next`, `clear`, `bin [player]`, `pause`, `resume`, `reset`, `reload`, `set interval <seconds>`.

## Compatibility

Separate, individually tested builds for Forge, Fabric, and NeoForge, covering every Minecraft band from 1.20.1 to 26.2 with no gaps. Download the file that matches your Minecraft version and loader. Fabric builds require Fabric API.

## Keywords

clear items, clear lag, clearlag, clearlagg, item cleaner, dropped item removal, ground item cleanup, reduce lag, server performance, entity cleanup, auto clear, server-side, recovery bin.

title: eXc BetterMending
description: Turn Mending into an active ability — Press R to instantly repair your gear using your own XP.
body:
# eXc BetterMending

Tired of waiting for Mending to slowly sip your XP orbs one at a time? **eXc BetterMending** turns Mending into an *active* ability. Hold a Mending-enchanted tool, weapon, or piece of armor, **Shift + Left-click**, and instantly pour your experience into repairing it — right when you need it.

## Features
- **On-demand repair** — Shift + Left-click a held item to repair it using your current XP.
- **Works with any Mending item** — tools, weapons, and armor all supported.
- **Vanilla-accurate rate** — 1 experience point restores 2 durability, just like regular Mending.
- **Smart spending** — one click repairs as much as it can; fully if you have enough XP, otherwise as far as your XP reaches.
- **Server-safe** — all repairs are handled server-side, so no desync and no cheating. Great for multiplayer.
- **Zero config, zero clutter** — no new items, no GUI, no keybinds to set up. It just works.

## How to use
1. Hold a **damaged** item that has the **Mending** enchantment in your main hand.
2. Press **R** (or your chosen key).
3. Your XP is spent and the item's durability is restored. A soft chime confirms the repair.

Nothing happens if the item is undamaged, has no Mending, or you have no XP — so your normal left-click is never in the way.
