title: MythicWeaponsUltimate
description: Adds 6 Mythic Weapons in Minecraft! With Custom Abilities, Textures and much more!
body:
# 🔮 MythicWeapons Ultimate
## ⚡ The Ultimate Custom Weapons Experience for PaperMC 1.21+
## 🕒 Short Description (Quick & Easy Overview)
MythicWeapons Ultimate is a custom weapon plugin for Minecraft servers. It adds 6 legendary weapons to your game. Each weapon has its own custom 3D look, helpful passive perks, and powerful special abilities.

**Easy Crafting:** Players can craft every weapon directly in a normal survival crafting table.

**Custom Textures:** Every weapon uses unique textures (CustomModelData), so they look completely different from standard Minecraft items.

**No Lag:** Built to run smoothly, even on big servers with lots of players.

**100% Safe:** Players cannot cheat or fake these items using anvils.

## 📜 Long Description (Full Guide & Every Feature)
MythicWeapons Ultimate makes combat on your server much more exciting. It is perfect for survival, RPG, or PvP servers. Here is exactly how every weapon works, how to craft them, and how they look!

## 🗡️ The Mythic Weapon Arsenal
### 🩸 Blood Blade
A powerful sword for players who love to go on the attack.

**How it looks:** A custom, blood-red blade texture.

**Passive Perk:** Gives you permanent Strength while you hold the sword in your hand.

**Active Ability (Blood Throw):** Right-click to throw your sword forward. It flies through the air, pierces through multiple enemies in a straight line, and deals exactly 5 hearts of damage to everyone it hits.

**Crafting Recipe:**

Top Row: 1x Spieder Eye | 1x Emerald Block | 1x Spider Eye

Middle Row: 1x Golden Apple | 1x Netherite Sword | 1x Golden Apple

Bottom Row: 1x Spider Eye | 1x Golden Apple | 1x Spider Eye

### 🪓 Titanium Axe
A heavy axe made for fast combat and crowd control.

**How it looks:** A heavy, futuristic titanium axe texture.

**Passive Perk:** Gives you Haste V. This makes your axe swing incredibly fast for fluid combat.

**Active Ability (Ground Smash):** Right-click to smash the ground. It creates a big shockwave that knocks back nearby enemies. The particles automatically match the blocks you are standing on (like grass, sand, or stone), but it will not destroy any blocks on your map.

**Crafting Recipe:**

Top Row: 1x Iron Block | 1x Gray Candle | 1x Iron Block

Middle Row: 1x Feather | 1x Netherite Axe | 1x Feather~~~~

Bottom Row: 1x Iron Block | 1x Feather | 1x Iron Block

### 🏹 Frozen Crossbow
The ultimate weapon for keeping your distance and slowing down fast enemies.

**How it looks:** A frost-covered crossbow with custom loading and shooting animations.

**Passive Perk:** Any normal arrow you shoot will apply a Slowness effect to the target.

**Active Ability (Arrow Rain):** Right-click to shoot a massive burst of ice arrows into the sky. When they land, they freeze and slow down entire groups of enemies at once.

**Crafting Recipe:**

Top Row: 1x Packed Ice | 1x Ominous Trial Key | 1x Packed Ice

Middle Row: 1x Gold Block | 1x Crossbow | 1x Gold Block

Bottom Row: 1x Packed Ice | 1x Gold Block | 1x Packed Ice

### 🔱 Void Trident
A legendary weapon for stealth, underwater movement, and teleportation.

**How it looks:** A dark, glowing purple trident from the void.

**Passive Perk:** Gives you permanent Dolphin's Grace and Water Breathing while holding it.

**Active Ability 1 (Void Cloak):** Shift + Right-click to become completely invisible to all other players for 10 seconds. It has a built-in safety system: if you log out while invisible, you will become visible again automatically so you don't get bugged.

**Active Ability 2 (Void Rift):** Right-click to instantly teleport up to 50 blocks in the direction you are looking. It features an anti-glitch system that prevents you from getting stuck inside walls.

**Crafting Recipe:**

Top Row: 1x Echo Shard | 1x Heart of the Sea | 1x Echo Shard

Middle Row: 1x Ender Pearl | 1x Trident | 1x Ender Pearl

Bottom Row: 1x Echo Shard | 1x Glowstone Dust | 1x Echo Shard

### ☄️ Inferno Mace
An explosive weapon made to complement the standard Minecraft mace mechanics.

**How it looks:** A fiery, heavy nether-themed mace.

**Passive Perk:** You take zero fall damage, allowing you to jump from any height to land epic mace attacks.

**Active Ability 1 (Inferno Pull):** Right-click an enemy from up to 30 blocks away to pull them through the air directly to your feet.

**Active Ability 2 (Hell Boost):** Shift + Right-click to create a fire explosion at your feet that launches you high up into the air. This is optimized so it won't trigger anti-cheat plugins.

**Crafting Recipe:**

Top Row: 1x Blaze Rod | 1x Nether Star | 1x Blaze Rod

Middle Row: 1x Diamond Block | 1x Mace | 1x Diamond Block

Bottom Row: 1x Blaze Rod | 1x Diamond Block | 1x Blaze Rod

### ⚡ Storm Shield
The ultimate defensive tool to protect yourself and turn enemy attacks against them.

**How it looks:** A large electric shield with custom blocking textures.

**Passive Perk:** Gives you permanent Resistance II when held in either your main hand or your offhand.

**Active Ability 1 (Divine Protection):** Shift + Right-click to become completely immune to all damage for 5 seconds. This effect safely stops if you leave the server, preventing godmode glitches.

**Active Ability 2 (Damage Reflect):** Right-click right before getting hit to absorb the enemy's attack and reflect 100% of the damage back at them.

**Crafting Recipe:**

Top Row: 1x Experience Bottle | 1x Netherite Ingot | 1x Experience Bottle

Middle Row: 1x Firework Star | 1x Shield | 1x Firework Star

Bottom Row: 1x Experience Bottle | 1x Firework Star | 1x Experience Bottle

### ⏳ Simple Cooldown System
To keep gameplay fair, players cannot spam the special abilities.

**Action Bar Timer:** When an ability is used, a clean timer appears right above the player's hotbar (for example, §c4.5s).

**Ready Message:** When the cooldown finishes, it clearly displays §aReady!.

**No Server Lag:** Cooldowns are instantly cleared from the server memory when they run out, keeping the server fast.

### 🛡️ Anti-Cheat & Exploit Protection
**Anvil Safe:** The plugin does not check the name of the item. It checks a hidden server-side number (CustomModelData 1001 to 1006). If a player renames a normal diamond sword to "Blood Blade" in an anvil, it will just be a normal diamond sword. They cannot cheat the system.

### 🔧 Commands & Setup
**Compatibility:** Works perfectly on PaperMC 1.21+ and uses Java 21+.

**Admin Command:** Admins can easily give items to players using:

/giveweapon <player> <weapon>

Permission needed: mythicweapons.command.give

* A built-in expression engine for math-driven power values.

title: SuperAccessTransformer
description: Set the modifiers of most classes to public and non-final runtime attributes, and support their use during the development.
body:
# English

SuperAccessTransformer (SAT) is an open-source coremod for Minecraft 1.21+ that modifies access modifiers at runtime by injecting a Java Agent, converting most `private`, `protected`, and `final` members to `public`. It also includes a Gradle plugin, allowing the transformations to work in development environments without extra JVM arguments.

## Core Functionality

**Runtime Bytecode Transformation**: Uses the `java.lang.instrument` API along with the ASM library to intercept class loading and modify bytecode. The transformation:

+   Removes `private`, `protected`, and `final` modifiers from fields and adds `public` 
    
+   Removes `private`, `protected`, and `final` modifiers from methods (except `<clinit>`) and adds `public`
    
+   Skips interfaces and enum `$VALUES` fields
    

## Development Environment Support

**Gradle Plugin Integration**: Add the SAT Gradle plugin to your project to enable transformation at development time. The plugin is compatible with both Fabric and NeoForge modules.

```
buildscript {
    dependencies {
        classpath 'io.github.yiyuyan:SuperAccessTransformerPlugin:1.000'
    }
}
apply plugin: 'io.github.yiyuyan.sat-plugin'
```

You can also find an example setup for Architectury NeoForge 1.21 at the `test` branch: [yiyuyan/SuperAccessTransformer (test)](https://github.com/yiyuyan/SuperAccessTransformer/tree/test)

## Known Limitations & Notes

+   **Fabric Loader Dev Environment**: `Mob::rotlerp` and `WitherBoss::rotlerp` methods will **not** be transformed.
    
+   **NeoForge Mod List**: As a coremod using the `lowcodefml` loader, SAT does **not** appear in the NeoForge mod list.
    

# 简体中文

SuperAccessTransformer（SAT）是一个面向 Minecraft 1.21+ 的开源 coremod，通过在运行时注入 Java Agent，将大多数 `private`、`protected` 和 `final` 修饰符转换为 `public`。该模组还提供 Gradle 插件，使得转换在开发环境中也能直接生效，无需额外 JVM 参数。

## 核心功能

**运行时字节码转换**：利用 `java.lang.instrument` API 与 ASM 库拦截类加载过程并修改字节码。转换规则如下：

+   移除字段的 `private`、`protected` 和 `final` 修饰符，并添加 `public`
    
+   移除方法（`<clinit>` 除外）的 `private`、`protected` 和 `final` 修饰符，并添加 `public`
    
+   跳过接口和枚举的 `$VALUES` 字段
    

## 开发环境支持

通过 Gradle 插件可在开发环境中启用运行时转换，同时适用于 Fabric 与 NeoForge 模块.

```
buildscript {
    dependencies {
        classpath 'io.github.yiyuyan:SuperAccessTransformerPlugin:1.000'
    }
}
apply plugin: 'io.github.yiyuyan.sat-plugin'
```

你也可以参考针对 Architectury NeoForge 1.21 的示例项目：[yiyuyan/SuperAccessTransformer at test](https://github.com/yiyuyan/SuperAccessTransformer/tree/test)

## 已知限制与提示

+   **Fabric Loader 开发环境**：`Mob::rotlerp` 和 `WitherBoss::rotlerp` 这两个方法不会被转换。
    
+   **NeoForge 模组列表**：该模组基于 `lowcodefml` 加载器，作为 coremod 不会出现在 NeoForge 模组列表中。

title: Create: Backtanks Expanded
description: Create addon for expanding backtanks functionality with modular upgrades
body:
1.3.0

![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/W7ztsOK4/images/c6dc5caaeced8010dbe1e4605a6c560ce2487a70.png)

# Description

This Create addon adds 1 new block and 5 new items to expand the functionality of your backtanks.

# Backtank Upgrade Station.

When redstone powered with non-upgraded backtank on top: equips backtank with upgrades from nearby connected depots.  
When redstone powered with upgraded backtank on top: strips backtank upgrades onto nearby connected depots.

Crafting recipe (shaped crafting): Smithing Table above. Depot below.

![Backtank Upgrade Station recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/W7ztsOK4/images/3dff3b67e3ad281e7fef014f96df7bf8a63959b3.png)

# Hover Upgrade.

+3 Hover Distance. (Max: 12).

Hover: Fly and stay grounded as long as you can reach nearby blocks. Works with Sable sub-levels.

Crafting recipe (shapeless crafting): Andesite Alloy + Extendo-Grip.

![Hover Upgrade recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/W7ztsOK4/images/72a25e2a22f942694af5f18dacf378321b047bec.png)

# Pressurized Air Regeneration Upgrade.

+2 Pressurized air per second. (Max: 128).

Doesn't have a crafting recipe

# Elytra Upgrade.

+Elytra Flight. Doesn't stack.

Crafting recipe (shapeless crafting): Andesite Alloy + Elytra

![Elytra Upgrade recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/W7ztsOK4/images/11bf03baf0d2f57c50499ec224ad082322fe5d69.png)

# Speed Upgrade

+5% Move Speed. (Max: 320%)

Crafting recipe (shapeless crafting): Andesite Alloy + 3 Sugar.

![Speed Upgrade recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/W7ztsOK4/images/4ddc0a08487f048233456a098e9de9d5538a9675.png)

# Defence Upgrade

+Defence against most damage sources. Knockback Multiplier: 1.2 (Max: 16). Knockback Radius: 5 (Max: 80). Consumes 60 Pressurized Air on Use

Defence: Wearer blocks incoming damage and releases a wind burst that knockbacks entities away.

Crafting recipe (shapeless crafting): Andesite Alloy + Breeze Rod + Shield + Nozzle.

![Defence Upgrade recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/W7ztsOK4/images/79bce1ec74a02e98bec2d3643501d435914e02ae.png)

# Fluid Tank Upgrade

Stores 1000mB of any fluid. Doesn't stack

Crafting recipe (shapeless crafting): Copper Sheet + Bucket.

![Fluid Tank upgrade](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/W7ztsOK4/images/39ebdb3cad49c9cd010223bb83e5fcdb54472a37.png)

# Auto Drink Upgrade

Automatically consumes potion fluids from Fluid Tank Upgrades on the equipped Backtank to apply their effect on the owner. Consumes 250mB on apply. Doesn't stack

Crafting recipe (shapeless crafting): Copper Sheet + Copper Diving Helmet.

![Auto Drink Upgrade](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/W7ztsOK4/images/802c9ae1cff02308f06ad85d686532b281fc8bdb.png)

# Why so few upgrades?

Upgrades are designed to help you with Create and Aeronautics related stuff such as making building and maintaining your contraptions more comfortable. Upgrades like simple stat bonuses are not considered (Maybe I will create a separate addon that adds simple stat bonuses as upgrades). Honestly I just wanted to have something like Hover Upgrade to solve a problem of building on an airborne and angled sub-level.

# Mod Compatibilities

*   Hover Upgrade works with Sable sub-levels.
*   Backtank Upgrade Station should accept all depots (tested with Create: Encased depots).
*   Backtank Upgrade Station should be able to upgrade all backtanks (tested with Create: Jetpacks).
*   Auto Drink Upgrade should apply all possible potion effects and all fluids that have Builder's Tea tag

# TO-DO

*   Unprogrammer art.
*   More useful upgrades.
*   Utilise Create ponder and tooltips.
*   Make Elytra Upgrade effect stackable.
*   Make Auto Drink effect stackable.
*   More translations if possible.
*   Add viewbob to Hover Upgrade hovering.
*   Add cool Extendo-Grip spider limbs visual for Hover Upgrade.
*   Make hovering always keep velocity of the nearest sub-level.
*   Fabric port.
*   Optimize Hover Upgrade and remove the limit.
*   Fix Pressurized Air Regenereration feature.
*   Make conditional Pressurized Air Regeneration feature.
*   Filtering for Auto Drink.
*   Make code good.

title: HideChat
description: Hide and show your chat instantly with a keybind — a clean, client-side Fabric mod with a quick green/red flash to confirm each toggle. Messages keep arriving in the background, so nothing is lost.
body:
# Chat Toggle

A lightweight, **client-side** Fabric mod that hides and shows your chat with a single keypress — with a clean visual confirmation each time.

## What it does
- Press a key (default **H**, under *Controls → Multiplayer*) to toggle the chat overlay on or off.
- Hiding is purely visual: messages still arrive and stack up in the background — **nothing is dropped**, and your vanilla chat settings are untouched.
- You can still open chat to type or run commands while it's hidden; you just won't see the history.
- Each toggle plays a quick **350 ms bar** at the chat line: **green** when chat is shown, **red** when hidden. It always plays — even with no messages on screen.

## Why
Sometimes chat gets in the way — screenshots, cinematic shots, PvP, or just a cleaner HUD. chat toggle gives you an instant, reversible way to clear it without digging through options or losing messages.

## Details
- Client-side only — works on any server, nothing needed server-side.
- No config files, no extra menus. Install and bind a key.
- Tiny footprint.

## Requirements
- Minecraft **26.2**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.3+**
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

## Install
1. Install Fabric for 26.2.
2. Put **Fabric API** and **chat toggle** in your `mods` folder.
3. Launch, then bind **Toggle Chat** under *Options → Controls → Multiplayer* (defaults to **H**).

title: Crown Core
description: This mod adds features and utilities for the Crown Championship server.
body:
# Crown Core

The official client mod for the **Crown Championship** server, built for **Minecraft 1.21.11** using Fabric.

Install Crown Core to get the full Crown Championship experience, including a team-coloured **kill feed HUD**, in-game video screens, and resource-pack error reporting.

---

## ✨ What it adds

### 💀 Kill feed HUD

* A polished, team-coloured kill feed showing **attacker → method → victim**, with inline player heads, kill-method icons, and kill-streak or assist badges.

### 📺 Video screens

* Allows the Crown Championship server to play videos during events, including game intros, trailers, announcements, and lobby content.

### 🧾 Resource-pack failure reporter

* If the Crown Championship resource pack fails to apply, the mod uploads the relevant section of your log to mclo.gs.
* A clickable and copyable link is then posted in chat, allowing staff to quickly determine why the resource pack failed to load.

---

## 📦 Requirements

| Dependency        |               Version | Notes    |
| ----------------- | --------------------: | -------- |
| **Fabric Loader** |              ≥ 0.16.0 | Required |
| **Fabric API**    | For Minecraft 1.21.11 | Required |

---

## 🚀 Installation

1. Install **Fabric Loader** for Minecraft 1.21.11.
2. Download **Fabric API** for Minecraft 1.21.11.
3. Place both the Fabric API jar and the Crown Core jar inside your Minecraft `mods` folder.
4. Launch the game and join the Crown Championship server.
5. Accept the server resource pack when prompted. The kill feed fonts, icons, and other assets are provided through the resource pack.

---

## 🎮 Commands

The primary player command is:

```text
/killfeed side
```

This moves the kill feed between the left and right sides of your screen.

Everything else, including kill feed visibility and video playback, is controlled by the Crown Championship server.

---

## ❓ FAQ

### The kill feed icons or player heads do not appear.

Make sure you accepted the Crown Championship resource pack. The kill-method icons and custom fonts are supplied by it.

Player heads and team colours may only appear correctly for players who are currently online and participating in the event.

### Can I use this mod on other servers?

Crown Core is built specifically for the Crown Championship server. Features such as the kill feed, video system, and resource-pack integration rely on the server's companion plugin and infrastructure, so the mod will not do anything meaningful on most other servers.

---

## 🙏 Credits and license

* Original **Video Player** mod by **NGoedix**: https://github.com/NGoedix/WatchVideoMod
* Kill feed design inspired by the **[Trident](https://modrinth.com/mod/trident-mcci)** mod and reimplemented using vanilla `GuiGraphics`

---

## ⚠️ Development notice

Some features in this mod were created with the assistance of AI while I continue learning Java. The code is still reviewed, tested, and maintained for use on the Crown Championship server.

Released under the **CC0-1.0** license.

Enhance your Minecraft journey with two incredible size-altering armors! The Size Shifter Expansion introduces the powerful **Giant Armor** and the stealthy **Shrink Armor** sets, utilizing Minecraft's native attribute systems to change your physical scale and capabilities.

With the **Giant Armor**, you gain overwhelming offensive power and extreme reach, but you must navigate the world with a significantly larger hitbox.
With the **Shrink Armor**, your strength is reduced, but your minuscule size lets you slip into narrow gaps, secret passages, and 0.5-block spaces.

description: Displays coordinates, direction, biome and locator bar while holding a compass. Compass ∙ Death Compass ∙ Locator Bar ∙ Lodestone
body:
![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-3.5.0-1E90FF?style=for-the-badge) ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.6+-4C9A2A?style=for-the-badge) ![Loaders](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loaders-Fabric%20%7C%20Forge-FF6B35?style=for-the-badge) ![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21+-ED8B00?style=for-the-badge&logo=openjdk&logoColor=white) [![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/compasslocator-kasperoid?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white&color=00AF5C&label=downloads)](https://modrinth.com/mod/compasslocator-kasperoid) ![Side](https://img.shields.io/badge/side-client%20%26%20server-9B4DCA?style=for-the-badge) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-channel-26A5E4?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/pro100chnl)
--- ## 📌 What is this? **CompassLocator** is a client-side mod for Minecraft 1.21.6+ that adds useful compass information directly to the action bar. A port of the CompassLocator plugin, now with even more features and an **in-game config GUI**. No more opening F3. Just hold a compass and see: - where you are - which direction you're facing - what biome you're in - where you died last time - players around you on the radar --- ## ✨ Features **Normal Compass** - Coordinates (adjustable precision — integer or decimal) - Current biome - Cardinal direction (North/South or N/S) - Time of day (optional) - World name (optional) - **Lodestone support** — shows the coordinates your compass is linked to, even if broken (shows last known position) **Recovery Compass** - Where you last died (coordinates) - Which world - Time since death - Distance to death location **Combined Mode** - Hold a normal compass in one hand and a recovery compass in the other - The action bar shows information from both at once **PvP/HCF-style Locator Bar** - See nearby players on your radar - Shows player direction relative to you - Perfect for competitive gameplay **In-Game Configuration GUI** - Full configuration menu right in your game - No need to edit files manually (but you still can) - Changes apply instantly --- ## 🖼️ Gallery
| Normal Compass | Recovery Compass | Combined Mode | Locator Bar | |:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:| | | | | | | In-Game Config GUI | Lodestone (Working) | Lodestone (Broken) | |:---:|:---:|:---:| | | | |
--- ## 🎮 Usage Simply hold a compass in your hand. That's it. The mod works with both hands — main hand and offhand. --- ## 🛠 Configuration The mod offers two ways to configure everything: | Method | What you can do | |:------:|:----------------| | **In-Game GUI** | Change settings on the fly, see changes immediately | | **YAML Files** | `config.yml` and `lang.yml` — all original plugin settings preserved | You can toggle every feature individually, change colors, adjust update frequency, and much more. --- ## 📥 Installation ### Fabric 1. Install **Fabric Loader** for Minecraft 1.21.6+ 2. Put **Fabric API** and **CompassLocator** in your `mods/` folder 3. Launch the game ### Forge 1. Install **Forge** for Minecraft 1.21.6+ 2. Put **CompassLocator** in your `mods/` folder 3. Launch the game --- ## 📦 Dependencies ### Fabric **Required:** - Fabric API **Optional (recommended):** - Mod Menu — for the configuration screen - Cloth Config API — for advanced config options ### Forge No required dependencies. --- ## ⚙️ Requirements - **Minecraft 1.21.6+** - **Java 21** ---
🔄 There's also a server plugin version! A server-side plugin for Paper/Spigot/Purpur on Minecraft 1.21+. 👉 [CompassLocator — Plugin Version](https://modrinth.com/plugin/compasslocator)
--- ## ❓ FAQ
Do I need to install anything on the server? No. This is a client-side mod. It works on any server, even vanilla.
Does it work in multiplayer? Yes. The Locator Bar shows other players even if they don't have the mod installed.
What's the difference between the mod and the plugin? The plugin runs on the server. The mod runs on your client and has access to more features (like the in-game GUI and client-side optimizations).
Do I need Mod Menu and Cloth Config? No, but they're recommended. Without them, you can still edit `config.yml` manually.
Does the compass work in both hands? Yes, you can hold it in either hand. Both are checked.

title: Final Tinted Touch (FTT)
description: A mod that optimizes the enchantment order of your equipment.
body:
# Final Tinted Touch

FTT helps you fully max out the enchantments on your gear. It is even compatible with mods that add new or modify existing enchantments!

To start, hover over an item and press X to open up a menu to that lets you choose which enchantments should be present in your maxed out items.
The menu features the list of all enchantments in the game, with the bars indicating incompatible paths. (ex. Sharpness | Bane of Arthropods | Smite; Loyalty, Channeling | Riptide)
It will let you choose certain profiles to save and configure.
If you have default profiles on, what is regarded as the best build will be automatically configured - note that this does not consider modded enchants.

Hovering over an item that is configured will list in orange the enchantments that need to be applied to the item to max it out. You can choose which items to show this menu on, including modded ones.

# Profiles

A Profile is a remembered loadout; the exact set of enchantments and levels you want, saved once and ready to pour onto any item you press X over.

Open the menu and look to the bottom right. That little bar is the whole system: `[ + ✔ | None ]`. Click anywhere on it and a dropdown climbs upward, listing **None** at the top, then **Default**, then every Profile you have made glowing green below.

The green ones are yours. Press `+` to make a new one; it grabs whatever you have selected on screen right then and lets you name it. Press the blue `✔` to save over the active Profile after you tweak it. Press the red `✕` to delete one you are done with.

**None** and **Default** are White Profiles. They are read-only; you cannot rename them, save over them, or delete them.

**Default** is the best build (community standard) there is for that item, maxed all the way out and already curated so nothing fights anything else. Every item carries its own Default; a sword's is not a pickaxe's. It ships inside the mod, so it reads the same on every world you join. Modded items usually have none, and that is fine; they simply fall back to None.

Flip on `defaultX` and the menu steps out of the way completely. Press X over a piece of gear and its Default lands instantly. If there is no Default to find, the regular menu opens like always.

You build the loadout once. The gear remembers.

# The Hover Guide

Hover an item you have configured and the enchantments it still needs glow orange right under its name. It is the running checklist for that piece of gear, and you decide which items get one, modded gear included.

The list is alive. Apply an enchantment at the anvil and it crosses itself off; the orange shrinks every time you do real work. Grind the item back down and the whole task lets go with it. You never have to remember where you left off. The item remembers for you.

# Cheapest Anvil Order

Anvils keep score. Every combine raises the prior work penalty, and a clumsy order makes the levels balloon, sometimes all the way to "Too Expensive!" before the build is even done.

FTT runs the math so you do not have to. Press Y and it hands you the cheapest order to fuse your books and gear together, plus exactly what that order will cost. Bind a key in Controls and you can pull the same plan up as a graph for whatever item you are hovering, a little tree of what marries what and when.

The solver thinks on its own thread, so even a monster build never stalls your game. You will see a quiet "Calculating..." while it works, then the answer drops in the moment it is ready. It remembers what it solved, so you only pay for the thinking once.

# Particularities

To open the maxing menu, you can press X while:
- Holding an Item in your Hand
- Handling an Item in a GUI
- Holding an Item in a GUI

Autofusing is a special mechanism to make the UI of the Enchantment Modification Menu a lot better by fusing options together across different paths.
Toggle UI is a different implementation of the selecting of Enchantments during the Enchantment Modification Menu.

You can press Y to open a menu of current tasks that are assigned. You can click the circle next to a task to see the graph of which order it should combine in, or you can also see it inlay. You can also assign a button to open the enchantmax graph of something naturally.

# Config

This mod is compatible with ModMenu.
The complete list of Config material is listed in `src/main/net/nosam08/enchantmaxxing/config/EnchantifyConfig.java`.
It's formatted in `json5` if you want to edit the file in config directly.

Everything this mod remembers lives under `config`, in plain readable files you can open, back up, or hand to a friend:

- `config/enchantify.json5` is the config itself; every option from `EnchantifyConfig.java`.
- `config/ftt/profiles/{profile_name}.json` is one file per green Profile you make. The name you type becomes the file name.
- `config/ftt/sp/<world>/profiles.json` and `config/ftt/mp/<server>/profiles.json` hold the live maxxing jobs you have started, kept per world and per server so a singleplayer save and a multiplayer server never step on each other.
- The White **Default** Profiles ride along inside the mod at `assets/enchantmaxxing/defaults.json`.

# Version Nomenclature

The nomenclature follows (MAJOR).(MINOR).(MINISCULE)

In a standardized UPDATE model to be specified with CHANGELOG, it is presented as the following:

| Type      | Repo Pattern | Description                    |
| --------- | ------------ | ------------------------------ |
| Major     | Milestone    | Large Update                   |
| Minor     | Issue        | New Feature                    |
| Miniscule | Commit       | Bug Fix, Dependency Bump, etc. |

Releases typically follow the (MILESTONE).(ISSUE).(COMMIT) pattern. Version 1.0.0 is essentially an MVP.

# Dependency Guide

The following table represents a guide for the dependencies used in what versions.

Starting with Minecraft 26.1, the game is **unobfuscated**: there are no Yarn mappings to download, the
build uses the non-remapping `net.fabricmc.fabric-loom` plugin, and **Java 25+** is required to run and to build.

| FTT               | Fabric Loader | Config Lib¹  | Owo Lib        | Mod Menu (optional) |
| ----------------- | ------------- | ------------ | -------------- | ------------------- |
| **2.1.0+26.1.x**  | 0.19.3        | 1.0.11+26.1  | 0.13.0+26.1    | 18.0.0-beta.1       |
| 2.0.0+1.21.11     | 0.19.3        | 21.11.153    | 0.13.0+1.21.11 | 17.0.0              |
| 2.0.0+1.21.10     | 0.19.3        | 20.0.149     | 0.12.24+1.21.9 | 16.0.1              |
| 2.0.0+1.21.9      | 0.19.3        | 20.0.149     | 0.12.24+1.21.9 | 16.0.1              |
| 2.0.0+1.21.8      | 0.19.3        | 19.0.147     | 0.12.23+1.21.8 | 15.0.2              |
| 2.0.0+1.21.7      | 0.19.3        | 19.0.147     | 0.12.23+1.21.8 | 15.0.2              |
| 2.0.0+1.21.6      | 0.19.3        | 19.0.147     | 0.12.21+1.21.6 | 15.0.2              |

| 2.0.0+1.21.4      | 0.19.3        | 17.0.144     | 0.12.20+1.21.4 | 13.0.3              |

¹ **Config Lib**: from `2.1.0+26.1.x` onward FTT uses [WalksyLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/walksylib) for its
config screen and persistence (the value shown is the WalksyLib version). Releases `2.0.0` and earlier used
[Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) instead.

title: iClearLag
description: The best Minecraft cleaner, fully customizable
body:
# 🧹 iClearLag - Optimized Performance & Lag Clearing
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6329ba5aee7d5b48c8999632cca291b603f3482.jpeg)
---
**iClearLag** is a premium-quality performance plugin designed for modern Minecraft servers (1.16 - 1.21+). It doesn't just clear items; it optimizes your server's TPS and FPS in real-time using advanced culling and AI management techniques.

---

> ## ✨ Key Features

- 🚀 **Smart Entity Clearing:** Fully customizable automated clearing of items, mobs, projectiles, and experience orbs.
- ⚡ **Real-time Optimizations:**
  - **Chunk Entity Culling:** Automatically prevents chunks from being overloaded with too many entities.
  - **Spawner AI Management:** Disable AI for mobs spawned from spawners to massively boost TPS on mob farms.
  - **Hopper Optimization:** Reduces the performance overhead of hopper inventory checks.
- 🎨 **Premium Aesthetics:**
  - **Pastel HEX Support:** Stunning modern color palette for all messages and interfaces.
  - **Dynamic BossBar:** A smooth, real-time countdown bar for upcoming clearings.
  - **Interactive Feedback:** Sound effects, particles, titles, and action bars for every event.
- 🌍 **Multi-Language Support:** Native support for **English** and **Spanish** with auto-switching based on your config.
- 📊 **Server Stats:** Real-time monitoring of TPS, entity counts, and memory usage.

---

> ## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/icl help` | Shows the help menu | None |
| `/icl time` | Shows time until next clearing | None |
| `/icl clear` | Forces a manual clearing | `iclearlag.admin` |
| `/icl reload` | Reloads the configuration | `iclearlag.admin` |
| `/icl stats` | View server performance stats | `iclearlag.admin` |

---

> ## ⚙️ Configuration

The plugin is designed to be plug-and-play but offers deep customization for power users.

### Language Auto-Switching
Simply set `language: "en"` or `language: "es"` in `config.yml`, run `/icl reload`, and the plugin will automatically update your `lang.yml` to the selected language!

---

> ## 🚀 Performance
> Built with Kotlin and highly optimized code, iClearLag ensures minimal impact on your main server tick while providing maximum stability.

---
> *Created with ❤️ by Ivonia Studio.*

There are no quest lines, forced progression or complicated mechanics.

We adopt classic performance mods to keep high frame rates and low resource usage, even on regular devices.

body:
# CoreBoost 
Experience Minecraft at its absolute peak.
Tired of stuttering and low frames? This pack is the ultimate lightweight optimization solution for Minecraft 1.21.11. Built on the high-performance Fabric loader, this collection strips away engine inefficiencies to deliver a butter-smooth, high-FPS experience.
Why This Pack?
Designed for creators and survivalists alike, this stack removes bottlenecks to ensure maximum stability. We have curated the most essential performance mods to give you the highest frame rates possible without compromising the vanilla feel.
## Core Enhancements:
**Rendering Power:** Replaces the engine with **Sodium** and boosts entity processing with **ImmediatelyFast.**
**Logic & Physics:** Optimizes game logic and network performance with **Lithium** and **Krypton** to eliminate micro-stutters.
**Memory Efficiency:** Drastically lowers your RAM footprint using ,*FerriteCore.,,
**Smart Resource Usage:** Includes **Dynamic FPS** to save power when minimized and **Entity Culling** to stop rendering hidden objects.

**RAM:** We recommend allocating **4GB–6GB** for the best performance.
_Built for speed. Built for stability._

title: Forgotten Horizons
description: A premium Vanilla+ exploration modpack for Minecraft 1.21.1. Discover breathtaking world generation, immersive audio, enhanced visuals, rare relics, exploration-driven progression, and a world designed for hundreds of hours of meaningful survival.
body:
# Forgotten Horizons

## 🚀 A Premium Vanilla+ Adventure for Minecraft 1.21.1

**Forgotten Horizons** turns Minecraft survival into a deeper, more immersive adventure while keeping the heart of vanilla intact.

No bloated tech trees.
No confusing magic systems.
No quest book telling you how to play.

Just a richer world, better exploration, stronger atmosphere, rare rewards, dangerous encounters, and the feeling that Minecraft has grown into something bigger without becoming a different game.

If you want Minecraft to feel fresh again while still feeling like Minecraft, this is the pack.

---

## ⚡ The Quick Details

**Style:** Vanilla+ Exploration, Immersion & Adventure
**Version:** Minecraft 1.21.1
**Loader:** Fabric
**Focus:** Worldgen, structures, atmosphere, progression, visuals, performance
**Recommended RAM:** 6–8GB
**Best With:** Complementary Reimagined or other Iris-compatible shaders

---

## 🌍 A World Worth Exploring

Forgotten Horizons rebuilds the Overworld into something far more dramatic and memorable.

With **Terralith** and **Tectonic**, terrain feels larger, wilder, and more natural. Mountain ranges stretch into the distance, rivers carve through the land, caves feel massive, and every journey has the potential to reveal something worth stopping for.

This is not random biome spam. The goal is simple:

**make walking over the next hill exciting again.**

---

## 🏛 Structures, Dungeons & Forgotten Places

Exploration is backed by a full suite of **YUNG’s Better Structures**, including improved dungeons, mineshafts, strongholds, temples, witch huts, ocean monuments, nether fortresses, and more.

Vanilla structures are no longer tiny boxes you loot in thirty seconds. They are larger, more atmospheric, more dangerous, and more rewarding.

You will find:

* Reworked dungeons and mineshafts
* Strongholds that feel like real underground ruins
* Improved temples, huts, monuments, and fortresses
* Extra small structures and world details
* Better loot opportunities through Artifacts and Lost Relics

---

## 🧭 Exploration-Driven Progression

The End is no longer something you rush in the first hour.

With **End Remastered**, reaching the End requires finding unique Eyes across the world’s structures and dangerous locations. Progression is pushed outward into exploration, not just downward into strip mining.

Along the way, you can uncover rare artifacts, relics, enchanted gear, trims, loot bags, and special rewards that make adventure feel genuinely worthwhile.

---

## ⚔ Rare Champion Encounters

Forgotten Horizons includes **Champions**, adding rare elite versions of hostile mobs with special abilities, extra strength, and unique affixes.

Most of the world still feels like Minecraft, but every now and then you will run into something that makes you stop and think:

**“Wait… what is that?”**

Champion mobs can be fast, poisonous, reflective, shielded, magnetic, blinding, or far stronger than normal enemies. Combined with improved structures and dungeon spawners, this creates dangerous moments without turning the pack into a full RPG overhaul.

---

## 🍂 Seasons & Atmosphere

The world changes over time.

With **Fabric Seasons**, the Overworld moves through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Forests shift colour, snow arrives in colder months, and the world feels less static.

The atmosphere is built further through:

* AmbientSounds
* Sound Physics Remastered
* Falling leaves
* Cave dust
* Particle rain
* Dynamic lights
* Fireflies
* Better biome and dimension title cards

Caves echo. Forests breathe. Storms feel heavier. The world feels more alive.

---

## 🎨 Vanilla Visuals, Upgraded

Forgotten Horizons keeps the vanilla art direction but adds a huge layer of polish.

Included visual improvements:

* Fresh Animations support
* Fresh Moves
* 3D skin layers
* Better eating animations
* Visual enchantments
* Glowing ores
* Better armor trims
* Animated mobs and improved entity textures
* Visual particles and environmental effects

It still looks like Minecraft — just cleaner, smoother, and more expressive.

---

## 🧰 Quality-of-Life Without Breaking the Game

This pack improves the feel of survival without removing the survival part.

You get:

* Better advancements
* Advancement Plaques
* Jade
* AppleSkin
* Shulker Box Tooltip
* Inventory Profiles Next
* Better F3
* Armor HUD
* Detail Armor Bar
* Better anvil and enchanting handling
* Xaero’s Minimap and World Map
* Traveler’s Backpack
* Vein mining
* Better tooltips and item borders

The aim is comfort, not cheating.

---

## 🛠 Optimized for Smooth Play

Forgotten Horizons uses a strong Fabric performance stack to keep the game smooth despite the larger world, shaders, animations, and structure generation.

Included performance and stability mods include:

* Sodium
* Lithium
* Iris
* FerriteCore
* ModernFix
* ImmediatelyFast
* Entity Culling
* C2ME
* Krypton
* Noisium
* Bobby
* Dynamic FPS
* Debugify
* Enhanced Block Entities

The pack is shader-ready and designed to look good without feeling sluggish.

---

## 🏡 Built for Long-Term Worlds

Forgotten Horizons is made for players who want to settle into a world and keep finding reasons to continue.

Build outposts across continents.
Map distant regions.
Collect rare artifacts and trims.
Explore seasonal landscapes.
Clear dangerous dungeons.
Discover structures worth remembering.
Turn your world into a story.

This is Minecraft survival expanded — not replaced.

---

## 🌅 Explore Further. Discover More. Leave a Legacy.

Forgotten Horizons is for players who want Minecraft to feel adventurous again.

A bigger world.
A deeper journey.
A stronger atmosphere.
A better reason to keep walking.

title: SmartBooks
description: Create fully customizable books with images, custom fonts, and templates right inside Minecraft! A modern, canvas-based book editor.
body:
**SmartBooks** is an advanced, in-game book creation and editing mod that takes Minecraft's traditional book and quill to a whole new level. Whether you are creating a detailed server guide, a rich quest log, a comic book, or an encyclopedia, SmartBooks provides a modern, canvas-like editor directly in the game.

### ✨ Key Features

*   **Modern Canvas Editor:** Move, resize, and rotate text and image elements anywhere on the page, just like professional design software.
*   **Rich Text Formatting:** Choose from built-in fonts, change font sizes, colors, and apply formatting (bold, italics, underline, strikethrough). Supports left, center, and right text alignment.
*   **Custom Images:** Upload images directly from your computer or import them using a URL! Adjust image opacity, add rounded corners, and customize border styles.
*   **Page Backgrounds & Colors:** Customize each page with specific background colors or styles like lined paper, grid, or classic parchment.
*   **10+ Pre-made Templates:** Don't want to start from scratch? Use built-in templates like Comic, Magazine, Guide, Encyclopedia, Quest Log, Manual, and Newspaper to instantly format your pages.
*   **Layering System:** Bring elements to the front or send them to the back with a simple click.
*   **Multiplayer Compatible:** Fully synchronized with the server. Books are saved on the server and safely sent to clients.

### 📖 How to Use
1. Get a **Smart Book**.
2. Right-click to open the editor. (If the book is empty, or you sneak-right-click an unsigned book, the editor opens. Otherwise, it opens in reader mode).
3. Use the **left sidebar** to add text, images, pages, or apply templates.
4. Use the **right inspector panel** to customize the properties of the selected element.
5. Click **Save** to keep your progress or **Sign** to lock the book permanently!

### ⚙️ Technical Details
*   **Version:** Minecraft 1.20.1
*   **Loaders:** Available natively for both **Fabric** and **Forge**.
*   **Client & Server:** Needs to be installed on both the client and the server for multiplayer synchronization to work correctly.

title: Ore Casino
description: Trade in ores for gambling money, then buy more with your winnings!
body:
### Overview
Ore Casino turns any Minecraft server into a tiny casino. Sell ores for coins, place bets on slots, blackjack, coinflip, dice, and roulette, and try to win the progressive jackpot. All winnings live in the casino balance; there is no virtual currency item to manage.

### Features
- Sell any tracked ore or mineral for casino coins (or buy them back from the shop).
- Five playable games with persistent balances and a server-wide progressive jackpot.
- A clickable main menu, prices page, shop, and operator admin panel.
- Admin commands for granting, taking, setting, or wiping player balances and the jackpot.
### How to Use
- Type `/casino` to open the clickable main menu.
- Or use the game commands directly, for example `/casino slots 100`, `/casino blackjack 250`, `/casino coinflip 50 tails`, `/casino dice 100 7`, or `/casino roulette 200 red`.
- Sell the item in your hand with `/casino sell hand`, or everything sellable in your inventory with `/casino sell all`.
- Check ore prices with `/casino prices` and your balance with `/casino balance`.
### Tips & Tricks
- The minimum bet is 10 coins and the maximum is 1,000,000 coins.

- 5% of every losing bet is added to the progressive jackpot, and three sevens on the slot machine pays out the whole pot.
- Operators can open the admin panel from the main menu, or via /casino admin, to grant coins, wipe balances, or reset the jackpot.

### Known Limitations
- The graphical main-menu game buttons still bet a fixed 50 coins; the half / all shortcut only applies to the text commands for now.
- The half shortcut always uses your casino balance, not the contents of your physical inventory.

title: Building Competition
description: A Paper plugin for creating a long-term building competition server. Provides plot management and protections.
body:
![The banner image for the plugin. It's blue text in a modernized minecraft style that says "BC". It's on top of a blurred background which is an image of an example plot design for the plugin.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d263ec965b621d4d642179b050abd90821192e0_0.webp)

[Source Code](https://github.com/nfoert/building-competition) | [Issues](https://github.com/nfoert/building-competition/issues)

**A paper plugin for a long-term building competition in Minecraft.**

Existing solutions for a building competition style server involve short "build battle" games that repeat over and over again. I needed to set up a server where participants have a week or more to log in and make their build before they're later judged. This plugin makes it easier to set up a longer-term building competition server.

Once configured, the plugin allows players to create a plot with `/bc buildplot`, and later return to it using the same command. WorldGuard regions are automatically created so that players are only able to build in their own plot. When setting up the plugin, the buildable area can be specified, so that players can't damage the walls of their plot.

Requires `FastAsyncWorldEdit` for pasting plot schematics, and `WorldGuard` for setting up plot protections. `Multiverse` is recommended for creating a designated plot world.

## Features
- Create a plot for a player upon running a command, tiled in a plot world next to other plots, and automatically teleport them there
- Don't let players damage plots outside of their own
- Define a buildable area, so that players can't damage the walls of their plot
- Send the player back to their existing plot if it was already created
- Dev mode for testing

## Usage
See the [README](https://github.com/nfoert/building-competition#usage) for detailed set up instructions.

1. Install this plugin, `FastAsyncWorldEdit`, and `WorldGuard` to your server.
2. Create a plot schematic and save it to disk using FAWE.
3. Place that `.schem` file into the plugin's configuration folder, and specify some options in the `config.yml` file.
4. Then, players can run `/bc buildplot` to generate their plots. This command can be run from other places too, like when a user enters a Multiverse portal.

title: Tales & Taverns
description:
Tales & Taverns: A Cozy RPG Experience
A lightweight Fabric modpack that blends beautiful world generation, deep farming/cooking mechanics, and casual RPG exploration.
body:
#  Tales & Taverns:  A Cozy RPG Experience

Welcome to a world where adventure meets ultimate comfort. This Modpack transforms Minecraft into a vibrant, cozy, and deeply immersive RPG experience. It’s tailor-made for builders who love detail, adventurers who want breathtaking landscapes, and anyone who enjoys a warm tavern after a long day of exploring.

---

##  Key Features

###  The Ultimate Builder & Foodie Paradise
Thanks to some of the **[Let's Do]** series (*Meadow, HerbalBrews, Farm & Charm, Wildernature, Hearth & Timber, Lili's Pottery*), building and cooking have never been more rewarding. 
* Bake professional bread, brew your own herbal teas, and age fine wines.
* Decorate your settlements with incredible detail using **Chipped**, **Rechiseled**, and **Handcrafted**.
* Build breathtaking historical estates with **Dawn of Time: Ancient Structures**.

###  Breathtaking Exploration & Seasons
The world generation has been completely overhauled to feel alive, grand, and dynamic.
* **Tectonic** creates massive, realistic mountain ranges and smooth terrain.
* **Biomes O' Plenty** and **Nature's Spirit** add dozens of unique, vibrant biomes to discover.
* **Serene Seasons** introduces a full seasonal cycle—watch the leaves change color and prepare your fields for winter!

###  Soft RPG & Threatening Depths
Adventure awaits, but it won't overwhelm you. It's the perfect balance to keep things exciting.
* Master the art of magic and ranged combat with the **Spell Engine** and **Archers (RPG Series)**.
* Discover reworked, lively villages and dangerous strongholds with **Towns and Towers** and **Villages&Pillages**.
* If you dare, delve into the terrifying, pitch-black depths of the **Deeper and Darker** dimension or plunder the structures from **Dungeons and Taverns**.

###  Quality of Life
Say goodbye to everyday survival struggles:
* Pick up and move chests or blocks easily with **Carry On** or **Carry Me**.
* Keep your inventory clean and modular using **Trinkets** and the **Bundle API**.
* Never lose your loot again thanks to **Player Corpse** and **Lootr** (which ensures every player gets their own unique dungeon loot!).

---

##  Modpack Overview

Loader: Fabric /
Required RAM: 4-6G Bof RAM.

| Feature | Mod |
| :--- | :--- |
| **World Gen** | Tectonic + Biomes O' Plenty + Nature's Spirit  |
| **Main Theme** | Cottagecore, Farming, Cooking & Cozy RPG  |
| **Combat** | Spell Engine & RPG Weapon Attributes  |
| **Atmosphere** | Serene Seasons & Fusion (Connected Textures)  |

title: Waypoint Compass
description: Save your current location with a keypress; a HUD compass at the top of the screen points back to it with live direction and distance — across all dimensions.
body:
**Waypoint Compass** is a tiny, mixin-free, client-only Fabric mod for players who just want a "drop a pin, find your way back" tool — without installing a whole minimap suite. Press a key, the spot is saved. Walk away, and a slim compass strip at the top of your HUD shows an arrow pointing back and how far you have to go.

### Features
- **One-key save.** Press **B** anywhere to save your current X, Y, Z as a new waypoint. The mod confirms in the action bar (`Waypoint saved: WP 1 (123, 64, -512)`).
- **HUD compass.** A small bar at the top center of your screen shows an arrow, the waypoint name, and the live distance in meters / km. The arrow rotates as you turn, so "↑" always means "the waypoint is straight ahead".
- **Cycle through saved spots.** Press **N** to switch which waypoint the compass is tracking. Great for multi-base setups.
- **Delete the current pin.** Press **K** to remove the waypoint you're tracking. No menu required.
- **Toggle the HUD.** Press **H** to hide or re-show the compass without losing your saved points.
- **Dimension-aware.** Each waypoint remembers the dimension it was saved in. If you're in the Nether and the waypoint is in the Overworld, the compass shows `in Overworld` instead of a misleading distance.
- **Persistent.** Waypoints are stored in `config/waypoints.json` and survive restarts.
- **No mixins. No server install.** Pure client mod — works on any server, including vanilla Realms.

### Default keys
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| **B** | Save current position as a new waypoint |
| **N** | Cycle to next saved waypoint |
| **K** | Delete the currently tracked waypoint |
| **H** | Toggle the HUD compass on/off |

Keys are read directly from the OS via GLFW, so they ignore Minecraft's input routing — but they're suppressed while a GUI (chat, sign edit, inventory) is open, so they won't fire mid-type.

### Cross-version
Tested on **1.21.8, 1.21.9, 1.21.10, 1.21.11**. One JAR, one install.

Sentic is a utility for server administrators that integrates Large Language Models into the Minecraft environment. It allows users with appropriate permissions to manage the server through natural language processing.

Key Functionality:

Natural Language Interpretation: The mod captures text input from a private interface and utilizes an external AI engine to translate human intent into executable Minecraft commands.

Contextual Data Processing: Before processing a request, the mod gathers environmental metadata, including nearby entities, player coordinates, and world states, to provide the AI with the necessary context for precise command generation.

Silent Command Execution: Commands are executed on behalf of the player using automated network packets. The mod intercepts and suppresses standard command feedback to ensure that administrative actions remain invisible to other players on the server.

Secure Access Control: Access to the AI interface and its command execution capabilities is strictly restricted to players with Operator Level 4. The mod performs client-side permission checks before initializing any external API calls.

Custom Terminal Interface: A dedicated, non-intrusive GUI provides a workspace for inputting requests and receiving status updates from the AI assistant without using the standard game chat.

title: AxoCore
description: AxoCore is a lightweight, high-performance core designed to unify essential commands across Minecraft networks, proxies, and multi-threaded servers like Folia. It serves as an efficient, single-JAR replacement for heavy, traditional command suites.
body:
# 🌌 AxoCore – The Ultimate Multi-Platform Core > ⚠️ **WARNING:** This plugin is currently in active development. It may contain bugs or unstable features. Please report any issues on our official issue tracker.

AxoCore is the ultimate solution for high-performance Minecraft networks.
Designed from the ground up to be lightweight, modular, and natively compatible with distributed environments.

--- ## 🚀 Why choose AxoCore? AxoCore was born to replace heavy, monolithic suites. Using a "Universal JAR" architecture with automatic environment detection, AxoCore adapts to the platform it is running on, executing only the necessary processes to maximize CPU and RAM efficiency. ### Key Features * ⚡ **Industrial-Grade Performance**: Native integration with **FoliaLib** to safely handle multi-threaded tasks on Folia and Paper. * 📦 **Single JAR Deployment**: Forget about managing multiple files. Use one single JAR for your proxies and your backend servers. * 🛡️ **Network-Ready**: Data synchronization via unified database (MySQL/MariaDB/SQLite). * 🎛️ **Full Modularity**: Disable any command or feature in `config.yml` to minimize your system footprint. * 🎨 **MiniMessage Support**: Modern gradient and styling support for all system messages. --- ## 🏗️ Compatibility Matrix | Environment | Node | Role | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Proxy** | Velocity / BungeeCord | Network management, Global Moderation, Proxy Chat. | | **Backend** | Paper / Purpur / Folia | Local teleportation, Economy, Utilities, Kits. | --- ## 🕹️ System Commands These commands allow you to manage the plugin settings efficiently. | Command | Alias (Backend) | Alias (Proxy) | Function | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/axocore help` | `/axo`, `/axc` | `/axov`, `/axcv` | Displays this help menu. | | `/axocore reload`| `/axo reload` | `/axov reload` | Reloads the plugin configuration files. | --- ## 🛠️ Functional Commands ### 🌐 Proxy Commands (Network Management) * `/msg `: Send a private message across the network. * `/r `: Reply to the last received whisper. * `/staffchat `: Secure staff-only communication channel. * `/ban` / `/mute` / `/kick`: Synchronized network-wide moderation. * `/glist`: Real-time global player counts per server. * `/find `: Locate which subserver a player is currently in. ### 🏠 Backend Commands (World Interaction) * `/home` / `/sethome` / `/delhome`: Home point management. * `/warp` / `/setwarp`: Public network warp points. * `/spawn`: Return to the server's spawn point. * `/back`: Return to your previous location after teleporting. * `/vanish`: Become invisible to other players. * `/fly`: Toggle flight mode. * `/heal` / `/feed`: Restore health and saturation. * `/kit`: Claim serialized system kits. --- ## ⚙️ Installation & Configuration 1. **Deployment**: Place the `axocore-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar` file into the `/plugins/` folder of **all** your servers (Proxies and Backends). 2. **Auto-Detection**: Upon startup, the plugin will automatically detect if it is running on a Proxy or a Backend and initialize the appropriate module. 3. **Configuration**: - Edit `config.yml` to toggle features. - Configure your database credentials (MySQL recommended) to sync homes and logs across servers. 4. **Permissions**: All commands require the node `axocore.command.`. (e.g., `axocore.command.home`). --- ## 🆘 Troubleshooting * **Plugin not detecting the Proxy?**: Ensure `bungee: true` is set in `spigot.yml` (for Spigot) or `velocity: enabled: true` is set in `paper-global.yml` (for Paper/Folia). * **Folia loading error?**: Ensure `folia-supported: true` is present in your `plugin.yml`. * **Library Conflicts?**: AxoCore uses package relocation to avoid conflicts with other plugins, ensuring total system stability. --- ## 👨‍💻 Authors Developed with ❤️ by **Axira Estudio & MiguelTime**.

Need technical support? Reach out through our official channels.

body:
# Music Notifications

Music Notifications is a client-side Fabric mod by aaltay. It reads the music currently playing on Windows and shows it inside Minecraft as a toast notification.

## Features

- Shows track title and artist from Windows media controls.
- Uses Minecraft-style toast notifications with a music disc icon.
- Adds notification options to the sound settings screen.
- Lets you enable or disable notifications, hide the disc icon, choose toast position, and change display duration.
- Suppresses the default toast sound for these music notifications.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.1.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.1 or newer
- Fabric API
- Java 25
- Windows, for SMTC media metadata

## Build

```powershell
.\gradlew.bat build
```

The built jar will be in:

```text
build/libs/musicnotifications-1.26.1.2.jar
```

## Notes

The mod uses Windows System Media Transport Controls. Apps such as Spotify, Chrome, Edge, and other media players may expose different metadata quality depending on how they publish currently playing media to Windows.

## License

This project uses the MIT license.

title: MobBlocks
description: MobBlocks replaces normal block drops with a mob encounter. When you break a block, a random mob spawns and you must kill it to receive the items.
body:
# MobBlocks
MobBlocks completely changes how block breaking works. Instead of instantly receiving items when mining a block, a glowing mob spawns in its place. You must kill that mob to receive the block's drops. Until you do, you cannot break any other block. If you die before killing the mob, it is removed and the items are lost permanently as a punishment.

> 💡 Inspired by a challenge of the YouTuber [BastiGHG](https://www.youtube.com/@BastiGHG).

---

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/mobblocks status` | Shows the current values of all settings |
| `/mobblocks mobdrops <on\|off>` | Toggles natural mob loot on top of block drops |
| `/mobblocks blockbinding <on\|off>` | Toggles deterministic block-to-mob mapping |

**`/mobblocks mobdrops <on|off>`**
Controls whether mobs drop their own natural loot in addition to the block's items. Default: `off`.

**`/mobblocks blockbinding <on|off>`**
When set to `on`, each block type is permanently mapped to one specific mob. The mapping is determined by the block type combined with the world seed, so it differs between worlds but stays consistent within the same world. When set to `off`, a completely random mob is chosen every time. Default: `off`.

title: MoreActions
description: MoreActions is a plugin that enhances player movement with new mechanics like prone crawling and wall climbing.
body:
# MoreActions

![Functions that can be implemented via plugins(Wall climb)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e139be0efeb5964ea4bcaac1ee418dc176112810.gif)

A plugin that enables parkour-style actions in a vanilla environment. This plugin allows players to perform dynamic movements like prone, wall climbing, and sliding, bringing a more active and immersive experience to your Minecraft server.

---

## Requirements
| | |
|---|---|
| Server | Spigot or Paper 1.21.1+ |
| Java | 21+ |

---

## Features
Each feature can be turned on or off.
- **Prone movement** — Double tap Shift (sneak) to go prone and move through small spaces.
- **Wall climb** — Look at a wall while mid-air to grab it. Press movement keys (W) to climb up and Shift to descend. Climbing takes stamina!
- **Sliding** — Sneak while sprinting to perform a fast forward sliding maneuver.

---

## Installation
1. Download `MoreActions-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar`
2. Place the jar file inside the `plugins/` directory
3. Start the server

---

## Configuration (`plugins/MoreActions/config.yml`)
```yaml
# MoreActions - Parkour Action Settings
# You can configure the enable/disable state and parameters of each action.

# =====================
# General Settings
# =====================
# Language (en or ja)
language: "en"

messages:
  # You can individually configure whether to display chat messages such as action activations.
  # (UI elements like the stamina bar are always displayed)
  prone-start: true
  prone-stop: true
  slide-start: true
  wall-climb-start: true
  wall-climb-stamina-empty: true
  wall-climb-max-height: true

# =====================
# Prone Settings
# =====================
prone:
  # Whether to enable this feature
  enabled: true
  # Maximum time interval for double-tapping Shift (milliseconds)
  double-shift-interval: 400
  # Movement speed multiplier while prone (normal = 1.0)
  speed-multiplier: 0.6

# ===========================
# Wall Climb Settings
# ===========================
wall-climb:
  # Whether to enable this feature
  enabled: true
  # Ascent speed
  climb-speed: 0.15
  # Descent speed (when descending with Shift)
  descend-speed: 0.10
  # Maximum wall climbing duration (seconds, 0 for unlimited)
  max-climb-duration: 5
  # Maximum climbable height in a single climb (blocks, 0 for unlimited)
  max-climb-height: 0
  # Cooldown time after finishing a wall climb (seconds, 0 for none)
  cooldown: 3
  # Wall facing angle threshold (allowable angle deviation between player pitch/yaw and the wall direction)
  facing-angle-threshold: 75

# ===========================
# Sliding Settings
# ===========================
sliding:
  # Whether to enable this feature
  enabled: true
  # Initial speed strength (Velocity multiplier)
  speed: 1.2
  # Sliding duration in seconds
  duration: 0.6
  # Cooldown time after sliding ends (seconds, 0 for none)
  cooldown: 2
```

- Simple Voice Chat included for multiplayer

title: Fall Damage Preview
description: See how much fall damage you would take before falling!
body:
# Fall Damage Preview
This **clientside** mod adds a small display over your hotbar, when you **look down** and **press tab**, to tell you how much **damage** you would take if you **fall** down to where you're **looking** at. The mod calculates the damage taken, consideres armor, enchantments potion effects and the block you're landing on. If you want to see the **raw damage** that you would take without armor you can **press shift** by default to display the **raw damage**. The Colors of the Display and numbers and many other settings are **configurable**. The mod requires [YetAnotherConfigLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl).

title: Vital Reflexes
description: A mod that makes you manually manage breathing and blinking, adding a small but constant survival challenge to gameplay.
body:
Vital Reflexes is a survival realism mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge) that adds basic human body functions you can’t ignore anymore.
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/d7Ot_xp_WJ0" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
You now need to manually breathe — inhale (Z) and exhale (X) every few seconds. If you forget, you’ll start to suffer from Weakness, Slowness, and eventually lose health.

On top of that, you must also blink (V) regularly. If you don’t, you’ll get Darkness effects and a red flashing screen border as a warning that your eyes are overdue for a blink.

All keybinds can be fully reconfigured in the controls menu.



Credits

Thanks to [Roman Svyatkov](https://t.me/roman_svyatkov) for the development help.

title: BossBarUltra
description: Modern floating health bars for mobs using Minecraft’s TextDisplay system. Lightweight, customizable, and perfect for RPG and PvE servers.
body:
## ⭐ BossBarUltra

**Modern floating health bars for mobs**

**Recommended:** Paper / Purpur  
**Supported Minecraft Versions:** 1.20 → 1.21+

BossBarUltra adds **clean floating health bars above mobs** using Minecraft's **TextDisplay system**.  
It is lightweight, modern, and designed to work best on **Paper and Purpur servers**.

Perfect for **PvE servers, RPG gameplay, custom mobs, and boss encounters.**

***

## ✨ Features

### 🟩 Modern Floating Health Bars

*   Uses **TextDisplay (Minecraft 1.19.4+)**
*   Smooth real-time health updates
*   Follows mobs accurately
*   No vanilla boss bars
*   No scoreboards
*   No shadows or background boxes

***

### ❤️ Customizable Bar Styles

Change styles directly from the **in-game GUI**.

**Available Styles**

*   **Solid** → ██████▒▒▒▒
*   **Hearts** → ❤❤❤❤♡♡♡♡
*   **Glitch Mode** → Unique glitch-style bar

**Customization Options**

*   Adjustable bar width
*   Multiple bar colors
*   Optional glowing mode

***

### 👁 Display Modes

Control when health bars appear.

*   **Look Mode** – Visible only when the player looks at the mob
*   **Combat Mode** – Visible while the mob is in combat
*   **Always Mode** – Always visible for nearby mobs

Configurable options include:

*   Combat timeout
*   Detection range
*   Update interval

***

## ⚙️ In-Game Admin GUI

Use **`/bb`** to open the admin GUI.

From the GUI you can:

*   Change display modes
*   Switch bar styles
*   Change bar colors
*   Reload the configuration
*   Send feedback directly from the plugin

All changes apply **instantly — no server restart required**.

***

## 🚀 Performance

BossBarUltra is designed to be **lightweight and server-friendly**.

*   Very low performance impact
*   No dependencies required
*   Automatic cleanup when mobs die
*   No leftover TextDisplay entities
*   Safe for long-running servers

***

## 📥 Installation

1.  Download **BossBarUltra.jar**
2.  Place it in your **/plugins/** folder
3.  Start the server
4.  (Optional) edit `config.yml`

The default configuration is already optimized.

***

## 🕹 Commands & Permissions

**Command**

*   `/bb` — Opens the admin settings GUI

**Permission**

*   `bossbarultra.admin` (default: OP)

***

## ⚙️ Compatibility

*   **Minecraft:** 1.20 – 1.21+
*   **Recommended:** Paper / Purpur
*   **Spigot:** Supported but some features may be limited
*   **Dependencies:** None

***

## ❤️ Support

If you enjoy **BossBarUltra**, please consider leaving a ⭐.  
Feedback helps improve the plugin and future updates.

title: KillPoints
description: A simple Minecraft plugin where killing players earns you points that can be spent on powerful armor.
body:
# 💻 Platforms

[![Purpur](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/intergrav/devins-badges/v3/assets/cozy/supported/purpur_vector.svg)](https://purpurmc.org/)
[![Spigot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/intergrav/devins-badges/v3/assets/cozy/supported/spigot_vector.svg)](https://www.spigotmc.org/)

[![Bukkit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/intergrav/devins-badges/v3/assets/cozy/supported/bukkit_vector.svg)](https://dev.bukkit.org/)

---

# 🩸 KillPoints

A simple Minecraft plugin where killing players earns you points that can be spent on powerful armor.

---

## ⚔️ Features

- Gain **points for each player kill**
- Check your points with `/points`
- Open a shop with `/shop`
- Buy **expensive diamond armor** using your points
- Simple and lightweight (no config needed)

---

## 💰 How it works

- Kill a player → earn **+10 points**
- Use `/points` to see your balance
- Use `/shop` to open the armor shop
- Spend your points on gear:

| Item | Price |
|------|------|
| Diamond Helmet | 100 |
| Diamond Chestplate | 200 |
| Diamond Leggings | 150 |
| Diamond Boots | 80 |

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the plugin `.jar`
2. Put it in your `/plugins` folder
3. Start your server
4. Done ✅

---

## 🖥️ Requirements

- Minecraft server: **Paper / Spigot**
- Version: **1.20.4+**
- Java: **17+**

---

## ⚠️ Important

- Points are **not saved** (they reset when the server restarts)
- This is a **simple plugin** made for small servers or testing

---

## 🚀 Future plans

- Save points to file
- Add enchanted armor
- Better GUI with item prices
- More items in the shop

body:
# DynamicAPI Stop searching the eCloud. Start creating your own PlaceholderAPI placeholders. [![Kofi](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/donate/kofi-plural_vector.svg "Support us on Ko-fi")](https://ko-fi.com/maxxvoiid/donate) [![Modrinth](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/modrinth_vector.svg "Download on Modrinth")](https://modrinth.com/plugin/dynamicapi) [![Alternative](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Voiid-Studios/voiidstudios/main/assets/buttons/alternative_cozy.svg "Browse builds in Alternative")](https://alternative-ui.pages.dev/projects/dapi) [![Hangar](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy-minimal/available/hangar_vector.svg "Download on Hangar")](https://hangar.papermc.io/VoiidStudios/DynamicAPI) [![SpigotMC](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy-minimal/supported/spigot_vector.svg "Download on SpigotMC")](https://spigotmc.org/resources/133873/) [![DWiki](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Voiid-Studios/dynamicapi/wiki/docs/assets/img/external/dwiki_compact.svg "Read the DynamicAPI Wiki")](https://voiid-studios.github.io/dynamicapi/) [![VSPL](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Voiid-Studios/voiidstudios/main/assets/buttons/vspl_license.svg "View the Voiid Studios Public License")](https://github.com/Voiid-Studios/voiidstudios/blob/main/LICENSE.md) [![Crowdin](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact-minimal/translate/crowdin_vector.svg "Translate DAPI on Crowdin")](https://crowdin.com/project/dynamicapi) [![GitHub](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact-minimal/available/github_vector.svg "View DAPI Source Code on GitHub")](https://github.com/Voiid-Studios/dynamicapi)
## ❓ What is DynamicAPI? DynamicAPI (DAPI) is a [PlaceholderAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/placeholderapi) addon that lets you create your own custom placeholders directly from YAML files — no Java knowledge required. Instead of searching through eCloud's thousands of expansions and never finding exactly what you need, DynamicAPI lets you define your own in minutes. ## ✨ Features - 📝 Define placeholders directly from YAML - 📂 Multi-file support — organize your placeholders however you want - 🔄 Hot reload — no server restart needed with `/dapi reload` - 🔌 Access any Bukkit API data via simple expressions - 🧩 Fully compatible with PlaceholderAPI ## 📋 Requirements - **Minecraft version:** `1.8+` - **Server software:** Spigot, Paper or forks - **Dependency:** [PlaceholderAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/placeholderapi) ## 🚀 Installation 1. Download the [latest version here](https://modrinth.com/plugin/dynamicapi/versions) 2. Place the downloaded `.jar` file in your server's `plugins/` folder 3. Make sure PlaceholderAPI is also installed 4. Restart the server, DynamicAPI is ready! ⚡ ## 📖 How to use it - Define your placeholders in any `.yml` file inside `plugins/DynamicAPI/placeholders/` - Any file with a `Placeholders:` section is loaded automatically - Use `/dapi reload` to apply changes without restarting - Use `/dapi list` to see all registered placeholders ## [📚 DWiki](https://voiid-studios.github.io/dynamicapi) ## 🔥 bStats

An easy way to add a Boogey curse or Secret Society integrated through tasks that will happen whenever you want! This allows for customisation, such as what session you want it to happen in, what kind of task you want it to be and which of the 2 you want to select!

title: UnPattern

It's typically used by bloggers to avoid exposing their bedrock in streams and videos, similar to DonutSMP servers. Bedrock and obsidian are easy to understand and almost impossible to confuse.

title: ClaimPlus
description: Claim plugin, to secure bases!
body:
# 🏡 ClaimPlus **Protect your builds. Your land, your rules.** ClaimPlus is a lightweight but powerful area claiming plugin for PaperMC 1.21.x that lets players protect exactly the space they want not entire chunks, not full height columns, but the precise 3D region they select. Built with WorldGuard compatibility in mind, it slots cleanly into any existing server setup without conflict. [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.0-blue)]() [![Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper-1.21.x-orange)]() [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/badge/downloads-1+-green)]() ---


--- ## ✨ Features ### 🔲 Precision Area Claiming Select any rectangular area using the claim wand just like WorldEdit. Claims protect the exact Y range you select, so a basement claim won't interfere with what's built above it. ### 🛡️ Granular Protection Flags Toggle protections on or off per claim: - Block breaking & placing - Lava & water flow - Fire spread - Creeper & TNT explosions - Mob spawning - Chest & container access - Button, lever & door interactions - Item drop & pickup - PvP *(admin-controllable — prevent players from creating safe zones)* ### 👥 Member System Add trusted players to your claim and control exactly what they can do build, open chests, use levers, manage other members, or change flags. Full per-permission granularity. ### ⚙️ Admin Control Panel Admins decide which features players are allowed to use at all. Want to prevent players from disabling PvP in their claims so nobody can abuse safe zones? One line in the config. Every flag can be locked by server admins independently. ### 📊 Claim Block Limits - Set a default block limit for all players - Assign a higher VIP limit by username list or permission node - Set per-player custom limits with a single command great for donor ranks ### 🌍 WorldGuard Compatible ClaimPlus is fully aware of WorldGuard. It never overrides WorldGuard decisions, respects your existing regions, and can optionally prevent players from claiming inside WorldGuard-protected areas entirely. --- ## 🎮 Commands | Command | Description | |---|---| | `/claimplus wand` | Get the claim selection wand | | `/claimplus claim [name]` | Create a claim from your selection | | `/claimplus unclaim ` | Delete one of your claims | | `/claimplus flag ` | Set a protection flag | | `/claimplus member add/remove/grant/revoke ...` | Manage members & permissions | | `/claimplus list` | View all your claims | | `/claimplus blocks` | Check remaining claim blocks | | `/claimadmin list [player]` | View all claims on the server | | `/claimadmin delete ` | Delete any claim | | `/claimadmin setlimit ` | Set a custom block limit | | `/claimadmin bypass` | Toggle admin bypass mode | | `/claimadmin teleport ` | Teleport to any claim | | `/claimadmin reload` | Reload config without restart | --- ## 🔧 Requirements - **Server:** PaperMC 1.21.x - **Java:** 21+ - **WorldGuard:** Optional, auto-detected if present --- ## 📦 Installation 1. Drop `ClaimPlus.jar` into your `/plugins` folder 2. Start the server config generates automatically 3. Edit `plugins/ClaimPlus/config.yml` to configure limits, flags and VIP players 4. Run `/claimadmin reload` to apply changes --- *Made by Rradajbi*

title: player Revive plugin
description: Revive Dead Players Using Craftable Revival Totems.
body:
**Revive Dead Players Using Craftable Totems**

Revive Dead Players Using Craftable Revival Totems.
A plugin that allows players to revive dead teammates through a ritual system.
When a player dies, they drop a Revival Gem. Other players can use this gem to craft a Revival Totem by surrounding it with 8 Totems of Undying in a crafting table.
Place the crafted Revival Totem on an Item Frame inside the Revival Hall to start the revival ritual, which brings the dead player back to life.

**Features**
- Death Drops Revival Tag – When a player dies, a unique Revival Gem representing that player
  is dropped.
- Player Revival System – Use a PlayerRevival Gem + Totems of Undying to revive the dead
  player.
- Universal Revival Totem can revive any currently online dead player if the original
  gem/totem is lost
- Perfect for Hardcore / SMP Servers
- Custom crafting recipes
- Lightweight & optimized
- Encourages teamwork and risk management

**Download** the custom a resource pack featuring:
- Custom Revival Totem texture
- Hardcore-style hearts for revived players
  
Resourcepack : [Totem Resourcepack Download](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1br5DonLMsDHdi1_xYusb7abPp6NOrqTo/view?usp=sharing)

**Commands:**
- /newbornprot set <player> <minutes> – Set protection time for a player
- /newbornprot setall <minutes> – Set protection time for all players
- /newbornprot toggle – Show/Hide the protection timer bossbar
- /giveuniversalrevivaltotem <player> - Give Universal Revival Totem to anyone
- /deadplayerlist - Open dead players list
- /revivalhall - Teleport to Revival hall(Revival Ritual Hall)
- /return - Teleport back to overworld home from Revival hall
- /hr - Plugin Reload

**Permissions:**
- hardcorerevival.givetotem
- hardcorerevival.newbornprot.toggle
- hardcorerevival.newbornprot.add

**Use Cases**
- Hardcore SMP servers
- Story-based Minecraft servers
- Team survival gameplay
- Challenge-based worlds

## IMPORTANT
This plugin requires two structure maps to function properly.
Download the maps and place them in your server with the following names:

Revival Hall → folder name: revival_hall

Prison → folder name: prison

These structures are used for:

Revival Hall – Where players place the Revival Totem to start the revival ritual

Prison – Where dead players wait until they are revived

Make sure the folders are named exactly as shown above for the plugin to detect them correctly.
Download World File : [Prison and Revival hall World Download](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DObMMlaQXKItZa4Jbik-3mfeqodzfCZp/view?usp=sharing)
