title: FreeProtect
description: Log your players, your world, and everything that exists for FREE!
body:
![About](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d848e43da1cf807faf202a97454bc609f9644b1_0.webp)

![construction](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69af3985c0022083c4f45b83d89f6efea5647c99.png)

# FreeProtect — Block Logging & Protection Plugin

**FreeProtect** is a lightweight, efficient, and feature-rich Minecraft plugin designed to log player block interactions and help server owners track griefing or suspicious activities. With simple commands and powerful lookup tools, FreeProtect makes it easy to protect your world without unnecessary bloat.

---

## ✨ Features

* Logs block break/place events with **timestamps, location, player name & UUID**.
* **Radius-based lookup** to search for events around you.
* **Clickable chat components** for teleporting to logged actions.
* **Paginated results** with easy navigation buttons (⏮ ◀ ▶ ⏭).
* Fully asynchronous lookups (no lag).
* Works out of the box, no complicated setup.

---

## 📜 Commands

| Command                                    | Description                                                                      |
| ------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `/fp lookup event:<event> radius:<blocks>` | Lookup events around you. Example: `/fp lookup event:PlayerBlockBreak radius:20` |
| `/fp page <number>`                        | Show a specific lookup results page.                                             |
| `/fp help`                                 | Show all available commands.                                                     |

---

## 🔍 Example Usage

### 1. Lookup Block Breaks

```mcfunction
/fp lookup event:PlayerBlockBreak radius:15
```

* Shows all blocks broken within 15 blocks of your position.
* Hover over the **player name** to view their UUID.
* Hover over the **location line** and click to teleport there instantly.

### 2. Navigate Pages

```mcfunction
/fp page 2
```

* Shows the second page of results if multiple pages are available.

### 3. Help Menu

```mcfunction
/fp help
```

* Displays a list of available commands.

---

## 📖 Lookup Result Example

```
3m ago - Steve broke stone.
   (x120/y64/z-300/world)
```

* Hover `Steve` → shows UUID.
* Hover `(x120/y64/z-300/world)` → tooltip: "Click to teleport".
* Click location → instantly teleport there.

---

## 🚀 Installation

1. Download the plugin JAR from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/).
2. Place it into your server's `/plugins/` folder.
3. Restart the server.
4. Done! 🎉

---

## 🛠️ Permissions

| Permission           | Description                           |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `freeprotect.use`    | Allows player to use lookup command.  |

---

## 🧭 Roadmap

* Support for more event types (placements, interactions).
* GUI-based log viewer.
* MySQL/SQLite storage backend.

---

## ❤️ Contributing

Contributions, suggestions, and PRs are welcome! Help shape FreeProtect into the best free block logging plugin for the Minecraft community.

---

## 📌 Summary

FreeProtect is your go-to lightweight **block logging plugin** for Bukkit/Spigot/Paper servers. Easy to use, no setup headaches, and powerful lookup features built with performance in mind.

title: Tracer
description: A comprehensive Minecraft plugin for analyzing and visualizing server performance issues
body:
# **Tracer** - _Chunk Lag Visualization Plugin_
Tracer helps server administrators identify performance bottlenecks by visualizing chunk lag through particle effects, action bar messages, and detailed analysis reports.

## What it does
This plugin scans your server's chunks to find areas causing lag. When it detects problems, it shows you exactly where they are using colorful particles and helpful messages. You can then teleport directly to these problem areas to fix them.

## Main Features
Visual Feedback

- Particle effects highlight laggy chunks with different colors
- Action bar shows real-time performance data
- Chunk borders become visible around problem areas
- Floating text displays detailed lag information
Smart Analysis

- Counts entities, tile entities, and redstone components
- Categorizes lag into Low, Medium, High, and Critical levels
- Caches results to avoid repeated scanning
- Works asynchronously to prevent server freezing
Flexible Scanning

- Scan specific radius around you (1-20 chunks)
- Run server-wide scans to check everything
- Set up automatic background scanning
- Manual scanning when you need it
Easy Navigation

- Click to teleport to any laggy chunk
- Browse through results page by page
- Jump directly to coordinates if you know them


## Commands Basic Commands:

- /tracer scan - Scan chunks around you
- /tracer scan 10 - Scan 10 chunks in each direction
- /tracer scan server - Scan the entire server
- /tracer toggle - Turn visualization on/off
- /tracer teleport - Browse and teleport to laggy chunks
- /tracer info - Show plugin status
- /tracer stats - Display scanning statistics

  
Auto-Scanning:
- /tracer autoscan enable - Start automatic scanning
- /tracer autoscan disable - Stop automatic scanning
- /tracer autoscan interval 60 - Set scan interval (30, 60, 120, 300, or 600 seconds)
- /tracer autoscan server enable - Enable server-wide auto-scanning
- /tracer autoscan server interval 30 - Set server scan interval (5-120 minutes)


Utility Commands:
- /tracer clear cache - Clear analysis cache
- /tracer clear stats - Clear statistics
- /tracer clear all - Clear everything
- /tracer reload - Reload configuration
- /tracer debug on - Enable debug mode
- /tracer help - Show command help

  
## Requirements
- PaperMC 1.21 or newer
- Java 21


## Getting Started
1. Drop the plugin into your plugins folder
2. Restart your server
3. Give yourself permission: tracer.scan , tracer.toggle , tracer.teleport (or simply operator)
4. Run /tracer scan 5 to test it out
5. Use /tracer toggle to see the visual effects
6. Navigate to problematic areas with /tracer teleport
   
The plugin includes smart defaults and won't impact your server's performance. All scanning happens in the background, and you can adjust how often it runs based on your needs.

_Serverwide autoscans are disabled by default and can be enabled via /tracer autoscan server enable._

title: MidiReceiver
description: The MIDIReceiver plugin plays Minecraft note block sounds based on real-time MIDI data sent from the client
body:
# 🎼 MIDIReceiver (Spigot Plugin)

The **MIDIReceiver** plugin listens for `midi:action` plugin messages and plays matching Minecraft note block sounds in real time.

## 📡 Incoming Plugin Message: `midi:action`

The plugin receives `MidiAction` packets from the client mod and triggers sounds accordingly.

### `MidiAction` Payload Structure

```java
record MidiAction(
    String name,
    int command,
    int channel,
    int data1,
    int data2
)
```

| Field     | Type     | Description                          |
| --------- | -------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `name`    | `String` | Name of the MIDI device              |
| `command` | `int`    | MIDI command (e.g., `144` = Note On) |
| `channel` | `int`    | MIDI channel (0–15)                  |
| `data1`   | `int`    | Note number                          |
| `data2`   | `int`    | Velocity                             |

## 🔊 MIDI to Minecraft

If `command == 144` and `velocity > 0`, the plugin maps `data1` (MIDI note) to Minecraft note block pitch `0–24` and plays the note using `player.playNote(...)`.

## ✅ Requirements

* A Spigot/Paper server (1.20+ recommended)
* A client mod that sends `midi:action` plugin messages

---

Need help or want to contribute? Check out the [repository](https://github.com/uebliche/midireciever) or open an issue!

body:
# Halal Mod

A Minecraft mod that enforces halal dietary laws with divine retribution. If a player consumes pork products, they will die.

## Features

- Detects when players attempt to eat porkchop or cooked porkchop
- Waits for players to fully consume the forbidden food
- Strikes sinners with multiple lightning bolts
- Delivers divine punishment with a custom death message
- Accurately tracks food consumption with hunger level verification
- Provides exceptions for starving players (Hunger < 3)

## Dependencies

- Fabric API (included with most Fabric installations)

## How It Works

The mod keeps track of players who attempt to consume pork products. After the standard Minecraft eating animation completes (approximately 1.6 seconds), the mod checks if the player's hunger level increased, confirming they actually ate the pork. If so, divine retribution is delivered in the form of multiple lightning strikes and instant death, accompanied by a custom death message.

title: IceBoostPanel
description: Reward plugin for Discord server boosters
body:
🌟 IceBoostPanel – Discord Boost Rewards Plugin

IceBoostPanel is a powerful and easy-to-use plugin that rewards your Discord server boosters — fully automated and customizable through a simple configuration file.
If you're running a Minecraft community and want to show appreciation to users who support your server with Discord boosts, this plugin is the perfect solution. It bridges the gap between Discord and your server environment by letting users claim rewards directly through Discord using a clean, interactive interface.

- 🎁 Reward Boosters Instantly
 When a user boosts your Discord server, they can claim their in-game reward directly via a button in Discord. The plugin handles the rest.

- 🛠️ Easy Configuration
All settings are defined in a single config.yml file. Customize your embed messages, set command rewards, and control cooldowns without writing code.
  
- 🔐 Permission and Cooldown Handling
Automatically checks if the user has permission to claim, and prevents abuse with a built-in cooldown system.
  
- 💬 Fully Customizable Messages
Edit all messages, embed texts, button labels, and modal fields to match your server's branding or language.
  
- 🧩 Command Execution Integration
Supports any server-side commands — give items, run scripts, or trigger other plugins via placeholders like {PLAYER}.

✅ How to use this?
1. Create a Booster role and a channel visible only to boosters
2. Type /boostpanel (requires the MANAGE_SERVER permission)
3. Done! Users can now claim their reward

⚙️ How It Works

A user with a Discord boost clicks the "✅ Claim" button in the embed.
The bot opens a modal where they input their in-game nickname.
The plugin verifies the user, checks cooldowns, and executes the configured reward commands.
The user receives confirmation and their in-game rewards — no staff intervention required!

Configuration:
```yaml
discord:
  token: ""
  status: "IceBoostPanel"
  embed:
    title: "Get your boost reward"
    description: "To claim your boost reward, click the button below"
    color: "#FF009B"
    image: ""
    footer: "IceBoostPanel"
    footer-image: ""
    button: "✅ Claim"
  messages:
    no-perm: "❌ You do not have the appropriate permissions"
    cooldown: "⚠️ You have recently claimed your reward. Please wait **{TIME}**"
    reading-error: "⚠️ An error occurred while reading the nickname"
    bad-user: "❌ This user does not exist or is not currently online"
    received: "✅ The reward has been received"
    modal:
      title: "Claim your reward"
      nickname-input: "Enter your nickname"

reward:
  # cooldown in hours
  cooldown: 24
  commands:
    - "give {PLAYER} diamond"
    - "give {PLAYER} iron_ingot"
```

title: Hammond's QoL Vanilla+
description: Enjoy a smoother, more informative, and visually enhanced vanilla and vanilla+ SMP. This mod collection focuses on essential quality-of-life improvements for an unparalleled multiplayer experience.
body:
## Announcing the Release of **Hammonds 1.21 QoL Vanilla+**!

Experience Minecraft 1.21 like never before with **Hammonds 1.21 QoL Vanilla+**! This carefully curated modpack stays true to the heart of vanilla gameplay while injecting a significant dose of quality-of-life improvements, breathtaking visuals, optimized performance, and tools for content creation.

**Hammonds 1.21 QoL Vanilla+** enhances your world with:

* **Visual Enhancements:**
    * **Iris Shaders and Complementary Shaders - Unbound:** Dramatically overhaul the game's visuals with realistic lighting, shadows, reflections, and atmospheric effects for a much more immersive world.
    * **Faithful 64x:** Provide higher-resolution textures that stay true to the original Minecraft aesthetic but with much more detail.
    * **Dramatic Skys:** Deliver breathtaking and dynamic skies with realistic clouds, sunsets, and night skies.
    * **Motschen's Better Leaves:** Enhance the appearance of trees with more detailed and realistic leaf textures and models.
    * **Blur+:** Add a subtle blur effect to menus and backgrounds, making the interface more visually appealing.
    * **Dark Loading Screen:** Provide a simple but welcome change with a darker and potentially less jarring loading screen.
    * **Particle Rain:** Enhance the visual effect of rain with more detailed and numerous particles.
    * **Chunks fade in:** Make chunk loading less abrupt and more visually smooth.
* **Performance and Optimization:**
    * **Sodium, Lithium, and FerriteCore:** Core performance mods that significantly improve the game's frame rate, reduce lag, and optimize memory usage without altering gameplay.
    * **Fast IP Ping and Server Pinger Fixer:** Improve the speed and reliability of connecting to multiplayer servers.
* **Quality of Life and Information:**
    * **Jade 🔍 (Just Another Description Extractor):** Provide in-game tooltips with detailed information about blocks, items, and entities you're looking at.
    * **Shulker Box Tooltip:** Allow you to see the contents of shulker boxes without having to open them.
    * **Durability Tooltip:** Show the remaining durability of your tools and armor directly in your inventory.
    * **Held Item Info:** Display useful information about the item you're currently holding.
    * **AppleSkin:** Show how much hunger and saturation food items will restore.
    * **Status Effect Bars:** Display active status effects more clearly and intuitively.
    * **BetterF3:** Replace the default F3 debug screen with a more organized and informative version.
    * **Gamma Utils (Fullbright):** Allow you to easily toggle fullbright mode, making it easier to see in dark areas.
    * **Mouse Tweaks:** Add various mouse-based shortcuts for inventory management.
    * **Inventory Management:** Provide tools and shortcuts for organizing your inventory more efficiently.
    * **AutoSwitch:** Might automatically switch to the best tool in your inventory when you start mining or attacking.
    * **Low On Fire:** A small but helpful mod that reduces the visual intensity of being on fire.
    * **Chat Heads and Chat Animation [Smooth Chat]:** Enhance the chat interface with player avatars and smoother text animations.
    * **Litematica:** A powerful in-game schematic viewer and building tool, especially useful for complex constructions.
    * **Litematica Printer:** An addon for Litematica that assists with placing blocks according to a loaded schematic.
    * **JourneyMap and JourneyMap Web Map:** Provide a real-time in-game map and potentially a web-based interface to view your world.
    * **MapFrontiers:** Allow you to easily define and visualize world borders or explored areas on your map.
* **Content Creation Tools:**
    * **Flashback:** A recording mod that allows you to create in-game cinematics.
    * **Flashside:** Provides easy access to Flashback's controls by placing its buttons on the side of the menu screen.
* **Enhanced Entities:**
    * **[EMF] Entity Model Features and [ETF] Entity Texture Features:** Improve and allow for more varied and detailed entity models and textures.
    * **[ESF] Entity Sound Features:** Enhance the sound quality and variety for mobs.
    * **TslatEntityStatus:** Could provide more detailed status information about entities.
* **Functional and Technical Mods:**
    * **Fabric API:** A core library required by many Fabric mods to function correctly.
    * **YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL), Forge Config API Port, SuperMartijn642's Config Lib, and Cloth Config API:** These provide standardized in-game configuration menus for other mods, making customization easier.

title: Savanna farms - no more flooding
description: Simple datapack changing savanna village stuctures to prevent flooding from water sources that are part of mini-farms.
body:
### Description

Name mostly says it all.

I hate when water from mini-farms in savanna villages floods nearby area so this datapack gives you changed structures.

It removes most of the flooding. Only "small farm" structure is left unchanged because, in my testing, it is responsible for less than 5% of issues. I thought about making a flower garden or something but left it unchanged for now. If you guys have problems with "small farm", i'll change that one too.

### Scope

This datapack is about as small a fix as I could manage. Houses are intact, roads are still an eyesore. I just took care of flooding.

### Compatibility

Should be compatible with datapacks that change houses because I changed only one "house", one called large_farm_2, which is a farm. And will be compatible with anything what adds structures.

Not compatible with anything that changes roads (streets), because that is what I changed, but if the other mod/datapack changes villages, it likely redoes these ugly and patchy savanna roads.

title: Epic RPG: Salvage Inventory
description: An RPG-style salvage inventory that lets you destroy items and gain configurable rewards.
body:
Salvage Inventory

Salvage Inventory is a utility mod that adds an RPG-style salvage interface to help you recycle unwanted gear directly from your inventory. Instead of simply throwing items away, you can destroy them and receive configurable rewards based on Datapack rules.

When you open the player inventory, you can access the Salvage Inventory screen using a configurable keybind from the controls menu. By default, this key is R, but it can be changed to any other key in the settings.

Inside this interface, you will find a 27-slot upper storage area where you can place the items you want to salvage. Once the items are there, pressing the salvage button will process them using the configured rules, allowing items to be destroyed and optionally return rewards.

The salvage system is fully editable through Datapacks, making it possible to define custom item-based and tag-based rules, reward outputs, and optional chance values. This allows modpack creators to customize the feature for their own progression and balancing needs.

The mod also includes compatibility with Epic RPG: Rarity System and Legendary Tabs. When supported mods are present, salvage rewards can react to item rarity and the salvage screen can be accessed more conveniently from inventory tabs.

***

Datapack Integration

Any mod or Datapack can add its own salvage rules by placing JSON files in the following paths:
data/salvageinventory/salvage/by_id
data/salvageinventory/salvage/by_tag

File names do not need to match the ones included with the mod. Any valid .json file placed in those folders will be loaded, as long as it follows the correct salvage rule format.

Rules can be registered by item ID or by tag, allowing broad compatibility with other mods without requiring direct code integration. This makes it possible to support both specific items and whole categories of items through Datapack definitions.

***

title: Interactive World
description: A bunch of small in-world interactions that would fit right into vanilla
body:
TO-DO : Banner image

A bunch of small interactions that add a bit more depth to the game, and make use of items and blocks that are often overlooked.

## Features All features can be enabled, disabled, or for some set to 'only when crouching' in the config file. ### Cracking/Repairing Blocks - Click a block with a pickaxe to turn it into its cracked variant. (e.g. Stone Bricks -> Cracked Stone Bricks) - Use clay on cracked blocks to repair them. ### Mossifying/Shearing Blocks - Click a block with shears to remove the moss from it. (e.g. Mossy Cobblestone -> Cobblestone) - Use vines on a block to turn it into its mossy variant. (e.g. Cobblestone -> Mossy Cobblestone) ### Cauldron Washing - Use Dirt on a cauldron with water to turn it to mud. - Use Concrete Powder on a cauldron with water to harden it into a solid block. - Use a Wet Sponge on a cauldron with lava to dry it. - Dispensers pointed into cauldrons can also be used to perform these interactions. - Putting a hopper under a cauldron instantly collects the washed items, preventing sponges from burning in the lava. ### Campfires - Place a Wet Sponge on an active Campfire to dry it. ### Undoing Paths and Farmland - Use a shovel on a path block to turn it back into dirt. - Use a hoe on farmland to turn it back into dirt. - The height an entity must fall to trample farmland is increased. - This minimum height can be configured in the config file. ### Slime Chunks Checker - Right-clicking a Slime Ball shows if you're inside a slime chunk using particles. - If in a slime chunk, green particles will appear. - If not in a slime chunk, only a 'Slime Block break sound' can be heard. ### Glow Berries Effect - Eating Glow Berries gives the player or mob the Glow effect. - The duration of the effect can be configured in the config file. ### Item Frames Visibility - Crouch clicking an Item Frame toggles its visibility. - An invisible Item Frame can be clicked through to interact with blocks like Chests behind it. ### Click-Through Signs - Clicking on a sign on an interactable block (e.g. a Chest) will ignore the sign if not crouching, allowing you to interact with the block behind it. ### Blast Proof Tinted Glass - Tinted Glass are blast proof, meaning they will not break from explosions.
## Configuration On its own, the mod will not create a config file. To change settings, you can install [Fzzy Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/fzzy-config). To load changes to the config file, you can use the vanilla ``/reload`` command. > Some config options do require a full client/server restart to take effect, and will be noted as such in the config file.

title: Cobblemon No IVs
description: Every Pokémon rolls with the same IVs — no breeding for a perfect spread, no resetting spawns. What you catch is already competitive. And every IV screen just reads `none`.
body:
# Cobblemon No IVs

Every Pokémon rolls with the same IVs — no breeding for a perfect spread, no resetting spawns. What you catch is already competitive. And every IV screen just reads `none`.

**Not client-only — it changes real stats.** The server (or your single-player world) applies the equal IVs and battle math; the client renders the `none` display. Install it on both sides for the full effect.

---

## Features

- **Equal IVs, everywhere** — every stat of every Pokémon is locked to one value *(default 31)*. Wild spawns, starters, captures, eggs, trades, `/pokegive`, and even old saves get normalized on load.
- **IVs stop deciding battles** — the battle formula *(and the Showdown export)* uses the fixed value, so same species + level + nature + EVs = identical stats. Strategy wins, not the roll.
- **`none` on every IV surface** — Summary *(M key)* IV tab values **and** hover labels, PC *(Stat/IV view)*, and Trade *(both sides)*. The IV-mode radar hexagon is hidden.
- **Pokédex untouched** *(it only shows species base stats — no individual IVs live there)*.

## Config *(config/cobblemon-no-ivs.json)*

- `ivValue` — the IV applied to every stat *(0–31, default 31)*. Out-of-range values are clamped; edit and restart to change it.

---

## Requirements

**Minecraft 1.21.1 — Fabric & NeoForge** · Cobblemon 1.7+ · needed on **server & client**

| | Fabric | NeoForge |
|---|---|---|
| Required | Fabric Language Kotlin | NeoForge 21.1+, Kotlin for Forge 5+ |

*Fabric API comes bundled with Cobblemon's own dependencies.*

---

title: Ride Together (MCA + Immersive Vehicles)
description: Automatically lets Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn companions ride with you in Immersive Vehicles instead of running behind your vehicle.
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/0VZNskqqME8" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>🚗 Ride Together (MCA + Immersive Vehicles)  
Travel together, just as it should be.  

Have you ever wished your Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn spouse, children, or companions would ride with you instead of desperately running after your vehicle?  

Ride Together is a lightweight compatibility addon that seamlessly integrates Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn with Immersive Vehicles (MTS/IV), allowing your companions to automatically board your vehicle and occupy an available passenger seat whenever they're following you.  

No configuration. No commands. Just get in and drive.  

✨ Features  
🚗 Automatically seats nearby MCA companions that are following you.  
💺 Uses the first available passenger seat.  
👨‍👩‍👧 Only companions following you will board your vehicle.  
⚡ Lightweight and optimized for performance.  
🌍 Works in both Singleplayer and Multiplayer.  
🧩 Designed to integrate naturally without modifying the gameplay of either mod.  
🔧 No configuration required.  

**📦 Requirements**  
Minecraft 1.20.1  
Minecraft Forge 47.3.0+  
Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn 7.6.26+  
Immersive Vehicles (MTS/IV) 24.0.0+  
Architectury API  

**🚙 How It Works**  
Set an MCA companion to Follow.  
Enter any Immersive Vehicles vehicle with at least one free passenger seat.  
Your companion will automatically board the vehicle and take the first available seat.  

**_To have your companion leave the vehicle:_**  

Right-click the companion.  
Select Interact.  
Click Ride Horse.  

MCA will automatically make the companion dismount the vehicle.  

That's it!  

**🤝 Compatibility**  

Ride Together is designed to be as lightweight and non-invasive as possible.  

It does not replace or modify the gameplay of Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn or Immersive Vehicles. Instead, it simply bridges both mods by allowing companions to occupy available passenger seats automatically.  

The addon is intended to work alongside most Forge 1.20.1 modpacks and addons.  

As long as another mod doesn't replace or heavily modify the internal behavior of Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn or Immersive Vehicles, Ride Together should remain fully compatible.  

**❤️ Why this addon?**  

Watching your spouse, children, or companions chase your truck, bus, or car across the world never felt immersive.  

Ride Together solves that with a simple quality-of-life improvement that makes traveling together feel natural.  

Whether you're exploring new lands, transporting your family, or simply driving around your world, your companions can finally ride together with you.

MIT License  

Feel free to include this mod in public or private modpacks.  

🚀 Version 1.0.0  
Initial release.  
Automatic vehicle boarding for MCA companions following the player.  
Supports Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn 7.6.26+.  
Supports Immersive Vehicles (MTS/IV) 24.0.0+.  
Multiplayer compatible.

description: Day Counter  is a clean and lightweight Fabric mod that adds a simple day counter to your Minecraft HUD
body:
Day Counter

Day Counter** is a clean and lightweight Fabric mod that adds a simple day counter to your Minecraft HUD.

Instead of opening the F3 debug screen just to check the current day, this mod displays the day directly on your screen in a clean format like:

**Day: 01**

This is useful for survival players, hardcore worlds, Minecraft 100 Days challenges, multiplayer SMPs, content creators, and anyone who wants an easy way to track world progress.

## Features

* Shows the current Minecraft day on your HUD
* Clean display format: **Day: 01**
* Works in singleplayer and multiplayer when installed on the client
* Perfect for Hardcore, Survival, SMP, and 100 Days challenges
* Press **K** to cycle the HUD position
* Supports multiple screen positions:

  * Top Left
  * Top Center
  * Top Right
  * Center Left
  * Center
  * Center Right
  * Bottom Left
  * Bottom Center
  * Bottom Right
* Optional HUD toggle key through Minecraft Controls
* Config file support for changing text, color, margin, shadow, background, and position
* Lightweight and simple, with no unnecessary extra features

## Config

After launching the game once, the config file will be created here:

`.minecraft/config/sg-day-counter.json`

You can edit options like:

* Enable or disable the HUD
* Change the position
* Change the prefix text
* Change minimum digits
* Change text color
* Enable or disable shadow
* Enable or disable background
* Adjust margins

## Controls

Default key:

**K** — Cycle HUD position

The toggle key is available in Minecraft keybind settings but is unbound by default. You can set it from:

**Options → Controls → Key Binds → SG Day Counter**

## Recommended For

* Minecraft Survival
* Hardcore Minecraft
* 100 Days Challenges
* SMP gameplay
* YouTube recordings
* Live streams
* Players who want a clean day counter without using F3

description: Sheep Efficiency is a Minecraft mod that prevents woolly sheep from eating grass, only sheared adults are allowed to graze, so your wool supply stays efficient without micromanaging.
body:
# Sheep Efficiency

**Sheep Efficiency** keeps your wool farm running smoothly by preventing sheep from eating grass when they don't need to.

In vanilla Minecraft, all sheep, including woolly ones, constantly graze and turn grass blocks to dirt. This mod changes that: only sheared sheep will eat grass to regrow their wool. Woolly adults and baby sheep leave the grass alone entirely.

This means your pastures stay green, your farm looks better, and you stop fighting a losing battle against mud patches. No configuration needed, install and forget.

## Features

- 🐑 Woolly sheep (unsheared adults) never eat grass
- 🍼 Baby sheep never eat grass
- ✂️ Sheared sheep graze normally to regrow wool
- ⚙️ Zero configuration, zero performance impact
- 🌐 Works in singleplayer and multiplayer

title: Battle Music Crescendo
description: Mod that adds background music when fighting hostile mobs and players and more
body:
# Battle Music Crescendo

**Minecraft 1.21.x** · **Client-side** adaptive combat music · Custom **music packs** · In-game **editor** · Optional server sync · **Mob Battle Music** pack format supported

**Author:** MickDev

---

## What this mod actually does (under the hood)

Battle Music Crescendo is not a single looping track. Every second it:

1. **Scans** your world around you (hostile mobs, bosses, PvP, health, biomes, structures).
2. **Scores** combat intensity and picks a **mood** (exploration → tension → combat → intense → boss → PvP → critical danger).
3. **Resolves priority** so real danger always beats ambient fluff.
4. **Selects** the best matching track from your enabled **music packs** (JSON rules + conditions).
5. **Crossfades** between tracks with configurable fade in/out.
6. **Silences** vanilla Minecraft music while your custom music plays (optional).
7. **Plays victory** stings when combat ends (optional).

All audio runs on **your client only**. Other players hear their own music (or vanilla). The server never needs your `.ogg` files.

---

## Features at a glance

| Feature | Details |
|--------|---------|
| **Track moods** | Exploration, tension, light combat, intense combat, boss, PvP, victory, critical danger, ambient, menu (title screen), scripted |
| **Music packs** | Folder packs in `battlemusiccrescendo_musicpacks/` — enable them like resource packs |
| **Pack editor** | Create, edit, preview, export `.zip`, import packs, **Load example pack** (full template) |
| **JSON tracks** | One `.json` per track + matching `.ogg` in `sounds/music/` |
| **Conditions** | Biomes, dimensions, structures, entity ids, entity tags, min enemy count, boss, PvP, low health, screen (`title` for main menu) |
| **Mob Battle Music** | Import packs using `assets/mobbattlemusic/music_tracks/` (`mob_specific`, `mob_list`, `mob_tag`, `player_specific`) |
| **Multiplayer** | **Client-only on any server** — no server mod required |
| **Server sync** | Optional: install on server too for slightly better combat detection |
| **Config screen** | Volume, detection, fades, debug overlay, menu music, mute vanilla |
| **Debug overlay** | Live state, track id, priority, enemy count, intensity |

---

## Compatibility

| Setup | Result |
|-------|--------|
| Single-player | Full features |
| Multiplayer — mod **only on your client** | Works — local mob detection |
| Multiplayer — mod on **client + server** | Works — optional combat sync packets |
| Hybrid servers (Mohist, etc.) | Client fallback detection; no server mod required |
| Mob Battle Music packs | Drop JSON + OGG into your BMC music pack (see tutorial below) |

**Minecraft version:** **1.21.x**

---

# Complete tutorial

Follow these steps in order the first time you use the mod. After that, you only tweak packs or add new `.ogg` files.

---

## Part 1 — Install and open settings

1. Install **Battle Music Crescendo** on your **Minecraft client** (1.21.x).
2. Launch the game and join a world (single-player is fine for testing).
3. Open **Options → Controls** and find the category **Battle Music Crescendo**:
   - **Open config** (default `B`) — main settings screen
   - **Toggle debug** (default `F8`) — on-screen combat/music debug
   - **Test music** (unbound) — plays a test track if packs are loaded
4. Open **Options → Music & Sound** (or the mod config via `B` / Mods list).
5. Click **Music packs...** (placed near skin/resource pack buttons).

You do **not** need the mod on a dedicated server to hear music.

---

## Part 2 — Load the example pack (recommended)

The mod ships a full **ExamplePack** template. Use the in-game editor so you never start from an empty folder.

1. From the main menu or in-game, open the music pack UI:
   - **Options → Music packs...**, then **Music Pack editor**,  
   **or** use the editor shortcut from the mod config screen.
2. In the editor (left column), click **Load example pack**.
3. You should see **12 tracks** in the list, for example:
   - `tension_near`, `combat_light`, `combat_intense`, `boss_dark`, `pvp_duel`, `victory_sting`, `critical_danger`, `ambient_forest`, `ambient_stronghold`, `menu_title`, `exploration_calm`, `scripted_example`
4. Click **Open pack folder** — Windows Explorer opens your pack directory.

Default folder (game directory):

```text
battlemusiccrescendo_musicpacks/ExamplePack/
```

5. Click **Reload packs** in the editor after any file change.

**Important:** Loading the example pack creates **JSON + sounds.json** only. You still add **your own music files** (next part).

---

## Part 3 — Add your music files (.ogg)

Each track JSON references an **`ogg_file`**. Put the matching file here:

```text
battlemusiccrescendo_musicpacks/ExamplePack/assets/battlemusiccrescendo/sounds/music/
```

| Track JSON | Put this file in `sounds/music/` |
|------------|----------------------------------|
| `tension_near.json` | `tension.ogg` |
| `combat_light.json` | `combat_light.ogg` |
| `combat_intense.json` | `combat_intense.ogg` |
| `boss_dark.json` | `boss_dark.ogg` |
| `pvp_duel.json` | `pvp.ogg` |
| `victory_sting.json` | `victory.ogg` |
| `critical_danger.json` | `defeat.ogg` |
| `ambient_forest.json` | `ambient_forest.ogg` |
| `ambient_stronghold.json` | `ambient_stronghold.ogg` |
| `menu_title.json` | `menu_title.ogg` |
| `exploration_calm.json` | `exploration.ogg` |
| `scripted_example.json` | `scripted_event.ogg` |

Tips:

- Use **`.ogg`** (Vorbis), stereo, streamed music quality.
- File names must match **`ogg_file`** in the JSON exactly.
- You can use the same `.ogg` for several tracks if you want (duplicate the file with different names).

After copying files:

1. Return to the game.
2. **Music packs...** → enable **ExamplePack** (move it to **Selected**).
3. In the editor, click **Reload packs**.
4. Press **Play** on a track to preview, or spawn mobs to test live.

---

## Part 4 — Enable the pack in-game

1. **Options → Music packs...**
2. Left list: **Available Music Packs** — select `ExamplePack` (or your pack name).
3. Click the arrow to move it to **Selected Music Packs**.
4. Close the screen — the game reloads pack resources automatically.
5. Optional: enable **Menu test music** in mod config to hear `menu_title.ogg` on the **main menu** (screen condition `title`).

If you hear nothing:

- Confirm `.ogg` files exist in `sounds/music/`.
- Confirm the pack is **selected**, not only present on disk.
- Click **Reload packs** in the editor.
- Enable **Debug overlay** (`F8`) and check **Playing: true** and **State:** when near mobs.

---

## Part 5 — Test combat music in a world

1. Enable **Debug overlay** (`F8` or config).
2. Set **Detection range** to at least `48` blocks in config (default).
3. In Creative or Survival, spawn or find **hostile mobs** within range.
4. Watch the overlay:
   - **State** should move: `exploration` → `tension` → `light_combat` / `intense_combat` when you fight.
   - **Playing** should be `true` when a track matches.
5. Kill mobs and leave combat — a short **victory** track may play (if enabled in common config).
6. Take damage below the critical health threshold — **defeat / danger** music can play.

**Boss music:** spawn a high-HP mob or use the `boss: true` condition in JSON (see Part 7).

**PvP:** fight another player with PvP music enabled in config.

---

## Part 6 — Music Pack Editor (create your own tracks)

Open **Music Pack editor** from the music packs screen or mod config.

| Button | What it does |
|--------|----------------|
| **Load example pack** | Installs/refreshes all 12 example JSON files + Mob Battle Music samples + README |
| **Open pack folder** | Opens `battlemusiccrescendo_musicpacks/ExamplePack/` in your file manager |
| **New track** | Creates a blank JSON you edit and save |
| **Save** | Writes the current track JSON to disk |
| **Play / Stop** | Preview the selected track |
| **Reload packs** | Reloads resources so new sounds are registered |
| **Export zip** | Exports the pack folder as a shareable `.zip` |
| **Import .zip pack(s)** | Extracts zip packs into `battlemusiccrescendo_musicpacks/` |

### Editor fields (right panel)

| Field | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| **Id** | Unique track id, e.g. `battlemusiccrescendo:my_boss` |
| **Ogg file** | File name in `sounds/music/`, e.g. `my_boss.ogg` |
| **Type** | `tension`, `combat`, `intense`, `boss`, `pvp`, `victory`, `defeat`, `ambient`, `menu`, `exploration`, `scripted` |
| **Priority** | Higher number wins when multiple tracks match (boss > combat > tension) |
| **Dimensions / Biomes / Structures** | Comma-separated ids — track only plays when matched |
| **Entity tags** | e.g. `minecraft:skeletons` |
| **Min enemies** | Minimum hostile count required |
| **Boss / PvP / Critical** | Toggle condition flags |

After **Save**, click **Reload packs**. The mod rebuilds `sounds.json` from your JSON files automatically.

---

## Part 7 — Track JSON reference (manual editing)

Folder:

```text
assets/battlemusiccrescendo/music_tracks/my_track.json
```

Minimal example:

```json
{
  "id": "battlemusiccrescendo:my_track",
  "ogg_file": "my_track.ogg",
  "type": "combat",
  "priority": 30,
  "fade_in_ticks": 60,
  "fade_out_ticks": 80,
  "loop": true,
  "conditions": {
    "min_enemy_count": 1
  }
}
```

### `type` values

| type | When it plays |
|------|----------------|
| `exploration` | Calm — no real threat |
| `tension` | Enemies nearby, not full combat |
| `combat` | Light combat |
| `intense` | Many enemies / heavy fight |
| `boss` | Boss detected or `boss: true` condition |
| `pvp` | Fighting players |
| `victory` | One-shot after combat ends |
| `defeat` | Critical low health |
| `ambient` | Biome/structure ambience override |
| `menu` | Main menu (`conditions.screen`: `"title"`) |
| `scripted` | Custom scripted/event use |

### `conditions` (all optional)

```json
"conditions": {
  "dimensions": ["minecraft:overworld", "minecraft:the_nether"],
  "biomes": ["minecraft:deep_dark"],
  "structures": ["minecraft:stronghold"],
  "entities": ["minecraft:wither"],
  "entity_tags": ["minecraft:skeletons"],
  "min_enemy_count": 4,
  "boss": true,
  "pvp": true,
  "critical_health": true,
  "screen": "title"
}
```

- **`ogg_file`** is the main reference — the sound id is derived from the file name (without `.ogg`).
- Do **not** rely on copyrighted placeholder names in packs you publish; use your own file names.

---

## Part 8 — Mob Battle Music compatible packs

You can reuse the track format from [Mob Battle Music](https://github.com/nonamecrackers2/mob-battle-music) inside your BMC pack.

Folder:

```text
assets/mobbattlemusic/music_tracks/
```

Example — zombie aggro track:

```json
{
  "type": "mob_specific",
  "sound": "mobbattlemusic:aggro_track",
  "priority": 30,
  "fade_time": 40,
  "group": "attacking",
  "selector": "any",
  "mob": "minecraft:zombie"
}
```

Place audio:

```text
assets/mobbattlemusic/sounds/aggro_track.ogg
assets/mobbattlemusic/sounds/non_aggro_track.ogg
assets/mobbattlemusic/sounds/player_track.ogg
```

Supported types: `mob_specific`, `mob_list`, `mob_tag`, `player_specific`, `player_specific_uuid`.

The example pack includes three sample JSON files. **Load example pack** in the editor copies them for you.

---

## Part 9 — Multiplayer and servers

| Your setup | What to do |
|------------|------------|
| Play on a **vanilla-like server** without the mod | Install BMC **only on your client** — music works via local detection |
| Play on a server **with the mod** | Optional better sync; same music packs on your client |
| Host your own server | Server mod is **optional** — not required for players to hear music |

Network sync is **optional**. If the server does not have the mod, the client never disconnects because of missing channels.

---

## Part 10 — Configuration files

| File | Location |
|------|----------|
| Common | `config/battlemusiccrescendo-common.toml` |
| Client | `config/battlemusiccrescendo-client.toml` |

### Common (shared logic)

| Option | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `enabled` | Master switch |
| `detectionRange` | Mob scan radius (blocks) |
| `bossDetectionRange` | Boss scan radius |
| `fadeInTicks` / `fadeOutTicks` / `crossfadeTicks` | Default transitions |
| `minMobsForBattle` / `minMobsForIntense` | Thresholds for combat moods |
| `pvpMusic` / `victoryMusic` | Enable PvP and victory stings |
| `allowServerSync` | Use server combat packets when available |
| `allowClientOnlyFallback` | Local detection when server has no mod |
| `blacklistDimensions` / `whitelistDimensions` | Limit where music runs |
| `entityBlacklist` / `entityWhitelist` | Filter which mobs count |

### Client

| Option | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `battleVolume` | Your battle music volume (0.0–1.0) |
| `showDebugOverlay` | On-screen debug |
| `muteVanillaDuringCombat` | Stop vanilla background music while mod music plays |
| `menuTestMusic` | Play menu track on title screen |

In-game: **Mods → Battle Music Crescendo → Config** or keybind **`B`**.

---

## Part 11 — Sharing a pack (.zip)

1. Build your pack under `battlemusiccrescendo_musicpacks/MyPack/`.
2. Include:
   - `pack.mcmeta`
   - `assets/battlemusiccrescendo/music_tracks/*.json`
   - `assets/battlemusiccrescendo/sounds/music/*.ogg`
   - Optional: `assets/mobbattlemusic/...`
3. In the editor, **Export zip**.
4. Others use **Import .zip pack(s)** and enable the pack in **Music packs...**.

---

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | Fix |
|---------|-----|
| No music at all | Enable pack in **Selected**; add `.ogg` files; **Reload packs** |
| Only one track in editor | Click **Load example pack** again (refreshes all 12 JSON files) |
| `Sound ... not loaded` in log | Missing `.ogg` or wrong file name vs `ogg_file` |
| Menu music silent | Add `menu_title.ogg`; enable **Menu test music**; pack selected |
| Vanilla music overlaps | Enable **mute vanilla during combat** in client config |
| Music on server requires mod | **False** — install on **client only** |
| Combat feels late | Increase `detectionRange`; install mod on server for sync |
| JSON error in log | Each track needs `ogg_file` (or `sound`) + `type` |

Enable **debug overlay** (`F8`) while testing — it shows the live combat state, selected track, and whether audio is playing.

---

##  inspiration

Combat music concept inspired by the goals of [Mob Battle Music] By:nonamecrackers2. Battle Music Crescendo adds its own priority system, pack editor, menu tracks, victory/critical layers, and optional server sync.

title: ChaosChunks
description: A NeoForge mod that gives you control over Minecraft world generation. Customize biome pools, blacklist or whitelist biomes, tweak region sizes, and use other chaos agents to create unpredictable worlds.
body: # ChaosChunks ## **NeoForge world generation control.** ### **Features**   * Custom biome selection system * Dimension-specific biome control * Chaos-style biome generation * Configurable through world creation UI * Biome tag and blacklist support  * Compatibility with dimension/biome mods   *** ### For usage please visit the wiki link *** **Version Numbering:** There being so many numbers may confuse some users so here is a brief explanation. chaoschunks-\[major\_version\].H#.F#-\[minecraft\_version\].jar \[major\_version\] is the major mod version. This version value will increase when there is a considerable change in the mod like a UI change or worldgen change (like smooth biome generation for example) H# is the hotfix version. Increase in this version number will tell you that there has been a fix to a bug or unexpected behaviour.   F# is the "Fun" version. Increase in this version number will tell you that only cosmetic changes are included in this version like banter or a painting being added.   T# is the test version. This number is completely independent and simply count up per minecraft version until either H or F increases.   \[minecraft\_version\] is the minecraft version that jar is made for.   To see which jar is newer simply follow the \[major\_version\] or if that one is the same add the numbers in H# and F# to get the total version number.   ***   **Known issues:** * Biomes without features are usually handled, but edge cases may still occur * Restricting biome lists to too little (like only having #minecraft:is\_nether) causes features to be missing or generation to stall, even keeping the game open when saving and closing. **For bug reports:** **https://github.com/dermitio/ChaosChunks** ***   ### **Future Plans**   * Hopefully nothing. * Smooth biomes * Updates to new minecraft versions * De-voidification of the void biome! * More sound effects and music * Better UI * True world generation customization (think of the old custom world type)   __Note:__ The mod is not exactly lightweight as it turns chunk generation into a benchmark for the CPU.

title: Zoomrgy
description: A fully customisable zoom mod that let you customise how your zoom look
body:
# Zoomrgy 🔍

A fully-featured, high-performance, and extremely configurable client-side zoom mod for Minecraft (Fabric).

Zoomrgy provides a smooth, premium zooming experience ("Smith Zoom") featuring highly-optimized easing curves, mouse sensitivity adjustment, scroll-wheel scaling, and built-in telemetry tools like a rangefinder and target highlighter.

---

## 🌟 Key Features

* **Ultra-Smooth Easing Transitions (Smith Zoom):** Eases your field of view dynamically rather than instantly snapping. Supports multiple easing functions (Quadratic, Cubic, Circular, Sine, Elastic, Bounce, Smoothstep, and more) optimized for zero frame-rate stutter.
* **Scroll-Wheel Leveling:** Hold down the zoom key and scroll your mouse wheel up or down to adjust your magnification level on the fly, with optional click audio feedback.
* **Dynamic Mouse Sensitivity Scaling:** Scales mouse look speed down proportionally with the current FOV, preventing your cursor from feeling wildly sensitive at high magnifications.
* **Dual Zoom Presets & Spyglass Integration:** Assign separate hotkeys for two distinct zoom presets (e.g., C for standard 4.5x zoom, V for high-power 14x zoom). Optionally intercepts and enhances vanilla Spyglass usage.
* **Intelligent Telemetry HUD:** Displays current zoom magnification factor, directional compass heading, block/entity rangefinder distance, and entity type markers under your crosshair.
* **Highlight Targeted Entity:** Automatically highlights the entity you are looking at under high magnification with a client-side glowing outline effect.
* **Cinematic Inertia:** Simulates high-inertia camera panning for butter-smooth cinematic tracking shots (fully customizable).
* **Fog Reduction:** Pushes fog distance back proportionally to the zoom multiplier to give you a clear line of sight over long distances.

---

## 🛠 Installation & Dependencies

To run Zoomrgy, place the compiled `.jar` file in your Minecraft `mods` folder. Make sure you have installed the following:

1. **[Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/)** (version `>=0.19.2` or newer)
2. **[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)** (version `>=0.150.0`)
3. **[Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)** (Required for the configuration UI screen)
4. **[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)** (Highly recommended; provides access to the config screen GUI)

---

## 🎮 Controls & Keybindings

Zoomrgy registers a custom controls category. You can rebind these keys in Minecraft's default **Controls > Key Binds** menu:

| Key Bind Description | Default Key | Behavior |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Zoom** | `C` | Activates primary zoom level (holds state by default, supports toggling / double-tap lock). |
| **Zoom Preset 2** | `V` | Activates secondary high-magnification preset zoom. |
| **Zoom In** | *Unbound* | Increases scroll-wheel zoom step manually. |
| **Zoom Out** | *Unbound* | Decreases scroll-wheel zoom step manually. |
| **Toggle Zoom Lock** | *Unbound* | Manually locks/unlocks the current active zoom state. |

* **Scroll Wheel Mechanics:** While zooming, use `Scroll Up` to zoom in further, and `Scroll Down` to zoom out.
* **Double Tap to Lock:** Double tap the Zoom key within `300ms` to lock your zoom state. Tap again or press any zoom binding to release the lock.

---

## ⚙ Configuration Settings

Configure Zoomrgy directly in-game by clicking the gear icon on the mod list using **Mod Menu**. The JSON configuration is saved to `config/zoomrgy.json`.

Below is a detailed breakdown of all available settings:

### 🎮 Controls & Behavior

| In-Game Setting Name | JSON Field Key | Default Value | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Base Zoom Level** | `zoomMultiplier` | `4.5` | The multiplier applied to your base FOV when using primary Zoom (C). |
| **Preset 2 Zoom Level** | `zoomMultiplierPreset2` | `14.0` | The multiplier applied when using Zoom Preset 2 (V). |
| **Max Scroll Level** | `maxScrollLevel` | `10` | The maximum step limit for scroll-wheel zoom scaling. |
| **Reset Scroll on Release**| `resetScrollOnRelease` | `true` | Snaps your scroll multiplier back to `1.0x` when you release the zoom key. |
| **Zoom Toggle Mode** | `zoomToggleMode` | `false` | Pressing the zoom key toggles the state permanently until pressed again (no hold required). |
| **Double Tap to Lock** | `doubleTapToLock` | `true` | Allows double-tapping the hold-zoom key to lock the camera zoom. |
| **Auto Zoom-Out on Damage**| `zoomOutOnDamage` | `true` | Automatically drops zoom mode if you take damage to prevent combat disorientation. |
| **Scroll Audio Feedback** | `scrollAudioFeedback` | `true` | Plays a subtle mechanical click sound when changing zoom levels. |
| **Spyglass Auto-Zoom** | `spyglassAutoZoom` | `true` | Integrates mod easing transitions automatically when looking through a vanilla spyglass. |
| **Spyglass Zoom Level** | `spyglassZoomMultiplier`| `10.0` | The zoom multiplier applied to vanilla spyglass usage. |
| **Show Vanilla Spyglass Overlay**| `showVanillaSpyglassOverlay`| `false` | Retains or hides the default black square spyglass vignette border. |

### 📈 Easing & Transitions

| In-Game Setting Name | JSON Field Key | Default Value | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Zoom Speed** | `zoomSpeed` | `0.1` (`10%`) | The rate of transition (interpolation factor). `0.05` is cinematic; `1.0` is instant. |
| **Transition Type** | `transitionType` | `SMOOTHSTEP` | The mathematical easing function used to interpolate FOV transitions. |
| **Dynamic Movement Damping**| `movementFovDamping` | `0.8` (`80%`) | Dampens sudden FOV offsets caused by in-game motion (sprinting, flight) to stabilize view. |

### 🖱 Mouse & Sensitivity

| In-Game Setting Name | JSON Field Key | Default Value | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Cinematic Zoom Smoothness**| `cinematicSmoothness`| `0.0` (`OFF`) | Smooths out mouse look inputs (camera inertia). Increase up to `0.95` (`95%`) for cinematic pans. |
| **Reduce Sensitivity** | `reduceSensitivity` | `true` | Proportionally lowers mouse sensitivity as zoom levels increase to maintain pixel-perfect aiming. |
| **Affect Hand FOV** | `affectHandFov` | `true` | Scales first-person hand rendering FOV down during zoom animations. |

### 🎨 Visuals & Overlay

| In-Game Setting Name | JSON Field Key | Default Value | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Show Zoom HUD Overlay** | `showZoomHud` | `true` | Renders a clean glassmorphism-styled info bar at the bottom center of your screen. |
| **Zoom HUD Background** | `zoomHudBackground` | `true` | Shows a semi-transparent dark plate with a subtle border outline behind the HUD. |
| **Show Telemetry HUD** | `showTelemetryHud` | `true` | Shows target name (block/entity) and live distance reading under the crosshair. |
| **Highlight Targeted Entity**| `highlightTargetEntity`| `true` | Highlights the entity under your crosshair with a glowing client outline. |
| **Zoom Vignette Opacity** | `zoomVignetteOpacity` | `0.4` (`40%`) | Adds a cinematic dark vignette shadow around screen edges. Set to `0%` to disable. |
| **Reduce Fog during Zoom** | `reduceFog` | `true` | Dynamically pushes environmental fog back during active zoom to maximize sight lines. |
| **Hide Crosshair during Zoom**| `hideCrosshair` | `false` | Hides the crosshair cursor during active zoom. |
| **Spyglass Scope Simulation**| `spyglassScopeOverlay`| `false` | Renders a circular spyglass overlay mask on the screen during zoom. |

---

## 📈 Easing Curve Types

Choose from a variety of transition styles under the **Easing & Transitions** settings:

* **`INSTANT`**: Bypasses transitions entirely (instant snap).
* **`LINEAR`**: Constant, steady animation speed.
* **`SINE` / `QUAD` / `CUBIC`**: Eased transitions (In, Out, or In-Out) for a soft start/end.
* **`SMOOTHSTEP`**: A classic graphics interpolation curve that starts slow, speeds up, and ends slow.
* **`CIRCULAR`**: Eases aggressively using a circular root-based curve.
* **`BACK`**: Slightly overshoots target zoom before pulling back, giving a spring-like feel.
* **`ELASTIC`**: A wavy, physical spring-like oscillation transition.
* **`BOUNCE`**: Bounces slightly upon reaching the target zoom.

---

## 👨‍💻 For Developers (Building from Source)

Zoomrgy is built using Gradle. If you wish to build or compile the mod yourself:

1. Clone or download the repository.
2. Open a terminal in the root directory.
3. Run the Gradle build script:
   ```powershell
   # Windows PowerShell
   .\gradlew.bat build
   
   # Linux / macOS
   ./gradlew build
   ```
4. The compiled `.jar` artifact will be located in:
   ```
   build/libs/zoomrgy-[version].jar
   ```

---

## 📄 License

This mod is available under the **MIT License**. Feel free to fork, modify, or include it in custom modpacks.

title: VexFPS
description: A lightweight client-side FPS counter with customizable position. Toggle display with U, open position GUI with J
body:
# VexFPS

VexFPS is a lightweight and minimalist FPS counter for Minecraft Fabric. It displays your current frames per second directly on the screen with a clean design and virtually no performance impact.

Designed for players who want a simple FPS display without opening the F3 debug screen.

---

## Features

* Lightweight client-side FPS counter
* Clean and minimal HUD
* No backgrounds or unnecessary UI elements
* Fully customizable position
* Multiple color presets
* Automatic settings saving
* Smart auto-hide with the F3 screen
* Optimized for maximum performance

---

## Display

The FPS counter is displayed in a simple format:

```text
[144 FPS]
```

The text includes a shadow for improved readability while keeping the interface clean and unobtrusive.

---

## Customization

Customize the HUD to match your preferences.

Available options:

* Enable or disable the FPS counter
* Move the counter anywhere on the screen
* Choose from multiple anchor positions
* Adjust X and Y offsets
* Select one of 8 text colors

Available colors:

* White
* Red
* Green
* Blue
* Yellow
* Cyan
* Pink
* Orange

All settings are saved automatically.

---

## Default Hotkeys

**U** — Toggle the FPS counter

**J** — Open the settings menu

Both keybindings can be changed in Minecraft's Controls menu.

---

## Smart Features

* Automatically hides while the F3 debug screen is open
* Works on every world and server
* Runs entirely on the client
* Safe for multiplayer servers

---

## Performance

VexFPS is designed to be as lightweight as possible.

Performance optimizations include:

* FPS updates every 250 ms
* Minimal CPU usage
* Minimal memory usage
* Virtually zero performance impact

---

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader.
2. Install Fabric API.
3. Place the **VexFPS** `.jar` file into the **mods** folder.
4. Launch Minecraft.

The FPS counter appears in the bottom-left corner by default.

---

## Compatibility

* Minecraft **1.21.11**
* Fabric Loader
* Client-side
* Singleplayer
* Multiplayer

---

## Requirements

* Fabric API

title: Better Map Zoom
description: Makes vanilla map exploration easier by retaining explored areas and banners when zooming out of a map.
body:
# Better Map Zoom

## Overview
For now, all this mod does is improve the vanilla map experience when zooming out, or scaling, a map. It does its best to persist the area you have already explored, which will scale down and remain in one of the quadrants of the newly zoomed out map. This saves a lot of exploration effort, especially in larger maps!

### Known issues:
Because I'm downscaling existing pixel data and not doing a block by block recalculation, you may notice very slight pixel updates when rexploring the zoomed out areas that you've already been to.

title: AeroPastel
description: Modpack built around Create Aeronautics, Pastel, and No Man's Land
body:
A feature-rich engineering and exploration pack combining advanced airship mechanics with Pastel's deep magical progression and No Man's Land's breathtaking world overhaul. With over 200 mods, AeroPastel offers a rich, content-packed experience where you can build complex flying contraptions, automate large-scale production lines, explore stunning new landscapes, and uncover countless structures scattered across a completely reimagined world.

<details>
<summary>🛑 WARNING: ALPHA VERSION</summary>

* **Status:** Active testing and development are in progress.
* **Readiness:** The modpack is not yet finished; things may change, be removed, or be added in the future.
* **Issues:** Unstable performance, FPS drops, or sudden crashes may occur.
* **Feedback:** Found a bug or have an idea? Please report them in GitHub Issues.
* **Important:** Not recommended for serious survival worlds. Make sure to back up your saves!

</details>

## No Man's Land – World Generation
The world of AeroPastel is brought to life by No Man's Land, a vanilla-friendly overhaul that transforms the Overworld with great attention to detail. Every biome has been redone – most enhanced, some completely reworked. Discover new biomes like the Maple Forest or the Bog, and find new vegetation for every climate, from Reeds in rivers to Flowerbeds in fields. The world feels more alive with enhanced ambient effects like thicker, environment-dependent fog. From the tallest peaks to the deepest oceanic trenches, through ancient ruins and dense forests, the world's beauty permeates every block. Perfect for those who get immersed in their world to the point of getting lost in it, so infatuated by mystery and discovery.

## Structures & Exploration
A massive collection of structure mods ensures every journey is rewarding:
- YUNG's series – Better Dungeons, Mineshafts, Ocean Monuments, Nether Fortresses, Desert Temples, Jungle Temples, Witch Huts, and End Islands, plus Bridges and Extras
  
- Structory & Towers – atmospheric structures scattered across the world
  
- Moog's structures – Nether, End, and Overworld additions including Soaring and Voyager structures
  
- Integrated Stronghold, Villages, and Dungeons – seamless generation integration
  
- Explorify – adds more points of interest
  
- Towns and Towers – improved villages and watchtowers
  
- Hellish Trials – Nether challenges
  
- Illager Invasion – pillager raids and outposts expanded
  
- Bountiful – reward system for exploration

## Core Features
**Create Aeronautics** – the heart of the pack. Build fully functional airships, planes, and custom moving vehicles with realistic physics. Design modular vessels with working engines, propellers, balloons, and control systems. Take to the skies and explore No Man's Land's stunning world from a completely new perspective.

**Pastel** – a full-feature magic mod centered around the exploration of color as resonance, as natural energy. Embark on a long, expansive journey through the path of the artist. Discover more about the land as you explore – the world grows alongside you, revealing things that were not there before. Pursue the meaning of the rainbow and nature itself. Create new and powerful tools as your newfound comprehension allows you to make yet finer works. Assemble striking machines and contraptions to support your march towards the heart of magic. And once you begin to believe you understand the lands and their essence, descend past the earth's false floor. Descend past the barrier at the foot of the world – the bedrock – and in the final chapter discover a world forgotten, a world left behind. Descend past the veil, and find in the deepest abyss the truth desired. The color itself. Descend, artist, descend...

## Create & Technology
Create Aeronautics is just the beginning. The pack is loaded with Create addons for every playstyle:
- Core – Create, Crafts & Additions, Deco, Encased, Connected, Copycats+, Framed, Interiors
  
- Transport – Big Cannons, Diesel Generators, Propulsion: Simulated, Tracks+, Radars
  
- Production – Ore Excavation, Slice & Dice, Stuff & Additions, Gears n' Kinetics, Power Grid, Power Loader
  
- Magic & Tech – Enchantment Industry, Nuclear, Dragons Plus, CC: Tweaked with Advanced Peripherals, Create: CC Better Recipes
  
- Integration – Compatibility with Rechiseled, Sable, Bits 'n' Bobs, Bells & Whistles

## Pastel Integration & Magic
- Pastel – deep color-based magic progression with a full endgame
  
- Artifacts – powerful equipable items to discover
  
- CC: Tweaked (ComputerCraft) – programmable computers with Advanced Peripherals and Sable integration
  
- Sophisticated Backpacks – upgradable backpacks with massive storage

## Mobs & Creatures
- Alex's Mobs – over 90 new animals and creatures, from alligators and bears to elephants, gorillas, and mythical beasts, each with unique behaviors and interactions
  
- Enderman Overhaul – varied Enderman variants across dimensions
  
- Creeper Overhaul – biome-specific creepers with unique abilities
  
- Guard Villagers – armed villagers who protect their homes
  
- Productive Bees – expanded beekeeping with custom bees and honey products

## Building & Decoration
- Quark – dozens of building blocks and quality-of-life tweaks
  
- Supplementaries – decorative blocks and functional items
  
- Handcrafted – furniture and interior decoration
  
- Design n' Decor – additional building options
  
- Rechiseled – decorative block variants with Create compatibility
  
- Let's Do series – Vinery, Meadow, Beachparty, BloomingNature, HerbalBrews
  
- Upgrade Aquatic – ocean-themed blocks and items
  
- Snow! Real Magic! – dynamic snow accumulation

## Food & Farming
- Farmer's Delight and addons: Slice & Dice, Central Kitchen, Crabber's Delight, Ender's Delight, Miner's Delight, Ocean's Delight, Cultural Delights, Expanded Delight, My Nether's Delight, More Delight

## Quality of Life
- EMI – recipe viewing with EMI Loot, EMI Ores, and EMI integration
  
- Xaero's Minimap & World Map – full mapping system
  
- Jade – tooltip and entity information with addons
  
- Carry On – pick up and move tile entities
  
- Corpse – death inventory management with Curios support
  
- AppleSkin – food and hunger information
  
- Mouse Tweaks – improved inventory management
  
- Traveler's Titles – biome and dimension name display
  
- Better Advancements – improved advancement UI
  
- Polymorph – recipe conflict resolution
  
- Comforts – sleeping bags and hammocks
  
- Gliders – glide through the air
  
- Ok Zoomer – zoom functionality
  
- Presence Footsteps – immersive footstep sounds
  
- Sound Physics Remastered – realistic sound propagation

## Visual & Performance
- Sodium – rendering performance with extras: Dynamic Lights, Leaf Culling, Extra, Reese's Options
  
- Iris – shader support with Flywheel compatibility
  
- Entity Model Features / Entity Texture Features – custom entity visuals
  
- NotEnoughAnimations – smoother player animations
  
- Particle Core & Particle Rain – enhanced particle effects
  
- Alternate Current – optimized redstone
  
- Ferrite Core, ModernFix, Lithium, Krypton – performance optimizations
  
- BadOptimizations, Dynamic FPS, EntityCulling, ImmediatelyFast, Noisium – FPS and server performance
  
- ServerCore – server-side optimization
  
- Clumps – XP orb optimization


### Perfect for players who enjoy:
- Engineering complex mechanical systems with Create and its many addons
  
- Building custom airships and exploring from above with Create Aeronautics
  
- Deep magical progression with Pastel's color-based system
  
- Rich world generation and exploration across No Man's Land's overhauled biomes and countless structures
  
- Creative building with thousands of decorative blocks
  
- A vibrant, living world filled with diverse creatures and mobs
  
- Full tech/magic hybrid progression with ComputerCraft and automation
  
- Smooth performance with extensive optimization mods

title: Seed Delight Renewed
description: A maintained fork of the Seed Delight mod. It has bug fixes and updates!
body:
# Seed Delight Renewed **A maintained Fabric port of Seed Delight - forest foraging fully integrated with Farmer's Delight.** Seed Delight Renewed is a fork of the original [Seed Delight](https://github.com/HiedaCamellia/SeedDelight) by HiedaCamellia, ported to Fabric 1.20.1 and rebuilt to work natively with [Farmer's Delight Refabricated](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated). All content has been reviewed, rebalanced, and extended with new dishes, proper food tiers, and full FD tag compatibility. --- ## What does it add? Seed Delight expands Farmer's Delight with ingredients and dishes sourced from forest biomes. Every ingredient has a processing chain that ends in cooking-pot meals, baked goods, or drinks.
Click to expand: full ingredient & dish list ### Acorn > Acorn → Acorn Kernel → Acorn Tofu → Raw Acorn Noodle → Pasta dishes - **Acorn Kernel** - cut acorns on a cutting board - **Acorn Tofu** - cooked from acorn kernels - **Stir Fried Cabbage with Acorn** - vegetable bowl, Nourishment 1:00 - **Acorn Bread** - baked good - **Raw Acorn Noodle** - cut from acorn tofu; edible but may cause Hunger (30% chance), just like FD's raw pasta - **Acorn Pasta with Meatballs** - hearty bowl, Nourishment 3:00 - **Acorn Pasta with Mutton Chop** - hearty bowl, Nourishment 3:00 ### Pine Nut > Pinecone → Pine Nut Kernel → Dishes - **Pine Nut Kernel** - cut pinecones on a cutting board - **Pinenut Gruel** - cooked meal - **Pinenut with Meatballs** - hearty bowl, Nourishment 3:00 - **Pinenut Cake** - baked good - **Pine Needle Wine** - drink, grants Resistance 1:30 ### Sunflower Seed > Sunflower Seed → Fried / Dried variants → Dishes - **Fried Sunflower Seed** - light snack - **Dried Watermelon Seed** / **Dried Pumpkin Seed** - light snacks - **Sunflower Seed Crisp** - baked snack - **Sunflower Seed Toast** - baked good ### Rosehip > Rosehip → Jam Jar → Dishes & Drinks - **Rosehip Jam Jar** - crafting ingredient - **Rosehip Jam Sandwich** - quick snack - **Rosehip Tea** - drink, grants Regeneration 0:10 - **Seed Rosehip Pie** - baked good - **Rosehip Cake** - baked good - **Rosehip Pie** - placeable feast block - **Rose Cookie** - baked treat ### Cherry > Cherry → Jam Jar / Wine → Dishes - **Cherry** - raw fruit; foxes love it - **Cherry Jam Jar** - crafting ingredient - **Cherry Jam Sandwich** - quick snack - **Cherry Pork** - meat bowl, Nourishment 3:00 - **Cherry Ice Cream** - dessert, grants Haste 1:00 + Slowness 0:30 - **Cherry Wine** - drink, grants Haste 1:30 - **Milk Cherry Mousse** - light dessert, grants Regeneration 0:30
--- ## Changes from the original mod This is not just a port - several things were fixed and improved: - **Two new acorn pasta dishes** added (Acorn Pasta with Meatballs, Acorn Pasta with Mutton Chop) - **All hearty bowl meals now grant Nourishment**, scaled by dish weight - matching FD's own food tier logic - **Tooltips use FD's native ConsumableItem system** - no duplicate or incorrectly formatted effect lines - **Full tag compatibility**: meals tagged under `farmersdelight:meals`, drinks under `farmersdelight:drinks`, cherry and rosehip under `c:foods/berries`, breads under `c:foods/breads` - **Raw Acorn Noodle** now matches FD's raw pasta behaviour (edible but risky) - **All four storage blocks** (Acorn Bag, Pinecone Bag, Cherry Crate, Rosehip Crate) correctly axe-mineable --- ## Supported Versions | Minecraft | Status | |-----------|--------| | 1.20.1 | ✅ Active | --- ## Dependencies | Mod | Required | |-----|----------| | [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) | ✅ Required | | [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) | ✅ Required | | [Farmer's Delight Refabricated](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated) | ✅ Required | --- ## Credits - **HiedaCamellia / PartheliaSieboldii** - original Seed Delight mod - **EmpireWarrior** - Fabric port and Seed Delight Renewed maintainer

title: AntiBoats
description:
AntiBoats is a lightweight logging plugin that tracks Chest Boats and Storage Minecarts,
recording placements, locations, contents, destruction, and pickup/audit events—useful as a focused companion to CoreProtect style logging
body:
# EN

A server plugin that logs **Chest Boats** and **Chest Minecarts**.  
It can save what was inside, who placed it, who broke it, and who picked up the drops.

### ✨ Features
- **Tracks vehicles**: world + XYZ, last seen time, and status (**DESTROYED** / active).
- **Who placed it**: tries to remember who placed the boat/minecart.
- **Saves contents**: makes inventory snapshots of the chest inside.
- **Audit**: logs who took/put items and who picked up dropped items after destroy.
- **Languages**: `plugins/AntiBoats/lang/en.yml` and `ru.yml`.

### 🧰 Commands
- `/antiboats list [all]` — list records (`all` includes destroyed).
- `/antiboats near <radius>` — show records near you.
- `/antiboats show <id>` — show info + inventory + audit.
- `/antiboats user <name>` — show IDs placed by this player (active + destroyed).
- `/antiboats tp <id>` — teleport to the saved location of this record.
- `/antiboats remove <id>` — delete this record from the logs (and optionally remove the entity if enabled in config).
- `/antiboats reload` — reload config + language files.
- `/antiboats save` — force-save data.yml right now.

### ⚠ Notes
- “Who placed it” is best-effort (depends on timing and distance).
- Drop pickup logging works for players and hoppers. Items are linked to the destroyed vehicle only for a short time window.

---

# RU

Серверный плагин, который логирует **лодки с сундуком** и **вагонетки с сундуком**.  
Он может сохранять что было внутри, кто поставил, кто сломал и кто подобрал дроп.

### ✨ Возможности
- **Отслеживание**: мир + координаты, последнее появление, статус (**DESTROYED** / активна).
- **Кто поставил**: пытается запомнить кто поставил лодку/вагонетку.
- **Сохранение содержимого**: делает снапшоты инвентаря сундука.
- **Аудит**: логирует кто клал/забирал предметы и кто подобрал выпавшие предметы после разрушения.
- **Языки**: `plugins/AntiBoats/lang/en.yml` и `ru.yml`.

### 🧰 Команды
- `/antiboats list [all]` — список записей (`all` показывает сломанные).
- `/antiboats near <радиус>` — показать записи рядом.
- `/antiboats show <id>` — информация + инвентарь + аудит.
- `/antiboats user <ник>` — ID записей, которые поставил игрок (активные + сломанные).
- `/antiboats tp <id>` — телепорт к сохранённым координатам этой записи.
- `/antiboats remove <id>` — удалить запись из логов (и опционально удалить сущность, если включено в config).
- `/antiboats reload` — перезагрузить конфиг + языки.
- `/antiboats save` — принудительно сохранить data.yml прямо сейчас.

### ⚠ Примечания
- “Кто поставил” определяется примерно (зависит от времени и расстояния).
- Подбор дропа логируется для игроков и хопперов. Предметы привязываются к разрушенной сущности только в небольшом временном окне.

title: Relics Of The Guide
description: The Relics Of The Guide adds items from terraria to help you on your journey.
body:
# Relics of the Guide

> *"The Guide would like to remind you that some things are worth carrying."*

Relics of the Guide brings loved and useful items from Terraria to Minecraft! 

---

## Items

### Recall Potion
Teleports you to your spawn point. If your bed or respawn anchor has been destroyed, you'll be sent to the world spawn instead.

- Found in village chests and other structures

### Magic Mirror
A non-consumable variation of the Recall Potion

- Found in Chests and structures underground

### Hermes Boots
Significantly increases your movement speed while equipped in an accessory slot. Like a permenant Speed II potion.

- Found in Chests and structures underground


### Soul of Flight
A rare crafting material dropped by flying creatures. Used to craft wings.

- Dropped rarely by common flying mobs like bees and bats
- Dropped uncommonly by vexxes, allays, phantoms
- Multiple drop from the Ender Dragon and the Wither

### Wings
Grants the ability to fly. Hold jump while airborne to ascend, release to fall naturally. When flight time runs out, glide slowly to safety. And removes all fall damage.

- Angel Wings crafted with Breeze Rods
- Demon Wings crafted with Blaze Rods

---

## Purpose

Relics of the Guide simply make minecraft just a bit better. currently improving the exploration side of minecraft by giving you valuable items for going in daring places.

And if you ever get lost, you can just teleport back home!

Plus the wings allow for you to traverse vertically with no problems.

---

## Dependencies

[Curios API](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios) - version 9.5.1 or later
Minecraft NeoForge 1.21.1

---

## Planned Content

- More mobility accessories such as Shiny Red Balloon and Lucky Horseshoe
- Full Terraspark Boots crafting tree
- Additional wing tiers
- Combat accessories

---

## Credits

Inspired by Terraria by Re-Logic. This is an unofficial fan mod and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Re-Logic.
